title.zh: 修正 HKTVmall 供應狀況檢索規則

brief.en: You are assisting the fictional HKTVmall shopping assistant team. The assistant wrongly marked some products available because retrieval defaults and filters conflicted with Policy v3.2. Review the supplied policy, defective config and synthetic records. Propose corrected retrieval settings and boundary regression tests. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, targeting about 100 to 180 words. Cite source documents, product IDs and the governing rule IDs such as R-UNKNOWN. State any uncertainty. This is an independent learning simulation, not an official HKTVmall process.
brief.zh: 你正協助虛構的 HKTVmall 購物助理團隊。助理因檢索預設值及篩選條件與政策 v3.2 衝突，錯誤地把部分產品標示為可供應。請審閱提供的政策、有缺陷設定及合成記錄。提出修正後的檢索設定及邊界回歸測試。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，目標約 100 至 180 字。引用文件、產品 ID 及適用規則 ID（例如 R-UNKNOWN）。說明任何不確定性。此為獨立學習模擬，並非 HKTVmall 官方流程。

title.zh: 虛構產品供應狀況政策 v3.2

body.en: This fictional policy governs the HKTVmall shopping assistant simulation. Rules are identified explicitly. R-INV requires inventory_status to be in_stock or low_stock, and low_stock is inclusive. R-UNKNOWN states that unknown or missing inventory_status returns unavailable, never available. R-WINDOW requires sale_window.state to be open, and a scheduled window is not open. R-REGION requires warehouse.allowed_regions to contain user_region. R-RECALL requires recall_flag to be no. R-AGE requires age_restricted to be no, or user_age_verified to be yes. R-DEFAULT states that no default availability may be applied and that any failed rule returns unavailable. Every availability response must cite the product_id and the governing rule_id. Past stock history must not be used. Staff, records and this policy are invented for learning.
body.zh: 此虛構政策規管 HKTVmall 購物助理模擬。各項規則均明確編號。R-INV 要求 inventory_status 為 in_stock 或 low_stock，而 low_stock 屬包括在內。R-UNKNOWN 規定 unknown 或缺少 inventory_status 時回覆不可供應，絕不可回覆可供應。R-WINDOW 要求 sale_window.state 為 open，預定時間窗並非 open。R-REGION 要求 warehouse.allowed_regions 包含 user_region。R-RECALL 要求 recall_flag 為 no。R-AGE 要求 age_restricted 為 no，或 user_age_verified 為 yes。R-DEFAULT 規定不得套用任何預設供應狀況，任何規則失敗即回覆不可供應。每次供應狀況回覆須引用 product_id 及適用 rule_id。不得使用過去庫存紀錄。職員、記錄及此政策均為學習而虛構。

body.en:
The following fictional retrieval config produced wrong availability answers. Contract: default_available must be false, require_inventory_status true, region_filter true, sale_window_filter true, recall_filter true, age_filter true, unknown_inventory_available false, to satisfy R-DEFAULT, R-INV, R-REGION, R-WINDOW, R-RECALL, R-AGE and R-UNKNOWN. The assistant must return unavailable when any filter fails and must not use default_available to fill gaps. Current defective config:
```yaml
retrieval:
  default_available: true
  require_inventory_status: false
  availability_fields:
    - inventory_status
  region_filter: false
  sale_window_filter: false
  recall_filter: false
  age_filter: false
  unknown_inventory_available: true
```
body.zh:
以下虛構檢索設定產生錯誤的供應狀況答案。合約：default_available 必須為 false，require_inventory_status 為 true，region_filter 為 true，sale_window_filter 為 true，recall_filter 為 true，age_filter 為 true，unknown_inventory_available 為 false，以符合 R-DEFAULT、R-INV、R-REGION、R-WINDOW、R-RECALL、R-AGE 及 R-UNKNOWN。任何篩選失敗時，助理必須回覆不可供應，且不得以 default_available 填補缺口。現時有缺陷設定如下。
```yaml
retrieval:
  default_available: true
  require_inventory_status: false
  availability_fields:
    - inventory_status
  region_filter: false
  sale_window_filter: false
  recall_filter: false
  age_filter: false
  unknown_inventory_available: true
```

exemplar.en:
Decision: replace the defective retrieval config with:
```yaml
retrieval:
  default_available: false
  require_inventory_status: true
  region_filter: true
  sale_window_filter: true
  recall_filter: true
  age_filter: true
  unknown_inventory_available: false
```
Evidence: Policy v3.2 defines R-INV, R-UNKNOWN, R-WINDOW, R-REGION, R-RECALL, R-AGE and R-DEFAULT. The old config set default_available true, unknown_inventory_available true and every filter false, so p-103 breached R-WINDOW, p-105 breached R-UNKNOWN and p-107 breached R-RECALL. For region HK and user_age_verified no, only p-101 and p-102 pass every rule, so the count is 2. Boundary tests: p-101 and p-102 available, p-103 scheduled unavailable, p-104 out_of_stock unavailable, p-105 unknown unavailable under R-UNKNOWN, p-106 region mismatch under R-REGION, p-107 recall yes under R-RECALL, p-108 age restricted unverified under R-AGE. Risk: live inventory and age verification feeds are not supplied, so revalidate before production. Escalate to Ada Cheung. This is a simulation, not an official HKTVmall process.
exemplar.zh:
決策：把有缺陷的檢索設定替換為：
```yaml
retrieval:
  default_available: false
  require_inventory_status: true
  region_filter: true
  sale_window_filter: true
  recall_filter: true
  age_filter: true
  unknown_inventory_available: false
```
證據：政策 v3.2 定義 R-INV、R-UNKNOWN、R-WINDOW、R-REGION、R-RECALL、R-AGE 及 R-DEFAULT。舊設定把 default_available 設為 true、unknown_inventory_available 設為 true，且所有篩選為 false，因此 p-103 違反 R-WINDOW、p-105 違反 R-UNKNOWN、p-107 違反 R-RECALL。就 region HK 及 user_age_verified no 而言，只有 p-101 及 p-102 符合所有規則，數目為 2。邊界測試：p-101 及 p-102 可供應，p-103 預定時間窗不可供應，p-104 缺貨不可供應，p-105 unknown 按 R-UNKNOWN 不可供應，p-106 地區不符按 R-REGION 不可供應，p-107 recall yes 按 R-RECALL 不可供應，p-108 年齡限制未驗證按 R-AGE 不可供應。風險：未提供即時庫存及年齡驗證來源，投產前須重新核實。轉交 Ada Cheung。此為模擬，並非 HKTVmall 官方流程。

feedback.en: All decisions are correct: predicate-a, the corrected YAML with default_available false and unknown_inventory_available false plus all filters true, p-101 and p-102 as the only available items, count 2, and unavailable under R-UNKNOWN. The five boundary tests you selected match the policy and you correctly excluded the past-stock option that would breach R-DEFAULT.
feedback.zh: 所有決策均正確：predicate-a、修正後 YAML（default_available 為 false、unknown_inventory_available 為 false 且所有篩選為 true）、只有 p-101 及 p-102 可供應、數目為 2，以及按 R-UNKNOWN 回覆不可供應。你選取的五項邊界測試均符合政策，並正確排除會違反 R-DEFAULT 的過去庫存選項。

feedback.en: You tie the defects to named rule IDs, showing p-103 breaches R-WINDOW, p-105 breaches R-UNKNOWN and p-107 breaches R-RECALL, and you explain why p-101 and p-102 pass every rule. Adding the rule ID for p-104 (R-INV) would make the per-product trace even tighter, though the reasoning is already sound.
feedback.zh: 你把缺陷連結至具名規則編號，指出 p-103 違反 R-WINDOW、p-105 違反 R-UNKNOWN、p-107 違反 R-RECALL，並解釋 p-101 及 p-102 為何符合所有規則。若為 p-104 補上規則編號（R-INV），逐項產品的追溯會更嚴密，但現時推理已屬穩妥。

feedback.en: Your test list covers the key boundaries for p-101 through p-108 and would catch the original defect. One small gap is an explicit config-level regression assertion that default_available and unknown_inventory_available must stay false, so add that check before release.

title.en: Repair the membership benefit retrieval rules
title.zh: 修正會員優惠檢索規則

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by HKTVmall. Not endorsed by the company. All policies, staff and records are fictional. You are the AI engineer on the membership benefit assistant. A retrieval configuration wrongly applies member benefits at checkout. Read the two fictional sources, answer the questions, then write a short handover in English or Traditional Chinese proposing corrected retrieval settings and boundary regression tests. Target around 100 to 180 words.
brief.zh: 此為受 HKTVmall 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由該公司認可。所有政策、職員及記錄均為虛構。你是會員優惠助理的 AI 工程師。一條檢索設定錯誤地在結賬時套用會員優惠。請閱讀兩份虛構文件、回答問題，然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡短交接，提出修正後的檢索設定及邊界回歸測試。目標約 100 至 180 字。

title.zh: 虛構會員優惠政策 BP-12

body.en: Fictional policy BP-12. Benefit precedence is highest-priority matching rule. Priority 1: valid birthday-month benefit, fixed HKD 50 off. Priority 2: tier discount, Silver 5%, Gold 10%, Platinum 15% of subtotal. Priority 3: promotional coupon, fixed HKD 20 off. Priority 4: no benefit. Benefits never stack. All benefits apply only when order subtotal is at least HKD 200. The threshold is inclusive. If subtotal is below HKD 200, no benefit applies. The assistant must return exactly one benefit. Birthday-month benefit overrides tier discount and coupon. Tier discount overrides coupon.
body.zh: 虛構政策 BP-12。優惠優先次序為最高優先度的相符規則。優先度 1：有效的生日月份優惠，固定減 HKD 50。優先度 2：等級折扣，銀級 5%，金級 10%，白金級 15% 的訂單小計。優先度 3：推廣優惠券，固定減 HKD 20。優先度 4：沒有優惠。優惠不可疊加。所有優惠只適用於訂單小計至少 HKD 200。門檻為包含在內。若小計低於 HKD 200，則不適用任何優惠。助理必須只回傳一個優惠。生日月份優惠覆蓋等級折扣及優惠券。等級折扣覆蓋優惠券。

title.en: Fictional member records and current retrieval configuration
title.zh: 虛構會員記錄及現行檢索設定

body.en:
Fictional records. Member M1: tier Gold, birthday month yes, subtotal 250. Member M2: tier Silver, birthday month no, subtotal 150, coupon yes. Member M3: tier Platinum, birthday month no, subtotal 500, coupon no. Member M4: tier Bronze, birthday month yes, subtotal 220. The current retrieval configuration below is defective. It applies benefits in the wrong order, ignores the subtotal threshold, and allows stacking. The corrected configuration must match policy BP-12.

```json
{
  "benefit_order": ["coupon", "tier", "birthday"],
  "subtotal_threshold": 0,
  "stacking": true
}
```
body.zh:
虛構記錄。會員 M1：金級，生日月份是，小計 250。會員 M2：銀級，生日月份否，小計 150，優惠券是。會員 M3：白金級，生日月份否，小計 500，優惠券否。會員 M4：銅級，生日月份是，小計 220。以下現行檢索設定有缺陷。它按錯誤次序套用優惠、忽略小計門檻，並允許疊加。修正後的設定必須符合政策 BP-12。

```json
{
  "benefit_order": ["coupon", "tier", "birthday"],
  "subtotal_threshold": 0,
  "stacking": true
}
```

exemplar.en: Handover: Corrected retrieval settings for membership benefit assistant. Policy BP-12 requires precedence: birthday benefit HKD 50, then tier discount (Silver 5%, Gold 10%, Platinum 15%), then coupon HKD 20, and no stacking. All benefits apply only when subtotal is at least HKD 200 inclusive. Current config is defective: order coupon first, threshold 0, stacking true. Corrected config: {"benefit_order":["birthday","tier","coupon"],"subtotal_threshold":200,"stacking":false}. Evidence: M1 Gold birthday subtotal 250 gets birthday HKD 50. M2 Silver subtotal 150 gets no benefit. M3 Platinum subtotal 500 gets tier 15% of 500 = HKD 75. M4 Bronze birthday subtotal 220 gets birthday HKD 50. Boundary tests to add: subtotal exactly 200 with Silver member should yield tier discount 5% of 200 = HKD 10. Subtotal 199 with Gold member should yield no benefit. Also test a birthday member with subtotal 199 to confirm no benefit overrides threshold. Next steps: deploy corrected config in staging, run these regression cases, and escalate any mismatch to membership platform lead. Risks: missing real member data, so validate with synthetic records only.
exemplar.zh: 交接：會員優惠助理的修正檢索設定。政策 BP-12 要求優先次序：生日優惠 HKD 50，然後等級折扣（銀級 5%、金級 10%、白金級 15%），然後優惠券 HKD 20，且不可疊加。所有優惠只適用於小計至少 HKD 200（包含在內）。現行設定有缺陷：先套用優惠券、門檻 0、允許疊加。修正設定：{"benefit_order":["birthday","tier","coupon"],"subtotal_threshold":200,"stacking":false}。證據：M1 金級生日小計 250 得生日優惠 HKD 50。M2 銀級小計 150 沒有優惠。M3 白金級小計 500 得等級折扣 15% 的 500 = HKD 75。M4 銅級生日小計 220 得生日優惠 HKD 50。須加入的邊界測試：小計剛好 200 的銀級會員應得等級折扣 5% 的 200 = HKD 10。小計 199 的金級會員應沒有優惠。亦測試生日會員小計 199 以確認沒有優惠覆蓋門檻。下一步：在預備環境部署修正設定、執行這些回歸個案，並把任何不符轉交會員平台主管。風險：欠缺真實會員數據，因此只以虛構記錄驗證。

title.en: Adapt the delivery-exception policy for outlying islands
title.zh: 為離島地區調整送貨例外政策

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on the HKTVmall fulfilment decision team. A fictional policy update changes how the delivery-estimate assistant must treat outlying-island addresses. Compare the old and new rules, update only the affected decisions, keep all other behaviour unchanged, and write a short evidence-based handover. All policies, staff and records are invented for this learning simulation, which is inspired by HKTVmall but not endorsed by it.
brief.zh: 你是 HKTVmall 履約決策團隊的 AI 工程師。一項虛構政策更新改變了送貨估算助理處理離島地址的方式。請比較新舊規則，只更新受影響的決策，保留其他行為不變，並撰寫簡短的證據為本交接。所有政策、職員及記錄均為此學習模擬而虛構，靈感來自 HKTVmall 但不獲其認可。

body.en: Fictional policy v3.2. The delivery-estimate assistant returns a single ETA band for every Hong Kong address. Outlying-island addresses (Lantau South, Cheung Chau, Peng Chau, Lamma) use the same ETA band as urban addresses. No address is excluded from the standard estimate. The assistant never shows a delivery-exception notice. This version applied to all orders placed before 2026-09-01.
body.zh: 虛構政策 v3.2。送貨估算助理為所有香港地址傳回單一預計送達時段。離島地址（大嶼山南部、長洲、坪洲、南丫島）與市區地址使用相同時段。沒有地址被排除於標準估算之外。助理不會顯示送貨例外通知。此版本適用於 2026-09-01 前下的所有訂單。

body.en: Fictional policy v4.0. Outlying-island addresses (Lantau South, Cheung Chau, Peng Chau, Lamma) must now show a delivery-exception notice and an ETA band extended by 2 days. Urban addresses keep the v3.2 ETA band unchanged. The notice text is fixed: 'Outlying island delivery, allow extra 2 days.' Orders placed before 2026-09-01 keep the v3.2 behaviour. The assistant must not change any other address behaviour.
body.zh: 虛構政策 v4.0。離島地址（大嶼山南部、長洲、坪洲、南丫島）現須顯示送貨例外通知，並把預計送達時段延長 2 天。市區地址維持 v3.2 時段不變。通知文字固定為：「離島送貨，請預留額外 2 天。」2026-09-01 前下的訂單維持 v3.2 行為。助理不得改變其他地址行為。

body.en: Fictional records. Order A-101, address Cheung Chau, placed 2026-08-28, v3.2 ETA band 3 days. Order A-102, address Cheung Chau, placed 2026-09-03, v3.2 ETA band 3 days. Order A-103, address Mong Kok, placed 2026-09-03, v3.2 ETA band 3 days. Order A-104, address Lamma, placed 2026-09-05, v3.2 ETA band 4 days. Order A-105, address Peng Chau, placed 2026-09-06, v3.2 ETA band 3 days.
body.zh: 虛構記錄。訂單 A-101，地址長洲，下單日 2026-08-28，v3.2 時段 3 天。訂單 A-102，地址長洲，下單日 2026-09-03，v3.2 時段 3 天。訂單 A-103，地址旺角，下單日 2026-09-03，v3.2 時段 3 天。訂單 A-104，地址南丫島，下單日 2026-09-05，v3.2 時段 4 天。訂單 A-105，地址坪洲，下單日 2026-09-06，v3.2 時段 3 天。

exemplar.en: Evidence: v4.0 (effective 2026-09-01) requires outlying-island addresses (Lantau South, Cheung Chau, Peng Chau, Lamma) to show the fixed notice and add 2 days to the ETA band. Urban addresses keep v3.2. Orders before 2026-09-01 keep v3.2. Decision: A-102 (Cheung Chau, 2026-09-03) shows the notice and ETA 3 + 2 = 5 days. A-104 (Lamma, 2026-09-05) and A-105 (Peng Chau, 2026-09-06) also show the notice. A-103 (Mong Kok) stays 3 days with no notice. A-101 (Cheung Chau, 2026-08-28) keeps v3.2 behaviour because it predates the effective date. Unchanged: urban ETA band. Risks: the log is a small fictional extract, so other address types are unverified. Next steps: run regression tests for pre-cutoff, urban and each island case, confirm the fixed notice text appears only for v4.0 island orders, and assign the test owner.

feedback.en: You anchored each decision in the supplied sources, citing the v4.0 island list, the 2-day extension, the 2026-09-01 effective date and the specific order dates and addresses. The A-102 calculation and the reason A-103 is unaffected are both explained clearly.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連結到提供來源，引用 v4.0 離島名單、延長 2 天、2026-09-01 生效日，以及具體訂單日期與地址。A-102 的計算及 A-103 不受影響的原因均解釋清楚。

feedback.en: You correctly noted that the log is a small fictional extract and that other address types are unverified. Stating that no real HKTVmall policy or production data is claimed would close the remaining scope gap.

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, setting out the changed decisions, the evidence, the unchanged urban behaviour and the next steps with an owner. It is ready for a teammate to pick up without further explanation.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，列明已更改的決策、所用證據、不變的市區行為，以及連同負責人的下一步，隊友毋須額外解釋即可接手。

title.en: Adapt the catalogue visibility policy for restricted listings
title.zh: 為受限商品調整目錄可見性政策

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on the HKTVmall catalogue decision team. A fictional policy update changes how the listing-visibility assistant treats restricted-category products. Compare the old and new rules, update only the affected decisions, keep all other behaviour unchanged, and write a short evidence-based handover. All policies, staff and records are invented for this learning simulation, which is inspired by HKTVmall but not endorsed by it.
brief.zh: 你是 HKTVmall 目錄決策團隊的 AI 工程師。一項虛構政策更新改變了上架可見性助理處理受限類別商品的方式。請比較新舊規則，只更新受影響的決策，保留其他行為不變，並撰寫簡短的證據為本交接。所有政策、職員及記錄均為此學習模擬而虛構，靈感來自 HKTVmall 但不獲其認可。

body.en: Fictional policy v2.1. The listing-visibility assistant shows every approved product in the main catalogue grid. Restricted-category products (health supplements, medical devices, alcohol) are shown in the main grid with a small age-gate badge. No product is hidden from the main grid. The assistant never applies a separate restricted shelf. This version applied to all listings approved before 2026-09-01.
body.zh: 虛構政策 v2.1。上架可見性助理在主目錄格顯示所有已批准商品。受限類別商品（健康補充品、醫療器材、酒精）在主格顯示並附小型年齡門檻標籤。沒有商品被隱藏於主格之外。助理不會套用獨立受限貨架。此版本適用於 2026-09-01 前批准的所有上架。

body.en: Fictional policy v3.0. Restricted-category products (health supplements, medical devices, alcohol) must now be removed from the main catalogue grid and placed only on a separate restricted shelf. The main grid must not show these products at all. Non-restricted products keep the v2.1 main-grid behaviour unchanged. The restricted shelf label is fixed: 'Restricted items, age verification required.' Listings approved before 2026-09-01 keep the v2.1 behaviour. The assistant must not change any other catalogue behaviour.
body.zh: 虛構政策 v3.0。受限類別商品（健康補充品、醫療器材、酒精）現須從主目錄格移除，只放在獨立受限貨架。主格完全不得顯示這些商品。非受限商品維持 v2.1 主格行為不變。受限貨架標籤固定為：「受限商品，須年齡驗證。」2026-09-01 前批准的上架維持 v2.1 行為。助理不得改變其他目錄行為。

body.en: Fictional records. Listing L-201, category health supplements, approved 2026-08-25, v2.1 placement main grid. Listing L-202, category health supplements, approved 2026-09-04, v2.1 placement main grid. Listing L-203, category kitchenware, approved 2026-09-04, v2.1 placement main grid. Listing L-204, category alcohol, approved 2026-09-07, v2.1 placement main grid. Listing L-205, category medical devices, approved 2026-09-08, v2.1 placement main grid.
body.zh: 虛構記錄。上架 L-201，類別健康補充品，批准日 2026-08-25，v2.1 位置主格。上架 L-202，類別健康補充品，批准日 2026-09-04，v2.1 位置主格。上架 L-203，類別廚房用具，批准日 2026-09-04，v2.1 位置主格。上架 L-204，類別酒精，批准日 2026-09-07，v2.1 位置主格。上架 L-205，類別醫療器材，批准日 2026-09-08，v2.1 位置主格。

exemplar.en:
Evidence: Policy v3.0 (effective 2026-09-01) moves restricted categories (health supplements, medical devices, alcohol) off the main grid to a restricted shelf. The listing log shows L-202 (health supplements, 2026-09-04), L-204 (alcohol, 2026-09-07) and L-205 (medical devices, 2026-09-08) as restricted and approved on or after the cutoff. L-201 (health supplements, 2026-08-25) predates the cutoff. L-203 (kitchenware) is not restricted.
Decision: Move L-202, L-204 and L-205 to the restricted shelf with the fixed label. Keep L-201 under v2.1 in the main grid. Keep L-203 in the main grid. Affected count is 3.
Risks: The log is a fictional extract and may not cover all listings. Cutoff-date edge cases are not fully evidenced.
Next steps: Run regression tests confirming L-203 and L-201 stay in the main grid and the three restricted listings appear only on the restricted shelf. Escalate cutoff logic to the catalogue decision team lead for sign-off.
exemplar.zh:
證據：政策 v3.0（2026-09-01 生效）把受限類別（健康補充品、醫療器材、酒精）從主格移至受限貨架。上架記錄顯示 L-202（健康補充品，2026-09-04）、L-204（酒精，2026-09-07）及 L-205（醫療器材，2026-09-08）屬受限並於生效日或之後批准。L-201（健康補充品，2026-08-25）早於生效日。L-203（廚房用具）非受限。
決策：把 L-202、L-204 及 L-205 移至受限貨架並附固定標籤。L-201 維持 v2.1 於主格。L-203 留在主格。受影響數目為 3。
風險：記錄為虛構摘錄，未必涵蓋所有上架。生效日界線個案證據不足。
下一步：執行回歸測試，確認 L-203 及 L-201 留在主格，三個受限上架只出現在受限貨架。把界線邏輯轉交目錄決策團隊主管簽核。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: L-202, L-204 and L-205 move to the restricted shelf, count is 3, L-201 stays on v2.1 in the main grid, L-203 stays in the main grid, and non-restricted main-grid behaviour is unchanged. Your use of the 2026-09-01 cutoff and the restricted category list matches the supplied policy exactly.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：L-202、L-204 及 L-205 移至受限貨架，數目為 3，L-201 維持 v2.1 於主格，L-203 留在主格，非受限主格行為不變。你對 2026-09-01 生效日及受限類別清單的運用與提供政策完全一致。

feedback.en: You tie every decision to the specific log rows with their categories and approval dates, and you explain why L-201 (pre-cutoff) and L-203 (kitchenware) are excluded. Adding the exact fixed shelf label text 'Restricted items, age verification required' would make the evidence trail fully complete, though referencing the fixed label already satisfies the requirement.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連繫到具體記錄行及其類別與批准日期，並解釋 L-201（生效日前）及 L-203（廚房用具）被排除的原因。若補上固定貨架標籤原文「受限商品，須年齡驗證」會更完整，但提及固定標籤已符合要求。

feedback.en: Your regression tests correctly cover the three restricted listings appearing only on the restricted shelf plus L-201 and L-203 staying in the main grid, and you escalate the cutoff logic to the catalogue decision team lead. A test asserting the fixed shelf label renders verbatim would strengthen the check set.
feedback.zh: 你的回歸測試正確涵蓋三個受限上架只出現在受限貨架，以及 L-201 及 L-203 留在主格，並把界線邏輯轉交目錄決策團隊主管。若加一項斷言固定貨架標籤逐字顯示的測試，檢查組合會更完整。

brief.en: You are an AI engineer on the HKTVmall customer assistant team. A customer asked whether a fictional 750 ml stainless-steel travel flask (SKU FLK-750) is in stock. The assistant replied that it is out of stock, but the customer says the product page shows stock. Diagnose the retrieval and prompt failure using the source hierarchy and trace log. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by HKTVmall and is not endorsed by it. Policies, staff and records are fictional.
brief.zh: 你是 HKTVmall 客戶助理團隊的 AI 工程師。一名顧客查詢一款虛構 750 毫升不鏽鋼旅行保溫瓶（SKU FLK-750）是否有貨。助理回覆缺貨，但顧客指產品頁顯示有貨。請按文件優先次序及追蹤記錄診斷檢索與提示問題。以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據交接。此為受 HKTVmall 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由該公司認可。政策、職員及記錄均為虛構。

managerRole.zh: 客戶 AI 團隊主管

body.en: Source hierarchy for stock answers: (1) live inventory feed, (2) product catalogue version marked active, (3) cached page snapshot. The live feed overrides all other sources. A catalogue version is active only if its status field is active and its effective date is not later than the query date. The prompt must instruct the assistant to cite the live feed first. If the live feed is unavailable, the assistant must say the stock is unconfirmed, not out of stock. Next-day delivery eligibility requires stock quantity of 1 or more and a delivery zone flag of eligible.
body.zh: 存貨回覆的文件優先次序：(1) 即時庫存饋送，(2) 標記為生效的產品目錄版本，(3) 快取頁面快照。即時饋送優先於所有其他文件。目錄版本只在狀態欄為生效且生效日期不遲於查詢日期時方為生效。提示須指示助理優先引用即時饋送。若即時饋送不可用，助理須說存貨未確認，而非缺貨。翌日送達資格要求存貨數量為 1 或以上，且送達區域標記為符合資格。

Catalogue version C-21 status active, effective date 2026-09-15, quantity 0. Catalogue version C-22 status draft, effective date 2026-10-05, quantity 14. Cached snapshot S-7 quantity 0. The prompt used was: Answer stock questions from the catalogue. The assistant answered out of stock. The live feed was available at query time.

exemplar.en: Diagnosis for query Q-5120. The live inventory feed is the first source under the fictional policy, and it shows FLK-750 quantity 14 with zone flag eligible. Catalogue C-21 (active, quantity 0) and cached snapshot S-7 (quantity 0) conflict with the live feed, but the live feed overrides both. Catalogue C-22 is draft, so it is not active. Next-day delivery requires quantity 1 or more, so FLK-750 is eligible. The prompt failure is that it told the assistant to answer from the catalogue and did not require citing the live feed first. Corrected configuration: put the live feed first in retrieval and change the prompt to cite the live feed first. Next step: re-run Q-5120 with the corrected settings and add a regression test asserting the live feed is cited first. Owner: AI engineer, escalate to Ada Cheung if the test fails. This is a fictional simulation and no code was executed.
exemplar.zh: 查詢 Q-5120 的診斷。按虛構政策，即時庫存饋送為首選來源，顯示 FLK-750 數量 14，區域標記為符合資格。目錄 C-21（生效，數量 0）及快取快照 S-7（數量 0）與即時饋送衝突，但即時饋送優先於兩者。目錄 C-22 為草稿，並非生效。翌日送達要求數量為 1 或以上，故 FLK-750 符合資格。提示失誤在於指示助理按目錄回答，且未要求優先引用即時饋送。修正設定：把即時饋送放在檢索首位，並把提示改為優先引用即時饋送。下一步：以修正設定重跑 Q-5120，並加入斷言優先引用即時饋送的回歸測試。負責人：AI 工程師，若測試失敗則轉交 Ada Cheung。此為虛構模擬，並無執行代碼。

You identify the live feed as the first source with quantity 14, name C-21 and S-7 as the conflicting records, apply the quantity 1+ rule to find FLK-750 eligible for next-day delivery, and diagnose the prompt failure as omitting the live-feed-first requirement.
feedback.zh: 五項決策全部正確。你指出即時饋送為首選來源、數量 14，列出 C-21 及 S-7 為衝突記錄，按數量 1 或以上規則判定 FLK-750 符合翌日送達資格，並診斷提示失誤為未要求優先引用即時饋送。

feedback.en: You correctly scope the work as a fictional simulation with no code executed, and you limit the authoritative stock source to the live feed without claiming real system behaviour or policies.

title.en: Fictional eligibility retrieval and prompt policy
title.zh: 虛構資格檢索及提示政策

body.en: Source hierarchy for eligibility answers: (1) live eligibility store, filtered by customer ID, (2) cached eligibility snapshot matched by customer ID. The live store overrides all other sources. A customer is eligible for Priority Delivery if loyalty tier is Gold or Platinum and delivery zone is A or B. The store record must match the customer ID in the query. If no record matches, say eligibility is unconfirmed. The prompt must instruct the assistant to filter by customer ID and cite the live store record. All policy versions are current, so version conflicts do not apply. Next-day delivery eligibility also requires a valid address in zone A or B.
body.zh: 資格回覆的文件優先次序：(1) 即時資格儲存庫，按客戶 ID 過濾，(2) 按客戶 ID 匹配的快取資格快照。即時儲存庫優先於所有其他來源。客戶若忠誠等級為 Gold 或 Platinum 且送達區域為 A 或 B，即符合 Priority Delivery 資格。儲存庫記錄必須與查詢中的客戶 ID 匹配。若無記錄匹配，須說資格未確認。提示須指示助理按客戶 ID 過濾並引用即時儲存庫記錄。所有政策版本均為現行，故不存在版本衝突。翌日送達資格亦要求送達地址位於 A 或 B 區。

body.en: Query Q-7072 from customer CUST-2048 (Mr. Lee) asked: Am I eligible for Priority Delivery? Session context shows customer ID CUST-2048. Retrieved from live eligibility store without a customer filter: returned two rows: CUST-3199 (tier Gold, zone A, eligible true) and CUST-2048 (tier Silver, zone A, eligible false). The assistant answered eligible based on CUST-3199. The prompt used was: Answer eligibility questions using the eligibility store. The live store was available and current. The cached snapshot S-9 contains the same two rows. No version conflicts exist.
body.zh: 查詢 Q-7072 來自客戶 CUST-2048（李先生），問題為：我是否符合 Priority Delivery 資格？工作階段內容顯示客戶 ID 為 CUST-2048。從即時資格儲存庫檢索時未加客戶過濾，返回兩行：CUST-3199（等級 Gold，區域 A，符合 true）及 CUST-2048（等級 Silver，區域 A，符合 false）。助理根據 CUST-3199 回答符合。所用提示為：按資格儲存庫回答資格問題。即時儲存庫當時可用且為現行。快取快照 S-9 包含相同兩行。不存在版本衝突。

body.en:
The assistant configuration contains a retrieval block and a prompt block. The retrieval block currently lists source: eligibility_store, with no filter on customer_id. The prompt block currently says: Answer eligibility questions using the eligibility store. A corrected configuration must add filter: customer_id from query context. It must also change the prompt to: Filter the eligibility store by the customer ID in the query. Cite the live store record for that customer ID. If no record, say eligibility is unconfirmed. Example configuration:
```
retrieval:
  source: eligibility_store
  filter: none
prompt: "Answer eligibility questions using the eligibility store."
```
Corrected:
```
retrieval:
  source: eligibility_store
  filter: customer_id from query context
prompt: "Filter the eligibility store by the customer ID in the query. Cite the live store record for that customer ID. If no record, say eligibility is unconfirmed."
```
body.zh:
助理設定包含檢索區塊及提示區塊。檢索區塊目前列出 source: eligibility_store，且沒有對 customer_id 的過濾。提示區塊目前為：按資格儲存庫回答資格問題。修正後的設定須加入 filter: customer_id from query context。亦須將提示改為：按查詢中的客戶 ID 過濾資格儲存庫。引用該客戶 ID 的即時儲存庫記錄。若無記錄，須說資格未確認。範例設定：
```
retrieval:
  source: eligibility_store
  filter: none
prompt: "按資格儲存庫回答資格問題。"
```
修正後：
```
retrieval:
  source: eligibility_store
  filter: customer_id from query context
prompt: "按查詢中的客戶 ID 過濾資格儲存庫。引用該客戶 ID 的即時儲存庫記錄。若無記錄，須說資格未確認。"
```

exemplar.en: The retrieval failure is an omitted entity filter. For query Q-7072 from CUST-2048, the live eligibility store was queried without filtering on customer ID. It returned two records: CUST-3199 (tier Gold, zone A, eligible true) and CUST-2048 (tier Silver, zone A, eligible false). The assistant cited the CUST-3199 record and answered eligible. Per the policy, eligibility for Priority Delivery requires a Gold or Platinum tier and zone A or B. CUST-2048 has Silver tier, so the correct answer is not eligible. The prompt also failed because it did not require filtering by customer ID or citing the matching live record. I will update the retrieval configuration to filter by customer_id from the query context and update the prompt to require that filter. I will run a regression test using CUST-2048 to confirm only its record is used. All policy versions are current, so version conflict is not a factor.
exemplar.zh: 檢索失誤為省略實體過濾。就查詢 Q-7072 來自 CUST-2048，即時資格儲存庫在查詢時未按客戶 ID 過濾。它返回兩項記錄：CUST-3199（等級 Gold，區域 A，符合 true）及 CUST-2048（等級 Silver，區域 A，符合 false）。助理引用 CUST-3199 記錄並回答符合。按政策，Priority Delivery 資格要求 Gold 或 Platinum 等級及區域 A 或 B。CUST-2048 為 Silver 等級，故正確答案為不符合。提示亦失誤，因它未要求按客戶 ID 過濾或引用匹配的即時記錄。我會更新檢索設定，按查詢內容的 customer_id 過濾，並更新提示以要求該過濾。我會以 CUST-2048 進行回歸測試，確認僅使用其記錄。所有政策版本均為現行，故版本衝突並非因素。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct and the diagnosis is complete. You identify the live store filtered by CUST-2048 as the right first source, state CUST-2048 is not eligible on Silver tier in zone A, name the omitted customer ID filter as the retrieval failure, note the prompt also omitted the filter and citation duty, and give two records returned.

feedback.en: Strong evidence linking: trace Q-7072 records CUST-3199 (Gold, zone A, eligible true) and CUST-2048 (Silver, zone A, eligible false), and you correctly show the assistant cited CUST-3199. The policy rule requiring Gold or Platinum plus zone A or B is applied explicitly to explain the wrong answer.
feedback.zh: 證據連結有力：追蹤記錄 Q-7072 列出 CUST-3199（Gold，區域 A，符合 true）及 CUST-2048（Silver，區域 A，符合 false），你正確指出助理引用了 CUST-3199。你亦明確引用須 Gold 或 Platinum 且區域 A 或 B 的政策規則，解釋錯誤回覆的成因。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete: add the customer_id filter from query context, update the prompt, and run a CUST-2048 regression test to confirm only the matching record is used. Add one check that the cached snapshot is also matched by customer ID, since the policy names it as the secondary source.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體可行：加入按查詢內容的 customer_id 過濾、更新提示，並以 CUST-2048 進行回歸測試確認僅使用匹配記錄。請補上一項檢查，確認快取快照亦按客戶 ID 匹配，因政策將其列為次要來源。

feedback.en: You correctly rule out version conflict because all policy versions are current, and you keep claims tied to Q-7072 and the supplied records. You do not state that no evidence exists about other customers or wider system behaviour, so add that boundary explicitly.
feedback.zh: 你正確排除版本衝突，因所有政策版本均為現行，並把聲明限於 Q-7072 及提供記錄。你未有說明缺乏其他客戶或更廣泛系統行為的證據，宜明確補上此界線。

title.en: Compare automation costs for a merchant exception desk
title.zh: 比較商戶異常處理台的自動化成本

brief.en: You are a business analyst in an independent learning simulation inspired by Lalamove. Lalamove is a real logistics platform. This exercise and all records are fictional and not endorsed by Lalamove. A fictional merchant exception desk handles delivery booking failures manually. You must compare two automation options with one-time and running costs, apply the supplied eligibility rule, recommend an eligible process improvement, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Use only supplied synthetic data. Do not treat this as official company or financial advice.
brief.zh: 你是 Lalamove 啟發的獨立學習模擬中的商業分析師。Lalamove 是真實物流平台。此練習及所有記錄均為虛構，並不獲 Lalamove 認可。虛構商戶異常處理台以手動方式處理配送預約失敗。你須比較兩個含一次性及營運成本的自動化方案，應用提供的資格規則，建議合資格流程改善，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔證據為本交接。只使用提供的合成數據。不要把此視為官方公司或財務建議。

body.en: Fictional baseline for Harbour Fresh Mart, a synthetic merchant. Annual exception cases: 1,800. Each case takes 15 minutes of coordinator time. Loaded coordinator cost: HKD 160 per hour. Rework applies to 10 percent of cases. Each rework takes 5 minutes. No other manual costs are in scope. Baseline annual cost covers manual handling plus rework only. These figures are synthetic learning data and not Lalamove figures.
body.zh: 虛構基線，對象為合成商戶 Harbour Fresh Mart。每年異常個案：1,800。每宗個案耗用協調員 15 分鐘。協調員負載成本：每小時 HKD 160。重新處理適用於 10% 個案。每宗重新處理耗用 5 分鐘。範圍不包括其他手動成本。基線年度成本只涵蓋手動處理及重新處理。此等數字為合成學習數據，並非 Lalamove 數字。

body.en: Fictional options. AutoRoute: one-time configuration HKD 30,000. Monthly running HKD 1,200. It cuts manual handling time by 80 percent and lowers rework to 3 percent of cases. DispatchAssist: one-time configuration HKD 16,000. Monthly running HKD 600. It cuts manual handling time by 60 percent and lowers rework to 5 percent of cases. Rework time stays 5 minutes per affected case. Running costs cover twelve months. These are synthetic quotes.
body.zh: 虛構方案。AutoRoute：一次性設定 HKD 30,000。每月營運 HKD 1,200。它把手動處理時間減少 80%，並把重新處理降至個案的 3%。DispatchAssist：一次性設定 HKD 16,000。每月營運 HKD 600。它把手動處理時間減少 60%，並把重新處理降至個案的 5%。每宗受影響個案的重新處理時間維持 5 分鐘。營運成本涵蓋十二個月。此等為合成報價。

body.en: Fictional decision rule for this simulation. One-time budget cap: HKD 35,000 inclusive. First-year net saving versus baseline must be at least HKD 15,000 inclusive. First-year total equals one-time cost plus twelve months of running cost plus residual manual handling plus residual rework. First-year net saving equals baseline annual cost minus first-year total. An option is eligible only if it meets both thresholds. Among eligible options, choose the highest first-year net saving. If none is eligible, retain baseline. All policy text is synthetic.
body.zh: 此模擬的虛構決策規則。一次性預算上限：HKD 35,000，包含此數。相對基線的首年淨節省必須至少 HKD 15,000，包含此數。首年總額等於一次性成本加十二個月營運成本加剩餘手動處理加剩餘重新處理。首年淨節省等於基線年度成本減首年總額。方案必須同時符合兩個門檻才合資格。合資格方案中，選擇首年淨節省最高者。若無方案合資格，保留基線。所有政策文字均為合成。

expectedEvidence.en: Produces concise handover with decision, key calculations, eligibility reasoning, risks and next steps. Names fictional owner or escalation path if included. Keeps language clear and actionable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫簡潔交接，包含決策、主要計算、資格推理、風險及下一步。如包括，列明虛構負責人或轉交途徑。語言清晰可行。

exemplar.en:
Decision. Recommend DispatchAssist. Under decision-rule, an option is eligible only if one-time cost is at or below HKD 35,000 and first-year net saving is at least HKD 15,000. Among eligible options, choose the highest first-year net saving.
Baseline. From baseline-data, 1,800 cases x 15 minutes / 60 x HKD 160 = HKD 72,000 manual handling. Rework is 10% x 1,800 x 5 / 60 x HKD 160 = HKD 2,400. Baseline total is HKD 74,400.
AutoRoute. From automation-options, first-year total is HKD 30,000 one-time + HKD 14,400 running + HKD 14,400 residual handling + HKD 720 rework = HKD 59,520. First-year net saving is HKD 74,400 - HKD 59,520 = HKD 14,880. It meets the cap but fails the HKD 15,000 saving threshold.
DispatchAssist. First-year total is HKD 16,000 + HKD 7,200 + HKD 28,800 + HKD 1,200 = HKD 53,200. First-year net saving is HKD 21,200. It meets both thresholds and is recommended.
Risks and next steps. Vendor rates and performance are synthetic. Validate rework rates with four weeks of records, confirm running quotes in writing, and ask the fictional operations lead to approve a limited pilot. This simulation is not endorsed by Lalamove.
exemplar.zh:
決策。建議 DispatchAssist。按 decision-rule，方案只有在一次性成本等於或低於 HKD 35,000，且首年淨節省至少 HKD 15,000 時才合資格。合資格方案中，選擇首年淨節省最高者。
基線。按 baseline-data，1,800 宗 x 15 分鐘 / 60 x HKD 160 = HKD 72,000 手動處理。重新處理為 10% x 1,800 x 5 / 60 x HKD 160 = HKD 2,400。基線總額為 HKD 74,400。
AutoRoute。按 automation-options，首年總額為 HKD 30,000 一次性 + HKD 14,400 營運 + HKD 14,400 剩餘處理 + HKD 720 重新處理 = HKD 59,520。首年淨節省為 HKD 74,400 - HKD 59,520 = HKD 14,880。它符合上限但未達 HKD 15,000 節省門檻。
DispatchAssist。首年總額為 HKD 16,000 + HKD 7,200 + HKD 28,800 + HKD 1,200 = HKD 53,200。首年淨節省為 HKD 21,200。它符合兩個門檻並獲建議。
風險及下一步。供應商價格及表現均為合成。用四星期記錄驗證重新處理率，以書面確認營運報價，並請虛構營運主管批准有限試行。此模擬不獲 Lalamove 認可。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct. Baseline HKD 74,400, AutoRoute net saving HKD 14,880 (fails the HKD 15,000 threshold despite meeting the cap) and DispatchAssist first-year total HKD 53,200 with net saving HKD 21,200 are all derived accurately, and DispatchAssist is correctly recommended as the only eligible option.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確。基線 HKD 74,400、AutoRoute 淨節省 HKD 14,880（符合上限但未達 HKD 15,000 門檻）及 DispatchAssist 首年總額 HKD 53,200、淨節省 HKD 21,200 均計算準確，並正確建議唯一合資格的 DispatchAssist。

feedback.en: You tie each figure to baseline-data, automation-options and decision-rule, showing the 1,800 cases, 15 minutes, HKD 160 rate, rework percentages and monthly running costs, and you explicitly state that AutoRoute meets the cap but fails the saving threshold. This is complete transparent reasoning.
feedback.zh: 你把每個數字連結至 baseline-data、automation-options 及 decision-rule，展示 1,800 宗、15 分鐘、HKD 160 費率、重新處理百分比及每月營運成本，並明確指出 AutoRoute 符合上限但未達節省門檻。推理完整透明。

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete, namely validating rework rates against four weeks of records, confirming running quotes in writing and requesting a limited pilot. For fuller credit you could also add recalculating the twelve-month running totals and confirming the inclusive meaning of both thresholds.
feedback.zh: 你的檢查具體，包括用四星期記錄驗證重新處理率、以書面確認營運報價及要求有限試行。若要更完整，可再加入重算十二個月營運總額及確認兩個門檻的包含式含義。

feedback.en: You correctly flag vendor rates and performance as synthetic and note the simulation is not endorsed by Lalamove. You could also state the missing real vendor performance, integration cost and actual error-rate evidence.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出供應商價格及表現為合成，並說明此模擬不獲 Lalamove 認可。你亦可補充欠缺真實供應商表現、整合成本及實際錯誤率等證據。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and well structured with decision, calculations, eligibility reasoning, risks and next steps in clear language. Naming a fictional owner or escalation path for the pilot approval would make it slightly more actionable.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔且結構良好，包含決策、計算、資格推理、風險及下一步，語言清晰。若為試行批准列明虛構負責人或轉交途徑，可行動性會更高。

summary.en: Excellent submission. All field answers are correct and your written handover fully supports the DispatchAssist recommendation with accurate calculations tied to the supplied records. Only minor strengthening of verification scope and ownership would improve an already strong piece.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。所有欄位答案正確，書面交接以準確計算及提供記錄全面支持建議 DispatchAssist。只需略為加強核實範圍及負責人，已屬穩健之作。

nextSteps.en: Add recalculating the twelve-month running totals and confirming the inclusive threshold wording to your checks, and name a fictional owner for pilot approval.
nextSteps.zh: 在檢查中加入重算十二個月營運總額及確認包含式門檻措辭，並為試行批准列明虛構負責人。

title.zh: 比較員工協助異常處理流程

brief.en: You are a business analyst in an independent learning simulation inspired by Lalamove. Lalamove is a real logistics platform. This exercise and all records are fictional and not endorsed by Lalamove. A fictional merchant support desk handles delivery booking exceptions. You must compare two staff-assisted workflow alternatives with one-time and running costs, apply the supplied eligibility rule, recommend an eligible process improvement, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Use only supplied synthetic data. Do not treat this as official company or financial advice. No real employee promises are made.
brief.zh: 你是 Lalamove 啟發的獨立學習模擬中的商業分析師。Lalamove 是真實物流平台。此練習及所有記錄均為虛構，並不獲 Lalamove 認可。虛構商戶支援台處理配送預約異常。你須比較兩個含一次性及營運成本的員工協助流程方案，應用提供的資格規則，建議合資格流程改善，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔證據為本交接。只使用提供的合成數據。不要把此視為官方公司或財務建議。本模擬不對真實員工作出任何承諾。

body.en: Fictional baseline for Lantern Bay Grocers, a synthetic merchant. Annual exception cases: 3,000. Each case takes 15 minutes of coordinator time. Loaded coordinator cost: HKD 200 per hour. Rework applies to 12 percent of cases. Each rework takes 6 minutes. No other manual costs are in scope. Baseline annual cost covers manual handling plus rework only. These figures are synthetic learning data and not Lalamove figures.
body.zh: 虛構基線，對象為合成商戶 Lantern Bay Grocers。每年異常個案：3,000。每宗個案耗用協調員 15 分鐘。協調員負載成本：每小時 HKD 200。重新處理適用於 12% 個案。每宗重新處理耗用 6 分鐘。範圍不包括其他手動成本。基線年度成本只涵蓋手動處理及重新處理。此等數字為合成學習數據，並非 Lalamove 數字。

title.zh: 虛構員工協助流程方案

body.en: Fictional options. Part-time shift: one-time training HKD 10,000. Monthly running HKD 5,000. It cuts manual handling time by 50 percent and lowers rework to 8 percent of cases. Cross-training: one-time training HKD 6,000. Monthly stipend HKD 2,500. It cuts manual handling time by 40 percent and lowers rework to 10 percent of cases. Rework time stays 6 minutes per affected case. Running costs cover twelve months. These are synthetic quotes and make no real employee promises.
body.zh: 虛構方案。兼職輪班：一次性培訓 HKD 10,000。每月營運 HKD 5,000。它把手動處理時間減少 50%，並把重新處理降至個案的 8%。跨職能培訓：一次性培訓 HKD 6,000。每月津貼 HKD 2,500。它把手動處理時間減少 40%，並把重新處理降至個案的 10%。每宗受影響個案的重新處理時間維持 6 分鐘。營運成本涵蓋十二個月。此等為合成報價，並不對真實員工作出承諾。

body.en: Fictional decision rule for this simulation. One-time budget cap: HKD 12,000 inclusive. First-year net saving versus baseline must be at least HKD 15,000 inclusive. First-year total equals one-time cost plus twelve months of running cost plus residual manual handling plus residual rework. First-year net saving equals baseline annual cost minus first-year total. An option is eligible only if it meets both thresholds. Among eligible options, choose the highest first-year net saving. If none is eligible, retain baseline. All policy text is synthetic.
body.zh: 此模擬的虛構決策規則。一次性預算上限：HKD 12,000，包含此數。相對基線的首年淨節省必須至少 HKD 15,000，包含此數。首年總額等於一次性成本加十二個月營運成本加剩餘手動處理加剩餘重新處理。首年淨節省等於基線年度成本減首年總額。方案必須同時符合兩個門檻才合資格。合資格方案中，選擇首年淨節省最高者。若無方案合資格，保留基線。所有政策文字均為合成。

exemplar.en: Evidence: Baseline annual cost is HKD 157,200 (3,000 cases x 15 min x HKD 200/hr plus 12% rework x 6 min). Part-time shift first-year total is HKD 149,800 and net saving HKD 7,400. Cross-training first-year total is HKD 132,000 and net saving HKD 25,200. Decision rule: one-time cap HKD 12,000 inclusive, net saving threshold HKD 15,000 inclusive. Part-time shift passes cap but fails saving threshold. Cross-training passes both thresholds and has the higher net saving. Decision: recommend Cross-training. Risks: synthetic data, unverified case volume and rework rates. Next steps: pilot Cross-training for one month, verify case volume with Lantern Bay Grocers records, confirm loaded cost with finance, and measure actual handling time and rework rate. Owner: Ada Lam, team lead, to approve pilot and escalate if savings fall below HKD 15,000.
exemplar.zh: 證據：基線年度成本為 HKD 157,200（3,000 宗個案 x 15 分鐘 x HKD 200/小時，加上 12% 重新處理 x 6 分鐘）。兼職輪班首年總額為 HKD 149,800，淨節省 HKD 7,400。跨職能培訓首年總額為 HKD 132,000，淨節省 HKD 25,200。決策規則：一次性上限 HKD 12,000（包含），淨節省門檻 HKD 15,000（包含）。兼職輪班通過上限但未達節省門檻。跨職能培訓通過兩個門檻，且淨節省較高。決策：建議跨職能培訓。風險：合成數據，個案量及重新處理率未經核實。下一步：試行跨職能培訓一個月，以 Lantern Bay Grocers 記錄核實個案量，與財務確認負載成本，並量度實際處理時間及重新處理率。負責人：Ada Lam，團隊主管，批核試行並在節省低於 HKD 15,000 時轉交。

feedback.en: All answer fields are correct. Baseline annual cost is HKD 157,200, Cross-training first-year total is HKD 132,000 with net saving HKD 25,200, and Part-time shift fails the HKD 15,000 net saving threshold. The written work also recommends Cross-training as the only eligible option.
feedback.zh: 所有答案欄位均正確。基線年度成本為 HKD 157,200，跨職能培訓首年總額為 HKD 132,000，淨節省 HKD 25,200，而兼職輪班未能達到 HKD 15,000 淨節省門檻。書面工作亦建議跨職能培訓為唯一合資格方案。

feedback.en: The work links the baseline calculation, option totals and thresholds to the supplied figures. It explains why Part-time shift fails the saving threshold and why Cross-training meets both thresholds.
feedback.zh: 工作把基線計算、方案總額及門檻連結至提供的數字。它解釋了兼職輪班未能通過節省門檻，以及跨職能培訓符合兩個門檻。

feedback.en: The next steps are concrete, including a one-month pilot, case volume verification, finance confirmation of loaded cost, and measurement of handling time and rework rate. The owner is named as Ada Lam.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體可行，包括試行一個月、核實個案量、與財務確認負載成本，以及量度處理時間及重新處理率。負責人列明為 Ada Lam。

feedback.en: The submission acknowledges synthetic data and unverified case volume and rework rates. It does not explicitly state the stable volume and cost assumption, staff availability limits, or that no real employee promises are made.
feedback.zh: 提交內容承認合成數據，以及個案量及重新處理率未經核實。它沒有明確說明個案量及成本穩定的假設、員工可用性限制，或不對真實員工作出承諾。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 141 English words with a clear decision, supporting figures, risks, next steps and owner. It includes a source reference to Lantern Bay Grocers records and a baseline calculation method.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，共 141 個英文字，列明清晰決策、支持數字、風險、下一步及負責人。它包括 Lantern Bay Grocers 記錄的來源引用及基線計算方法。

summary.en: Strong submission. All calculations, selected statements and the recommendation are correct. The main gap is scope and uncertainty wording, which covers synthetic data and unverified inputs but omits stable assumptions, staff availability and no real employee promises.
summary.zh: 整體表現強。所有計算、所選陳述及建議均正確。主要不足在於範圍及不確定性表述，雖涵蓋合成數據及未經核實的輸入，但未提及穩定假設、員工可用性及不對真實員工作出承諾。

brief.en: You are a business analyst in a fictional learning simulation inspired by Lalamove but not endorsed by it. Review the fictional booking confirmation policy and event log. Identify the workflow gap, define measurable acceptance criteria and responsibilities, then write a concise evidence-based handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. Use only supplied facts. State assumptions and limits. Do not claim real company data or performance.
brief.zh: 你是一位商業分析師，正在參與一個受 Lalamove 啟發但未獲其認可的虛構學習模擬。請審閱虛構的預約確認政策及事件記錄。找出流程缺口，定義可量度接納標準及責任，然後撰寫一份約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文的簡潔證據為本交接。只使用提供的資料。說明假設及限制。不得聲稱代表真實公司數據或表現。

body.en: This fictional policy supports a learning simulation. It is not a real Lalamove policy. A booking is confirmed when the merchant receives an in-app notification with driver name, plate, and estimated pickup time. Target: 95% of bookings confirmed within 10 minutes of submission. If not confirmed within 15 minutes, it is at-risk. At-risk bookings require Merchant Support to contact the merchant within 5 minutes of the flag. Classification rule: driver-assignment delay means driver assigned after 10 minutes. Notification failure means confirmation received after 15 minutes or not received. If both apply, notification failure is the primary gap. The primary workflow gap is the category with more affected bookings. Platform Ops owns notifications. Merchant Support owns outreach. Merchant Success owns templates.
body.zh: 此虛構政策支援學習模擬，並非 Lalamove 真實政策。當商戶收到包含司機姓名、車牌及預計取貨時間的應用程式內通知時，預約即視為已確認。目標：95% 的預約在提交後 10 分鐘內確認。若未在 15 分鐘內確認，即列為高風險。高風險預約要求商戶支援團隊在風險標記後 5 分鐘內聯絡商戶。分類規則：司機分配延遲指司機在 10 分鐘後才獲分配。通知失敗指確認在 15 分鐘後才收到或未收到。若兩者同時出現，通知失敗為主要缺口。主要流程缺口為受影響預約較多的類別。平台營運負責通知。商戶支援負責外展。商戶成功負責範本。

exemplar.en: Evidence: The fictional policy defines confirmed as merchant receiving driver name, plate and pickup time. At-risk means not confirmed within 15 minutes. The log shows 4 of 10 bookings met the 10-minute target, a 40% confirmation rate. Under the classification rule, notification failures are B004, B005, B007 and B008, which is 4 bookings. Driver-assignment delays are B002, B005 and B007, which is 3 bookings. Since notification failure is larger and takes priority when both apply, the primary gap is notification delay or failure. Decision: Fix confirmation notification after driver assignment. Acceptance criteria: 95% confirmed within 10 minutes, at-risk flagged at 15 minutes, and Merchant Support contacts the merchant within 5 minutes. Responsibilities: Platform Ops owns notifications, Merchant Support owns outreach, Merchant Success owns templates. Risks: One fictional week and 10 bookings only, no real company data, and missing merchant or driver evidence. Next steps: Sample more logs, test automated alerts, track weekly rate against 95%, and assign Platform Ops to the notification fix.

title.zh: 虛構變更請求交接政策

body.en: This fictional policy supports a learning simulation. It is not a real Lalamove policy. The change request process handles merchant requests to modify delivery details after booking. Stages: 1. Acknowledgement: Merchant Success must acknowledge within 10 minutes of submission. Target: 90% of requests. 2. Handover to Platform Ops: Merchant Success validates and hands over within 20 minutes of acknowledgement. Target: 95% of requests. 3. Handover to Driver Ops: Platform Ops checks feasibility and hands over within 15 minutes of receiving handover. Target: 90% of requests. 4. Driver notification: Driver Ops notifies driver within 20 minutes of receiving handover. Target: 85% of requests. End-to-end target: 75 minutes from submission to completion for 80% of requests. At-risk: any request with total time from submission to completion or rejection exceeding 90 minutes. Classification for at-risk requests: Handover delay means any stage duration exceeds its target by 50% or more (duration > target * 1.5). Validation failure means request rejected due to missing or incorrect information. If both apply, handover delay is the primary gap. Primary workflow gap: the category with the greater number of at-risk requests. Responsibilities: Merchant Success owns acknowledgement and validation. Platform Ops owns feasibility check and handover to Driver Ops. Driver Ops owns driver notification. Merchant Support owns merchant communication for at-risk requests.
body.zh: 此虛構政策支援學習模擬，並非 Lalamove 真實政策。變更請求流程處理商戶在預約後修改配送詳情的請求。階段：1. 確認：商戶成功須在提交後 10 分鐘內確認。目標：90% 的請求。2. 交接至平台營運：商戶成功驗證並在確認後 20 分鐘內交接。目標：95% 的請求。3. 交接至司機營運：平台營運檢查可行性並在收到交接後 15 分鐘內交接。目標：90% 的請求。4. 司機通知：司機營運在收到交接後 20 分鐘內通知司機。目標：85% 的請求。端到端目標：80% 的請求在提交後 75 分鐘內完成。高風險：任何請求從提交到完成或拒絕的總時間超過 90 分鐘。高風險請求分類：交接延遲指任何階段時長超過其目標 50% 或以上（時長 > 目標 * 1.5）。驗證失敗指因資料缺失或錯誤而被拒絕。若兩者同時出現，交接延遲為主要缺口。主要流程缺口：高風險請求數量較多的類別。責任：商戶成功負責確認及驗證。平台營運負責可行性檢查及交接至司機營運。司機營運負責司機通知。商戶支援負責高風險請求的商戶溝通。

about.en: Lalamove describes an on-demand delivery platform founded in Hong Kong in 2013, connecting people and businesses with delivery vehicles.
about.zh: Lalamove 介紹其為 2013 年於香港創立的即時配送平台，連結個人、企業及配送車輛。

publicValues.zh: 快捷、簡單及實惠的配送

simulationStyle.en: Analyse fictional merchant processes, prioritise requirements and compare synthetic operating costs or budget variances. Explain assumptions and service limits without claims about real company finances or platform performance.
simulationStyle.zh: 分析虛構商戶流程、排列需求優先次序，並比較合成營運成本或預算差異。解釋假設及服務限制，不聲稱代表真實公司財務或平台表現。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Identify a workflow gap and define measurable acceptance criteria and responsibilities.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。找出流程缺口，並定義可量度接納標準及責任。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.zh: 找岀交接延遲為主要流程缺口。正確列出高風險請求為 CR-003、CR-005、CR-007、CR-009。計算商戶成功至平台營運交接率為 75%。準確應用高風險定義（總時間 > 90 分鐘）及分類規則。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites specific timestamps from the event log to justify at-risk classification and handover delay. Explains that 6 of 8 completed requests met the 20-minute MS to PO target, giving 75%. Links the primary gap to the policy's classification rule (3 handover delay vs 1 validation failure).
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用事件記錄中的具體時間戳記，以證明高風險分類及交接延遲。解釋 8 個已完成請求中有 6 個達到 20 分鐘商戶成功至平台營運目標，得出 75%。將主要缺口連結至政策的分類規則（3 個交接延遲對 1 個驗證失敗）。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks such as reviewing the Platform Ops to Driver Ops step, sampling additional weeks, or adding monitoring alerts for stage durations. Suggests validating with Platform Ops and Driver Ops. Defines measurable acceptance criteria such as 90% of PO to DO handovers within 15 minutes.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如審查平台營運至司機營運步驟、抽樣多幾週數據，或為階段時長增設監控警示。建議與平台營運及司機營運驗證。定義可量度接納標準，例如 90% 的平台營運至司機營運交接在 15 分鐘內完成。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that the log covers only one fictional week. Notes missing root-cause evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario. Does not assert real Lalamove performance or policies.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認記錄僅涵蓋一個虛構星期。指出欠缺根本原因證據，並將聲明限於虛構情境。不聲稱 Lalamove 真實表現或政策。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover stating the primary gap, at-risk request IDs, the 75% metric, ownership (Platform Ops for handover to Driver Ops), and next steps such as process fix and monitoring. Uses clear structure and actionable language.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫簡潔交接，列明主要缺口、高風險請求編號、75% 指標、責任（平台營運負責交接至司機營運），以及流程修正及監控等下一步。使用清晰結構及可行語言。

exemplar.en: Primary workflow gap is handover delay, specifically the Platform Ops to Driver Ops handover. From the fictional log, at-risk requests with total time over 90 minutes are CR-003, CR-005, CR-007 and CR-009. Three of these show handover delay in the PO to DO stage, with durations exceeding 22.5 minutes. Only CR-007 is a validation failure. So handover delay is the primary gap. The MS to PO handover rate is 75%, as 6 of 8 completed requests met the 20-minute target. Platform Ops owns the handover to Driver Ops. I recommend adding a 15-minute alert for this stage, sampling two more weeks of data, and defining acceptance criteria as 90% of PO to DO handovers within 15 minutes. This analysis is limited to one fictional week and does not represent real Lalamove performance.
exemplar.zh: 主要流程缺口為交接延遲，特別是平台營運至司機營運的交接。根據虛構記錄，總時間超過 90 分鐘的高風險請求為 CR-003、CR-005、CR-007 及 CR-009。其中三個在平台營運至司機營運階段出現交接延遲，時長超過 22.5 分鐘。僅 CR-007 屬驗證失敗。因此主要缺口為交接延遲。商戶成功至平台營運的交接率為 75%，因 8 個已完成請求中有 6 個達到 20 分鐘目標。平台營運負責交接至司機營運。我建議為此階段增設 15 分鐘警示，抽樣多兩週數據，並定義接納標準為 90% 的平台營運至司機營運交接在 15 分鐘內完成。此分析僅限於一個虛構星期，不代表 Lalamove 真實表現。

feedback.en: All five decisions are correct. You identify handover delay as the primary gap, list CR-003, CR-005, CR-007 and CR-009 as at-risk, calculate 75% for the MS to PO handover rate, and name Platform Ops as owner of the handover to Driver Ops.
feedback.zh: 五項決策全部正確。你指出交接延遲為主要缺口，列出 CR-003、CR-005、CR-007 及 CR-009 為高風險，計算商戶成功至平台營運交接率為 75%，並指明平台營運負責交接至司機營運。

feedback.en: You cite the over-90-minute totals for the at-risk requests and explain that six of eight completed requests met the 20-minute MS to PO target. You also link the primary gap to the classification rule with three handover delays versus one validation failure.
feedback.zh: 你引用高風險請求總時間超過 90 分鐘，並解釋 8 個已完成請求中有 6 個達到 20 分鐘商戶成功至平台營運目標。你亦把主要缺口連結至分類規則，即三個交接延遲對一個驗證失敗。

feedback.en: You propose a 15-minute alert for the PO to DO step, sampling two more weeks, and an acceptance criterion of 90% within 15 minutes. These checks are concrete and test the identified requirement.
feedback.zh: 你建議為平台營運至司機營運步驟增設 15 分鐘警示，抽樣多兩週數據，並定義 90% 在 15 分鐘內的接納標準。這些檢查具體並能測試所指要求。

feedback.en: You state that the analysis is limited to one fictional week and does not represent real Lalamove performance. Consider also noting that root-cause evidence is missing beyond the log.
feedback.zh: 你說明分析僅限於一個虛構星期，不代表 Lalamove 真實表現。可進一步指出除事件記錄外仍欠缺根本原因證據。

feedback.en: Your handover is concise at 133 English words, within the 100 to 180 guidance. It includes the primary gap, evidence, the 75% metric, ownership and actionable next steps.
feedback.zh: 你的交接簡潔，英文 133 詞，符合 100 至 180 的指引。內容包括主要缺口、證據、75% 指標、責任及可行下一步。

summary.en: Strong submission. All decisions and calculations are correct and the handover is evidence based, bounded and actionable. The written work is concise and clear.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。所有決策及計算正確，交接以證據為本、範圍受控且可行。書面內容簡潔清晰。

nextSteps.en: Keep the same structure for similar analyses. If repeating this task, add one sentence noting that root-cause evidence is limited so the uncertainty section is even stronger.
nextSteps.zh: 同類分析可沿用此結構。若重做此任務，可加一句指出根本原因證據有限，令不確定性部分更完整。

brief.en: You are a business analyst at a Hong Kong on-demand delivery platform. A fictional merchant, Sunrise Noodles, submitted four booking improvement requirements. You have a one-time budget of HKD 180,000 and must select the set that maximizes estimated monthly reduction in late bookings while meeting all eligibility and prerequisite conditions. Review the supplied documents. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Include your decision, calculations, risks and next steps. Around 100 to 180 words.
brief.zh: 您是一家香港即時配送平台的商業分析師。虛構商戶「朝陽麵店」提交了四項預約改善需求。您有一筆港幣180,000元的一次性預算，必須在符合所有資格及先決條件下，選出能最大程度減少每月延誤預約的組合。請查閱提供的文件。然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫一份簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明。包括您的決策、計算、風險及下一步。約100至180字。

body.en:
Requirement ID | Description | One-time cost (HKD) | Estimated monthly reduction in late bookings | Eligibility and prerequisites
R1 | Auto-assign nearest driver for multi-stop bookings | 60,000 | 220 | None
R2 | Merchant bulk booking API with real-time slot availability | 75,000 | 280 | Requires existing API integration and R1 implemented first
R3 | Recurring booking templates with driver preference | 45,000 | 150 | Merchant must be Gold tier
R4 | Dynamic buffer time suggestions based on traffic | 90,000 | 310 | Merchant must have at least 12 months history and monthly orders >= 1000
All costs are one-time. Estimated reductions are monthly compared to current baseline. No other dependencies.
body.zh:
需求編號 | 描述 | 一次性成本（港幣） | 每月預計減少延誤預約 | 資格及先決條件
R1 | 為多站點預約自動分配最近司機 | 60,000 | 220 | 無
R2 | 商戶批量預約API及實時時段可用性 | 75,000 | 280 | 需要現有API整合，並先實施R1
R3 | 含司機偏好的週期性預約範本 | 45,000 | 150 | 商戶必須為金級
R4 | 基於交通的動態緩衝時間建議 | 90,000 | 310 | 商戶必須有至少12個月歷史，且每月訂單 >= 1000
所有成本均為一次性。預計減少量為每月與當前基準比較。無其他依賴。

body.en: Fictional policy for this simulation. The total one-time implementation budget is HKD 180,000. Only requirements that meet all eligibility conditions for the merchant may be selected. Tier and history are confirmed in the merchant profile. A requirement with a prerequisite can only be selected if its prerequisite is also selected. No partial implementations. The objective is to maximize total estimated monthly reduction in late bookings within the budget.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構政策。一次性實施總預算為港幣180,000元。只有符合商戶所有資格條件的需求才可選取。等級及歷史於商戶概況中確認。有先決條件的需求，必須同時選取其先決條件才可選取。不可部分實施。目標是在預算內最大程度減少每月延誤預約總數。

body.en: Sunrise Noodles is a fictional merchant. Tier: Gold. Months active: 18. Monthly orders: 1,200. Existing API integration: No. The merchant has submitted the four requirement proposals above. All other conditions not stated are not met.
body.zh: 朝陽麵店為虛構商戶。等級：金級。活躍月數：18。每月訂單：1,200。現有API整合：無。該商戶已提交上述四項需求提案。所有其他未說明的條件均不符合。

label.en: Which requirement is NOT eligible for Sunrise Noodles?
label.zh: 哪一項需求不符合朝陽麵店的資格？

label.en: Which requirements are eligible for Sunrise Noodles? (Select all that apply)
label.zh: 哪些需求符合朝陽麵店的資格？（選取所有適用者）

label.en: Which set of requirements maximizes the total estimated monthly reduction within the HKD 180,000 budget?
label.zh: 在港幣180,000元預算內，哪一組需求能最大程度減少每月延誤預約？

label.en: What is the total one-time cost of the optimal set? (Unit: HKD)
label.zh: 最佳組合的總一次性成本是多少？（單位：港幣）

label.en: What is the total estimated monthly reduction in late bookings for the optimal set? (Unit: bookings)
label.zh: 最佳組合每月預計減少的延誤預約總數是多少？（單位：預約）

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover stating the selected set R1 and R4, total cost HKD 150,000, expected reduction 530 late bookings per month. Notes R2 ineligible. Suggests next step: product owner to confirm and schedule implementation. Escalation if budget or eligibility changes.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫簡潔交接，列明所選組合R1及R4、總成本港幣150,000元、每月預計減少530宗延誤預約。註明R2不符合資格。建議下一步：產品負責人確認並安排實施。若預算或資格有變則上報。

exemplar.en: Decision: Implement R1 and R4 for Sunrise Noodles. Total one-time cost is HKD 150,000, within the HKD 180,000 budget. Estimated monthly reduction in late bookings is 530 (220 from R1 plus 310 from R4). R2 is ineligible because the merchant has no existing API integration. R3 is eligible but adding it to R1 and R4 would cost HKD 195,000, exceeding the budget. R1 plus R3 alone would cost HKD 105,000 and reduce 370 late bookings. R3 plus R4 would cost HKD 135,000 and reduce 460. Therefore R1 and R4 give the highest reduction within budget. Risks: estimates are synthetic and may not reflect real traffic or driver supply. Next step: confirm merchant details, then pilot R1 and R4 before full rollout. Owner: product owner for merchant tools.
exemplar.zh: 決策：為朝陽麵店實施R1及R4。總一次性成本為港幣150,000元，在港幣180,000元預算內。每月預計減少延誤預約530宗（R1的220宗加R4的310宗）。R2不符合資格，因商戶沒有現有API整合。R3符合資格，但若與R1及R4一同實施將花費港幣195,000元，超出預算。僅R1加R3成本港幣105,000元，減少370宗延誤預約。R3加R4成本港幣135,000元，減少460宗。因此R1及R4在預算內提供最高減少量。風險：估算屬合成數據，未必反映真實交通或司機供應。下一步：確認商戶資料，然後試行R1及R4再全面推出。負責人：商戶工具產品負責人。

feedback.en: All five responses are correct: R2 is ineligible, eligible set is R1 R3 R4, optimal set is R1 and R4, cost HKD 150,000 and reduction 530. Your comparison of R1+R3+R4 at HKD 195,000 against the HKD 180,000 budget cap is accurate.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確：R2不符合資格、合資格組合為R1 R3 R4、最佳組合為R1及R4、成本港幣150,000元、減少量530宗。你以港幣195,000元對比港幣180,000元預算上限的比較準確。

feedback.en: You tie the decision to the requirement table costs and reductions plus the merchant profile point that there is no existing API integration. Adding the merchant's Gold tier and 18-month history as extra evidence for R3 and R4 eligibility would make the reasoning complete.
feedback.zh: 你把決策連結至需求表的成本及減少量，以及商戶概況中無現有API整合的要點。若補充商戶為金級及18個月歷史作為R3及R4資格的額外證據，推理會更完整。

feedback.en: Confirming merchant details and piloting R1 and R4 before rollout is a useful check. Add explicit verification of API integration status, tier and order history and budget availability with no hidden costs to cover all prerequisites.
feedback.zh: 確認商戶資料並在全面推出前試行R1及R4是有用的檢查。請補充明確核實API整合狀態、等級與訂單歷史，以及預算可用且無隱藏成本，以涵蓋所有先決條件。

feedback.en: You correctly flag that the reduction estimates are synthetic and may not reflect real traffic or driver supply. Naming seasonality and stating that the scenario and figures are fictional would strengthen the scope limit.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出減少量估算屬合成數據，未必反映真實交通或司機供應。若同時提及季節性並說明情境與數字均為虛構，範圍界定會更強。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable with the selected set, cost, reduction, the excluded R2, a pilot next step and a named owner. It stays within the 132-word guidance range.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，列明所選組合、成本、減少量、被排除的R2、試行下一步及指定負責人。內容亦在132字的建議範圍內。

summary.en: Strong submission. All calculation and selection answers are correct and the handover is clear and well evidenced. Minor gaps remain in verifying every prerequisite and fully bounding the synthetic scenario.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。所有計算及選項答案正確，交接清晰且證據充分。在核實所有先決條件及完整界定合成情境方面仍有少許不足。

nextSteps.en: Add checks for API integration status, Gold tier and order history, and budget availability, and state that traffic, driver supply and seasonality are unverified so results may differ.
nextSteps.zh: 請補充檢查API整合狀態、金級與訂單歷史及預算可用性，並說明交通、司機供應及季節性未經核實，實際結果可能有所不同。

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by Lalamove, not endorsed by it. You are a business analyst supporting a fictional Hong Kong merchant, Kowloon Kitchen, which has a support escalation backlog and has submitted four improvement requirements. You have a one-time budget of HKD 150,000. Select the requirement set that maximises total estimated monthly reduction in escalation backlog while meeting every eligibility condition and prerequisite. Review the three supplied documents, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering your decision, calculations, risks and next steps. Around 100 to 180 words.
brief.zh: 獨立學習模擬，靈感來自 Lalamove，未獲其認可。您是一名商業分析師，支援虛構香港商戶「九龍廚房」。該商戶有支援升級積壓，並提交了四項改善需求。您有一筆港幣150,000元的一次性預算。請選出能在符合所有資格條件及先決條件下，最大程度減少每月升級積壓總數的需求組合。查閱三份文件後，以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，涵蓋決策、計算、風險及下一步。約100至180字。

body.en:
Fictional requirement register. Costs are one-time, in HKD. Reductions are estimated monthly changes against the current escalation backlog baseline.
E1 Automated escalation triage. Cost 55,000. Reduction 140. Eligibility: none. Prerequisites: none.
E2 Knowledge base refresh for top escalation reasons. Cost 35,000. Reduction 100. Eligibility: the merchant must already operate a knowledge base. Prerequisites: none.
E3 Dedicated escalation manager. Cost 85,000. Reduction 210. Eligibility: the merchant must be Gold tier. Prerequisites: E1 must be selected.
E4 Real-time escalation dashboard. Cost 70,000. Reduction 180. Eligibility: at least 12 months of order history and at least 1,000 monthly orders. Prerequisites: none.
Eligibility conditions are facts about the merchant. Prerequisites are selection dependencies. No other dependencies apply.
body.zh:
虛構需求登記冊。成本為一次性，以港幣計。減少量為相對目前升級積壓基準的每月估算變化。
E1 自動化升級分流。成本 55,000。減少量 140。資格條件：無。先決條件：無。
E2 針對主要升級原因的知識庫更新。成本 35,000。減少量 100。資格條件：商戶必須已設有知識庫。先決條件：無。
E3 專責升級經理。成本 85,000。減少量 210。資格條件：商戶必須為金級。先決條件：必須選取 E1。
E4 實時升級儀表板。成本 70,000。減少量 180。資格條件：至少12個月訂單歷史，且每月訂單至少1,000。先決條件：無。
資格條件為商戶的事實。先決條件為選取依賴。並無其他依賴。

body.en: The total one-time implementation budget is HKD 150,000. Only requirements that satisfy every eligibility condition for the merchant may be selected. A requirement with a prerequisite may be selected only if that prerequisite is also selected. Partial implementation is not allowed. The objective is to maximise the total estimated monthly reduction in escalation backlog within the budget. Where two feasible sets tie on total reduction, record the tie rather than choosing by cost. Unless the merchant profile states otherwise, a condition is not met. All amounts are HKD.
body.zh: 一次性實施總預算為港幣150,000元。只有符合商戶所有資格條件的需求方可選取。有先決條件的需求，僅在其先決條件亦被選取時方可選取。不可部分實施。目標是在預算內最大程度減少每月升級積壓總數。若有兩個可行組合的總減少量相同，須記錄該平手情況，而非按成本選擇。除商戶概況另有說明外，條件一律視為不符合。所有金額以港幣計。

body.en: Kowloon Kitchen is a fictional merchant in this simulation. Confirmed profile facts. Tier: Gold. Months of order history: 14. Monthly orders: 1,100. Existing knowledge base: none. Existing API integration: none. Support agents: 4. Average current monthly escalation backlog: 900 escalations. The merchant has submitted requirements E1 to E4. Any condition not listed here is not met.
body.zh: 九龍廚房為本模擬的虛構商戶。已確認概況事實。等級：金級。訂單歷史月數：14。每月訂單：1,100。現有知識庫：無。現有API整合：無。支援人員：4。目前平均每月升級積壓：900個升級個案。該商戶已提交需求 E1 至 E4。此處未列出的任何條件均不符合。

label.en: Which requirement is NOT eligible for Kowloon Kitchen?
label.zh: 哪一項需求不符合九龍廚房的資格？

label.en: Which requirements are eligible for Kowloon Kitchen? (Select all that apply)
label.zh: 哪些需求符合九龍廚房的資格？（選取所有適用者）

label.en: Which set of requirements maximises the total estimated monthly reduction within the HKD 150,000 budget?
label.zh: 在港幣150,000元預算內，哪一組需求能最大程度減少每月升級積壓總數？

label.en: What is the total one-time cost of the optimal set? (Unit: HKD)
label.zh: 最佳組合的總一次性成本是多少？（單位：港幣）

label.en: What is the total estimated monthly reduction in escalation backlog for the optimal set? (Unit: escalations)
label.zh: 最佳組合每月預計減少的升級積壓總數是多少？（單位：升級個案）

about.en: Lalamove describes an on-demand delivery platform founded in Hong Kong in 2013, connecting people and businesses with delivery vehicles.
about.zh: Lalamove 介紹其為 2013 年於香港創立的即時配送平台，連結個人、企業及配送車輛。

publicValues.zh: 快捷、簡單及實惠的配送

simulationStyle.en: Analyse fictional merchant processes, prioritise requirements and compare synthetic operating costs or budget variances. Explain assumptions and service limits without claims about real company finances or platform performance.
simulationStyle.zh: 分析虛構商戶流程、排列需求優先次序，並比較合成營運成本或預算差異。解釋假設及服務限制，不聲稱代表真實公司財務或平台表現。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Rank supplied requirements under an explicit objective, budget and eligibility conditions.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按明確目標、預算及合資格條件排列提供的需求。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Rank supplied requirements under an explicit objective, budget and eligibility conditions.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按明確目標、預算及合資格條件排列提供的需求。

expectedEvidence.en: Identifies E2 as ineligible because the merchant operates no existing knowledge base. Identifies E1, E3 and E4 as eligible: E3 meets the Gold tier condition, E4 meets both the 12-month history and the 1,000 monthly order conditions. Applies the prerequisite that E3 requires E1 to be selected. Enumerates feasible sets within HKD 150,000: E1 alone (cost 55,000, reduction 140), E4 alone (70,000, 180), E1+E4 (125,000, 320), E1+E3 (140,000, 350). Selects E1+E3 because it delivers the highest total estimated monthly reduction within budget, not because of cost efficiency per HKD. Reports total cost HKD 140,000 and total reduction 350 escalations, both within the budget and below the 900 escalation baseline. E1+E3+E4 is rejected as costing 210,000, above budget.
expectedEvidence.zh: 識別 E2 不符合資格，因商戶並無現有知識庫。識別 E1、E3 及 E4 符合資格：E3 符合金級條件，E4 同時符合12個月歷史及每月1,000訂單條件。應用 E3 須先選取 E1 的先決條件。列舉港幣150,000元內可行組合：E1 單獨（成本 55,000，減少量 140）、E4 單獨（70,000，180）、E1+E4（125,000，320）、E1+E3（140,000，350）。選擇 E1+E3，因其在預算內提供最高每月預計總減少量，而非基於每港幣成本效益。報告總成本港幣140,000元，總減少量350個升級個案，兩者均在預算內，並低於900個升級個案基準。E1+E3+E4 因成本210,000超出預算而被否決。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites specific figures from the requirement register: E1 cost 55,000 and reduction 140, E2 cost 35,000 and reduction 100 but ineligible, E3 cost 85,000 and reduction 210 with Gold tier condition and E1 prerequisite, E4 cost 70,000 and reduction 180 with 12-month and 1,000-order conditions. Cites the merchant profile: Gold tier, 14 months, 1,100 monthly orders, no knowledge base, 900 escalation baseline. Explains why E2 is excluded on eligibility evidence and why E4 is excluded on lower total reduction within budget rather than on cost efficiency per HKD.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用需求登記冊的具體數字：E1 成本55,000、減少量140；E2 成本35,000、減少量100但不符合資格；E3 成本85,000、減少量210，具金級條件及 E1 先決條件；E4 成本70,000、減少量180，具12個月及1,000訂單條件。引用商戶概況：金級、14個月、每月1,100訂單、無知識庫、900個升級個案基準。解釋為何基於資格證據排除 E2，以及為何基於預算內總減少量較低而非每港幣成本效益來排除 E4。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes reconfirming merchant profile facts (knowledge base status, tier, months active, monthly orders) with the merchant before committing. Suggests validating the cost and reduction estimates with internal data or a pilot on E1. Recommends confirming the E1 prerequisite sequencing. Next steps include budget approval, implementing E1 before E3, and monitoring actual escalation reduction against the 900 baseline.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議在承諾前與商戶重新確認商戶概況事實（知識庫狀態、等級、活躍月數、每月訂單）。建議以內部數據或 E1 試點驗證成本及減少量估算。建議確認 E1 先決條件的排序。下一步包括預算批准、先實施 E1 再實施 E3，並對照900個升級個案基準監測實際減少量。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges the reductions and costs are fictional estimates and unvalidated. States the scenario is limited to the supplied assumptions, budget and merchant profile. Notes missing evidence such as real escalation data, hidden dependencies and merchant-specific operational constraints. Does not claim or imply real Lalamove performance, finances or endorsement.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認減少量及成本為虛構估算且未經驗證。指出情境限於提供的假設、預算及商戶概況。指出缺失證據，如實際升級數據、潛在隱藏依賴及商戶特定營運限制。不聲稱或暗示代表 Lalamove 真實表現、財務或認可。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Delivers a concise handover stating the decision, the supporting evidence, the arithmetic (55,000 + 85,000 = 140,000 and 140 + 210 = 350), the risks, and the next steps. Names an owner or escalation route, for example the analyst documents and the team lead approves the budget. Structured so a colleague can act on it without further clarification.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提交簡潔交接，列明決策、支持證據、計算（55,000 + 85,000 = 140,000 及 140 + 210 = 350）、風險及下一步。指明負責人或轉交途徑，例如分析師記錄、團隊主管批准預算。結構化以便同事無須進一步澄清即可行動。

exemplar.en:
Decision: select E1 and E3. Total one-time cost HKD 140,000, within the HKD 150,000 budget. Total estimated monthly reduction 350 escalations, against a 900 escalation baseline.

Evidence: E2 is ineligible because the merchant has no existing knowledge base. E3 is eligible because the merchant is Gold tier, and its prerequisite E1 is selected. E4 is eligible (14 months history, 1,100 monthly orders) but E4 alone gives 180 and E1+E4 gives 320, both below the 350 from E1+E3. E1+E3+E4 would cost 210,000, above budget. Calculation: 55,000 + 85,000 = 140,000. 140 + 210 = 350.

Risks: the reductions are fictional estimates with no pilot data. E3 depends on E1 implementation succeeding. Prerequisite sequencing is assumed, not yet confirmed.

Next steps: reconfirm profile facts with the merchant, pilot E1 and measure actual escalation reduction, then release E3. Owner: analyst documents, team lead approves budget.
exemplar.zh:
決策：選擇 E1 及 E3。總一次性成本港幣140,000元，在港幣150,000元預算之內。每月預計總減少量350個升級個案，對照900個升級個案基準。

證據：E2 不符合資格，因商戶沒有現有知識庫。E3 符合資格，因商戶為金級，且其先決條件 E1 已被選取。E4 符合資格（14個月歷史、每月1,100訂單），但 E4 單獨為180，E1+E4 為320，均低於 E1+E3 的350。E1+E3+E4 成本為210,000，超出預算。計算：55,000 + 85,000 = 140,000。140 + 210 = 350。

風險：減少量為虛構估算，並無試點數據。E3 依賴 E1 實施成功。先決條件排序屬假設，尚未確認。

下一步：與商戶重新確認概況事實，試行 E1 並量度實際升級減少量，然後推行 E3。負責人：分析師記錄，團隊主管批准預算。

feedback.en: All five answers and the handover are correct. You identify E2 as ineligible due to no existing knowledge base, confirm E1, E3 and E4 as eligible, apply the E1 prerequisite for E3, and select E1+E3 at HKD 140,000 for 350 escalations against the 900 baseline.
feedback.zh: 五項答案及交接全部正確。你識別 E2 因沒有現有知識庫而不符合資格，確認 E1、E3 及 E4 符合資格，應用了 E3 的 E1 先決條件，並選擇 E1+E3，成本港幣140,000元，減少量350個升級個案，對照900個基準。

feedback.en: Your reasoning cites the specific register figures (55,000, 85,000, 140, 210, 180, 320) and profile facts (Gold tier, 14 months, 1,100 orders, no knowledge base), and correctly excludes E4 on lower total reduction rather than cost per HKD.
feedback.zh: 你的推理引用了登記冊具體數字（55,000、85,000、140、210、180、320）及概況事實（金級、14個月、1,100訂單、無知識庫），並正確地基於總減少量而非每港幣成本來排除 E4。

feedback.en: Next steps reconfirm merchant profile facts, pilot E1 to measure actual reduction, then release E3, with the analyst documenting and the team lead approving budget. This is concrete and actionable.
feedback.zh: 下一步包括重新確認商戶概況事實、試行 E1 以量度實際減少量，然後推行 E3，並由分析師記錄、團隊主管批准預算，具體且可行。

feedback.en: You acknowledge the reductions are fictional estimates with no pilot data and flag the prerequisite sequencing as assumed rather than confirmed, keeping claims within the supplied scenario.
feedback.zh: 你承認減少量為虛構估算且無試點數據，並指出先決條件排序屬假設而非已確認，把聲明限於提供的情境之內。

feedback.en: The handover is concise (149 words) and clearly structured with decision, evidence, arithmetic, risks, next steps and an owner, so a colleague could act on it directly.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔（149字），結構清晰，涵蓋決策、證據、計算、風險、下一步及負責人，同事可直接據此行動。

summary.en: Excellent submission: all answers are correct and the 149-word handover fully covers decision, evidence, calculations, risks and next steps with an owner named. No material gaps found.
summary.zh: 表現優異：所有答案正確，149字交接完整涵蓋決策、證據、計算、風險及下一步，並指明負責人。未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: No remediation needed. In future work you could briefly state the non-endorsement scope wording to strengthen bounded-claims coverage, but your current evidence is sufficient.
nextSteps.zh: 無須補救。日後可簡述非認可的範圍措辭以加強範圍及不確定性部分，但現有證據已足夠。

title.en: Support an access enquiry for a Klook experience
title.zh: 處理 Klook 體驗的無障礙查詢

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist in an independent learning simulation inspired by Klook. A customer has confirmed three functional needs for a booked experience. Read the fictional case log, venue access sheet and support policy. Decide which needs are supported, which lack evidence, and what to escalate. Produce a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. All policies and records are fictional.
brief.zh: 你是獨立學習模擬中的客戶營運專員，情境靈感來自 Klook。一名客戶已就預訂體驗確認三項功能需要。請閱讀虛構個案紀錄、虛構場地無障礙資料及虛構支援政策，判斷哪些需要已獲支援、哪些欠缺證據，以及須轉交甚麼。請以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，約 100 至 180 字。所有政策及紀錄均屬虛構。

body.en: Booking KX-88213 is for the Harbour Night Market Walk on 14 March, 19:00 start. The customer confirmed three functional needs by message on 2 March. Need one: enter and leave the venue without using stairs. Need two: a companion must stay with the customer throughout the walk. Need three: a seated rest point at the meeting point. The customer did not state any other need. The venue access sheet was last updated in January. The customer asked for written confirmation before 10 March. No companion ticket has been issued yet. The booking is paid in full.
body.zh: 預訂 KX-88213 為 3 月 14 日 19:00 出發的「海港夜市漫步」。客戶於 3 月 2 日以訊息確認三項功能需要。需要一：不使用樓梯進出場地。需要二：全程由同行者陪同。需要三：集合點設有座位休息點。客戶沒有說明其他需要。場地無障礙資料最後於 1 月更新。客戶要求於 3 月 10 日前獲書面確認。同行者門票尚未發出。預訂已全額付款。

body.en: Harbour Night Market Walk. Step-free route: the east gate has a level entrance and a lift to the meeting point. The west gate has 12 steps and no lift. Meeting point: Pier 4 kiosk, reachable by the east gate route. Companion policy: one companion may join at no extra charge when the lead booker requests it at least 5 days before the start time. The sheet does not state whether the walk route itself is step-free. The sheet does not state seating or rest points.

body.en: Confirm only needs that the supplied venue sheet supports. Escalate any confirmed need with no supporting evidence to the access review queue within one working day. Do not infer ability from any label. If a companion request is made at least 5 days before the start time, issue one free companion ticket. If it is made later, escalate to the access review queue. Record the booking ID, the confirmed needs, the evidence used and the escalation reason in the handover.

All records are fictional.
