title.en: Support an access enquiry for a Klook-inspired cruise
title.zh: 處理 Klook 靈感遊船的無障礙查詢

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist in an independent learning simulation inspired by Klook. A customer has confirmed three functional needs for a booked cruise. Read the fictional case log, service sheet and support policy. Decide which needs are supported, which lack evidence, and what to escalate. Produce a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. All policies and records are fictional and not endorsed by Klook.
brief.zh: 你是獨立學習模擬中的客戶營運專員，情境靈感來自 Klook。一名客戶已就預訂遊船確認三項功能需要。請閱讀虛構個案紀錄、服務資料及支援政策。判斷哪些需要已獲支援、哪些欠缺證據，以及須轉交甚麼。請以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，約 100 至 180 字。所有政策及紀錄均屬虛構，未經 Klook 認可。

body.en: Booking KX-11223 is for the Victoria Harbour Evening Cruise with Live Narration on 20 April, 19:30 start. The customer confirmed three functional needs on 1 April. Need one: live captions for all spoken narration. Need two: a printed transcript available before boarding. Need three: departure no later than 19:40 due to a connecting flight. The live caption request was made 10 days before start. The printed transcript request was made 12 days before start. The customer asked for written confirmation before 15 April. The booking is paid in full. No companion ticket is requested.
body.zh: 預訂 KX-11223 為 4 月 20 日 19:30 出發的「維多利亞港夜間遊船」，設現場旁述。客戶於 4 月 1 日確認三項功能需要。需要一：所有口述旁述提供現場字幕。需要二：登船前提供印刷版文字稿。需要三：因轉機關係，出發時間不遲於 19:40。現場字幕要求於出發前 10 天提出。印刷版文字稿要求於出發前 12 天提出。客戶要求於 4 月 15 日前獲書面確認。預訂已全額付款，沒有要求同行者門票。

body.en: Victoria Harbour Evening Cruise with Live Narration. Scheduled departure 19:30. Boarding opens 19:00. Live captions: available via a mobile app when requested at least 14 days before the scheduled departure. Printed transcript: available for collection at the ticket office when requested at least 7 days before the scheduled departure. The sheet does not state any policy on departure delays or on-time performance. The sheet does not state whether the live caption app works on all phones. The sheet does not state the duration of the cruise. The sheet does not state seating arrangements.
body.zh: 維多利亞港夜間遊船，設現場旁述。預計出發時間 19:30。登船於 19:00 開始。現場字幕：於預計出發時間至少 14 天前提出，可透過手機應用程式提供。印刷版文字稿：於預計出發時間至少 7 天前提出，可於售票處領取。資料沒有說明任何出發延誤或準時表現政策。資料沒有說明現場字幕應用程式是否適用於所有手機。資料沒有說明遊船時長。資料沒有說明座位安排。

body.en: Confirm only needs that the supplied service sheet supports. Escalate any confirmed need with no supporting evidence to the access review queue. For live captions, if the request is made at least 14 days before departure, issue the caption access code. If later, escalate to the access review queue. For printed transcripts, if the request is made at least 7 days before departure, confirm collection at the ticket office. If later, escalate. For timing needs, if the service sheet does not state a delay policy, escalate. Record booking ID, needs, evidence and escalation reason in the handover.
body.zh: 只確認服務資料有支援的需要。任何已確認但欠缺支援證據的需要，須轉交無障礙審核隊列。現場字幕：若於出發前至少 14 天提出，可發出字幕存取碼。若較遲提出，須轉交無障礙審核隊列。印刷版文字稿：若於出發前至少 7 天提出，可確認於售票處領取。若較遲提出，須轉交。時間需要：若服務資料沒有說明延誤政策，須轉交。交接須記錄預訂編號、需要、證據及轉交原因。

label.zh: 確認，因要求於出發前 10 天提出

label.en: Confirm, because the cruise always departs on time

The escalation owner is the access review queue.
expectedEvidence.zh: 需要一現場字幕須轉交，因要求於出發前 10 天提出，而服務資料要求至少 14 天前提出。需要二印刷版文字稿獲確認，因要求於出發前 12 天提出，符合 7 天要求，且資料確認可於售票處領取。需要三出發時間須轉交，因服務資料沒有說明延誤政策。須轉交的已確認需要共 2 項。現場字幕要求於出發前 10 天提出。轉交負責方為無障礙審核隊列。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the case log for request timings (10 days and 12 days before start) and the 19:40 timing requirement. Cites the service sheet for the 14-day caption policy, the 7-day transcript policy, and the absence of a delay policy. Cites the support policy for escalation rules. Explains that 10 is less than 14 so captions escalate, 12 is greater than 7 so transcript is confirmed, and no delay policy means timing escalates. Notes that companion ticket is not relevant.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用個案紀錄說明要求時間（出發前 10 天及 12 天）及 19:40 時間要求。引用服務資料說明 14 天字幕政策、7 天文字稿政策及沒有延誤政策。引用支援政策說明轉交規則。解釋 10 少於 14 所以字幕須轉交，12 大於 7 所以文字稿獲確認，沒有延誤政策所以時間需要須轉交。說明同行者門票與此個案無關。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes to verify exact request dates against policy, confirm transcript collection hours with the ticket office, check if any delay policy exists elsewhere, confirm escalation recipient, and set a reminder for written confirmation before 15 April. Suggests asking the service provider for on-time performance data.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議核對確切要求日期與政策是否相符，向售票處確認文字稿領取時間，查核是否有其他延誤政策，確認轉交接收方，並設定於 4 月 15 日前發出書面確認的提醒。建議向服務供應商查詢準時表現數據。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that the service sheet does not state a delay policy or caption app compatibility, that all policies are fictional, that no inference about customer ability from labels is made, and that claims are limited to this booking and supplied evidence.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認服務資料沒有說明延誤政策或字幕應用程式兼容性，所有政策均屬虛構，沒有從任何標籤推斷客戶能力，並把聲明限於此預訂及提供證據。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover includes booking ID KX-11223, three needs with statuses, evidence from case log and service sheet, escalation to access review queue for 2 needs, confirmation for transcript, and next step to check delay policy. Written in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, clear and actionable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接包括預訂編號 KX-11223、三項需要及其狀態、來自個案紀錄及服務資料的證據、將 2 項需要轉交無障礙審核隊列、確認文字稿，以及查核延誤政策的下一步。以英文或繁體中文撰寫，約 100 至 180 字，清晰可行。

exemplar.en: Booking KX-11223 for the Victoria Harbour Evening Cruise on 20 April. Three confirmed functional needs. Need one live captions: the case log shows the request was made 10 days before departure. The service sheet requires at least 14 days. Per support policy, this is a late request and must be escalated to the access review queue. Need two printed transcript: request made 12 days before, which meets the 7-day requirement and the sheet confirms collection at the ticket office. Confirm this need. Need three departure no later than 19:40: the service sheet does not state any delay policy. Per policy, escalate this need to the access review queue. Therefore two needs require escalation. Next step: send the transcript confirmation to the customer and escalate the captions and timing needs to the access review queue. Also verify if any delay policy exists elsewhere before the escalation. All records are fictional.
exemplar.zh: 預訂 KX-11223，維多利亞港夜間遊船，4 月 20 日出發。三項已確認功能需要。需要一：現場字幕。個案紀錄顯示要求於出發前 10 天提出，服務資料要求至少 14 天前提出。根據支援政策，此屬逾期要求，須轉交無障礙審核隊列。需要二：印刷版文字稿。要求於出發前 12 天提出，符合 7 天前的要求，服務資料確認可於售票處領取，因此確認此需要。需要三：出發時間不遲於 19:40。服務資料沒有說明延誤政策，根據政策須轉交無障礙審核隊列。因此兩項需要須轉交。下一步：向客戶發送文字稿確認，並將字幕及時間需要轉交無障礙審核隊列。轉交前先核查是否有其他延誤政策。所有紀錄均屬虛構。

feedback.en: All six answers are correct: need one escalates because 10 days is short of the 14-day caption rule, need two is confirmed under the 7-day transcript rule, need three escalates because no delay policy is stated, the caption request is 10 days, escalation count is 2, and the access review queue owns it.
feedback.zh: 六項答案全部正確：需要一因10天少於14天字幕規定而須轉交，需要二符合7天文字稿規定而獲確認，需要三因未載延誤政策而須轉交，字幕要求為10天前，轉交數目為2項，並由無障礙審核隊列負責。

feedback.en: You tie each decision to the case log timings, the service sheet thresholds and the support policy escalation rule, and your comparisons of 10 against 14 and 12 against 7 are clear. Adding that the companion ticket is irrelevant here would complete the source coverage.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決定連繫到個案紀錄的時間、服務資料的門檻及支援政策的轉交規則，10對14及12對7的比較清晰。若補充同行者門票在此個案無關，來源覆蓋會更完整。

feedback.en: You propose checking whether a delay policy exists elsewhere, which is the right key check, and you set out the transcript confirmation and escalations. Add concrete checks such as confirming transcript collection hours with the ticket office, a reminder for written confirmation before 15 April, and asking the provider for on-time performance data.
feedback.zh: 你提出查核是否有其他延誤政策，這正是關鍵檢查，並列明文字稿確認及轉交行動。建議補充具體檢查，例如向售票處確認領取時間、設定4月15日前書面確認的提醒，以及向供應商查詢準時表現數據。

feedback.en: You correctly note the service sheet is silent on departure delays and that all records are fictional. You do not mention the unstated caption app compatibility or that you draw no inference about customer ability, so the uncertainty section stays partial.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出服務資料未述出發延誤，並說明所有紀錄均屬虛構。你未提及字幕應用程式兼容性未載，也未說明沒有從標籤推斷客戶能力，因此不確定性部分仍屬部分完成。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 150 words and gives the booking ID, all three needs with statuses, evidence, the two escalations to the access review queue, the transcript confirmation and a next step. It is clear and directly actionable.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，共150字，列明預訂編號、三項需要及狀態、證據、將兩項需要轉交無障礙審核隊列、文字稿確認及下一步，清晰且可直接執行。

summary.en: Your decisions and calculations are fully accurate and your handover is clear and correctly scoped to booking KX-11223. Evidence citation is strong. The main gaps are extra verification steps and fuller uncertainty notes.
summary.zh: 你的決策與計算完全準確，交接清晰並正確聚焦於預訂 KX-11223，證據引用充足。主要不足在於額外核實步驟及更完整的不確定性說明。

nextSteps.en: Add concrete verification actions such as confirming transcript collection hours and a 15 April reminder, and note the unstated caption app compatibility and the absence of any ability inference.
nextSteps.zh: 補充具體核實行動，例如確認文字稿領取時間及4月15日提醒，並註明字幕應用程式兼容性未載及沒有推斷客戶能力。

title.en: Resolve a duplicate attraction booking case
title.zh: 處理重複景點預訂個案

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist at Klook (independent learning simulation, not endorsed by Klook). A customer booked the same attraction twice within minutes. Apply the fictional cancellation and escalation rules in the sources, answer the questions, and write a concise privacy-aware handover in English or Traditional Chinese (around 100 to 180 words).
brief.zh: 你是 Klook 的客戶營運專員（獨立學習模擬，並非 Klook 官方認可）。一名客戶在數分鐘內重複預訂同一景點。請應用文件中的虛構取消及轉交規則，回答問題，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔、顧及私隱交接說明。

body.en: Fictional simulation data. Case K-4471. Customer booked 'Harbour Lights Sky Deck' twice on the same day. Booking A: reference KL-88231, paid HKD 640, created 14:02. Booking B: reference KL-88247, paid HKD 640, created 14:06. Both are non-refundable standard tickets for the same date and same two visitors. The customer says the second purchase was accidental and asks for a refund of Booking B only. No duplicate-booking exception has been confirmed yet.
body.zh: 虛構模擬資料。個案 K-4471。客戶於同日兩次預訂「海港燈光觀景台」。預訂A：編號 KL-88231，已付港幣640元，於14:02建立。預訂B：編號 KL-88247，已付港幣640元，於14:06建立。兩者均為同一日期、同兩位訪客的不可退款標準門票。客戶表示第二次購買屬意外，要求只退款預訂B。重複預訂例外尚未獲確認。

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. Duplicate bookings qualify for a refund of the later booking only when all three conditions hold: same attraction, same visit date, and the later booking was created within 30 minutes of the earlier one. The refund equals the amount paid for the later booking. If any condition is unconfirmed, do not promise a refund and escalate to the Refunds Review team within one working day. Never share another person's booking details or payment data in a customer reply.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。重複預訂僅在以下三項條件全部成立時，方可退款較後的一筆預訂：同一景點、同一到訪日期，以及較後預訂於較早預訂後30分鐘內建立。退款金額等於較後預訂的已付金額。若有任何條件未獲確認，不得承諾退款，並須於一個工作天內轉交退款審核團隊。客戶回覆中不得披露他人的預訂或付款資料。

body.en: Fictional simulation message. 'I think I paid twice for the same Sky Deck visit by mistake. Please refund the second one, KL-88247. I do not want to cancel the first booking. I am travelling with my sister and we still want to go. Can you confirm today?' The customer has not provided any payment screenshot or bank record.
body.zh: 虛構模擬訊息。「我好像誤付了兩次同一觀景台門票。請退款第二筆 KL-88247。我不想取消第一筆預訂。我和妹妹同行，我們仍想前往。可否今日確認？」客戶未提供任何付款截圖或銀行紀錄。

label.en: Which condition set must be confirmed before refunding the later booking?
label.zh: 退款較後預訂前必須確認哪一組條件？

label.en: Same attraction, same visit date, later booking created within 30 minutes
label.zh: 同一景點、同一到訪日期、較後預訂於30分鐘內建立

label.en: Same attraction, any visit date, later booking created within 30 minutes
label.zh: 同一景點、任何到訪日期、較後預訂於30分鐘內建立

label.en: Same attraction, same visit date, no time limit
label.zh: 同一景點、同一到訪日期、沒有時間限制

label.en: Different attraction, same visit date, later booking created within 30 minutes
label.zh: 不同景點、同一到訪日期、較後預訂於30分鐘內建立

label.en: If all conditions are confirmed, what refund amount applies to the later booking?
label.zh: 若所有條件獲確認，較後預訂的退款金額是多少？

label.en: If any condition is unconfirmed, when must the case be escalated?
label.zh: 若有任何條件未獲確認，須於何時轉交？

label.en: Only after the customer calls again
Which statement about the customer reply is correct?
label.zh: 關於客戶回覆，哪項陳述正確？

label.en: Do not share another person's booking or payment data
label.zh: 不得披露他人的預訂或付款資料
可自由披露所有預訂編號

label.en: Share payment data if the customer asks
label.zh: 若客戶要求即可披露付款資料

label.en: Privacy rules do not apply to duplicate cases
label.zh: 私隱規則不適用於重複個案

label.en: Which conditions are already confirmed by the case log?
label.zh: 個案紀錄已確認哪些條件？
較後預訂於30分鐘內建立
重複預訂例外已獲批准

title.en: Resolve a rescheduled activity booking case
title.zh: 處理活動改期預訂個案

brief.en: You are a customer operations specialist at Klook (independent learning simulation, not endorsed by Klook). A customer received a provider-initiated reschedule for booking KL-73120 and asks for a refund. Apply the fictional cancellation and escalation rules in the sources, answer the questions, and write a concise privacy-aware handover in English or Traditional Chinese (around 100 to 180 words). Include the refund decision, calculation, escalation position, privacy handling for the companion booking, and next steps. All policies and records are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 你是 Klook 的客戶營運專員（獨立學習模擬，並非 Klook 官方認可）。一名客戶的預訂 KL-73120 被活動供應商改期，客戶要求退款。請應用文件中的虛構取消及轉交規則，回答問題，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約100至180字的簡潔、顧及私隱交接說明。內容須包括退款決定、計算、轉交立場、同行預訂的私隱處理及下一步。所有政策及紀錄均為虛構學習假設。

body.en: Fictional simulation data. Case K-5208. Booking KL-73120 is for Lantau Sunset Cable Car and Guided Walk, original visit date 2026-11-14 for two adults. Activity fare paid HKD 1,200 plus non-refundable booking fee HKD 80. Provider reference PR-4402 confirms the provider initiated a schedule change to 2026-11-15. The provider reschedule notice was sent 13 days before the original visit date. The customer explicitly declines the new slot and requests a refund. Companion booking KL-73121 belongs to a separate account. No consent or verification is recorded for that companion account.
body.zh: 虛構模擬資料。個案 K-5208。預訂 KL-73120 為大嶼山日落纜車及導賞步行團，原定到訪日期為2026-11-14，兩位成人。已付活動費用港幣1,200元，另加不可退款預訂費港幣80元。供應商參考編號 PR-4402 確認供應商主動改期至2026-11-15。供應商改期通知於原定到訪日期前13天發出。客戶明確拒絕新時段並要求退款。同行預訂 KL-73121 屬於另一個帳戶。該同行帳戶沒有同意或核實紀錄。

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. If the activity provider initiates a reschedule and sends notice at least 7 days before the original visit date, the customer may accept the new slot or receive a refund of the activity fare. The booking fee is not refundable. If provider reschedule confirmation or notice timing is missing, do not promise a refund and escalate to Resolutions within one working day. The exception is confirmed only when provider reference and notice timing are both recorded. Never share another traveller's booking or payment data, or internal provider notes, unless that traveller contacts us from their own account and passes verification.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。若活動供應商主動改期，並於原定到訪日期前至少7天發出通知，客戶可選擇接受新時段，或獲退還活動費用。預訂費不可退款。若供應商改期確認或通知時間欠缺，不得承諾退款，並須於一個工作天內轉交審核團隊。只有在供應商參考編號及通知時間均已紀錄時，例外方可確認。除非該旅客從其本人帳戶聯絡我們並通過核實，否則不得披露他人的預訂或付款資料，亦不得披露內部供應商備註。

body.en: Fictional simulation message. 'I received a notice that my Lantau Sunset Cable Car and Guided Walk moved to 15 November 2026. I cannot attend that date. Please refund booking KL-73120. My sister has booking KL-73121 for the same activity. Can you tell me her refund status and share her payment details so she does not need to contact you? We still want a same-day alternative for two adults if one is available.'
body.zh: 虛構模擬訊息。「我收到通知，我的大嶼山日落纜車及導賞步行團改期至2026年11月15日。我不能出席該日期。請退款預訂 KL-73120。我的妹妹有同一活動的預訂 KL-73121。可否告訴我她的退款狀態，並分享她的付款資料，讓她不用聯絡你們？若有兩位成人的同日替代活動，我們仍想參加。」

label.zh: 退款 KL-73120 前必須確認哪一組條件？

label.zh: 供應商主動改期，且通知於原定到訪日期前至少7天發出

label.zh: 客戶以任何理由要求退款

label.en: Customer missed the original time slot
If the exception is confirmed and the customer declines the new slot, what refund amount applies to KL-73120?

label.en: If provider reschedule confirmation is missing, when must the case be escalated?
label.zh: 若供應商改期確認欠缺，須於何時轉交？

label.en: What is the correct handling of companion booking KL-73121?
label.zh: 同行預訂 KL-73121 的正確處理方式是什麼？

label.en: Do not disclose KL-73121 details because it is a separate account with no consent
label.zh: 不得披露 KL-73121 資料，因屬另一帳戶且沒有同意

label.en: Share its refund status and payment data
label.zh: 分享其退款狀態及付款資料

label.en: Share internal provider notes about the activity
label.zh: 分享有關活動的內部供應商備註

label.en: Ask the customer to confirm the sister's identity and then share details
label.zh: 要求客戶確認妹妹身分後分享資料

label.en: Which conditions are already confirmed in the case log for KL-73120?
label.zh: 個案紀錄已確認 KL-73120 的哪些條件？

label.en: Notice sent at least 7 days before original visit date
label.zh: 通知於原定到訪日期前至少7天發出

label.en: What is the correct outcome for KL-73120?
label.zh: KL-73120 的正確結果是什麼？

label.en: Refund HKD 1,200 activity fare and no escalation because the exception is confirmed
label.zh: 退還港幣1,200元活動費用，且因例外已確認而無需轉交

about.en: Klook offers activity and travel experiences. Its public company page emphasises simplicity, authenticity and curiosity.

simulationStyle.en: Simulate booking support with clear explanations, supplied cancellation rules and an escalation handover. The booking policies are fictional.
simulationStyle.zh: 按虛構預訂政策模擬客戶支援，提供清晰說明、取消規則判斷及轉交紀錄。

exemplar.en: Case K-5208 decision: booking KL-73120 qualifies for the provider-initiated reschedule exception. Provider reference PR-4402 confirms the provider moved the Lantau Sunset Cable Car and Guided Walk from 14 November 2026 to 15 November 2026. The reschedule notice was sent 13 days before the original visit date, which meets the policy minimum of at least 7 days. The customer declines the new slot and requests a refund. Refund amount is HKD 1,200, the activity fare paid. The HKD 80 booking fee is non-refundable. No escalation to Resolutions is needed because the exception is confirmed. Next step: process the HKD 1,200 refund for KL-73120 only. For companion booking KL-73121, I cannot disclose refund status or payment data because it is under a separate account with no consent or verification. Please ask the companion to contact us from her own account. I will also check the payment record before releasing the refund.
exemplar.zh: 個案 K-5208 決定：預訂 KL-73120 符合供應商主動改期的例外。供應商參考編號 PR-4402 確認供應商把大嶼山日落纜車及導賞步行團由2026年11月14日改至2026年11月15日。改期通知於原定到訪日期前13天發出，符合政策最低7天要求。客戶拒絕新時段並要求退款。退款金額為港幣1,200元，即已付活動費用。港幣80元預訂費不可退款。因例外已確認，無需轉交審核團隊。下一步：僅為 KL-73120 處理港幣1,200元退款。就同行預訂 KL-73121，我不能披露退款狀態或付款資料，因該預訂屬另一帳戶且沒有同意或核實。請同行者從其本人帳戶聯絡我們。我亦會在發放退款前檢查付款紀錄。

feedback.en: All six answers are correct. You applied the provider-initiated reschedule exception, refunded only the HKD 1,200 activity fare and excluded the HKD 80 booking fee, and correctly stated no escalation was needed.
feedback.zh: 六題答案全部正確。你正確應用供應商主動改期例外，只退還港幣1,200元活動費用並排除港幣80元預訂費，亦正確指出無需轉交。

feedback.en: You linked each conclusion to specific records: case K-5208, booking KL-73120, provider reference PR-4402, the 13 day notice timing and both the HKD 1,200 fare and HKD 80 fee. This is precise and policy grounded.
feedback.zh: 你把每項結論連結至具體記錄：個案 K-5208、預訂 KL-73120、供應商參考編號 PR-4402、13天通知時間，以及港幣1,200元費用與港幣80元預訂費。內容精確且有政策依據。

feedback.en: You proposed checking the payment record before releasing the refund, directing the companion to contact from her own account, and processing one refund for KL-73120 only. Adding an explicit recheck of the PR-4402 notice timing record would make the verification plan complete.
feedback.zh: 你提出在發放退款前檢查付款紀錄、指示同行者從其本人帳戶聯絡，並只為 KL-73120 處理一筆退款。若再明確重查 PR-4402 通知時間紀錄，核實計劃就更完整。

feedback.en: You correctly refused to disclose KL-73121 refund status or payment data because there is no consent or verification, and kept to the supplied case. A short note that all policies here are fictional learning assumptions would strengthen scope framing.
feedback.zh: 你正確拒披露 KL-73121 的退款狀態及付款資料，因沒有同意或核實，並把內容限於提供的個案。若簡短註明所有政策均為虛構學習假設，範圍界定會更佳。

feedback.en: Your handover is 151 words, within the 100 to 180 range, and covers the refund decision, calculation, no-escalation position, KL-73121 privacy handling and next steps clearly and actionably.
feedback.zh: 你的交接為151字，在100至180字範圍內，清晰可行地涵蓋退款決定、計算、無需轉交立場、KL-73121 私隱處理及下一步。

summary.en: Excellent work. Your answers and handover fully match the supplied fictional policy, with accurate figures and correct privacy handling for the companion booking. No material errors were found.
summary.zh: 表現優異。你的答案及交接完全符合提供的虛構政策，數字準確，同行預訂的私隱處理亦正確。未發現重大錯誤。

nextSteps.en: Keep this standard. In future cases, make the verification plan fully explicit by naming each record you will recheck, such as the PR-4402 notice timing, before confirming an exception.
nextSteps.zh: 請保持此水準。日後個案中，請把核實計劃寫得更明確，逐一列出你會重查的紀錄，例如 PR-4402 通知時間，然後才確認例外。

brief.en: You are a data analyst at a Hong Kong delivery platform. A fictional 14-day pilot tested a new merchant onboarding flow. Merchants were randomly assigned to the new flow or the existing flow. Some merchants have no completed first-week order data yet. Compare the two cohorts, report only what the records support, and note what is still unknown. Deliver a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering evidence, calculations, uncertainty and next steps. This is an independent learning simulation, not company data.
brief.zh: 你是香港配送平台的數據分析師。一個虛構的14天先導計劃測試新的商戶上線流程。商戶被隨機分配到新流程或現有流程。部分商戶尚未有完整首週訂單數據。比較兩個組別，只報告記錄支持的事實，並指出未知之處。以英文或繁體中文提交約100至180字的簡潔書面交接，涵蓋證據、計算、不確定性及下一步。這是獨立學習模擬，並非公司數據。

title.zh: 先導計劃設計及組別數目

body.en: Fictional pilot ran 1 to 14 June 2026. Merchants were randomly assigned by a system randomiser. New flow cohort: 120 merchants assigned. Existing flow cohort: 120 merchants assigned. A merchant counts as activated only if the first order is completed within 7 days of assignment. Records show 84 of 120 new-flow merchants activated and 72 of 120 existing-flow merchants activated. Randomisation was checked and the two cohorts had similar pre-pilot order volumes. This is synthetic learning data.
body.zh: 虛構先導計劃於2026年6月1日至14日進行。商戶由系統隨機分配。新流程組別：120間商戶獲分配。現有流程組別：120間商戶獲分配。商戶只有在獲分配後7天內完成首張訂單才計為已啟用。記錄顯示新流程120間中有84間啟用，現有流程120間中有72間啟用。隨機分配已檢查，兩組先導前訂單量相近。此為合成學習數據。

title.zh: 未完整觀察及數據質素

body.en: Fictional records show 18 new-flow merchants and 30 existing-flow merchants have no completed first-week order data because their onboarding window ended after the data cut on 14 June 2026. These merchants are counted as not activated in the figures above. Two new-flow merchants were reassigned to the existing flow after assignment because of a system error, and their outcomes are recorded under the new-flow cohort. No revenue, satisfaction or retention data were collected in this pilot. This is synthetic learning data.
body.zh: 虛構記錄顯示18間新流程商戶及30間現有流程商戶因上線窗口在2026年6月14日數據截取後才結束，故沒有完整首週訂單數據。這些商戶在上述數字中計為未啟用。2間新流程商戶因系統錯誤在分配後被改派至現有流程，其結果記錄在新流程組別。本先導計劃沒有收集收入、滿意度或留存數據。此為合成學習數據。

body.en: Fictional reporting rules. Activation rate equals activated merchants divided by assigned merchants in that cohort, expressed as a percentage to one decimal place. A difference is reportable only when it is at least 5.0 percentage points. Any causal statement about the new flow must be supported by randomisation and complete outcome data. Merchants without completed first-week data must be flagged as missing, not treated as confirmed failures. This is synthetic learning data.
body.zh: 虛構報告規則。啟用率等於該組別已啟用商戶除以獲分配商戶，以百分比表示，取一位小數。差異只有在達到至少5.0個百分點時才可報告。任何關於新流程的因果聲明必須有隨機分配及完整結果數據支持。沒有完整首週數據的商戶必須標示為缺失，不可當作確定失敗。此為合成學習數據。

label.en: What is the new-flow activation rate?
label.zh: 新流程的啟用率是多少？

label.en: What is the existing-flow activation rate?
label.zh: 現有流程的啟用率是多少？

label.en: Is the observed difference reportable under the reporting rules?
label.zh: 根據報告規則，觀察到的差異是否可報告？

label.en: Yes, the difference is at least 5.0 percentage points
label.zh: 是，差異達到至少5.0個百分點

label.en: No, the difference is below 5.0 percentage points
Cannot tell from the supplied records
Which statement about the new flow is best supported?
label.zh: 關於新流程，哪項陳述最受支持？

label.en: The new flow caused higher activation
label.zh: 新流程導致啟用率上升

label.en: The new-flow cohort showed a higher observed activation rate, but missing data limit causal claims
label.zh: 新流程組別觀察到較高啟用率，但缺失數據限制因果判斷

label.en: There is no difference between the cohorts
How should merchants without completed first-week data be treated?
label.zh: 沒有完整首週數據的商戶應如何處理？

label.en: Exclude them from the assigned denominator without disclosure
label.zh: 不披露下從獲分配分母剔除

label.en: Note the limitation in the handover

exemplar.en:
Evidence: Source one shows 84 of 120 new-flow merchants activated and 72 of 120 existing-flow merchants activated. Source two shows 18 new-flow and 30 existing-flow merchants lack completed first-week data, and two new-flow merchants were reassigned after randomisation. Source three defines activation rate as activated divided by assigned, to one decimal place, with a 5.0 percentage point reporting threshold.

Decision and calculations: New-flow rate is 84/120 = 70.0%. Existing-flow rate is 72/120 = 60.0%. The difference is 10.0 percentage points, so it is reportable. The best-supported statement is that the new-flow cohort showed a higher observed activation rate, not that the new flow caused it.

Risks: Missing merchants are not confirmed failures. Reassignment may bias the new-flow cohort. No revenue, satisfaction or retention data were collected.

Next steps: Wait for the 18 and 30 merchants to complete their first-week window, recheck the two reassigned merchants, confirm the randomiser log, then recalculate. Escalate to Ada Wong, analytics team lead. This is synthetic learning data.
exemplar.zh:
證據：文件一顯示新流程120間中有84間啟用，現有流程120間中有72間啟用。文件二顯示18間新流程及30間現有流程商戶沒有完整首週數據，另有2間新流程商戶在隨機分配後被改派。文件三定義啟用率為已啟用除以獲分配，取一位小數，報告門檻為5.0個百分點。

決策與計算：新流程比率為84/120 = 70.0%。現有流程比率為72/120 = 60.0%。差異為10.0個百分點，因此可報告。最受支持的陳述是新流程組別觀察到較高啟用率，而非新流程導致啟用率上升。

風險：缺失商戶並非確定失敗。改派可能令新流程組別出現偏差。沒有收集收入、滿意度或留存數據。

下一步：等待18及30間商戶完成首週窗口、重新檢查2間被改派商戶、確認隨機分配記錄，然後重新計算。轉交分析團隊主管Ada Wong。此為合成學習數據。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: 70.0 percent new-flow, 60.0 percent existing-flow, the 10.0 percentage point gap meets the 5.0 threshold so it is reportable, and the observed-only statement properly avoids a causal claim. Field values and the written reasoning agree with each other.
feedback.zh: 四項決定全部正確：新流程70.0%、現有流程60.0%，10.0個百分點差距達到5.0門檻故可報告，而僅屬觀察的陳述正確避免因果判斷。欄位答案與書面推理一致。

brief.en: You are a data analyst at a Hong Kong delivery platform. A fictional 21-day promotion compared two merchant cohorts, but allocation was not random. Some merchants have incomplete order data. Compare the cohorts, apply the supplied reporting rules, and separate observed differences from causal claims. Deliver a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering evidence, calculations, uncertainty and next steps. This is an independent learning simulation, not foodpanda operational data.
brief.zh: 你是香港配送平台的數據分析師。一個虛構的21天推廣比較了兩組商戶，但分配並非隨機。部分商戶訂單數據不完整。比較兩組，套用提供的報告規則，並區分觀察差異與因果聲明。以英文或繁體中文提交約100至180字的簡潔書面交接，涵蓋證據、計算、不確定性及下一步。這是獨立學習模擬，並非 foodpanda 營運資料。

body.en: Fictional promotion ran 3 to 23 August 2026. Merchants were not randomly assigned. Merchants in Kowloon City district were offered the new bundle promotion. Merchants in Wan Chai district continued the existing promotion. New bundle cohort: 150 merchants assigned. Existing promotion cohort: 150 merchants assigned. A merchant counts as retained only if it placed at least one order in each of the three weeks after assignment. Records show 96 of 150 new-bundle merchants retained and 78 of 150 existing-promotion merchants retained. This is synthetic learning data.
body.zh: 虛構推廣於2026年8月3日至23日進行。商戶並非隨機分配。九龍城區商戶獲邀使用新組合推廣。灣仔區商戶繼續使用現有推廣。新組合組別：150間商戶獲分配。現有推廣組別：150間商戶獲分配。商戶只有在獲分配後三週中每週至少落一張訂單才計為已留存。記錄顯示新組合150間中有96間留存，現有推廣150間中有78間留存。此為合成學習數據。

title.zh: 未完整觀察及分配備註

body.en: Fictional records show 24 new-bundle merchants and 12 existing-promotion merchants have no completed three-week order data because their observation window ended after the data cut on 23 August 2026. These merchants are counted as not retained in the figures above. District managers chose which districts received the new bundle promotion, and Kowloon City merchants had higher pre-promotion order volumes than Wan Chai merchants. No revenue, satisfaction or commission data were collected. This is synthetic learning data.
body.zh: 虛構記錄顯示24間新組合商戶及12間現有推廣商戶因觀察窗口在2026年8月23日數據截取後才結束，故沒有完整三週訂單數據。這些商戶在上述數字中計為未留存。地區經理決定哪些地區獲得新組合推廣，而九龍城商戶的推廣前訂單量高於灣仔商戶。本推廣沒有收集收入、滿意度或佣金數據。此為合成學習數據。

body.en: Fictional reporting rules. Retention rate equals retained merchants divided by assigned merchants in that cohort, expressed as a percentage to one decimal place. A difference is reportable only when it is at least 5.0 percentage points. Any causal statement about the new bundle promotion must be supported by random allocation and complete outcome data. Merchants without completed three-week data must be flagged as missing, not treated as confirmed failures. This is synthetic learning data.
body.zh: 虛構報告規則。留存率等於該組別已留存商戶除以獲分配商戶，以百分比表示，取一位小數。差異只有在達到至少5.0個百分點時才可報告。任何關於新組合推廣的因果聲明必須有隨機分配及完整結果數據支持。沒有完整三週數據的商戶必須標示為缺失，不可當作確定失敗。此為合成學習數據。

exemplar.en:
Evidence: Source one shows 96 of 150 new-bundle merchants retained and 78 of 150 existing-promotion merchants retained. Source two notes 24 and 12 merchants have no completed three-week data, and district managers chose the districts, so allocation was nonrandom. Source three sets a 5.0 percentage point reporting threshold and requires random allocation for causal claims.

Calculations: New-bundle retention is 96/150 = 64.0%. Existing-promotion retention is 78/150 = 52.0%. The difference is 12.0 percentage points, so it is reportable.

Decision: Report the observed difference only. Do not claim the new bundle caused higher retention, because allocation was nonrandom and 36 merchants are missing.

Risks: Missing merchants are counted as not retained, which may understate both rates. Kowloon City had higher pre-promotion volumes.

Next steps: Check missing merchants after the data cut, compare pre-promotion volumes, and run a randomised trial with complete windows if a causal claim is needed. Owner: analyst, escalate to Marco Lai.
exemplar.zh:
證據：來源一顯示新組合150間中96間留存，現有推廣150間中78間留存。來源二指出24間及12間商戶沒有完整三週數據，且地區經理決定地區，故分配非隨機。來源三設定5.0個百分點報告門檻，並要求隨機分配方可作因果聲明。

計算：新組合留存率為96/150 = 64.0%。現有推廣留存率為78/150 = 52.0%。差異為12.0個百分點，故可報告。

決定：只報告觀察差異。不可聲稱新組合導致留存率上升，因分配非隨機且有36間商戶缺失。

風險：缺失商戶計為未留存，可能低估兩組比率。九龍城推廣前訂單量較高。

下一步：在數據截取後檢查缺失商戶、比較推廣前訂單量，如需因果聲明則進行隨機試驗並設完整窗口。負責人：分析師，轉交 Marco Lai。

feedback.en: Both rates are correct (96/150 = 64.0% and 78/150 = 52.0%) and the 12.0 percentage point gap correctly clears the 5.0 point threshold, so reportable. The causal-claim choice (observed-only) and the missing-data selections (flag as missing, note the limitation) also match the supplied rules.
feedback.zh: 兩個比率正確（96/150 = 64.0% 及 78/150 = 52.0%），12.0個百分點的差距正確超過5.0個百分點門檻，故可報告。因果選擇（僅觀察）及缺失數據處理（標示缺失、註明限制）亦符合提供規則。

feedback.en: You cite the specific source-one counts, the source-two notes on nonrandom district allocation and 24 plus 12 missing merchants, and the source-three 5.0 point threshold and random-allocation requirement. The division and subtraction are shown step by step, so the reasoning is fully traceable.

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and test the stated requirements: checking missing merchants after the data cut, comparing pre-promotion volumes across districts, and running a randomised trial with complete observation windows if causality is needed. Escalating ownership to Marco Lai is appropriate.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體且能測試所述要求：在數據截取後檢查缺失商戶、比較兩區推廣前訂單量，以及如需因果結論則進行隨機試驗並設完整觀察窗口。轉交 Marco Lai 負責亦恰當。

feedback.en: You correctly flag the 36 merchants with incomplete data, the nonrandom district allocation, and the absence of revenue or satisfaction data, keeping conclusions tied to this fictional promotion. Add that Kowloon City's higher pre-promotion volumes are a confounding factor rather than only a risk note, to sharpen the boundary further.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出36間數據不完整的商戶、地區分配非隨機，以及沒有收入或滿意度數據，並把結論限於此虛構推廣。可進一步說明九龍城推廣前訂單量較高屬混雜因素，而非僅屬風險備註，令界線更清晰。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 157 words and includes both rates, the 12.0 point difference, the reportable decision, the causal limitation, and a named escalation. The numbered sections and clear owner make it actionable for the team lead.
feedback.zh: 交接精簡（157字），包含兩個比率、12.0個百分點差異、可報告決定、因果限制及具名轉交。分段清晰並列明負責人，方便團隊主管跟進。

summary.en: Strong submission. All field answers are correct, the calculations and source citations are precise, and the causal boundary is respected. The handover is clear and appropriately scoped at 157 words.
summary.zh: 表現出色。所有欄位答案正確，計算及來源引用精確，並恰當尊重因果界線。交接清晰、範圍適切，共157字。

nextSteps.en: Keep this structure. In a real analysis, add a brief sensitivity check on how much the missing 36 merchants could move the reported difference, and state the pre-promotion volume imbalance as a confounder before recommending any causal test.
nextSteps.zh: 保持此結構。在真實分析中，可加入簡短敏感度檢查，估算36間缺失商戶對所報差異的潛在影響，並在建議因果測試前，把推廣前訂單量差異明確列為混雜因素。

brief.en: You are a data analyst in a fictional learning simulation inspired by foodpanda Hong Kong. Review synthetic zone-level delivery records for one week, calculate the defined reliability metrics, and recommend one bounded action. All records, policies and figures are fictional learning assumptions, not foodpanda operational data. Deliver a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering evidence, calculations, uncertainty and next steps.
brief.zh: 你是數據分析師，正在一個受 foodpanda 香港啟發的虛構學習模擬中工作。請檢視一週的合成區域配送記錄，計算指定可靠性指標，並建議一項有限度行動。所有記錄、政策及數字均為虛構學習假設，並非 foodpanda 營運資料。請以英文或繁體中文提交約100至180字的簡潔交接，涵蓋證據、計算、不確定性及下一步。

body.en: Fictional learning data for one week. Zone A: 200 orders placed, 180 delivered on time, 20 late. Zone B: 160 orders placed, 120 delivered on time, 30 late, 10 with missing promised-window timestamps. Zone C: 100 orders placed, 85 delivered on time, 15 late. On-time means delivered within the promised window. Late orders are counted once. No order is counted in two zones. These are synthetic records, not real foodpanda data.
body.zh: 一週的虛構學習數據。區域A：200張訂單，180張準時送達，20張遲到。區域B：160張訂單，120張準時送達，30張遲到，10張缺少承諾時段時間戳。區域C：100張訂單，85張準時送達，15張遲到。準時指在承諾時段內送達。遲到訂單只計算一次。沒有訂單同時計入兩個區域。此為合成記錄，並非真實 foodpanda 資料。

title.zh: 可靠性政策及行動規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning policy. On-time rate equals on-time orders divided by orders placed, expressed as a percentage rounded to one decimal place. A zone is below target when its on-time rate is strictly under 85.0 percent. The bounded action budget is HKD 20,000 for one week and may be spent on one zone only. The approved action is a rider incentive costing HKD 18,000 for the selected zone. Select the zone with the lowest on-time rate. Do not claim causation from these records alone.
body.zh: 虛構學習政策。準時率等於準時訂單除以訂單總數，以百分比表示並四捨五入至小數一位。當區域準時率嚴格低於85.0%時，即低於目標。有限度行動預算為一週港幣20,000元，只可用於一個區域。核准行動為騎手獎勵，選定區域費用為港幣18,000元。選擇準時率最低的區域。不得僅憑這些記錄聲稱因果關係。

body.en: Fictional learning note. Zone B records include 10 orders with missing promised-window timestamps. These 10 orders are excluded from both on-time and late counts but remain in orders placed. Zone A and Zone C have no missing timestamps. The note does not explain why timestamps are missing. Treat this as a data limitation, not a cause of lateness.
body.zh: 虛構學習備註。區域B記錄中有10張訂單缺少承諾時段時間戳。此10張訂單不計入準時及遲到，但仍計入訂單總數。區域A及區域C沒有缺少時間戳。備註沒有解釋時間戳缺失原因。請視此為數據限制，而非遲到原因。

label.en: What is Zone A on-time rate, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 區域A準時率四捨五入至小數一位是多少？

label.en: What is Zone B on-time rate, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 區域B準時率四捨五入至小數一位是多少？

label.en: Which zones are strictly below the 85.0 percent target?
label.zh: 哪些區域嚴格低於85.0%目標？

label.en: Which zone should receive the bounded action?
label.zh: 哪個區域應獲得有限度行動？

label.en: What is the main data limitation affecting Zone B?
label.zh: 影響區域B的主要數據限制是甚麼？
10張訂單缺少承諾時段時間戳

label.en: Orders are counted in two zones
label.zh: 訂單同時計入兩個區域

label.en: Late orders are excluded from orders placed

exemplar.en: Evidence: synthetic zone records show Zone A 180/200 on time, Zone B 120/160, Zone C 85/100. Calculations: Zone A 90.0 percent, Zone B 75.0 percent, Zone C 85.0 percent. Decision: only Zone B is strictly below the 85.0 percent target, so the bounded action goes to Zone B at HKD 18,000, within the HKD 20,000 budget. Uncertainty: 10 Zone B orders have missing timestamps and are excluded from on-time and late counts, so confidence is limited and these records do not prove the incentive causes improvement. Next steps: check the missing timestamps, confirm the cost, and re-measure Zone B after one week. Owner: operations analytics lead.
exemplar.zh: 證據：合成區域記錄顯示區域A準時180/200，區域B為120/160，區域C為85/100。計算：區域A為90.0%，區域B為75.0%，區域C為85.0%。決策：只有區域B嚴格低於85.0%目標，因此有限度行動用於區域B，費用港幣18,000元，在港幣20,000元預算內。不確定性：區域B有10張訂單缺少時間戳，不計入準時及遲到，因此可信度有限，記錄不能證明獎勵帶來改善。下一步：檢查缺失時間戳、確認費用，並在一週後重新量度區域B。負責人：營運分析主管。

feedback.en: All five decisions are correct: Zone A 90.0 percent, Zone B 75.0 percent, Zone C 85.0 percent, only Zone B below target, and the action assigned to Zone B at HKD 18,000 within the HKD 20,000 budget. The calculation method matches the supplied on-time rate definition.
feedback.zh: 五項決定全部正確：區域A為90.0%、區域B為75.0%、區域C為85.0%、只有區域B低於目標，行動用於區域B，費用港幣18,000元且在港幣20,000元預算內。計算方法符合提供的準時率定義。

feedback.en: You cite the specific counts for Zone A, Zone B and Zone C and correctly explain that only Zone B is strictly below 85.0 percent. You also connect the Zone B limitation to the 10 missing timestamps from the data quality note.

brief.en: You are a data analyst in a fictional learning simulation inspired by foodpanda Hong Kong. Review synthetic kitchen preparation-duration records for one week. Calculate the mean preparation duration for each kitchen line, apply the target and capacity rules, and recommend one bounded action. All records, policies and figures are fictional learning assumptions, not foodpanda operational data. Deliver a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering evidence, calculations, uncertainty and next steps.
brief.zh: 你是數據分析師，正在一個受 foodpanda 香港啟發的虛構學習模擬中工作。請檢視一週的合成廚房備餐時長記錄。計算每條廚房線的平均備餐時長，應用目標及容量規則，並建議一項有限度行動。所有記錄、政策及數字均為虛構學習假設，並非 foodpanda 營運資料。請以英文或繁體中文提交約100至180字的簡潔交接，涵蓋證據、計算、不確定性及下一步。

body.en: Fictional learning data for one week. Line K1 has 40 orders with measured preparation duration, total measured preparation time 720 minutes, and 10 orders with missing duration. Line K2 has 50 measured orders, total 1,100 minutes, and 0 missing. Line K3 has 35 measured orders, total 595 minutes, and 5 missing. Each order belongs to exactly one line. Capacity limit: each line has two preparation benches. K1 has 2 prep assistants, K2 has 1, K3 has 2. A line can receive at most one additional prep assistant without exceeding bench capacity. Missing durations are not estimated. These are synthetic records, not real foodpanda data.
body.zh: 一週的虛構學習數據。廚房線K1有40張訂單具已量度備餐時長，已量度備餐總時間720分鐘，另有10張訂單缺少時長。廚房線K2有50張已量度訂單，總時間1,100分鐘，0張缺少。廚房線K3有35張已量度訂單，總時間595分鐘，5張缺少。每張訂單只屬於一條廚房線。容量限制：每條線有兩個備餐工作台。K1有2名備餐助理，K2有1名，K3有2名。每條線最多可增加一名備餐助理而不超出工作台容量。缺少時長不予估算。此為合成記錄，並非真實 foodpanda 資料。

title.zh: 備餐時長政策及行動規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional policy. Mean preparation duration equals total measured preparation minutes divided by measured orders, rounded to one decimal place. The target mean is 18.0 minutes or less. A line is above target when its mean is strictly greater than 18.0 minutes. Missing durations are excluded from the mean and measured count but reported separately. The one-week action budget is HKD 18,000 for one line only. The approved action is one additional prep assistant for peak shifts, costing HKD 16,000 for the selected line. Select the line with the highest mean preparation duration among lines above target that have capacity to add one prep assistant. Do not claim causation from these records alone.
body.zh: 虛構政策。平均備餐時長等於已量度備餐總分鐘除以已量度訂單數，四捨五入至小數一位。目標平均為18.0分鐘或以下。當平均嚴格大於18.0分鐘時，該線高於目標。缺少時長不計入平均及已量度訂單數，但須另行報告。一週行動預算為港幣18,000元，只可用於一條線。核准行動為額外一名備餐助理負責高峰更，選定線費用為港幣16,000元。在高於目標且具容量增加一名備餐助理的線中，選擇平均備餐時長最高者。不得僅憑這些記錄聲稱因果關係。

title.zh: 數據品質及容量備註（虛構）

body.en: Fictional note. Lines K1 and K3 already have two prep assistants, so an additional assistant would exceed the two-bench capacity. Line K2 has one prep assistant and can receive one additional assistant within capacity. The 10 missing K1 durations and 5 missing K3 durations are not estimated because the source timestamps are absent. This note does not explain why timestamps are missing. Treat missingness as a data limitation, not a cause of preparation delay. These are synthetic learning records.
body.zh: 虛構備註。廚房線K1及K3已有2名備餐助理，因此額外一名助理會超出兩個工作台容量。廚房線K2有1名備餐助理，可在容量內增加一名助理。K1的10張缺少時長及K3的5張缺少時長不予估算，因來源時間戳缺失。此備註沒有解釋時間戳缺失原因。請視缺失為數據限制，而非備餐延誤原因。此為合成學習記錄。

label.en: What is the mean preparation duration for Line K1, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 廚房線K1平均備餐時長四捨五入至小數一位是多少？

label.en: What is the mean preparation duration for Line K2, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 廚房線K2平均備餐時長四捨五入至小數一位是多少？

label.en: Which lines are strictly above the 18.0 minute target?
label.zh: 哪些線嚴格高於18.0分鐘目標？

label.en: Which line should receive the bounded action?
label.zh: 哪條線應獲得有限度行動？

label.en: Which lines already have two prep assistants and cannot receive an additional assistant within the two-bench capacity?
label.zh: 哪些線已有2名備餐助理，不能在兩個工作台容量內增加一名助理？

exemplar.en: Evidence: Source one shows K1 720 measured minutes across 40 measured orders plus 10 missing, K2 1,100 minutes across 50 orders with no missing, and K3 595 minutes across 35 orders plus 5 missing. Source three states K1 and K3 already have two prep assistants, while K2 has one and can add one. Decision and calculations: mean preparation duration equals total measured minutes divided by measured orders. K1 is 720/40 = 18.0 minutes, K2 is 1,100/50 = 22.0 minutes, and K3 is 595/35 = 17.0 minutes. The target is 18.0 minutes or less, and a line is above target only when strictly greater than 18.0. Only K2 is above target. K2 also has capacity headroom. I recommend the approved HKD 16,000 additional prep assistant for K2, within the HKD 18,000 one-week budget. Risks: records are synthetic and cover one week only. The 10 missing K1 durations and 5 missing K3 durations reduce confidence in those means. The records show association, not causation. Next steps: recheck totals, verify missing timestamps and staffing, re-run the means, and track K2 after the assistant week. Escalate timestamp gaps to Iris Wong, merchant analytics lead.
exemplar.zh: 證據：來源一顯示K1有40張已量度訂單共720分鐘，另有10張缺少時長；K2有50張訂單共1,100分鐘，0張缺少；K3有35張訂單共595分鐘，另有5張缺少。來源三指出K1及K3已有2名備餐助理，K2有1名並可增加一名。決策與計算：平均備餐時長等於已量度總分鐘除以已量度訂單數。K1為720/40 = 18.0分鐘，K2為1,100/50 = 22.0分鐘，K3為595/35 = 17.0分鐘。目標為18.0分鐘或以下，只有嚴格大於18.0才高於目標。只有K2高於目標。K2亦有容量空間。我建議把核准的港幣16,000元額外備餐助理給予K2，在港幣18,000元一週預算內。風險：記錄為合成且僅一週。K1的10張缺少時長及K3的5張缺少時長降低該等平均值的可信度。記錄只顯示關聯，而非因果。下一步：重新核對總數、核實缺失時間戳及人手、重算平均值，並在助理週後追蹤K2。把時間戳缺口轉交Iris Wong，商戶分析主管。

title.en: Duplicate order IDs and missing durations
title.zh: 重複訂單編號與缺失時長

brief.en: You are a data analyst at a Hong Kong delivery platform. A synthetic weekly extract from the fictional 'Harbour Run' pilot has duplicate order identifiers and missing delivery durations. Define the valid denominator for average delivery duration, decide which records to exclude, and write a short handover. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by foodpanda, not endorsed by it, and uses no real operational data.
brief.zh: 你是香港配送平台的數據分析師。一份虛構「港灣試行」的合成每週摘錄出現重複訂單編號及缺失配送時長。請界定平均配送時長的有效分母、決定排除哪些記錄，並撰寫簡短交接。這是受 foodpanda 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲其認可，亦不使用任何真實營運資料。

title.zh: 港灣試行每週摘錄（合成）

body.en: Fictional extract, 8 rows, one row per raw record. Columns: order_id, status, duration_min. Rows: O-101 delivered 32; O-102 delivered 41; O-102 delivered 41; O-103 cancelled blank; O-104 delivered 28; O-105 delivered blank; O-106 delivered 55; O-107 delivered 39. Rule: a record is valid for duration analysis only if status is 'delivered' AND duration_min is a positive number. Duplicate order_id rows with identical status and duration count as one valid record. Cancelled rows are excluded. Blank durations are excluded.
body.zh: 虛構摘錄，8 行，每行一筆原始記錄。欄位：order_id、status、duration_min。內容：O-101 delivered 32；O-102 delivered 41；O-102 delivered 41；O-103 cancelled 空白；O-104 delivered 28；O-105 delivered 空白；O-106 delivered 55；O-107 delivered 39。規則：只有 status 為 'delivered' 且 duration_min 為正數的記錄才可用於時長分析。order_id 重複且 status 與 duration 相同的行，計為一筆有效記錄。已取消行排除。空白時長排除。

body.en: Fictional pilot rules. Valid denominator = count of unique valid records after removing cancelled rows, blank durations and duplicate rows. Average delivery duration = sum of valid durations divided by the valid denominator, rounded to one decimal place. Excluded records must be listed with a reason code: CANCELLED, MISSING_DURATION or DUPLICATE. The pilot ran 7 calendar days. No other exclusions are permitted.
body.zh: 虛構試行規則。有效分母 = 移除已取消行、空白時長及重複行後，唯一有效記錄的數目。平均配送時長 = 有效時長總和除以有效分母，四捨五入至一位小數。被排除記錄須列明原因代碼：CANCELLED、MISSING_DURATION 或 DUPLICATE。試行期為 7 個曆日。不允許其他排除。

label.en: How many valid records form the denominator for average delivery duration?
label.zh: 平均配送時長的有效分母包含多少筆有效記錄？

label.en: What is the average delivery duration in minutes, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 平均配送時長為多少分鐘，四捨五入至一位小數？

label.en: Which reason code applies to row O-105?
label.zh: O-105 行應使用哪個原因代碼？

label.en: How should the two O-102 rows be treated?
label.zh: 兩行 O-102 應如何處理？

label.en: Keep both rows as two valid records
label.zh: 兩行均保留為兩筆有效記錄

label.en: Keep one row as one valid record
label.zh: 保留一行為一筆有效記錄

exemplar.en: Evidence: Source one has 8 raw rows. O-103 is cancelled, O-105 has a blank duration, and O-102 appears twice with identical status and duration. Source two says valid records require status delivered and a positive duration, duplicates count once, and no other exclusions are allowed. Decision: exclude O-103 as CANCELLED, O-105 as MISSING_DURATION, and one O-102 row as DUPLICATE. The valid denominator is 5 records: O-101, O-102, O-104, O-106, O-107. Calculation: (32+41+28+55+39)/5 = 195/5 = 39.0 minutes. Risks: missing durations may hide longer or shorter deliveries, and this synthetic 7-day extract may not represent other weeks. Next steps: re-count unique order_id after exclusions, confirm no other blank durations, and escalate the duplicate and missing-duration pattern to the data engineering owner before publishing.
exemplar.zh: 證據：來源一有 8 行原始記錄。O-103 已取消，O-105 時長空白，O-102 出現兩次且狀態與時長相同。來源二規定有效記錄須為 delivered 且時長為正數，重複行只計一次，不允許其他排除。決策：O-103 以 CANCELLED 排除，O-105 以 MISSING_DURATION 排除，一行 O-102 以 DUPLICATE 排除。有效分母為 5 筆記錄：O-101、O-102、O-104、O-106、O-107。計算：(32+41+28+55+39)/5 = 195/5 = 39.0 分鐘。風險：缺失時長可能隱藏較長或較短的配送，且此合成 7 日摘錄未必代表其他週次。下一步：排除後重新計算唯一 order_id 數目，確認沒有其他空白時長，並在發布前把重複及缺失時長模式轉交數據工程負責人。

feedback.en: All four answers are correct: denominator 5, average 39.0 minutes, O-105 as MISSING_DURATION, and the O-102 duplicate kept once. Your stated exclusion set (O-103 CANCELLED, O-105 MISSING_DURATION, one O-102 DUPLICATE) matches the source-two rules exactly.
feedback.zh: 四項答案全部正確：分母 5、平均 39.0 分鐘、O-105 為 MISSING_DURATION，以及 O-102 重複行只保留一次。你列出的排除組合（O-103 為 CANCELLED、O-105 為 MISSING_DURATION、一行 O-102 為 DUPLICATE）與來源二規則完全一致。

feedback.en: You cite the 8 raw rows, tie each exclusion to the source-two validity rule, and show the arithmetic (32+41+28+55+39)/5 = 195/5 = 39.0. That gives a fully traceable audit trail from record to result.
feedback.zh: 你引用了 8 行原始記錄，把每項排除連繫到來源二的有效性規則，並展示運算 (32+41+28+55+39)/5 = 195/5 = 39.0，讓記錄到結果的審計線索完整可追溯。

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete: re-count unique order_id after exclusions, confirm no other blank durations, and escalate the duplicate plus missing-duration pattern to the data engineering owner before publishing. Adding a duplicate-detection query would strengthen this further, but the current steps already test the stated requirements.
feedback.zh: 你的檢查具體可行：排除後重新計算唯一 order_id、確認沒有其他空白時長，並在發布前把重複及缺失時長模式轉交數據工程負責人。若能加入重複偵測查詢會更完整，但現有步驟已能測試所述要求。

summary.en: Excellent submission. Every structured answer is correct, the calculation is shown in full, and the handover is concise and auditable with proper scope limits on this synthetic 7-day extract. No material gaps were found.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。所有結構化答案正確，計算完整展示，交接簡潔且可審計，並就此合成 7 日摘錄適度限定範圍。未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: Keep the same structure in future audits. For extra depth, add one duplicate-detection or reconciliation query so the verification step is reproducible rather than manual.
nextSteps.zh: 日後審計可沿用相同結構。若想更深入，可加入一個重複偵測或對帳查詢，讓核實步驟可重現而非只靠人手檢查。

title.en: Reconcile inconsistent status labels and units
title.zh: 核對不一致的狀態標籤與單位

brief.en: You are a data analyst at a Hong Kong delivery platform. A synthetic weekly extract from the fictional 'Kowloon Loop' pilot contains inconsistent status labels and mixed measurement units for delivery duration. Define the valid denominator for average delivery duration in minutes, decide which records to exclude or convert, and write a short handover. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by foodpanda, not endorsed by it, and uses no real operational data.
brief.zh: 你是香港配送平台的數據分析師。一份虛構「九龍環線」試行的合成每週摘錄，包含不一致的狀態標籤及混合的配送時長計量單位。請界定以分鐘計的平均配送時長之有效分母、決定排除或換算哪些記錄，並撰寫簡短交接。這是受 foodpanda 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲其認可，亦不使用任何真實營運資料。

title.zh: 九龍環線每週摘錄（合成）

body.en: Fictional extract, 9 rows, one row per raw record. Columns: order_id, status, duration_value, duration_unit. Rows: K-201 completed 28 min; K-202 delivered 35 min; K-203 completed 42 min; K-204 cancelled blank min; K-205 delivered 0.75 hr; K-206 completed 51 min; K-207 delivered blank min; K-208 completed 33 min; K-209 delivered 0.5 hr. Rule: a record is valid for duration analysis only if status is 'completed' or 'delivered' AND duration_value is a positive number. Convert hours to minutes by multiplying by 60. Cancelled rows are excluded. Blank durations are excluded. No other exclusions are permitted.
body.zh: 虛構摘錄，9 行，每行一筆原始記錄。欄位：order_id、status、duration_value、duration_unit。內容：K-201 completed 28 min；K-202 delivered 35 min；K-203 completed 42 min；K-204 cancelled 空白 min；K-205 delivered 0.75 hr；K-206 completed 51 min；K-207 delivered 空白 min；K-208 completed 33 min；K-209 delivered 0.5 hr。規則：只有 status 為 'completed' 或 'delivered' 且 duration_value 為正數的記錄才可用於時長分析。小時換算為分鐘須乘以 60。已取消行排除。空白時長排除。不允許其他排除。

body.en: Fictional pilot rules. Valid denominator = count of unique valid records after removing cancelled rows and blank durations. Average delivery duration = sum of valid durations in minutes divided by the valid denominator, rounded to one decimal place. Excluded records must be listed with a reason code: CANCELLED or MISSING_DURATION. The pilot ran 7 calendar days. No other exclusions are permitted.
body.zh: 虛構試行規則。有效分母 = 移除已取消行及空白時長後，唯一有效記錄的數目。平均配送時長 = 有效時長總和（以分鐘計）除以有效分母，四捨五入至一位小數。被排除記錄須列明原因代碼：CANCELLED 或 MISSING_DURATION。試行期為 7 個曆日。不允許其他排除。

label.en: How many valid records form the denominator for average delivery duration?
label.zh: 平均配送時長的有效分母包含多少筆有效記錄？

label.en: What is the average delivery duration in minutes, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 平均配送時長為多少分鐘，四捨五入至一位小數？

label.en: Which reason code applies to row K-207?
label.zh: K-207 行應使用哪個原因代碼？

label.en: How should the duration for K-205 be handled?
label.zh: K-205 的時長應如何處理？

label.en: Convert 0.75 hr to 45 min and include
label.zh: 將 0.75 小時換算為 45 分鐘並納入

label.en: Exclude because the unit is not minutes
label.zh: 因單位不是分鐘而排除

label.en: Keep 0.75 as a valid duration value
label.zh: 保留 0.75 為有效時長數值

label.en: How should the status labels 'completed' and 'delivered' be treated?
label.zh: 狀態標籤 'completed' 與 'delivered' 應如何處理？

label.en: Treat both as valid completion statuses
label.zh: 兩者均視為有效的完成狀態

expectedEvidence.en: Valid denominator is 7 records. Excluded rows: K-204 (CANCELLED), K-207 (MISSING_DURATION). Valid durations in minutes: K-201 28, K-202 35, K-203 42, K-205 45, K-206 51, K-208 33, K-209 30. Sum = 264. Average = 264 / 7 = 37.7 minutes. Status labels 'completed' and 'delivered' are treated as equivalent valid completion statuses. Unit conversion for K-205 is 0.75 * 60 = 45 minutes.
expectedEvidence.zh: 有效分母為 7 筆記錄。排除行：K-204（CANCELLED）、K-207（MISSING_DURATION）。有效時長（分鐘）：K-201 28、K-202 35、K-203 42、K-205 45、K-206 51、K-208 33、K-209 30。總和 = 264。平均 = 264 / 7 = 37.7 分鐘。狀態標籤 'completed' 與 'delivered' 均視為有效的完成狀態。K-205 單位換算為 0.75 * 60 = 45 分鐘。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites specific rows from source-one: K-204 cancelled blank, K-207 delivered blank, K-205 0.75 hr, K-209 0.5 hr. Explains that K-205 and K-209 require conversion to minutes. Explains that 'completed' and 'delivered' are both valid per source-one rule. Shows sum 264 and division by 7. References source-two rule for rounding to one decimal place.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 source-one 的具體行：K-204 cancelled 空白、K-207 delivered 空白、K-205 0.75 hr、K-209 0.5 hr。解釋 K-205 及 K-209 須換算為分鐘。解釋 'completed' 與 'delivered' 均按 source-one 規則屬有效。展示總和 264 及除以 7。引用 source-two 四捨五入至一位小數的規則。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checking that all duration_unit values are either 'min' or 'hr' and that no other units appear. Suggests verifying the sum 264 by adding the seven converted values. Recommends confirming with the pilot owner whether 'completed' and 'delivered' should be merged in future extracts. Suggests a validation rule to flag blank durations and cancelled rows automatically.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議檢查所有 duration_unit 值是否僅為 'min' 或 'hr'，且無其他單位。建議以七個換算值相加核實總和 264。建議向試行負責人確認未來摘錄是否應合併 'completed' 與 'delivered'。建議設立驗證規則自動標示空白時長及已取消行。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

Notes uncertainty about whether 'completed' and 'delivered' represent the same operational state in the source system. Does not claim causality or generalise beyond the fictional pilot.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明分析僅限於合成 9 行摘錄及 7 日試行。承認不使用任何真實 foodpanda 營運資料。指出 'completed' 與 'delivered' 在來源系統是否代表相同營運狀態存在不確定性。不主張因果關係，亦不推論至虛構試行以外。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states valid denominator 7, average 37.7 minutes, excluded rows K-204 and K-207 with reason codes, and unit conversions for K-205 and K-209. Includes a clear next step such as confirming status label equivalence with the pilot owner. Written in English or Traditional Chinese, concise and actionable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明有效分母 7、平均 37.7 分鐘、排除行 K-204 及 K-207 及其原因代碼，以及 K-205 與 K-209 的單位換算。包含清晰下一步，例如向試行負責人確認狀態標籤等效性。以英文或繁體中文撰寫，簡潔可行。

exemplar.en:
Evidence: Source-one has 9 rows. K-204 is cancelled with blank duration. K-207 is delivered with blank duration. K-205 is 0.75 hr and K-209 is 0.5 hr. Status labels 'completed' and 'delivered' both appear. Source-two defines valid denominator and rounding.

Decision and calculations: Exclude K-204 (CANCELLED) and K-207 (MISSING_DURATION). Treat 'completed' and 'delivered' as equivalent valid completion statuses. Convert K-205 to 45 min and K-209 to 30 min. Valid durations: 28, 35, 42, 45, 51, 33, 30. Sum = 264. Valid denominator = 7. Average = 264 / 7 = 37.7 minutes.

Risks: The extract is synthetic and covers only 7 days. It is uncertain whether 'completed' and 'delivered' mean the same state in the source system. No real foodpanda data is used.

Next steps: Confirm status label equivalence with the pilot owner. Add a validation rule to flag blank durations and cancelled rows. Verify the sum 264 by adding the seven converted values.
exemplar.zh:
證據：source-one 有 9 行。K-204 為 cancelled 且時長空白。K-207 為 delivered 且時長空白。K-205 為 0.75 hr，K-209 為 0.5 hr。狀態標籤 'completed' 與 'delivered' 均出現。source-two 界定有效分母及四捨五入規則。

決策與計算：排除 K-204（CANCELLED）及 K-207（MISSING_DURATION）。將 'completed' 與 'delivered' 視為等效的有效完成狀態。將 K-205 換算為 45 分鐘，K-209 換算為 30 分鐘。有效時長：28、35、42、45、51、33、30。總和 = 264。有效分母 = 7。平均 = 264 / 7 = 37.7 分鐘。

風險：摘錄為合成資料，僅涵蓋 7 日。'completed' 與 'delivered' 在來源系統是否代表相同狀態存在不確定性。不使用任何真實 foodpanda 資料。

下一步：向試行負責人確認狀態標籤等效性。增設驗證規則標示空白時長及已取消行。以七個換算值相加核實總和 264。

feedback.en: All five decisions are correct: denominator 7, average 264/7 = 37.7 minutes, K-207 as MISSING_DURATION, K-205 converted to 45 minutes, and 'completed' plus 'delivered' treated as equivalent valid statuses. The cleaning log is auditable with K-204 and K-207 excluded for the right reason codes.
feedback.zh: 五項決策全部正確：分母 7、平均 264/7 = 37.7 分鐘、K-207 屬 MISSING_DURATION、K-205 換算為 45 分鐘，以及把 'completed' 與 'delivered' 視為等效有效狀態。清理記錄可追溯，K-204 與 K-207 的排除原因代碼正確。

feedback.en: You cite the specific rows K-204, K-207, K-205 and K-209, list the seven converted durations 28, 35, 42, 45, 51, 33, 30 and show the sum 264 divided by 7. Source-two is correctly linked for the denominator definition and the one decimal rounding.
feedback.zh: 你引用了具體行 K-204、K-207、K-205 及 K-209，列出七個換算時長 28、35、42、45、51、33、30，並展示總和 264 除以 7。亦正確引用 source-two 的分母定義及一位小數四捨五入規則。

feedback.en: Confirming label equivalence with the pilot owner, re-adding the seven values to check 264 and adding a validation rule for blanks and cancellations are all concrete checks. Add one explicit check that duration_unit contains only 'min' or 'hr' with no other units appearing.
feedback.zh: 向試行負責人確認標籤等效性、以七個數值相加核實 264，以及增設空白與取消行的驗證規則，均屬具體檢查。建議再明確檢查 duration_unit 只含 'min' 或 'hr'，沒有其他單位出現。

feedback.en: You correctly limit the analysis to the synthetic 9-row extract and 7-day pilot, state that no real operations data is used, and flag uncertainty about whether the two status labels mean the same state in the source system. No causal or wider claims are made.
feedback.zh: 你正確地把分析限於合成 9 行摘錄及 7 日試行，說明不使用真實營運資料，並指出兩個狀態標籤在來源系統是否代表同一狀態的不確定性。沒有作出因果或更廣泛的推論。

feedback.en: The four-part structure is concise and actionable and gives the denominator, average, exclusions with reason codes, unit conversions and a clear next step. A reader could reproduce the result without further questions.
feedback.zh: 四段式結構簡潔可行，列明分母、平均值、排除行及原因代碼、單位換算，並有清晰下一步。讀者毋須再提問即可重現結果。

summary.en: Complete and accurate work: all five structured answers are correct and the handover reproduces the full calculation with row-level evidence, scope limits and next steps. The only small gap is that the verification plan does not explicitly check for unexpected units beyond 'min' and 'hr'.
summary.zh: 作品完整準確：五項結構化答案全部正確，交接重現完整計算並附行級證據、範圍限制及下一步。唯一小缺口是核實計劃未明確檢查 'min' 與 'hr' 以外的異常單位。

nextSteps.en: Add a unit-domain check to the verification list, for example asserting that duration_unit only ever takes the values 'min' or 'hr'. In future handovers you could also note who owns each next step, such as the pilot owner for status label confirmation.
nextSteps.zh: 在核實清單加入單位範圍檢查，例如斷言 duration_unit 只會取 'min' 或 'hr'。日後交接亦可註明每項下一步的負責人，例如由試行負責人確認狀態標籤。

title.en: Read Summer Cold Brew campaign performance
title.zh: 解讀夏日冷萃推廣表現

brief.en: You are a digital marketing analyst at FIMMICK. A fictional client, Harbour Blend Tea Co., needs a performance read of its Summer Cold Brew campaign. Using only the supplied synthetic records, calculate click-through and conversion rates for the two channels. Distinguish platform-attributed conversions from incremental impact using the holdout test. Prepare a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese with calculations, evidence, risks and next steps. This is an independent simulation inspired by FIMMICK's public context, not endorsed by FIMMICK.
brief.zh: 你是 FIMMICK 的數碼營銷分析師。虛構客戶 Harbour Blend Tea Co. 需要一份夏日冷萃推廣活動的表現解讀。只使用提供的合成記錄，計算兩個渠道的點擊率及轉換率。利用保留組測試區分平台歸因轉換與新增影響。以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔的書面交接，包含計算、證據、風險及下一步。此為受 FIMMICK 公開背景啟發的獨立模擬，未獲 FIMMICK 認可。

body.en: Fictional client Harbour Blend Tea Co. ran a 14-day Summer Cold Brew campaign. Platform-attributed data: Paid Social had 200,000 impressions, 4,000 clicks, 240 attributed conversions. Paid Search had 50,000 impressions, 2,500 clicks, 175 attributed conversions. Audiences for the two channels were disjoint by design. The same conversion event, 'completed checkout', was used for both channels, and both used the identical 14-day measurement window. These are synthetic records for the simulation.
body.zh: 虛構客戶 Harbour Blend Tea Co. 進行了為期 14 天的夏日冷萃推廣活動。平台歸因數據：付費社交媒體有 200,000 次曝光、4,000 次點擊、240 次歸因轉換。付費搜尋有 50,000 次曝光、2,500 次點擊、175 次歸因轉換。兩個渠道的受眾按設計並不相交。兩個渠道均使用相同的轉換事件「完成結帳」，並採用相同的 14 天測量窗口。此為模擬的合成記錄。

title.zh: 測量規則及保留組測試

body.en: Fictional measurement rules. Click-through rate (CTR) equals clicks divided by impressions. Conversion rate equals attributed conversions divided by clicks. To estimate incremental impact for Paid Social, a holdout test was run on 100,000 eligible users. 90,000 were exposed and 10,000 were held out. The exposed group had 270 conversions. The holdout group had 20 conversions. Incremental conversions equal (exposed conversion rate minus holdout conversion rate) times exposed users. Round percentages to two decimal places. No holdout test exists for Paid Search.
body.zh: 虛構測量規則。點擊率（CTR）等於點擊次數除以曝光次數。轉換率等於歸因轉換次數除以點擊次數。為估算付費社交媒體的新增影響，對 100,000 名合資格用戶進行了保留組測試。90,000 人獲曝光，10,000 人為保留組。曝光組有 270 次轉換。保留組有 20 次轉換。新增轉換等於（曝光組轉換率減保留組轉換率）乘以曝光用戶數。百分比四捨五入至小數後兩個位。付費搜尋沒有保留組測試。

label.en: Paid Social click-through rate as a percentage. Round to two decimal places.
label.zh: 付費社交媒體點擊率百分比。四捨五入至小數後兩個位。

label.en: Paid Search conversion rate as a percentage. Round to two decimal places.
label.zh: 付費搜尋轉換率百分比。四捨五入至小數後兩個位。

label.en: Based on the holdout test, what are Paid Social attributed and incremental conversions?
label.zh: 根據保留組測試，付費社交媒體的歸因轉換及新增轉換分別是多少？

label.en: Cannot determine incremental from supplied data
label.zh: 無法從提供數據確定新增

label.en: Select all checks required before comparing conversion rates across the two channels.
label.zh: 選出比較兩個渠道轉換率前所需的所有檢查。

label.en: Confirm the same conversion event definition
label.zh: 確認相同的轉換事件定義
確認渠道受眾並不相交

label.en: Which metric uses clicks as its denominator?
label.zh: 哪個指標以點擊次數為分母？

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Calculate supplied marketing metrics and distinguish attribution from incremental impact.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。計算提供的營銷指標，並區分歸因與新增影響。

expectedEvidence.en: Correct CTR for Paid Social is 2.00% (4,000 / 200,000). Correct conversion rate for Paid Search is 7.00% (175 / 2,500). Correctly identifies Paid Social attributed conversions as 240 and incremental conversions as 90, using exposed rate 0.30% minus holdout rate 0.20% times 90,000. Does not confuse attribution with incremental impact.
expectedEvidence.zh: 付費社交媒體正確點擊率為 2.00%（4,000 / 200,000）。付費搜尋正確轉換率為 7.00%（175 / 2,500）。正確指出付費社交媒體歸因轉換為 240，新增轉換為 90，使用曝光組轉換率 0.30% 減保留組轉換率 0.20% 乘以 90,000。不把歸因與新增影響混淆。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites campaign-data for impressions, clicks and attributed conversions. Cites measurement-rules for formulas and holdout counts. Shows calculation steps for CTR, conversion rate and incremental conversions. Explains that attributed conversions come from platform tracking while incremental conversions come from the holdout comparison.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 campaign-data 中的曝光、點擊及歸因轉換。引用 measurement-rules 中的公式及保留組計數。展示點擊率、轉換率及新增轉換的計算步驟。解釋歸因轉換來自平台追蹤，而新增轉換來自保留組比較。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checking identical conversion event and 14-day window before comparison. Notes Paid Search has no holdout, so its incremental impact cannot be checked. Recommends a Paid Search holdout test, significance testing, and confirming audience disjointness. Suggests revenue or profit data for fuller impact.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議在比較前檢查相同的轉換事件及 14 天窗口。指出付費搜尋沒有保留組，因此無法核實其新增影響。建議進行付費搜尋保留組測試、顯著性測試，並確認受眾並不相交。建議取得收入或利潤數據以更全面評估影響。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.

expectedEvidence.en: States the scenario is fictional and not FIMMICK client advice. Avoids claiming Paid Search incremental impact without a holdout. Notes no significance test, no revenue data, and small holdout counts. Limits conclusions to the supplied 14-day window and synthetic records.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明情境為虛構，並非 FIMMICK 客戶建議。避免在沒有保留組下聲稱付費搜尋的新增影響。指出沒有顯著性測試、沒有收入數據，且保留組計數較小。把結論限於提供的 14 天窗口及合成記錄。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover is concise, includes the two calculated rates, the attribution versus incremental distinction, key risks, and next steps. Names an owner or escalation route. Uses either English or Traditional Chinese as permitted.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接簡潔，包含兩個計算比率、歸因與新增的區分、主要風險及下一步。列明負責人或轉交途徑。按允許使用英文或繁體中文。

exemplar.en: From the supplied fictional records: Paid Social CTR = 4,000 / 200,000 = 2.00%. Paid Search conversion rate = 175 / 2,500 = 7.00%. Platform attribution credits Paid Social with 240 conversions. The holdout test on 90,000 exposed users shows 270 conversions (0.30%). The 10,000 holdout users show 20 conversions (0.20%). Incremental rate is 0.10%, so incremental conversions = 0.10% x 90,000 = 90. Therefore attribution overstates incremental impact by 150 conversions. Do not compare channels as if attribution equals incremental. Paid Search has no holdout, so its incremental impact is unknown. Before using these figures, verify the conversion event and 14-day window are identical, and confirm audiences remain disjoint. Recommend a Paid Search holdout test, significance testing, and a revenue view. This is a fictional simulation, not FIMMICK client advice. Handover owner: analyst.
exemplar.zh: 根據提供的虛構記錄：付費社交媒體點擊率 = 4,000 / 200,000 = 2.00%。付費搜尋轉換率 = 175 / 2,500 = 7.00%。平台歸因把 240 次轉換歸於付費社交媒體。90,000 名曝光用戶的保留組測試顯示 270 次轉換（0.30%）。10,000 名保留組用戶顯示 20 次轉換（0.20%）。新增率為 0.10%，因此新增轉換 = 0.10% x 90,000 = 90。歸因因而高估新增影響 150 次轉換。不要把渠道比較當成歸因等於新增。付費搜尋沒有保留組，因此其新增影響未知。使用這些數字前，請核實轉換事件及 14 天窗口相同，並確認受眾仍不相交。建議進行付費搜尋保留組測試、顯著性測試，並加入收入視角。此為虛構模擬，並非 FIMMICK 客戶建議。交接負責人：分析師。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct: Paid Social CTR 2.00% (4,000/200,000), Paid Search conversion rate 7.00% (175/2,500), attributed 240 versus incremental 90, the three valid comparison checks, and conversion rate as the clicks-denominator metric. The holdout arithmetic of 0.30% minus 0.20% times 90,000 giving 90 is applied correctly.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確：付費社交媒體點擊率 2.00%（4,000/200,000）、付費搜尋轉換率 7.00%（175/2,500）、歸因 240 對新增 90、三項有效比較檢查，以及以轉換率作為點擊分母的指標。保留組計算 0.30% 減 0.20% 乘以 90,000 得 90 亦應用正確。

feedback.en: Your handover cites the specific impression, click and conversion figures and shows each calculation step, then explains that attribution comes from platform tracking while incremental impact comes from the holdout comparison. The point that attribution overstates impact by 150 conversions is clearly linked to the supplied evidence.
feedback.zh: 你的交接引用具體曝光、點擊及轉換數字，並展示每步計算，其後解釋歸因來自平台追蹤而新增影響來自保留組比較。歸因高估影響 150 次轉換這一點清楚連繫至提供證據。

feedback.en: You correctly require identical conversion event and 14-day window checks plus audience disjointness before comparison, and you recommend a Paid Search holdout, significance testing and a revenue view. You also state that Paid Search incremental impact is unknown.
feedback.zh: 你正確要求在比較前檢查相同轉換事件、14 天窗口及受眾並不相交，並建議付費搜尋保留組、顯著性測試及收入視角。你亦指出付費搜尋新增影響未知。

feedback.en: You clearly state this is a fictional simulation and not client advice, and you avoid claiming Paid Search incremental impact. You could add that the holdout counts are small and that no significance test or revenue data exists yet, to bound the conclusions more tightly.
feedback.zh: 你清楚說明此為虛構模擬而非客戶建議，並避免聲稱付費搜尋的新增影響。你可補充保留組計數較小，以及目前沒有顯著性測試或收入數據，使結論範圍更嚴謹。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, covering both rates, the attribution versus incremental distinction, risks, next steps and a named owner. Ownership and escalation are clear.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，涵蓋兩個比率、歸因與新增的區分、風險、下一步及指定負責人。負責人及轉交安排清晰。

summary.en: A strong, complete submission with all answers correct and calculations shown against the supplied synthetic records. Only minor scope caveats such as small holdout counts and absent significance or revenue data are missing.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀，所有答案正確，並按提供的合成記錄展示計算。僅欠缺少量範圍提醒，例如保留組計數較小及未有顯著性或收入數據。

nextSteps.en: Add explicit caveats that the holdout sample is small and that significance testing and revenue data are still pending. This tightens the uncertainty framing without changing your correct conclusions.
nextSteps.zh: 補充明確提醒指保留組樣本較小，且顯著性測試及收入數據仍有待取得。這可收緊不確定性表述，而不影響你正確的結論。

title.en: Read Autumn Harvest Delivery campaign performance
title.zh: 解讀秋季收成送遞推廣表現

brief.en: You are a digital marketing analyst at FIMMICK. A fictional client, Lantau Fresh Groceries, needs a performance read of its Autumn Harvest Delivery campaign. Using only the supplied synthetic records, calculate the cost per attributed conversion for Short Video and Display Retargeting. Use the holdout test to estimate Short Video incremental conversions and cost per incremental conversion. Answer the questions and prepare a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese with calculations, evidence, risks and next steps. This is an independent simulation inspired by FIMMICK's public context, not endorsed by FIMMICK.
brief.zh: 你是 FIMMICK 的數碼營銷分析師。虛構客戶大嶼山鮮果雜貨需要一份秋季收成送遞推廣活動的表現解讀。只使用提供的合成記錄，計算短片及展示再營銷的每次歸因轉換成本。利用保留組測試估算短片的新增轉換及每次新增轉換成本。回答問題並以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔的書面交接，包含計算、證據、風險及下一步。此為受 FIMMICK 公開背景啟發的獨立模擬，未獲 FIMMICK 認可。

body.en: Fictional client Lantau Fresh Groceries ran a 14-day Autumn Harvest Delivery campaign. Short Video had spend HKD 120,000, 800,000 impressions, 16,000 clicks, and 480 platform-attributed conversions. Display Retargeting had spend HKD 60,000, 500,000 impressions, 5,000 clicks, and 150 platform-attributed conversions. Audiences for the two channels were disjoint by design. Both channels used the same conversion event, 'completed delivery order', and the same 14-day measurement window. These are synthetic records for the simulation.
body.zh: 虛構客戶大嶼山鮮果雜貨進行了為期 14 天的秋季收成送遞推廣活動。短片的支出為 HKD 120,000，有 800,000 次曝光、16,000 次點擊及 480 次平台歸因轉換。展示再營銷的支出為 HKD 60,000，有 500,000 次曝光、5,000 次點擊及 150 次平台歸因轉換。兩個渠道的受眾按設計並不相交。兩個渠道均使用相同的轉換事件「完成送遞訂單」，並採用相同的 14 天測量窗口。此為模擬的合成記錄。

title.zh: 測量規則及保留組測試

body.en: Measurement rules. Cost per attributed conversion equals channel spend divided by platform-attributed conversions. Click-through rate equals clicks divided by impressions. Conversion rate equals attributed conversions divided by clicks. For Short Video, a holdout test used 200,000 eligible users. 160,000 were exposed and 40,000 were held out. Exposed group had 288 conversions. Holdout group had 32 conversions. Incremental conversions equal (exposed conversion rate minus holdout conversion rate) times exposed users. Cost per incremental conversion equals channel spend divided by incremental conversions. Round HKD to nearest whole dollar. No holdout test exists for Display Retargeting.
body.zh: 測量規則。每次歸因轉換成本等於渠道支出除以平台歸因轉換。點擊率等於點擊次數除以曝光次數。轉換率等於歸因轉換除以點擊次數。短片的保留組測試使用 200,000 名合資格用戶。160,000 人獲曝光，40,000 人為保留組。曝光組有 288 次轉換。保留組有 32 次轉換。新增轉換等於（曝光組轉換率減保留組轉換率）乘以曝光用戶數。每次新增轉換成本等於渠道支出除以新增轉換。港元四捨五入至整數。展示再營銷沒有保留組測試。

label.en: Short Video cost per attributed conversion in HKD. Round to nearest whole dollar.
label.zh: 短片每次歸因轉換成本（港元）。四捨五入至整數。

label.en: Short Video cost per incremental conversion in HKD. Round to nearest whole dollar.
label.zh: 短片每次新增轉換成本（港元）。四捨五入至整數。

label.en: Based on the holdout test, what are Short Video attributed and incremental conversions?
label.zh: 根據保留組測試，短片的歸因轉換及新增轉換分別是多少？

label.zh: 無法從提供數據確定新增

label.en: Select all checks required before comparing cost per attributed conversion across the two channels.

確認渠道受眾並不相交

expectedEvidence.zh: 計算短片每次歸因轉換成本為 HKD 250（120,000 / 480）。計算短片每次新增轉換成本為 HKD 750（120,000 / 160）。識別歸因 480 及新增 160。選出檢查：相同轉換事件、相同測量窗口、受眾並不相交。識別每次歸因轉換成本以歸因轉換為分母。亦可提及展示再營銷每次歸因轉換成本為 HKD 400（60,000 / 150）。

Cites holdout numbers (160,000 exposed, 40,000 holdout, 288 exposed conversions, 32 holdout conversions) from document 2. Explains incremental conversion formula: (288/160,000 - 32/40,000) * 160,000 = 160. Explains cost per attributed conversion formula. Uses correct rounding.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用文件 1 的推廣支出及歸因轉換。引用文件 2 的保留組數字（160,000 曝光、40,000 保留、曝光組 288 次轉換、保留組 32 次轉換）。解釋新增轉換公式：（288/160,000 − 32/40,000）× 160,000 = 160。解釋每次歸因轉換成本公式。使用正確四捨五入。

exemplar.en: Handover for Autumn Harvest Delivery. Source records: campaign-records and measurement-rules. Short Video cost per attributed conversion is HKD 250 (120,000 / 480). Display Retargeting cost per attributed conversion is HKD 400 (60,000 / 150). Short Video attributed conversions are 480. From the holdout test, exposed conversion rate is 0.18% (288 / 160,000) and holdout rate is 0.08% (32 / 40,000). Incremental conversions are 160 ((0.18% - 0.08%) * 160,000). Cost per incremental conversion is HKD 750 (120,000 / 160). Attribution overstates incremental impact by 320 conversions. Risks: no holdout for Display Retargeting, so its incremental impact is unknown. Next steps: confirm audience disjointness and same conversion event. Request a holdout test for Display Retargeting. Rounding applied. Escalate to Ava Wong for holdout expansion.
exemplar.zh: 秋季收成送遞交接。文件來源：campaign-records 及 measurement-rules。短片每次歸因轉換成本為 HKD 250（120,000 / 480）。展示再營銷每次歸因轉換成本為 HKD 400（60,000 / 150）。短片歸因轉換為 480。根據保留組測試，曝光組轉換率為 0.18%（288 / 160,000），保留組轉換率為 0.08%（32 / 40,000）。新增轉換為 160（（0.18% − 0.08%）× 160,000）。每次新增轉換成本為 HKD 750（120,000 / 160）。歸因高估新增影響 320 次轉換。風險：展示再營銷沒有保留組測試，故其新增影響未知。下一步：確認受眾並不相交及相同轉換事件。要求為展示再營銷進行保留組測試。已應用四捨五入。轉交 Ava Wong 擴展保留組。

feedback.en: All calculations and selections are correct. Short Video cost per attributed conversion is HKD 250 (120,000 / 480), incremental conversions are 160, cost per incremental conversion is HKD 750 (120,000 / 160), and you correctly separated attribution from incrementality. Display Retargeting at HKD 400 is a valid extra comparison.
feedback.zh: 所有計算及選項均正確。短片每次歸因轉換成本為 HKD 250（120,000 / 480），新增轉換為 160，每次新增轉換成本為 HKD 750（120,000 / 160），你亦正確區分歸因與新增影響。展示再營銷 HKD 400 為合理補充比較。

feedback.en: You cite both supplied records and show the formulas clearly. The holdout working (288 / 160,000 minus 32 / 40,000 times 160,000) and the 320-conversion overstatement are well evidenced.
feedback.zh: 你引用兩份提供文件並清楚展示公式。保留組推算（288 / 160,000 減 32 / 40,000 乘 160,000）及高估 320 次轉換均有充分證據。

title.en: Review fictional SeaSalt Crackers creative and consent
title.zh: 審查虛構 SeaSalt Crackers 創意及同意

brief.en: You are a digital marketing analyst at FIMMICK. A fictional client, Lantau Naturals, wants to launch a paid social campaign for SeaSalt Crackers. Review the supplied policy, brief and claim register. Identify prohibited claims, missing approvals and consent limits, and decide what can be released. Then write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese with decisions, evidence, the consent calculation, risks and next steps. Do not access live accounts or client data. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by FIMMICK and not endorsed by it. Around 100 to 180 words for the handover.
brief.zh: 你是 FIMMICK 的數碼營銷分析師。虛構客戶 Lantau Naturals 計劃為 SeaSalt Crackers 推出付費社交推廣。請按提供的政策、簡介及聲明登記冊審查。找出禁止的聲明、欠缺的審批及同意限制，並決定可發布的內容。然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，列明決策、證據、同意人數計算、風險及下一步。不要存取真實帳戶或客戶資料。本練習為受 FIMMICK 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲該公司認可。交接約 100 至 180 英文字。

body.en: FIMMICK fictional policy for Lantau Naturals. Ad copy may use product claims only where a substantiation ID is on file and valid on the campaign start date. Health, immunity and bodily-effect claims are prohibited and cannot be approved by any substantiation, legal approval or client instruction. They must be removed or rewritten. A customer testimonial that asserts a health or bodily effect counts as a prohibited health claim, and consent does not make it acceptable. Superlatives such as only or best require a legal approval ID. Marketing messages may be sent only to contacts with opt-in consent recorded within 12 months. Unknown status counts as no consent. Creative release requires brand manager approval, and any flagged claim also requires compliance approval.
body.zh: FIMMICK 為 Lantau Naturals 制定的虛構政策。廣告文案只在證明編號已存檔並於推廣開始日期仍有效時，方可使用產品聲明。健康、免疫及身體效果聲明屬禁止，任何證明、法律審批或客戶指示均不可令其獲批。此類聲明必須移除或改寫。客戶見證若聲稱健康或身體效果，即屬禁止的健康聲明，同意亦不能使其可接受。只有、最佳等最高級聲明需要法律審批編號。只可向過去 12 個月內記錄了選擇加入的聯絡人發送營銷訊息。狀態不明視作未同意。創意發布需要品牌經理審批，任何被標示的聲明亦需要合規審批。

title.zh: Lantau Naturals 付費社交簡介

body.en: Client Lantau Naturals requests a paid social campaign for SeaSalt Crackers. Launch date 15 November 2026. Media budget HKD 120,000. Channels are Instagram and Facebook. Ad copy headline: Clinically proven to strengthen immunity. Body: The only crackers approved by Hong Kong nutritionists. Made with natural sea salt. Available in three flavours and packed in Hong Kong. Testimonial: I feel healthier after two weeks, attributed to Mabel C., real customer. Campaign list has 12,000 contacts. Consent records show 4,800 opted in within 12 months, 2,200 opted out, and 5,000 with unknown status. The client asks for fast approval without changes.
body.zh: 客戶 Lantau Naturals 要求為 SeaSalt Crackers 推出付費社交推廣。推出日期 2026 年 11 月 15 日。媒體預算 120,000 港元。渠道為 Instagram 及 Facebook。廣告標題：臨床證明可增強免疫力。內文：唯一獲香港營養師認可的餅乾。採用天然海鹽製成。供應三種口味，並在香港包裝。見證：兩週後我感到更健康。署名為真實客戶 Mabel C.。推廣名單有 12,000 名聯絡人。同意記錄顯示 4,800 人在 12 個月內選擇加入，2,200 人選擇退出，5,000 人狀態不明。客戶要求快速審批，不作修改。

body.en: Claim register for Lantau Naturals SeaSalt Crackers. Sea salt claim: certificate SS-204, valid until 31 December 2026. Immunity headline: flagged as a prohibited health claim, no substantiation can make it approvable. Superlative the only crackers approved by Hong Kong nutritionists: no legal approval ID supplied. Testimonial from Mabel C.: flagged as a prohibited health claim because it asserts feeling healthier, signed consent on file would not change that status. Consent list: 12,000 total contacts, 4,800 opted in within 12 months, 2,200 opted out, 5,000 unknown. Brand manager approval: pending. Compliance approval: not requested. Campaign launch date: 15 November 2026.
body.zh: Lantau Naturals SeaSalt Crackers 聲明登記冊。海鹽聲明：證書 SS-204，有效至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。免疫力標題：標示為禁止的健康聲明，任何證明均不可使其獲批。最高級聲明「唯一獲香港營養師認可的餅乾」：未提供法律審批編號。Mabel C. 的見證：因其聲稱感到更健康而標示為禁止的健康聲明，即使有簽署同意亦不改變此狀態。同意名單：總數 12,000 名聯絡人，4,800 人在 12 個月內選擇加入，2,200 人選擇退出，5,000 人狀態不明。品牌經理審批：待處理。合規審批：未要求。推廣推出日期：2026 年 11 月 15 日。
