title.en: Fictional AI creative, approval and audience permission policy
title.zh: 虛構 AI 創意、審批及受眾同意政策

body.en: FIMMICK fictional policy for the Lamma Lane campaign. Every AI-generated asset must carry a registered AI content ID and a named human reviewer. If either is missing, the asset is not releasable, even if the other requirement is met. A factual product claim in AI copy needs a substantiation ID valid on the campaign start date. A synthetic person must never be shown or described as a real customer. An implied endorsement by a named organisation needs a written endorsement approval ID. Promotional messages may be sent only to contacts whose permission was recorded within 12 months and not withdrawn. Withdrawn or unknown permission counts as no permission. Client instruction cannot override this policy. Campaign-wide brand-manager approval must be recorded before any asset can be released. This approval is separate from asset-specific content and reviewer checks.
body.zh: FIMMICK 為 Lamma Lane 推廣制定的虛構政策。每項 AI 生成素材必須帶有已登記的 AI 內容編號及具名人工審核人。兩者任一欠缺，該素材即不可發布，即使另一項要求已符合亦然。AI 文案中的事實性產品聲明，須有於推廣開始日期仍然有效的證明編號。合成人物不得被展示或描述為真實客戶。任何暗示獲具名機構認可，須有書面認可審批編號。營銷訊息只可發送給過去 12 個月內記錄了同意且未撤回的聯絡人。已撤回或狀態不明的同意視作未同意。客戶指示不可凌駕本政策。全推廣的品牌經理審批必須先記錄，任何素材才可發布。此審批與素材特定的內容及審核人檢查分開。

title.zh: Lamma Lane 付費社交簡介

body.en: Fictional client Lamma Lane Furniture requests a paid social campaign for the Bamboo Desk Shelf. Campaign start 6 March 2026. Media budget HKD 90,000. Channels are Instagram and Facebook. The client supplies five creative assets produced with AI tools and asks for same-week release. Asset captions include Our customer Karen enjoys it, and a copy line states Recommended by the Hong Kong Interior Design Association. The client asks to message the full 8,100-contact list. Campaign-wide brand-manager approval is pending, so no asset may be released yet, regardless of asset-specific checks. Compliance approval has not been requested for the flagged items.
body.zh: 虛構客戶 Lamma Lane Furniture 要求為 Bamboo Desk Shelf 推出付費社交推廣。推廣開始日期為 2026 年 3 月 6 日。媒體預算 90,000 港元。渠道為 Instagram 及 Facebook。客戶提供五項以 AI 工具製作的創意素材，並要求同週發布。素材字句包括「我們的客戶 Karen 很喜歡」，另有文案寫有「獲香港室內設計協會推薦」。客戶要求向全部 8,100 名聯絡人發送訊息。全推廣的品牌經理審批待處理，因此無論素材特定檢查結果如何，目前任何素材均不可發布。合規審批未就標示項目提出要求。

title.en: AI asset register and permission totals
title.zh: AI 素材登記冊及同意人數總計

body.en: AI asset register. Asset 1 hero image: AI content ID AIC-331, human reviewer J. Lau, no person shown. Asset 2 video: AI content ID AIC-407, no human reviewer named. Asset 3 copy block: claim made from recycled bamboo, substantiation SUB-88 valid to 31 December 2026, AI content ID AIC-412, human reviewer M. Chan. Asset 4 image: synthetic person holding the shelf, caption Our customer Karen enjoys it, AI content ID AIC-455, human reviewer J. Lau. Asset 5 copy block: recommended by the Hong Kong Interior Design Association, no endorsement approval ID, AI content ID AIC-460, no human reviewer named. Contact list 8,100 total. Permission recorded within 12 months and not withdrawn: 4,400. Recorded outside 12 months: 1,650. Withdrawn: 1,100. No record: 950.
body.zh: AI 素材登記冊。素材 1 主視覺圖片：AI 內容編號 AIC-331，人工審核人 J. Lau，沒有展示人物。素材 2 影片：AI 內容編號 AIC-407，沒有具名人工審核人。素材 3 文案區塊：聲明以再生竹製造，證明編號 SUB-88 有效至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，AI 內容編號 AIC-412，人工審核人 M. Chan。素材 4 圖片：合成人物手持層架，字句「我們的客戶 Karen 很喜歡」，AI 內容編號 AIC-455，人工審核人 J. Lau。素材 5 文案區塊：獲香港室內設計協會推薦，沒有認可審批編號，AI 內容編號 AIC-460，沒有具名人工審核人。聯絡人名單總數 8,100。過去 12 個月內記錄同意且未撤回：4,400。於 12 個月前記錄：1,650。已撤回：1,100。沒有記錄：950。

label.en: Under the fictional policy, what is the correct treatment of Asset 2?
label.zh: 根據虛構政策，素材 2 的正確處理方式是甚麼？

label.en: Withhold it until a named human reviewer is recorded
label.zh: 暫緩，直至記錄具名人工審核人

label.en: Release it because AI content ID AIC-407 is registered
label.zh: 因已登記 AI 內容編號 AIC-407 而可發布

label.en: Release it once the client signs off the video
label.zh: 客戶簽署確認影片後即可發布

label.en: Release it if it appears only in Instagram Stories
label.zh: 只在 Instagram 限時動態出現即可發布

label.en: Which supplied assets require asset-specific content or reviewer remediation before release, independent of the pending campaign-wide brand-manager approval?
label.zh: 在有待處理的全推廣品牌經理審批之外，哪些素材需要素材特定的內容或審核人補救才可發布？

label.en: Asset 4 image captioned as a customer
label.zh: 素材 4 以客戶字句署名的圖片
素材 5 認可文案區塊

label.en: How many contacts may receive the campaign under the fictional permission policy?
label.zh: 根據虛構同意政策，多少名聯絡人可收到此推廣？

label.en: What is the correct remediation for Asset 4?
label.zh: 素材 4 的正確補救方法是甚麼？

label.en: Remove it, or relabel the synthetic person as clearly not a real customer
label.zh: 移除它，或把合成人物清楚標示為並非真實客戶

label.zh: 取得合成人物的簽署同意

label.zh: 為該字句取得認可審批編號

label.zh: 保留字句並加上效果因人而異的免責聲明

label.en: What asset-specific remediation is needed before Asset 5 can be released under the fictional policy?
label.zh: 根據虛構政策，素材 5 發布前須作甚麼素材特定補救？

label.en: Record a named human reviewer AND either provide an endorsement approval ID OR remove the endorsement line
label.zh: 記錄具名人工審核人，並且（提供認可審批編號或刪除推薦字句）

label.en: Record a named human reviewer only, keeping the endorsement line unchanged
label.zh: 只記錄具名人工審核人，推薦字句保持不變

label.en: Provide the endorsement approval ID only, keeping the asset without a named reviewer
label.zh: 只提供認可審批編號，素材維持不設具名審核人

label.en: Obtain a client waiver covering both requirements
label.zh: 取得涵蓋兩項要求的客戶豁免

label.en: What approval gate still applies to every asset before release in this fictional case?
label.zh: 在本虛構個案中，任何素材發布前仍適用哪項審批關卡？

label.en: Campaign-wide brand-manager approval must be recorded before any asset can be released
label.zh: 全推廣的品牌經理審批必須先記錄，任何素材才可發布

label.zh: 素材特定問題修正後，客戶簽署確認即可發布素材

label.en: Compliance approval is automatic when AI content IDs are registered
label.zh: AI 內容編號一經登記，合規審批即自動完成

label.en: No further approval is needed after asset-specific fixes are made
label.zh: 完成素材特定修正後，無須進一步審批

about.en: FIMMICK describes marketing and technology services involving reporting, creative work, campaigns and managed AI workflows.
about.zh: FIMMICK 公開介紹其營銷及科技服務，包括報告、創意工作、推廣活動及受管理的 AI 工作流程。

publicValues.zh: 營銷專業及可量度的工作流程

simulationStyle.en: Review a fictional client campaign using supplied metrics, brand constraints and human approval rules. No actual client account, spend or campaign is accessed.
simulationStyle.zh: 按提供的指標、品牌限制及人手審批規則審查虛構客戶推廣活動，不會存取真實客戶帳戶、支出或活動。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Review a synthetic bilingual creative brief against supplied brand, consent and approval requirements.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按提供的品牌、同意及審批要求審查合成雙語創意簡介。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Review a synthetic bilingual creative brief against supplied brand, consent and approval requirements.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按提供的品牌、同意及審批要求審查合成雙語創意簡介。

expectedEvidence.en: Asset-specific requirements: Asset 2 is withheld because AI content ID AIC-407 is present but no named human reviewer is recorded. Asset 4 is withheld because a synthetic person is captioned as a real customer. Asset 5 is withheld because no endorsement approval ID is recorded for the Hong Kong Interior Design Association recommendation and no named human reviewer is recorded alongside AIC-460, so its remediation is a named reviewer AND either an endorsement approval ID OR removal of the endorsement line. Assets 1 and 3 have no asset-specific remediation. Separately, campaign-wide brand-manager approval is pending, so no asset may release yet. Eligible contacts are 4,400.
expectedEvidence.zh: 素材特定要求：素材 2 須暫緩，因其有 AI 內容編號 AIC-407 但沒有記錄具名人工審核人。素材 4 須暫緩，因合成人物被署名為真實客戶。素材 5 須暫緩，因香港室內設計協會的推薦沒有認可審批編號，且 AIC-460 沒有同時記錄具名人工審核人，因此其補救為具名審核人，並且（提供認可審批編號或刪除推薦字句）。素材 1 及素材 3 沒有素材特定補救需要。另外，全推廣的品牌經理審批待處理，因此目前任何素材均不可發布。可發送的聯絡人數為 4,400。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source-one clauses on the AI content ID plus named reviewer requirement, synthetic persons, endorsement approval, the 12-month permission window and withdrawal, and the separate campaign-wide brand-manager approval gate. Cites source-three register entries and permission totals. Notes that Asset 5 fails both the reviewer requirement and the endorsement requirement, so fixing only one leaves it non-releasable. Explains 4,400 of 8,100 by excluding 1,650 contacts recorded outside 12 months, 1,100 withdrawn and 950 with no record.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引述 source-one 關於 AI 內容編號加具名審核人要求、合成人物、認可審批、12 個月同意期限及撤回，以及獨立的全推廣品牌經理審批關卡的條文。引述 source-three 的登記冊項目及同意人數總計。指出素材 5 同時未符合審核人要求及認可要求，只修正其一仍不可發布。解釋 8,100 人中的 4,400 人，是排除 1,650 名於 12 個月前記錄、1,100 名已撤回及 950 名沒有記錄的聯絡人後得出。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checking that a named human reviewer is recorded for Asset 2 and for Asset 5, confirming Asset 5 has an endorsement approval ID or that the endorsement line is removed, confirming Asset 4 is removed or relabelled so no real-customer implication remains, confirming campaign-wide brand-manager approval is on file before any release, and re-validating each contact's permission window and withdrawal status at launch.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出檢查素材 2 及素材 5 是否已記錄具名人工審核人、確認素材 5 已取得認可審批編號或已刪除推薦字句、確認素材 4 已移除或重新標示而不再暗示真實客戶、確認任何發布前已存檔全推廣的品牌經理審批，以及在推出時重新核實每名聯絡人的同意期限及撤回狀態。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States the case is fictional, no live client accounts or data are used, and no legal advice is given. Notes missing evidence such as no named reviewer for Asset 2, no named reviewer and no endorsement approval ID for Asset 5, and no brand-manager approval yet, and allows that a permission record could lapse or be withdrawn before launch.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明本案屬虛構，沒有使用真實客戶帳戶或資料，亦不提供法律意見。指出欠缺證據之處，例如素材 2 沒有具名審核人、素材 5 沒有具名審核人及沒有認可審批編號，以及尚未有品牌經理審批，並指出同意記錄可能在推出前到期或被撤回。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover listing the hold decision, the separate approval gate, the asset-specific remediations with source references and both Asset 5 grounds, the 4,400 contact calculation, escalation to the brand manager for campaign-wide release approval and to compliance for the flagged items, and the corrected assets requested from the client including a named reviewer for Assets 2 and 5.
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接列明暫緩決定、獨立的審批關卡、附文件出處的素材特定補救及素材 5 的兩項理由、4,400 名聯絡人的計算、就全推廣發布審批轉交品牌經理及就標示項目轉交合規，以及向客戶要求的修正素材，包括為素材 2 及素材 5 具名人工審核人。

exemplar.en:
Decision: hold the full creative set. Campaign-wide brand-manager approval is pending, so no asset may be released yet even if asset-specific checks pass. Separately, Assets 2, 4 and 5 need asset-specific remediation. Asset 2 has AI content ID AIC-407 but no named human reviewer, which source-one requires for every AI asset. Asset 4 shows a synthetic person captioned as our customer Karen, which source-one forbids. Asset 5 claims endorsement by the Hong Kong Interior Design Association with no endorsement approval ID, and it also carries AIC-460 with no named human reviewer, so its fix is a named reviewer AND either an endorsement approval ID OR removal of that line. Assets 1 and 3 have no asset-specific defect, and SUB-88 is valid to 31 December 2026, covering the 6 March 2026 start.

Reach: message only the 4,400 contacts whose permission was recorded within 12 months and not withdrawn. The 1,650 recorded outside 12 months, 1,100 withdrawn and 950 with no record are excluded from the 8,100 total.

Next steps: ask the client to name reviewers for Assets 2 and 5, remove or relabel Asset 4, and supply an endorsement approval ID for Asset 5 or drop that line. Escalate to the brand manager for the campaign-wide release approval. No live client data was accessed in this simulation.
exemplar.zh:
決策：暫緩整組創意。全推廣的品牌經理審批待處理，因此即使素材特定檢查通過，目前任何素材均不可發布。另外，素材 2、4、5 需要素材特定補救。素材 2 有 AI 內容編號 AIC-407 但沒有具名人工審核人，違反 source-one 對每項 AI 素材的要求。素材 4 展示合成人物並署名為「我們的客戶 Karen」，屬 source-one 禁止的做法。素材 5 聲稱獲香港室內設計協會推薦但沒有認可審批編號，同時只有 AIC-460 而沒有具名人工審核人，因此其補救為具名審核人，並且（提供認可審批編號或刪除該句）。素材 1 及素材 3 沒有素材特定缺陷，且 SUB-88 有效至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，涵蓋 2026 年 3 月 6 日的開始日期。

發送範圍：只向過去 12 個月內記錄同意且未撤回的 4,400 名聯絡人發送訊息。在 8,100 名總數中，1,650 名於 12 個月前記錄、1,100 名已撤回及 950 名沒有記錄者均被排除。

下一步：要求客戶為素材 2 及素材 5 具名人工審核人、移除或重新標示素材 4，並為素材 5 提供認可審批編號或刪除該句。就全推廣發布審批轉交品牌經理。本模擬沒有存取任何真實客戶資料。

feedback.en: All decisions are correct. You held the whole set pending campaign-wide brand-manager approval, flagged Assets 2, 4 and 5 for asset-specific remediation, gave Asset 4 the remove-or-relabel fix, required both a named reviewer and an endorsement approval ID or removal of the line for Asset 5, and set eligible reach at 4,400 of 8,100.
feedback.zh: 所有決策均正確。你以全推廣品牌經理審批待處理為由暫緩整組素材，把素材 2、4、5 列為需素材特定補救，為素材 4 提出移除或重新標示，就素材 5 同時要求具名審核人及認可審批編號或刪除該句，並把可發送人數定為 8,100 人中的 4,400 人。

feedback.en: You tied each decision to the right record, citing AIC-407 lacking a reviewer, the synthetic person captioned as a real customer, AIC-460 plus the missing endorsement ID, and SUB-88 validity covering the 6 March 2026 start. The 4,400 calculation is explained by excluding 1,650 out-of-window, 1,100 withdrawn and 950 unrecorded contacts.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連繫到正確記錄，引用 AIC-407 欠缺審核人、合成人物被署名為真實客戶、AIC-460 加上欠缺認可編號，以及 SUB-88 有效期涵蓋 2026 年 3 月 6 日開始日。4,400 人的計算亦解釋為排除 1,650 名超期、1,100 名已撤回及 950 名沒有記錄者。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete for naming reviewers for Assets 2 and 5, resolving the Asset 5 endorsement line, fixing Asset 4 and escalating to the brand manager. Adding a launch-day recheck of each contact's 12-month permission window and withdrawal status, plus escalation of the flagged items to compliance, would make the plan fully testable.
feedback.zh: 你為素材 2 及素材 5 具名審核人、處理素材 5 推薦字句、修正素材 4 及轉交品牌經理的下一步相當具體。若再加入推出日重新核實每名聯絡人的 12 個月同意期限及撤回狀態，並把標示項目轉交合規，計劃就更完整可測。

feedback.en: You correctly state no live client data was accessed and the missing reviewer and endorsement records are named. Adding that this is a fictional case, that no legal advice is given, and that permission records could lapse or be withdrawn before launch would strengthen the scope statement.
feedback.zh: 你正確說明沒有存取真實客戶資料，並點出欠缺的審核人及認可記錄。若補充本案屬虛構、不提供法律意見，以及同意記錄可能在推出前到期或被撤回，範圍說明會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable, with the hold decision, asset-specific remediations, source references, the 4,400 contact figure and a named escalation to the brand manager. It reads well as a working note for Katie Ng's team.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰可行，列明暫緩決定、素材特定補救、文件出處、4,400 名聯絡人數目，以及向品牌經理轉交。作為 Katie Ng 團隊的工作紀錄相當合適。

summary.en: A strong submission with every structured answer correct and evidence linked to the supplied register, brief and policy. Reach, remediation and the separate approval gate are all handled accurately, with only minor room to broaden verification and scope caveats.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀，所有結構化答案均正確，證據亦連繫到提供的登記冊、簡介及政策。發送範圍、補救及獨立審批關卡均處理準確，只在核實步驟及範圍聲明方面有輕微擴充空間。

nextSteps.en: Add a launch-day recheck of contact permission status, note the fictional and non-legal-advice limits, and route the flagged assets to compliance alongside the brand-manager escalation.
nextSteps.zh: 加入推出日重新核實聯絡人同意狀態、註明虛構性質及不提供法律意見的限制，並在轉交品牌經理之外，把標示素材一併轉交合規。

title.en: Plan the next controlled message test
title.zh: 規劃下一個受控訊息測試

brief.en: Fictional client Harbour Bean plans a controlled email test to existing Hong Kong subscribers aged 25 to 44 who have not started a trial. The eligible audience is 2,400 people. The hard test budget is HKD 8,000. The send cost is HKD 2.50 per recipient. The test will compare a pre-approved convenience message with a standard control message in an equal split. The primary metric is trial-start rate. The baseline trial-start rate is 2.0 percent. The test must show at least a 20 percent relative lift over baseline to count as success. This is a fictional learning simulation inspired by FIMMICK. It is not endorsed by FIMMICK and does not access real accounts, spend or campaigns.

body.en: Wave 1 controlled email test, identical audience segment, equal split of 600 recipients per cell. Control copy: opens 150, clicks 30, trial starts 12. Convenience copy: opens 168, clicks 36, trial starts 15. No other changes were made. Both cells ran in the same 7-day window. No price or saving claims were used. These are synthetic records for training only.
body.zh: 第一輪受控電郵測試，相同受眾劃分，每組均等分配 600 名收件人。對照文案：開啟 150，點擊 30，試用開始 12。便利文案：開啟 168，點擊 36，試用開始 15。沒有其他變更。兩組均在同一 7 天期間進行。沒有使用價格或節省聲明。此為僅供訓練用的合成記錄。

body.en: Fictional approval policy for Harbour Bean. Any message that states a price, discount, or saving amount needs written price substantiation and a legal check before use. The convenience copy is pre-approved for one send to the controlled audience until 30 November 2026. The savings copy that mentions HKD 120 is not approved because price substantiation is missing. A human client brand manager must approve the final send plan at least 2 business days before send. Any change to copy or audience cancels pre-approval.
body.zh: Harbour Bean 的虛構審批政策。任何列明價格、折扣或節省金額的訊息，使用前均需書面價格證明及法律檢查。便利文案已預先批准於 2026 年 11 月 30 日前向受控受眾發送一次。提及 HKD 120 的節省文案未獲批准，因欠缺價格證明。人手客戶品牌經理必須在發送前至少 2 個工作天批准最終發送計劃。任何文案或受眾變更均會取消預先批准。

expectedEvidence.en: Selects convenience message versus standard control. Explains that the savings copy mentioning HKD 120 is not approved because price substantiation is missing. States the primary metric is trial-start rate. Calculates the threshold as 29 trial starts. Calculates total cost as HKD 6,000. States approval conditions: pre-approved copy, controlled audience, brand manager approval at least 2 business days before send.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選擇便利訊息對標準對照。解釋提及 HKD 120 的節省文案未獲批准，因欠缺價格證明。指出主要指標為試用開始率。計算門檻為 29 個試用開始。計算總成本為 HKD 6,000。指出審批條件：預先批准文案、受控受眾、品牌經理在發送前至少 2 個工作天批准。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Uses source-two wave 1 data: control 12 trial starts from 600 recipients gives 2.0 percent. Convenience 15 trial starts from 600 gives 2.5 percent. Relative lift is 25 percent, above the 20 percent requirement. Uses source-one figures: 2,400 eligible recipients, HKD 8,000 hard budget, HKD 2.50 per recipient, 2.0 percent baseline. Uses source-three approval policy: HKD 120 savings claim lacks price substantiation and is not approved.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用文件二第一輪數據：對照組 600 名收件人有 12 個試用開始，即 2.0%。便利組 600 名收件人有 15 個試用開始，即 2.5%。相對提升為 25%，高於 20% 要求。引用文件一數字：2,400 名合資格收件人、HKD 8,000 硬性預算、每名收件人 HKD 2.50、基準 2.0%。引用文件三審批政策：HKD 120 節省聲明欠缺價格證明，未獲批准。

expectedEvidence.zh: 檢查文案維持預先批准、受眾篩選為受控劃分、品牌經理批准記錄在發送前至少 2 個工作天、總成本 HKD 6,000 在 HKD 8,000 之內、沒有使用節省聲明、測試組有 1,200 名收件人、發送後試用開始與 29 比較，並報告開啟率及點擊率作診斷。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Provides a concise handover with decision, evidence, calculations, risks, approval owner, and next action. Names client brand manager approval as the approval step and states that any copy or audience change must be escalated for new approval.

exemplar.en: Decision. Run the convenience message versus the standard control in an equal split of the 2,400 eligible subscribers. The savings copy that mentions HKD 120 cannot proceed because source three records no price substantiation and no approval. Evidence. In wave 1, control had 12 trial starts from 600 recipients, a 2.0 percent rate. The convenience copy had 15 trial starts from 600, a 2.5 percent rate. That is a 25 percent relative lift, above the required 20 percent. Calculations. The test arm has 1,200 recipients. Baseline expected trial starts are 24. A 20 percent lift requires 28.8, rounded up to 29 trial starts. Total send cost is 2,400 times HKD 2.50, which equals HKD 6,000, within the HKD 8,000 hard budget. Risks. Wave 1 is small and synthetic. The result is not proof of future lift. Next steps. Keep copy and audience unchanged, obtain client brand manager approval at least two business days before send, then compare trial-start rate against 29 starts and report open and click rates as diagnostics. Escalate any copy or audience change for new approval.
exemplar.zh: 決策。以 2,400 名合資格訂閱者均等分配，進行便利訊息對標準對照。提及 HKD 120 的節省文案不可進行，因文件三記錄欠缺價格證明及未獲批准。證據。第一輪中，對照組 600 名收件人有 12 個試用開始，即 2.0%。便利文案 600 名收件人有 15 個試用開始，即 2.5%。相對提升為 25%，高於所需的 20%。計算。測試組有 1,200 名收件人。基準預期試用開始為 24。20% 提升需要 28.8，向上調整為 29 個試用開始。總發送成本為 2,400 乘 HKD 2.50，等於 HKD 6,000，在 HKD 8,000 硬性預算之內。風險。第一輪規模小且為合成數據。結果不證明未來提升。下一步。保持文案及受眾不變，在發送前至少 2 個工作天取得客戶品牌經理批准，然後把試用開始率與 29 個開始比較，並報告開啟率及點擊率作診斷。任何文案或受眾變更均須轉交以重新審批。

feedback.en: All decisions and figures are correct: you chose convenience versus control, rejected the HKD 120 savings copy for missing price substantiation, set trial-start rate as the primary metric, and reached 29 trial starts and HKD 6,000 total cost. The three approval conditions are also complete and accurate.
feedback.zh: 所有決策及數字均正確：你選擇便利訊息對對照、以欠缺價格證明為由排除提及 HKD 120 的節省文案、以試用開始率為主要指標，並得出 29 個試用開始及總成本 HKD 6,000。三項審批條件亦完整準確。

feedback.en: You tie each claim to a specific record: wave 1 control 12 of 600 at 2.0 percent versus convenience 15 of 600 at 2.5 percent, a 25 percent lift, plus the 2,400 audience, HKD 2.50 unit cost and 2.0 percent baseline. The reasoning chain from evidence to the 29-start threshold is clear and verifiable.
feedback.zh: 你把每項主張連結至具體記錄：第一輪對照組 600 人中 12 人即 2.0%，便利組 600 人中 15 人即 2.5%，提升 25%，並引用 2,400 名受眾、每名 HKD 2.50 及 2.0% 基準。由證據推導至 29 個開始門檻的推理清晰可核。

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete: keep copy and audience unchanged, secure brand manager approval at least two business days ahead, compare post-send trial starts with 29, and report open and click rates as diagnostics. You also confirm the HKD 6,000 cost sits within the HKD 8,000 budget.
feedback.zh: 你的檢查具體：保持文案及受眾不變、發送前至少 2 個工作天取得品牌經理批准、把發送後試用開始與 29 比較，並報告開啟率及點擊率作診斷。你亦確認 HKD 6,000 成本在 HKD 8,000 預算之內。

feedback.en: You correctly flag that wave 1 is small and synthetic and that prior lift does not prove future results, which is the key caveat. Adding that no real client account, spend or campaign is accessed and that no external market data or legal review was supplied would strengthen the scope limits.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出第一輪規模小且為合成數據，先前提升不證明未來結果，這是最關鍵的保留。若再補充不會存取真實客戶帳戶、支出或活動，且沒有提供外部市場數據或法律審查，範圍界定會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, covering decision, evidence, calculations, risks, the client brand manager as approval owner, the next comparison step and escalation for any copy or audience change. A reader could act on it without further clarification.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，涵蓋決策、證據、計算、風險、以客戶品牌經理為審批負責人、下一步比較，以及任何文案或受眾變更的轉交。讀者無須再澄清即可行動。

summary.en: An accurate, well-evidenced plan that matches the supplied rules and calculations and is ready to hand over. The main gap is only a slightly narrower statement of scope limits around real accounts and external review.
summary.zh: 此計劃準確且證據充分，符合提供的規則及計算，可直接交接。唯一較弱處是對真實帳戶及外部審查的範圍界定略為不足。

nextSteps.en: Add one line noting no real account, spend or campaign is accessed and no external market or legal review was supplied. Keep the unchanged-copy and audience condition explicit in the final send plan given any change cancels pre-approval.
nextSteps.zh: 補充一句說明不會存取真實帳戶、支出或活動，且沒有提供外部市場或法律審查。由於任何變更會取消預先批准，請在最終發送計劃中明確保留文案及受眾不變的條件。

title.zh: 規劃下一個著陸頁比較

brief.en: Fictional client Lantau Outfitters is comparing two landing pages for a day-hike gear rental campaign. The test budget is fixed at HKD 12,000 and media costs HKD 4.00 per click. Run 1 ended with an uneven click split and a failed mobile load gate on Page B. Review the request, results and technical policy. Decide the next experiment, apply the acceptance rules and budget, and write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering the decision, calculations, evidence, uncertainty, approval and next steps. This independent learning simulation is inspired by FIMMICK but is not endorsed by FIMMICK.
brief.zh: 虛構客戶 Lantau Outfitters 正比較兩個著陸頁，用於一日遠足裝備租借活動。測試預算固定為 HKD 12,000，媒體成本為每點擊 HKD 4.00。第一輪以不均等的點擊分配結束，且 Page B 未通過流動載入門檻。請審閱要求、結果及技術政策。決定下一個實驗，套用接納規則及預算，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，涵蓋決策、計算、證據、不確定性、審批及下一步。此為受 FIMMICK 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲 FIMMICK 認可。

body.en: Fictional client Lantau Outfitters compares two landing pages for a day-hike gear rental campaign. The test budget is fixed at HKD 12,000. Media costs HKD 4.00 per click and spend must not exceed the budget. The primary metric is qualified-lead rate. A page needs at least 1,000 clicks for its rate to count as valid. An accepted page must beat the control by at least 1.0 percentage point absolute and keep cost per qualified lead at or below HKD 85. Every page must pass the mobile load gate in the technical policy. Simulation only, not endorsed by FIMMICK, no real ad spend or client account.
body.zh: 虛構客戶 Lantau Outfitters 比較兩個著陸頁，用於一日遠足裝備租借活動。測試預算固定為 HKD 12,000。媒體成本為每點擊 HKD 4.00，支出不得超過預算。主要指標為合格潛在客戶率。每個頁面須有至少 1,000 次點擊，其比率方計為有效。獲接納的頁面須較對照頁高出至少 1.0 個百分點（絕對值），且每次合格潛在客戶成本須不高於 HKD 85。每個頁面均須通過技術政策所述的流動載入門檻。僅為模擬，未獲 FIMMICK 認可，不使用真實廣告支出或客戶帳戶。

body.en: Run 1 results, 14-day window. Page A, the current control, received 2,200 clicks and produced 66 qualified leads. Page B, the new one-page booking layout, received 800 clicks and produced 40 qualified leads. Spend was HKD 4.00 per click in both arms. A redirect loop on Page B was active from day 1 to day 3 and sent some Page B traffic back to Page A, so the click split was not even. These are synthetic training records, not real campaign data.
body.zh: 第一輪結果，為期 14 日。Page A 為現行對照頁，獲得 2,200 次點擊，產生 66 個合格潛在客戶。Page B 為新單頁預約版面，獲得 800 次點擊，產生 40 個合格潛在客戶。兩組均以每點擊 HKD 4.00 計算支出。Page B 的重新導向循環於第 1 日至第 3 日生效，把部分 Page B 流量送回 Page A，因此點擊分配並不均等。此為合成訓練記錄，並非真實活動數據。

body.en: Fictional technical and approval policy. Page A mobile p75 load time is 1.9 seconds and passes the 2.5 second gate. Page B mobile p75 load time is 3.4 seconds and fails the gate. A page that fails the gate cannot be used in a valid comparison. The client digital operations lead must confirm in writing that the redirect loop is closed and that Page B passes the load gate before any re-run starts. A re-run must use an even click split inside the same HKD 12,000 budget. Neither page states a price, discount or saving, so no price substantiation is required.
body.zh: 虛構技術及審批政策。Page A 流動 p75 載入時間為 1.9 秒，通過 2.5 秒門檻。Page B 流動 p75 載入時間為 3.4 秒，未通過門檻。未通過門檻的頁面不得用於有效比較。客戶數碼營運主管必須在重新測試開始前，以書面確認重新導向循環已關閉，且 Page B 已通過載入門檻。重新測試須在同一 HKD 12,000 預算內使用均等點擊分配。兩個頁面均無列明價格、折扣或節省金額，因此毋須價格證明。

label.zh: 下一步應進行哪項行動？

label.en: Re-run a controlled comparison with an even click split after closing the redirect loop and fixing the Page B load time
label.zh: 在關閉重新導向循環及修正 Page B 載入時間後，以均等點擊分配重新進行受控比較

label.en: Declare Page B the winner and move all budget to it
label.zh: 宣布 Page B 勝出並把全部預算轉至該頁

label.en: Declare Page A the winner because it received more clicks
label.zh: 因 Page A 獲得較多點擊而宣布其勝出

label.en: Stop all landing-page work on both pages
label.zh: 停止兩個著陸頁的所有工作

label.en: Which statement about Run 1 is correct?
label.zh: 關於第一輪的哪項陳述正確？

label.en: Page B's 5.0 percent rate cannot yet be the basis for a winner decision because Page B had fewer than 1,000 clicks and the redirect fault contaminated the split
label.zh: Page B 的 5.0% 比率目前不能作為勝出決定的依據，因 Page B 少於 1,000 次點擊，且重新導向故障污染了分配

about.en: FIMMICK describes marketing and technology services involving reporting, creative work, campaigns and managed AI workflows.

publicValues.zh: 營銷專業及可量度的工作流程

simulationStyle.en: Review a fictional client campaign using supplied metrics, brand constraints and human approval rules. No actual client account, spend or campaign is accessed.
simulationStyle.zh: 按提供的指標、品牌限制及人手審批規則審查虛構客戶推廣活動，不會存取真實客戶帳戶、支出或活動。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Select an evidence-backed campaign experiment with measurable success and an approval handover.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。選擇有證據支持的推廣實驗，定義可量度成功及審批交接。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Select an evidence-backed campaign experiment with measurable success and an approval handover.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。選擇有證據支持的推廣實驗，定義可量度成功及審批交接。

expectedEvidence.en: Chooses the re-run with an even split after fixes, not a winner declaration. States Run 1 cannot pick a winner because Page B had 800 clicks, below the 1,000 click minimum, and the day 1 to day 3 redirect loop contaminated assignment, so the split was not even. Applies budget HKD 12,000 at HKD 4.00 per click = 3,000 clicks, even split 1,500 per page. Page B cost per qualified lead = 800 x HKD 4.00 = HKD 3,200 / 40 = HKD 80, inside the HKD 85 guardrail. Page A = 2,200 x HKD 4.00 = HKD 8,800 / 66 = about HKD 133.33, outside the HKD 85 guardrail. Page B fails the 2.5 second mobile p75 load gate at 3.4 seconds. Accepts re-run or repeat controlled comparison wording.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選擇在修正後以均等分配重新測試，而非宣布勝出者。說明第一輪不能選出勝出者，因 Page B 只有 800 次點擊，低於 1,000 次最低要求，且第 1 日至第 3 日的重新導向循環污染了分配，故分配並不均等。套用預算 HKD 12,000，以每點擊 HKD 4.00 計，等於 3,000 次點擊，均等分配為每頁 1,500 次。Page B 每次合格潛在客戶成本 = 800 x HKD 4.00 = HKD 3,200 / 40 = HKD 80，位於 HKD 85 防護線之內。Page A = 2,200 x HKD 4.00 = HKD 8,800 / 66 = 約 HKD 133.33，超出 HKD 85 防護線。Page B 流動 p75 載入時間為 3.4 秒，未通過 2.5 秒門檻。接受重新測試或重複受控比較等表述。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source-two click and qualified-lead counts for Page A (2,200 clicks, 66 leads) and Page B (800 clicks, 40 leads), source-one acceptance rules and the HKD 12,000 budget at HKD 4.00 per click, and source-three load times and written approval rule. Explains the arithmetic in the domain-accuracy criterion and explains that the 5.0 percent versus 3.0 percent rate gap is directionally positive but not a valid basis until exposure and traffic assignment are fixed. Accepts either the exact figures or close equivalents.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用來源二 Page A（2,200 次點擊，66 個合格潛在客戶）及 Page B（800 次點擊，40 個合格潛在客戶）的點擊及合格潛在客戶數目，來源一的接納規則及 HKD 12,000 預算與每點擊 HKD 4.00，以及來源三的載入時間及書面審批規則。解釋決策準確度準則中的運算，並解釋 5.0% 對 3.0% 的比率差距方向正面，但在曝光及流量分配獲修正前並非有效依據。接受準確數字或相近等值。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Requires the redirect loop to be closed and verified in writing by the client digital operations lead before launch, Page B mobile p75 load time re-measured and confirmed below the 2.5 second gate stated in the technical policy, an even split confirmed at 1,500 clicks per page inside the HKD 12,000 budget, and at least 1,000 clicks per page confirmed before the qualified-lead rates are read. Accepts counting delivered clicks at the end of the run to confirm the split stayed even.
expectedEvidence.zh: 要求重新導向循環在推出前關閉並由客戶數碼營運主管以書面核實，重新量度 Page B 流動 p75 載入時間並確認低於技術政策所述的 2.5 秒門檻，確認在 HKD 12,000 預算內每頁 1,500 次點擊的均等分配，並在解讀合格潛在客戶率前確認每頁至少達 1,000 次點擊。接受在測試結束時點算實際送達點擊以確認分配保持均等。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States the scenario is fictional with no real ad spend or client account, notes the current rate difference is not yet a valid decision basis, notes the redirect fault and failed load gate are unresolved, and avoids any claim about real company policy or guaranteed future performance.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明情境為虛構，不使用真實廣告支出或客戶帳戶，指出目前比率差距尚未成為有效決策依據，指出重新導向故障及載入門檻未通過仍未解決，並避免任何關於真實公司政策或保證未來表現的聲明。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover naming the decision to re-run with an even split after fixes, the supporting numbers (5.0 percent versus 3.0 percent rate, HKD 80 versus about HKD 133.33 cost per qualified lead, 1,500 clicks per page), the approval owner (client digital operations lead), and the next action to close the redirect loop and re-measure Page B mobile p75 load time before launch.
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接列明在修正後以均等分配重新測試的決策、支持數字（5.0% 對 3.0% 比率、HKD 80 對約 HKD 133.33 的每次合格潛在客戶成本、每頁 1,500 次點擊）、審批負責人（客戶數碼營運主管），以及推出前關閉重新導向循環及重新量度 Page B 流動 p75 載入時間的下一步。

exemplar.en: Decision: do not declare a winner from Run 1. Re-run a controlled comparison after two fixes. Evidence: Page B produced 40 qualified leads from 800 clicks, a 5.0 percent rate, and Page A produced 66 from 2,200 clicks, a 3.0 percent rate. Page B had fewer than the required 1,000 clicks, and the day 1 to day 3 redirect loop contaminated traffic assignment, so the split was not even. Page B also failed the mobile p75 load gate at 3.4 seconds against the 2.5 second limit. Calculations: Page B spend was 800 x HKD 4.00 = HKD 3,200, so cost per qualified lead was HKD 3,200 / 40 = HKD 80, inside the HKD 85 guardrail. Page A was HKD 8,800 / 66 = about HKD 133.33, outside it. Re-run plan: close and verify the redirect loop, bring Page B mobile p75 load time below 2.5 seconds, then split the HKD 12,000 budget at HKD 4.00 per click evenly at 1,500 clicks per page, with at least 1,000 clicks per page before reading rates. Approval: the client digital operations lead must confirm the fixes in writing before launch. Uncertainty: the current rate gap is not a valid decision basis.
exemplar.zh: 決策：不要從第一輪宣布勝出者。在兩項修正後進行受控重新測試。證據：Page B 從 800 次點擊產生 40 個合格潛在客戶，比率 5.0%，Page A 從 2,200 次點擊產生 66 個，比率 3.0%。Page B 少於規定的 1,000 次點擊，且第 1 日至第 3 日的重新導向循環污染了流量分配，因此分配並不均等。Page B 亦以 3.4 秒未通過 2.5 秒的流動 p75 載入門檻。計算：Page B 支出為 800 x HKD 4.00 = HKD 3,200，故每次合格潛在客戶成本為 HKD 3,200 / 40 = HKD 80，位於 HKD 85 防護線之內。Page A 為 HKD 8,800 / 66 = 約 HKD 133.33，超出防護線。重新測試計劃：關閉並核實重新導向循環，把 Page B 流動 p75 載入時間降至 2.5 秒以下，然後以每點擊 HKD 4.00 把 HKD 12,000 預算均等分為每頁 1,500 次點擊，並在解讀比率前每頁至少達 1,000 次點擊。審批：客戶數碼營運主管必須在推出前以書面確認修正。不確定性：目前比率差距並非有效決策依據。

feedback.en: All six answers are correct and the handover applies the rules properly. You correctly refuse to declare a winner, apply the HKD 80 Page B cost per qualified lead inside the HKD 85 guardrail, note Page A at about HKD 133.33 outside it, and split the HKD 12,000 at HKD 4.00 per click into 1,500 clicks per page.
feedback.zh: 六項答案全部正確，交接亦正確套用規則。你正確地拒絕宣布勝出者，指出 Page B 每次合格潛在客戶成本 HKD 80 位於 HKD 85 防護線之內，Page A 約 HKD 133.33 超出防護線，並以每點擊 HKD 4.00 把 HKD 12,000 預算均分為每頁 1,500 次點擊。

feedback.en: You cite the specific supplied records well, including Page B's 800 clicks and 40 leads against Page A's 2,200 clicks and 66 leads, the day 1 to day 3 redirect loop, and the 3.4 second load time versus the 2.5 second gate. The 5.0 percent versus 3.0 percent gap is correctly framed as directionally positive but not yet a valid basis.
feedback.zh: 你妥善引用具體提供記錄，包括 Page B 的 800 次點擊及 40 個合格潛在客戶對比 Page A 的 2,200 次點擊及 66 個，第 1 日至第 3 日的重新導向循環，以及 3.4 秒載入時間對比 2.5 秒門檻。你正確地把 5.0% 對 3.0% 的差距描述為方向正面但尚未成為有效依據。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete, covering the written confirmation from the client digital operations lead, re-measuring the Page B load time, the even 1,500-click split inside budget, and the 1,000-click minimum before reading rates. Adding a step to count delivered clicks at run end would strengthen confirmation that the split stayed even.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體可行，涵蓋客戶數碼營運主管的書面確認、重新量度 Page B 載入時間、預算內每頁 1,500 次點擊的均等分配，以及解讀比率前至少 1,000 次點擊。若加入在測試結束時點算實際送達點擊的步驟，將更能確認分配保持均等。

feedback.en: You correctly state that the current rate gap is not a valid decision basis and flag the unresolved redirect fault and failed load gate. Naming the scenario as a fictional simulation with no real ad spend would make the scope limit fully explicit.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出目前比率差距並非有效決策依據，並指出尚未解決的重新導向故障及未通過的載入門檻。若明確說明此為虛構模擬且不使用真實廣告支出，將可把範圍限制完整表達。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, naming the decision, the supporting numbers, the approval owner and the launch prerequisites. Length is slightly above the suggested guide but the content is complete and clear, so no penalty applies.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，列明決策、支持數字、審批負責人及推出前條件。長度略高於建議指引，但內容完整清晰，故不扣分。

summary.en: Complete and accurate submission. Every decision, calculation and caveat matches the supplied brief, data and policy, and the handover is clear enough for a teammate to act on.
summary.zh: 提交完整且準確。每項決策、計算及注意事項均符合提供的要求、數據及政策，交接清晰，足以讓團隊成員跟進。

nextSteps.en: Add one explicit line stating the scenario is fictional with no real ad spend or client account, and consider counting delivered clicks at run end to verify the split stayed even.
nextSteps.zh: 可加入一句明確說明此為虛構情境、不使用真實廣告支出或客戶帳戶，並考慮在測試結束時點算實際送達點擊以核實分配保持均等。

brief.en: You are an environmental scientist at Enviro Labs. A client has drafted a claim about an aeration unit installed at Point B. Review the synthetic monitoring records and the fictional scenario policy. Edit the client claim to separate supported observations from unsupported causality and unverified safety conclusions. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. State the calculation method and cite the specific sampling records. The scenario thresholds are invented for this simulation and are not legal discharge standards. Do not claim site-wide or safety conclusions without the required evidence.
brief.zh: 你是環境化驗有限公司的環境科學家。客戶就安裝於點 B 的曝氣裝置草擬了一項聲明。請審閱合成的監測紀錄及虛構情境政策。修改客戶聲明，區分獲支持的觀察、未獲支持的因果及未核實的安全結論。以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔、基於證據的交接說明，約 100 至 180 字。說明計算方法並引用具體採樣紀錄。情境門檻為本模擬虛構，並非法定排放標準。在缺乏所需證據下，不得聲稱全場或安全結論。

body.en: We installed an aeration unit at Point B on 1 April 2026. Since then, copper has fallen from 0.20 mg/L in March to 0.05 mg/L in June. That is a 75% reduction at Point B and we believe it proves the unit works. Because 0.05 mg/L meets the 0.05 mg/L screening level, the water is now safe for contact recreation. We want to state that the intervention reduced copper site-wide by 80% and improved stream health. Please review this claim before we publish it.
body.zh: 我們於 2026 年 4 月 1 日在點 B 安裝了曝氣裝置。此後，銅濃度由三月的 0.20 mg/L 降至六月的 0.05 mg/L。這是點 B 的 75% 減少，我們相信這證明該裝置有效。由於 0.05 mg/L 符合 0.05 mg/L 篩查水平，水體現已適合接觸康樂用途。我們希望聲明該干預使全場銅濃度減少 80%，並改善溪流健康。請在我們發布前審查此聲明。

body.en: Synthetic data for this simulation only. Copper in mg/L. Sampling events: 12 March 2026 before installation and 15 June 2026 after installation. Point A is upstream control. Point B is downstream of the aeration unit. March 12: Point A 0.21, Point B 0.20. June 15: Point A 0.06, Point B 0.05. Only two events per point. No flow, rainfall, pH or other metals recorded. Installation date: 1 April 2026. These values are fictional and are not legal discharge results.
body.zh: 本模擬專用合成數據。銅濃度單位為 mg/L。採樣事件：2026 年 3 月 12 日安裝前，以及 2026 年 6 月 15 日安裝後。點 A 為上游對照。點 B 位於曝氣裝置下游。3 月 12 日：點 A 0.21，點 B 0.20。6 月 15 日：點 A 0.06，點 B 0.05。每個點僅兩次事件。未記錄流量、降雨、pH 或其他金屬。安裝日期：2026 年 4 月 1 日。此等數值為虛構，並非法定排放結果。

body.en: This policy is invented for the exercise and is not a legal standard. Scenario screening level for copper in contact recreation: 0.05 mg/L. Supported observation means a value directly present in the supplied records. Causality needs a before-after change at the intervention point that is not matched by an upstream control over the same period. Safety conclusion needs at least two post-installation samples on separate dates plus all parameters named in the monitoring plan. A single event at one point cannot support a site-wide or safety conclusion. Revise claims to match these limits.
body.zh: 本政策為練習虛構，並非法定標準。接觸康樂用途銅的情境篩查水平：0.05 mg/L。獲支持觀察指直接存在於提供紀錄中的數值。因果需要干預點的前後變化，且未在同一期間的上游對照中出現相若變化。安全結論需要至少兩次不同日期的安裝後樣本，以及監測計劃所列全部參數。單一事件於一個點不能支持全場或安全結論。修改聲明以符合此等限制。

label.en: Which client statement is directly supported by the supplied monitoring records?
label.zh: 哪項客戶陳述獲提供監測紀錄直接支持？

label.en: Copper at Point B fell from 0.20 mg/L in March to 0.05 mg/L in June.
label.zh: 點 B 銅濃度由三月 0.20 mg/L 降至六月 0.05 mg/L。

label.en: Copper fell by 80% across the stream.
The aeration unit caused the copper decrease.
label.zh: 曝氣裝置導致銅濃度下降。

label.en: The water is safe for contact recreation.
label.zh: 水體適合接觸康樂用途。

label.en: Which statements are unsupported conclusions under the scenario policy? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 根據情境政策，哪些陳述屬未獲支持的結論？選出所有適用項。

label.en: The aeration unit caused the copper decrease at Point B.
label.zh: 曝氣裝置導致點 B 銅濃度下降。

label.en: The water is safe for contact recreation.
label.zh: 水體適合接觸康樂用途。

label.en: Copper at Point B was 0.20 mg/L in March.
label.zh: 點 B 三月銅濃度為 0.20 mg/L。

label.en: What is the percent reduction in copper at Point B from March to June?
label.zh: 點 B 銅濃度由三月至六月的減少百分比是多少？

label.en: What additional evidence is most useful to test the causality claim?
label.zh: 測試因果聲明最有用的額外證據是甚麼？

label.en: Multiple pre- and post-installation samples at Point A and Point B, with rainfall and flow records.
label.zh: 點 A 及點 B 多次安裝前後樣本，連同降雨及流量紀錄。

label.en: A single additional sample at Point B.
label.zh: 點 B 一次額外樣本。
居民關於水質清澈度的陳述。

label.en: A copy of the laboratory accreditation certificate.
Which revised sentence is appropriately bounded by the supplied evidence?
label.zh: 哪句修訂句子恰當地受提供證據限制？

label.en: In the supplied two sampling events, copper at Point B was lower in June (0.05 mg/L) than in March (0.20 mg/L), while upstream Point A also fell from 0.21 to 0.06 mg/L, so the cause is not established.
label.zh: 在提供的兩次採樣事件中，點 B 六月銅濃度（0.05 mg/L）低於三月（0.20 mg/L），而上游點 A 亦由 0.21 降至 0.06 mg/L，因此成因尚未確定。

label.en: The aeration unit reduced copper at Point B by 75%, proving it works.

Correctly rejects site-wide 80% reduction because records cover only two points and calculated reduction at Point B is 75%, not 80%. Correctly rejects safety conclusion because only one post-installation sample exists per point and no other parameters are supplied.

expectedEvidence.en: Cites specific records: 12 March and 15 June 2026, Point A and Point B copper values. Explains percent reduction calculation for Point B: (0.20-0.05)/0.20 = 0.75 = 75%. Notes Point A reduction: (0.21-0.06)/0.21 = 0.714 = about 71%. Connects policy requirement for upstream control to unsupported causality.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用具體紀錄：2026 年 3 月 12 日及 6 月 15 日，點 A 及點 B 銅數值。解釋點 B 減少百分比計算：(0.20-0.05)/0.20 = 0.75 = 75%。指出點 A 減少：(0.21-0.06)/0.21 = 0.714 = 約 71%。把政策對上游對照的要求連結至未獲支持因果。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.

exemplar.en: Review of client draft claim. Supported observation: synthetic records show copper at Point B fell from 0.20 mg/L on 12 March 2026 to 0.05 mg/L on 15 June 2026. That is a 75% reduction at that point. Unsupported causality: the aeration unit cannot be credited because upstream Point A also fell from 0.21 mg/L to 0.06 mg/L over the same period, a 71% reduction. No differential effect is shown. Unsupported extent: only two points were sampled, so an 80% site-wide claim is not supported. Unverified safety: one post-installation sample per point cannot confirm contact recreation safety under the scenario policy. Next steps: collect multiple pre- and post-installation samples at Point A and Point B, record flow, rainfall, pH and other metals, then retest causality. I will revise the claim to state only the observed Point B decrease and flag the need for more evidence. Escalate to the laboratory supervisor if the client insists on safety or site-wide wording.
exemplar.zh: 客戶草擬聲明審查。獲支持觀察：合成紀錄顯示點 B 銅濃度由 2026 年 3 月 12 日的 0.20 mg/L 降至 2026 年 6 月 15 日的 0.05 mg/L。這是該點的 75% 減少。未獲支持因果：不能歸因於曝氣裝置，因上游點 A 同期亦由 0.21 mg/L 降至 0.06 mg/L，減少 71%。未顯示差異效應。未獲支持範圍：僅兩個點採樣，故 80% 全場聲明不獲支持。未核實安全：在情境政策下，每個點一次安裝後樣本不能確認接觸康樂安全。下一步：在點 A 及點 B 採集多次安裝前後樣本，記錄流量、降雨、pH 及其他金屬，然後重新測試因果。我會修改聲明，只陳述觀察到的點 B 減少，並標示需要更多證據。若客戶堅持安全或全場措辭，轉交化驗所主管。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct: you accepted only the supported Point B decrease, and rejected causality, the 80% site-wide claim and the safety conclusion. Your 75 percent reduction figure is also right.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確：你只接納獲支持的點 B 下降，並拒絕因果、全場 80% 及安全結論。你計算的 75% 減少亦正確。

feedback.en: Strong reasoning. You cite 12 March and 15 June 2026, give Point B as 0.20 to 0.05 mg/L, compute the 75% reduction, and correctly show upstream Point A also fell from 0.21 to 0.06 mg/L (about 71%) so no differential effect exists.
feedback.zh: 推理穩健。你引用 2026 年 3 月 12 日及 6 月 15 日，列明點 B 由 0.20 降至 0.05 mg/L，計算 75% 減少，並正確指出上游點 A 亦由 0.21 降至 0.06 mg/L（約 71%），故無差異效應。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete and testable: multiple pre and post-installation samples at Point A and Point B, plus flow, rainfall, pH and other metals, then retest causality. Naming the laboratory supervisor as escalation is exactly right.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體可測：在點 A 及點 B 採集多次安裝前後樣本，並記錄流量、降雨、pH 及其他金屬，然後重新測試因果。指名化驗所主管作轉交對象完全正確。

feedback.en: You acknowledge the missing evidence well, including only two points and one post-installation sample per point, and you call the data synthetic. Add one explicit statement that the scenario threshold is invented and not a legal discharge or safety standard to fully bound the claim.
feedback.zh: 你充分承認欠缺證據，包括僅兩個點及每個點只有一次安裝後樣本，並說明數據為合成。請補充一句明確指出情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放或安全標準，以完全限制聲明範圍。

feedback.en: This is a clear, concise handover at 166 words with decisions, evidence, next steps, a revision commitment and an escalation path. It is ready to send to the team lead.
feedback.zh: 這是一份清晰簡潔的交接，共 166 字，包含決策、證據、下一步、修改承諾及轉交路徑，可直接發送給團隊主管。

summary.en: Excellent work. All decisions and calculations match the supplied records and scenario policy, and your handover is appropriately cautious on causality, extent and safety. The only small gap is an explicit note that the scenario threshold is fictional rather than a legal standard.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。所有決策及計算均符合提供紀錄及情境政策，交接對因果、範圍及安全保持恰當審慎。唯一小缺漏是未明確說明情境門檻屬虛構而非法律標準。

nextSteps.zh: 補充一句說明 0.05 mg/L 篩查水平為虛構情境數值並非法定標準，此交接便完整。

title.en: Review a client claim about a constructed wetland
title.zh: 審查有關人工濕地的客戶聲明

brief.en: You are an environmental scientist at Enviro Labs. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Enviro Labs and is not endorsed by it. A client has drafted a claim about a constructed wetland installed at Outlet C. Review the synthetic nitrate monitoring records and the fictional scenario policy. Edit the client claim to separate supported observations from unsupported causality, site-wide and safety conclusions. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words or comparable Chinese. State the calculation method and cite the specific sampling records. Scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards. Do not claim causality, site-wide or safety conclusions without the required evidence. All records are fictional.
brief.zh: 你是環境化驗有限公司的環境科學家。這是受環境化驗有限公司啟發的獨立學習模擬，並未獲其認可。客戶就安裝於點 C 的人工濕地草擬了一項聲明。請審閱合成的硝酸鹽監測紀錄及虛構情境政策。修改客戶聲明，區分獲支持的觀察與未獲支持的因果、全場及安全結論。以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔、基於證據的交接說明，約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文字數。說明計算方法並引用具體採樣紀錄。情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放標準。在缺乏所需證據下，不得聲稱因果、全場或安全結論。所有紀錄均為虛構。

body.en: We installed a constructed wetland at Outlet C on 15 June 2026. Since then, nitrate has fallen from 15.0 mg/L in May to 6.0 mg/L in August. That is a 60% reduction at Outlet C and we believe it proves the wetland works. Because 6.0 mg/L is below the 10 mg/L screening level, the stream is now safe for contact recreation and aquatic life. We want to state that the wetland reduced nitrate site-wide by 60% and improved stream health. Please review this claim before we publish it.
body.zh: 我們於 2026 年 6 月 15 日在點 C 安裝了人工濕地。此後，硝酸鹽由五月的 15.0 mg/L 降至八月的 6.0 mg/L。這是點 C 的 60% 減少，我們相信這證明該濕地有效。由於 6.0 mg/L 低於 10 mg/L 篩查水平，溪流現已適合接觸康樂用途及水生生物。我們希望聲明該濕地使全場硝酸鹽減少 60%，並改善溪流健康。請在我們發布前審查此聲明。

body.en: Synthetic data for this simulation only. Nitrate in mg/L. Sampling events: 5 May 2026 before installation and 20 August 2026 after installation. Only Outlet C was sampled. 5 May: Outlet C 15.0. 20 August: Outlet C 6.0. No upstream reference, other tributary, flow, rainfall, dissolved oxygen, temperature or pH data were recorded. Installation date: 15 June 2026. The monitoring plan names nitrate, dissolved oxygen, temperature and pH. Only nitrate was measured. Two events total. These values are fictional and are not legal discharge results.
body.zh: 本模擬專用合成數據。硝酸鹽單位為 mg/L。採樣事件：2026 年 5 月 5 日安裝前，以及 2026 年 8 月 20 日安裝後。僅有點 C 被採樣。5 月 5 日：點 C 15.0。8 月 20 日：點 C 6.0。未記錄上游對照、其他支流、流量、降雨、溶解氧、溫度或 pH 數據。安裝日期：2026 年 6 月 15 日。監測計劃列明硝酸鹽、溶解氧、溫度及 pH。僅測量硝酸鹽。合共兩次事件。此等數值為虛構，並非法定排放結果。

body.en: This policy is invented for the exercise and is not a legal standard. Scenario screening level for nitrate in the claimed stream use: 10 mg/L. Supported observation means a value directly present in the supplied records. Causality needs a before-after change at the intervention point that is not matched by an upstream control over the same period. Safety conclusion needs at least two post-installation samples on separate dates plus all parameters named in the monitoring plan. Site-wide conclusion needs samples from all major tributaries or a defined spatial sampling design covering the claimed area. A single event at one point cannot support causality, site-wide or safety conclusions. Revise claims to match these limits.
body.zh: 本政策為練習虛構，並非法定標準。所聲稱溪流用途的硝酸鹽情境篩查水平：10 mg/L。獲支持觀察指直接存在於提供紀錄中的數值。因果需要干預點的前後變化，且未在同一期間的上游對照中出現相若變化。安全結論需要至少兩次不同日期的安裝後樣本，以及監測計劃所列全部參數。全場結論需要所有主要支流的樣本，或涵蓋所聲稱範圍的明確空間採樣設計。單一事件於一個點不能支持因果、全場或安全結論。修改聲明以符合此等限制。

label.en: Which client statement is directly supported by the supplied monitoring records?
label.zh: 哪項客戶陳述獲提供監測紀錄直接支持？

label.en: Nitrate at Outlet C fell from 15.0 mg/L in May to 6.0 mg/L in August.
label.zh: 點 C 硝酸鹽由五月 15.0 mg/L 降至八月 6.0 mg/L。

label.en: The constructed wetland caused the nitrate decrease.
label.zh: 人工濕地導致硝酸鹽下降。

label.en: Nitrate fell by 60% across the stream.
The stream is safe for contact recreation and aquatic life.
label.zh: 溪流適合接觸康樂用途及水生生物。

label.en: Which statements are unsupported conclusions under the scenario policy? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 根據情境政策，哪些陳述屬未獲支持的結論？選出所有適用項。

label.en: The constructed wetland caused the nitrate decrease at Outlet C.
label.zh: 人工濕地導致點 C 硝酸鹽下降。

label.en: The stream is safe for contact recreation and aquatic life.
label.zh: 溪流適合接觸康樂用途及水生生物。

label.en: Nitrate at Outlet C was 15.0 mg/L in May.
label.zh: 點 C 五月硝酸鹽為 15.0 mg/L。

label.en: What is the percent reduction in nitrate at Outlet C from May to August?
label.zh: 點 C 硝酸鹽由五月至八月的減少百分比是多少？

label.en: What additional evidence is most useful to test the causality and site-wide claims?
label.zh: 測試因果及全場聲明最有用的額外證據是甚麼？

label.en: Multiple pre- and post-installation samples at an upstream reference and several tributaries, with flow, rainfall, dissolved oxygen, temperature and pH records.
label.zh: 上游對照點及多條支流多次安裝前後樣本，連同流量、降雨、溶解氧、溫度及 pH 紀錄。

label.en: One more sample at Outlet C.
label.zh: 點 C 一次額外樣本。

label.en: A copy of the laboratory accreditation certificate.
Which revised sentence is appropriately bounded by the supplied evidence?
label.zh: 哪句修訂句子恰當地受提供證據限制？

label.en: In the two supplied events at Outlet C only, nitrate was lower in August (6.0 mg/L) than in May (15.0 mg/L), but no upstream or other tributary data were collected, so the cause and site-wide extent are not established.
label.zh: 在提供僅有點 C 的兩次事件中，八月硝酸鹽（6.0 mg/L）低於五月（15.0 mg/L），但未收集上游或其他支流數據，因此成因及全場範圍尚未確定。

label.en: The wetland reduced nitrate at Outlet C by 60%, proving it works.
label.zh: 濕地使點 C 硝酸鹽減少 60%，證明其有效。

label.en: Nitrate is 6.0 mg/L, so the stream is safe for contact recreation and aquatic life.
label.zh: 硝酸鹽為 6.0 mg/L，因此溪流適合接觸康樂用途及水生生物。

label.en: The intervention improved the whole stream.
label.zh: 該干預改善了整條溪流。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks such as multiple pre and post installation samples at an upstream reference and at least three tributaries on at least two dates each, with flow, rainfall, dissolved oxygen, temperature and pH records. States that these checks test causality, site-wide extent and safety before publication. Accepts equivalent practical next steps.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如上游對照及至少三條支流多次安裝前後樣本，每個點至少兩個日期，連同流量、降雨、溶解氧、溫度及 pH 紀錄。說明此等檢查在發布前測試因果、全場範圍及安全。接受等同實用下一步。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Limits supported claim to the two supplied events at Outlet C only. Acknowledges missing upstream, tributary, flow, rainfall, dissolved oxygen, temperature and pH evidence. Avoids asserting site-wide improvement, causality or safety. Keeps claims within the fictional scenario and does not treat the invented screening level as a legal standard.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把獲支持聲明限於提供僅有點 C 的兩次事件。承認欠缺上游、支流、流量、降雨、溶解氧、溫度及 pH 證據。避免聲稱全場改善、因果或安全。把聲明限於虛構情境，不把虛構篩查水平視為法定標準。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese with evidence, decision, calculation, risks and next steps. Names the owner or escalation route to the team lead for client disagreement. Provides actionable wording that the client can publish after the missing evidence is collected.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，列明證據、決策、計算、風險及下一步。列明負責人或就客戶異議轉交團隊主管的路徑。提供可行措辭，客戶可在收集欠缺證據後發布。

exemplar.en: Evidence: The synthetic monitoring records show only Outlet C was sampled. Nitrate was 15.0 mg/L on 5 May 2026 before installation and 6.0 mg/L on 20 August 2026 after installation. No upstream reference, other tributary, flow, rainfall, dissolved oxygen, temperature or pH data were recorded. Decision: The supported observation is that nitrate at Outlet C was lower in August than in May. The reduction is (15.0 minus 6.0) divided by 15.0, which equals 60%. The client's causality claim is not supported because there is no upstream control and only two events. The site-wide claim is not supported because only one point was sampled. The safety claim is not supported because the monitoring plan names nitrate, dissolved oxygen, temperature and pH, and only nitrate was measured, with one post-installation event. I have revised the claim to state the Outlet C observation and the 60% reduction at that point only. Risks and uncertainty: two events cannot separate seasonal or flow effects. Next steps: owner to arrange pre and post samples at an upstream reference and at least three tributaries on at least two dates each, with all monitoring plan parameters, before any causality, site-wide or safety statement is published. Escalate to the team lead if the client insists on the original wording.
exemplar.zh: 證據：合成監測紀錄顯示僅有點 C 被採樣。硝酸鹽在 2026 年 5 月 5 日安裝前為 15.0 mg/L，在 2026 年 8 月 20 日安裝後為 6.0 mg/L。未記錄上游對照、其他支流、流量、降雨、溶解氧、溫度或 pH 數據。決策：獲支持的觀察是點 C 硝酸鹽在八月低於五月。減少百分比為（15.0 減 6.0）除以 15.0，等於 60%。客戶的因果聲明未獲支持，因為沒有上游對照且僅有兩次事件。全場聲明未獲支持，因為僅一個點被採樣。安全聲明未獲支持，因為監測計劃列明硝酸鹽、溶解氧、溫度及 pH，而僅測量硝酸鹽，且只有一次安裝後事件。我已修訂聲明，僅陳述點 C 觀察及該點的 60% 減少。風險與不確定性：兩次事件不能分離季節或流量影響。下一步：負責人安排上游對照及至少三條支流的安裝前後樣本，每個點至少兩個日期，並包括所有監測計劃參數，然後才發布任何因果、全場或安全聲明。若客戶堅持原文，轉交團隊主管。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct. You identified the supported observation at Outlet C and correctly calculated the reduction as (15.0 minus 6.0) divided by 15.0, which equals 60 percent, while treating the causality, site-wide and safety claims as unsupported.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確。你正確識別點 C 獲支持的觀察，並正確計算減少百分比為（15.0 減 6.0）除以 15.0，等於 60%，同時把因果、全場及安全聲明視為未獲支持。

feedback.en: You cite the specific 5 May 2026 and 20 August 2026 records and explain that only Outlet C was sampled with no upstream control, tributary, flow, rainfall, dissolved oxygen, temperature or pH data. You also tie each unsupported claim to the sampling limits and the monitoring plan parameters.
feedback.zh: 你引用了具體的 2026 年 5 月 5 日及 8 月 20 日紀錄，並解釋僅有點 C 被採樣，缺乏上游對照、支流、流量、降雨、溶解氧、溫度及 pH 數據。你亦把每項未獲支持聲明連結至採樣限制及監測計劃參數。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and test the right requirements, covering upstream reference and tributary samples on multiple dates with all monitoring plan parameters before publication. Naming the owner and the escalation to the team lead makes the plan actionable.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體，並測試正確要求，涵蓋上游對照及支流多次樣本、每個點多個日期，以及所有監測計劃參數。列明負責人及轉交團隊主管使計劃可行。

feedback.en: You limit the supported statement to the two Outlet C events and acknowledge the missing evidence plus the seasonal and flow uncertainty. You avoid asserting causality, site-wide extent or safety.
feedback.zh: 你把獲支持聲明限於點 C 的兩次事件，並承認欠缺證據及季節與流量不確定性。你避免聲稱因果、全場範圍或安全。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and structured, with evidence, decision, calculation, risks and next steps in about 217 words. That is slightly above the 100 to 180 word guidance, but the content stays focused and useful.
feedback.zh: 交接說明清晰有條理，包含證據、決策、計算、風險及下一步，約 217 個英文詞。字數略高於 100 至 180 詞的指引，但內容保持聚焦及實用。

summary.en: Strong submission. All decisions and answers are correct and the reasoning is well evidenced from the supplied records, with bounded claims and a practical verification plan. Only note is length slightly above guidance, which does not affect accuracy.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。所有決策及答案均正確，推理有提供紀錄充分支持，聲明受適當限制，並有實用核實計劃。唯一注意點是字數略高於指引，但不影響準確性。

nextSteps.en: Trim the handover toward 180 words by condensing the missing-data list while keeping the calculation and the pre-publication sampling checks. State explicitly that the 10 mg/L screening level is a fictional scenario threshold and not a legal discharge standard.
nextSteps.zh: 可把交接說明精簡至約 180 詞，壓縮欠缺數據清單，同時保留計算及發布前採樣檢查。另請明確指出 10 mg/L 篩查水平為虛構情境門檻，並非法定排放標準。

title.zh: 合成水質監測狀態覆核

brief.en: You are assisting Enviro Labs in an independent learning simulation inspired by its public environmental testing services. This simulation is not endorsed by Enviro Labs. A fictional client supplied synthetic water records from three locations, one sampling round only. Use only the supplied scenario thresholds, which are invented and not legal standards. Decide each location status, identify supported claims and complete a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Target about 100 to 180 words. No real sampling or lab work is required.
brief.zh: 你正協助環境化驗有限公司進行一個獨立學習模擬，靈感來自其公開環境測試服務。本模擬未獲環境化驗有限公司認可。虛構客戶提供三個位置的合成水質記錄，只有一輪採樣。只可使用提供的虛構情境門檻，該門檻並非法律標準。判斷每個位置的狀態，識別可支持的聲明，並以英文或香港繁體中文完成簡潔交接。目標約100至180字。無需真實採樣或化驗工作。

body.en: Table: sample NO-1, North Outlet, copper 0.072 mg/L, pH 7.1, turbidity 6.4 NTU. Sample SO-1, South Outlet, copper 0.118 mg/L, pH 6.3, turbidity 3.8 NTU. Sample UR-1, Upstream Reference, copper 0.031 mg/L, pH 7.4, turbidity 2.2 NTU. One grab sample per location. No replicate samples. No flow measurements. Sampling window 09:00 to 10:00. All records are synthetic for this simulation.
body.zh: 表格：樣本NO-1，北排放口，銅0.072 mg/L，pH 7.1，濁度6.4 NTU。樣本SO-1，南排放口，銅0.118 mg/L，pH 6.3，濁度3.8 NTU。樣本UR-1，上游參考點，銅0.031 mg/L，pH 7.4，濁度2.2 NTU。每個位置一個採樣。沒有重複樣本。沒有流量測量。採樣時段09:00至10:00。所有記錄均為本模擬的合成資料。

title.en: Fictional scenario thresholds and classification rules
title.zh: 虛構情境門檻及分類規則

body.en: These fictional thresholds apply only to this simulation. Copper: within when result is 0.050 mg/L or less, alert when above 0.050 mg/L and 0.100 mg/L or less, exceed when above 0.100 mg/L. pH: within when 6.5 to 8.5 inclusive, alert when 6.0 to 6.49 or 8.51 to 9.0, exceed when below 6.0 or above 9.0. Turbidity: within when 5.0 NTU or less, alert when above 5.0 NTU and 10.0 NTU or less, exceed when above 10.0 NTU. Location status: exceed if any exceedance. Else alert if any alert. Else within.
body.zh: 此等虛構門檻僅適用於本模擬。銅：結果等於或低於0.050 mg/L為在範圍內，高於0.050 mg/L且等於或低於0.100 mg/L為警戒，高於0.100 mg/L為超標。pH：6.5至8.5（含）為在範圍內，6.0至6.49或8.51至9.0為警戒，低於6.0或高於9.0為超標。濁度：等於或低於5.0 NTU為在範圍內，高於5.0 NTU且等於或低於10.0 NTU為警戒，高於10.0 NTU為超標。位置狀態：任何超標即為超標。否則任何警戒即為警戒。否則為在範圍內。

body.en: From: fictional client Harbour View Management. To: Enviro Labs client services. We need a short review of the attached synthetic water records for one sampling round. Please do not state legal compliance or health safety. We need the status of each location under the supplied scenario thresholds, a check on which claims are supported, and a handover with next verification steps. The records cover only one date. No repeat samples exist yet. Kindly identify missing evidence and propose checks. This is a learning simulation.
body.zh: 發件人：虛構客戶港景管理。收件人：環境化驗有限公司客戶服務。我們需要簡短覆核隨附的一輪合成水質記錄。請勿述明法定合規或健康安全。我們需要各位置在提供情境門檻下的狀態、檢查哪些聲明可支持，以及包含下一步核實的交接。記錄只涵蓋一個日期。目前沒有重複樣本。請指出欠缺證據並提出檢查。本個案為學習模擬。

label.zh: 樣本SO-1的整體情境狀態是甚麼？

label.en: UR-1 is within all three scenario thresholds.

label.en: SO-1 exceeds the scenario copper threshold.
NO-1 turbidity is within the scenario threshold.
label.zh: NO-1濁度在情境門檻範圍內。

label.en: NO-1 pH is in the scenario alert range.
SO-1 is within all three scenario thresholds.

label.zh: 計算SO-1與UR-1的銅濃度差值，以mg/L計。

Explains NO-1 turbidity 6.4 NTU is alert because above 5.0 and at or below 10.0. Notes UR-1 values 0.031 mg/L, pH 7.4 and 2.2 NTU are within. Shows 0.118 minus 0.031 equals 0.087 mg/L. expectedEvidence.zh: 引用2026年9月18日合成記錄及情境門檻。解釋SO-1銅0.118 mg/L超過高於0.100 mg/L規則。解釋NO-1濁度6.4 NTU屬警戒，因高於5.0且等於或低於10.0。指出UR-1數值0.031 mg/L、pH 7.4及2.2 NTU均在範圍內。顯示0.118減0.031等於0.087 mg/L。指出pH 6.3屬警戒。

expectedEvidence.en: Provides a concise English or Traditional Chinese handover around 100 to 180 words as a guide. States location statuses, evidence, calculation, limits, next steps and owner or escalation to client services lead. Actionable and clear. Length is not strictly graded.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提供簡潔英文或香港繁體中文交接，約100至180字為指引。列明位置狀態、證據、計算、限制、下一步及負責人或轉交客戶服務主管。可行清晰。長度不作嚴格評分。

exemplar.en: Handover for Harbour View Management synthetic water review. Source: 18 Sep 2026 water results and scenario thresholds. Location statuses under the fictional rules: UR-1 is within all thresholds because copper 0.031 mg/L, pH 7.4 and turbidity 2.2 NTU fall in the within ranges. NO-1 is alert because turbidity 6.4 NTU is above 5.0 and at or below 10.0, while copper 0.072 mg/L is alert and pH 7.1 is within. SO-1 has exceedance status because copper 0.118 mg/L is above 0.100 mg/L, despite pH 6.3 being alert and turbidity 3.8 NTU being within. The copper difference SO-1 minus UR-1 is 0.118 minus 0.031 equals 0.087 mg/L. One location has pH in the alert range. Supported claims are UR-1 within all thresholds and SO-1 copper exceedance. Limits: one grab sample per location, one date, no replicate or flow records. Do not claim legal compliance or site-wide contamination. Next steps: request repeat sampling and field duplicates, verify sample handling records, and ask client services lead to confirm scope before any wider conclusion.
exemplar.zh: 港景管理合成水質覆核交接。來源：2026年9月18日水質結果及情境門檻。按虛構規則，各位置狀態如下：UR-1全部在範圍內，因為銅0.031 mg/L、pH 7.4及濁度2.2 NTU均屬在範圍內。NO-1為警戒，因為濁度6.4 NTU高於5.0且等於或低於10.0，銅0.072 mg/L屬警戒，pH 7.1在範圍內。SO-1為超標，因為銅0.118 mg/L高於0.100 mg/L，雖然pH 6.3屬警戒，濁度3.8 NTU在範圍內。銅差值SO-1減UR-1為0.118減0.031等於0.087 mg/L。有1個位置的pH屬警戒範圍。可支持聲明為UR-1全部在門檻內，以及SO-1銅超標。限制：每個位置只有一個採樣，只有一個日期，沒有重複樣本或流量紀錄。不可聲稱法定合規或全場污染。下一步：要求重複採樣及現場重複樣本，核對樣本處理紀錄，並請客戶服務主管確認範圍後才作更廣泛結論。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct: SO-1 exceed (copper 0.118 above 0.100 mg/L), NO-1 alert (turbidity 6.4 NTU), UR-1 within, copper difference 0.087 mg/L and one pH alert location. The multi-select choices ur1-all-within and so1-copper-exceed are both supported.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確：SO-1超標（銅0.118高於0.100 mg/L）、NO-1警戒（濁度6.4 NTU）、UR-1在範圍內、銅差值0.087 mg/L，以及1個pH警戒位置。多選項ur1-all-within及so1-copper-exceed均獲支持。

feedback.en: You cite the 18 Sep 2026 synthetic table and the scenario thresholds and tie each status to specific values, including the 0.118 minus 0.031 equals 0.087 mg/L calculation and the pH 6.3 alert. Reasoning is traceable and accurate.
feedback.zh: 你引用2026年9月18日合成記錄及情境門檻，並把每個狀態連結到具體數值，包括0.118減0.031等於0.087 mg/L的計算及pH 6.3屬警戒。推理清晰準確。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete: repeat sampling, field duplicates, sample handling record checks and client services lead confirmation of scope. This directly addresses the one-round limitation.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體可行：重複採樣、現場重複樣本、核對樣本處理紀錄，以及請客戶服務主管確認範圍。這直接回應單輪採樣的限制。

feedback.en: You correctly flag one grab sample per location, one date, no replicates and no flow records, and you avoid legal compliance or site-wide contamination claims. The fictional threshold basis is clear.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出每個位置只有一個採樣、只有一個日期、沒有重複樣本及流量紀錄，並避免聲稱法定合規或全場污染。虛構門檻的基礎清晰。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable with statuses, evidence, calculation, limits and escalation to the client services lead. At 189 English words it sits just above the 100 to 180 word guide, which does not reduce credit here.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，包含位置狀態、證據、計算、限制及轉交客戶服務主管。英文189字略高於100至180字指引，但在此不扣分。

summary.en: Excellent complete submission. All decisions, calculations and supported claims match the supplied synthetic records and fictional thresholds, with sound reasoning, clear limits and practical next steps. Only note is the handover is slightly longer than the suggested range.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。所有決策、計算及可支持聲明均符合提供的合成記錄及虛構門檻，推理穩妥、限制清晰、下一步實用。唯一可留意之處是交接略長於建議字數範圍。

nextSteps.en: Trim slightly toward the 150 to 180 word range for future handovers and add one explicit note that the thresholds are fictional scenario assumptions rather than standards. Both are minor refinements on strong work.
nextSteps.zh: 日後交接可略為精簡至150至180字左右，並明確加入一句指門檻屬虛構情境假設而非標準。兩者都是在優秀表現上的小改進。

title.en: Synthetic soil baseline and follow-up status review
title.zh: 合成泥土基線及跟進狀態覆核

brief.en: You assist Enviro Labs in an independent learning simulation inspired by its public environmental testing services. This simulation is not endorsed by Enviro Labs. A fictional client supplied synthetic soil records from two zones, each with one baseline and one follow-up sample. Use only the supplied scenario thresholds, which are invented and not legal or health standards. Decide each sample status, identify supported claims and complete a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Target about 100 to 180 words. No real sampling or lab work is required.
brief.zh: 你協助環境化驗有限公司進行一個獨立學習模擬，靈感來自其公開環境測試服務。本模擬未獲環境化驗有限公司認可。虛構客戶提供兩個區域的合成泥土記錄，每個區域各有一個基線及一個跟進樣本。只可使用提供的虛構情境門檻，該門檻並非法律或健康標準。判斷每個樣本狀態，識別可支持的聲明，並以英文或香港繁體中文完成簡潔交接。目標約100至180字。無需真實採樣或化驗工作。

body.en: Table. Zone A baseline B-A1: lead 42 mg/kg, pH 6.8. Zone A follow-up F-A1: lead 78 mg/kg, pH 6.3. Zone B baseline B-B1: lead 55 mg/kg, pH 7.9. Zone B follow-up F-B1: lead 48 mg/kg, pH 6.1. One baseline and one follow-up sample per zone. No replicate samples. No depth profile. No seasonal series. Sampling window 09:00 to 11:00. All records are synthetic for this simulation.
body.zh: 表格。區域A基線B-A1：鉛42 mg/kg，pH 6.8。區域A跟進F-A1：鉛78 mg/kg，pH 6.3。區域B基線B-B1：鉛55 mg/kg，pH 7.9。區域B跟進F-B1：鉛48 mg/kg，pH 6.1。每個區域各有一個基線及一個跟進樣本。沒有重複樣本。沒有深度剖面。沒有季節序列。採樣時段09:00至11:00。所有記錄均為本模擬的合成資料。

title.en: Fictional scenario thresholds and classification rules
title.zh: 虛構情境門檻及分類規則

body.en: These fictional thresholds apply only to this simulation. Lead: within when result is 50 mg/kg or less, alert when above 50 mg/kg and 100 mg/kg or less, exceed when above 100 mg/kg. pH: within when 6.5 to 8.5 inclusive, alert when 6.0 to 6.49 or 8.51 to 9.0, exceed when below 6.0 or above 9.0. Sample status: exceed if any exceedance. Else alert if any alert. Else within. Zone status is not defined here. These are not legal discharge or health standards.
body.zh: 此等虛構門檻僅適用於本模擬。鉛：結果等於或低於50 mg/kg為在範圍內，高於50 mg/kg且等於或低於100 mg/kg為警戒，高於100 mg/kg為超標。pH：6.5至8.5（含）為在範圍內，6.0至6.49或8.51至9.0為警戒，低於6.0或高於9.0為超標。樣本狀態：任何超標即為超標。否則任何警戒即為警戒。否則為在範圍內。此處沒有定義區域狀態。此等並非法律排放或健康標準。

body.en: From: fictional client Harbour View Management. To: Enviro Labs client services. We need a short review of the attached synthetic soil records for two zones. Please do not state legal compliance or health safety. We need the status of each sample under the supplied scenario thresholds, a check on which claims are supported, and a handover with next verification steps. The records cover one baseline and one follow-up round only. No repeat samples exist yet. Kindly identify missing evidence and propose checks. This is a learning simulation.
body.zh: 發件人：虛構客戶港景管理。收件人：環境化驗有限公司客戶服務。我們需要簡短覆核隨附的兩個區域合成泥土記錄。請勿述明法定合規或健康安全。我們需要各樣本在提供情境門檻下的狀態、檢查哪些聲明可支持，以及包含下一步核實的交接。記錄只涵蓋一輪基線及一輪跟進。目前沒有重複樣本。請指出欠缺證據並提出檢查。本個案為學習模擬。

label.en: What is the overall scenario status for sample F-A1?
label.zh: 樣本F-A1的整體情境狀態是甚麼？

label.en: What is the overall scenario status for sample B-B1?
label.zh: 樣本B-B1的整體情境狀態是甚麼？

label.en: Which statements are supported by the supplied synthetic records and scenario rules?
label.zh: 哪些聲明獲提供的合成記錄及情境規則支持？

label.en: Zone A lead increased from baseline to follow-up.
label.zh: 區域A鉛由基線至跟進上升。

label.en: Zone B lead decreased from baseline to follow-up.
label.zh: 區域B鉛由基線至跟進下降。

label.en: F-A1 pH is in the scenario alert range.
B-B1 pH is within the scenario threshold.
label.zh: B-B1 pH在情境門檻範圍內。

label.en: B-A1 lead is in the scenario alert range.
Calculate the lead concentration difference between F-A1 and B-A1, in mg/kg.
label.zh: 計算F-A1與B-A1的鉛濃度差值，以mg/kg計。

label.en: How many samples have pH in the scenario alert range?
label.zh: 有多少個樣本的pH屬情境警戒範圍？

about.en: Enviro Labs lists environmental testing, including water and soil analysis, among its laboratory services.
about.zh: 環境化驗有限公司的化驗服務包括水質及泥土分析等環境測試。

simulationStyle.en: Interpret synthetic water or soil monitoring records with explicit scenario thresholds, sample limitations and a client handover. Scenario thresholds are invented and are not legal discharge standards.
simulationStyle.zh: 以明確情境門檻、樣本限制及客戶交接紀錄解讀合成水質或泥土監測資料。情境門檻為虛構，並非法定排放標準。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Compare synthetic environmental observations with supplied fictional thresholds and limited sampling scope.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。以提供的虛構門檻及有限採樣範圍比較合成環境觀察。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Compare synthetic environmental observations with supplied fictional thresholds and limited sampling scope.

expectedEvidence.en: F-A1 status is alert because lead 78 mg/kg is above 50 and at most 100, and pH 6.3 is in the alert range 6.0 to 6.49. B-B1 status is alert because lead 55 mg/kg is above 50 and at most 100, while pH 7.9 is within. Lead difference F-A1 minus B-A1 is 78 minus 42 equals 36 mg/kg. pH alert samples are F-A1 at 6.3 and F-B1 at 6.1, count 2.
expectedEvidence.zh: F-A1狀態為警戒，因為鉛78 mg/kg高於50且等於或低於100，pH 6.3屬警戒範圍6.0至6.49。B-B1狀態為警戒，因為鉛55 mg/kg高於50且等於或低於100，pH 7.9在範圍內。鉛差值F-A1減B-A1為78減42等於36 mg/kg。pH警戒樣本為F-A1的6.3及F-B1的6.1，數目為2。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Links decisions to soil-results-2026-05 and scenario-thresholds. Uses lead rule: within <=50, alert >50 and <=100, exceed >100. pH rule: within 6.5 to 8.5 inclusive, alert 6.0 to 6.49 or 8.51 to 9.0. Sample status rule: exceed if any exceed, else alert if any alert, else within. Correct supported claims: Zone A lead increased from 42 to 78, Zone B lead decreased from 55 to 48, F-A1 pH alert, B-B1 pH within. B-A1 lead 42 is within not alert.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把決策連結至soil-results-2026-05及scenario-thresholds。鉛規則：等於或低於50為在範圍內，高於50且等於或低於100為警戒，高於100為超標。pH規則：6.5至8.5（含）為在範圍內，6.0至6.49或8.51至9.0為警戒。樣本狀態規則：任何超標即為超標，否則任何警戒即為警戒，否則為在範圍內。可支持聲明：區域A鉛由42升至78，區域B鉛由55降至48，F-A1 pH警戒，B-B1 pH在範圍內。B-A1鉛42在範圍內而非警戒。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes repeat sampling at both zones to address one baseline and one follow-up only, no replicates, no depth profile and no seasonal series. Suggests checking sample chain of custody, lab batch quality control and field duplicate precision. Recommends confirming whether lead and pH changes are sustained over time. Does not propose real lab work, only paper checks and resampling requests.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議在兩個區域重複採樣，以回應僅有一輪基線及一輪跟進、沒有重複樣本、沒有深度剖面及沒有季節序列。建議檢查樣本監管鏈、化驗批次質量控制及現場重複樣本精密度。建議確認鉛及pH變化是否持續。不建議真實化驗工作，只提出文件檢查及重新採樣要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges records cover only one baseline and one follow-up round. No replicate samples, no depth profile, no seasonal series, no flow or soil moisture data. States thresholds are fictional scenario assumptions and not legal or health standards. Does not claim legal compliance, health safety or zone-wide status beyond supplied samples.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認記錄只涵蓋一輪基線及一輪跟進。沒有重複樣本、沒有深度剖面、沒有季節序列、沒有流量或土壤水分資料。述明門檻為虛構情境假設，並非法律或健康標準。不聲稱法定合規、健康安全或超出提供樣本的區域整體狀態。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Provides concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese. States F-A1 alert, B-B1 alert, lead difference 36 mg/kg, pH alert count 2. Lists supported claims and missing evidence. Names client Harbour View Management and Enviro Labs client services. Suggests next steps such as repeat sampling and lab quality checks. Clear and actionable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文提供簡潔交接。述明F-A1警戒、B-B1警戒、鉛差值36 mg/kg、pH警戒數目2。列出可支持聲明及欠缺證據。列明客戶港景管理及環境化驗有限公司客戶服務。建議下一步如重複採樣及化驗質量檢查。清晰可行。

exemplar.en: Handover for Harbour View Management. From synthetic soil records soil-results-2026-05 and scenario-thresholds. Sample F-A1 status is alert. Lead is 78 mg/kg, above 50 and at most 100. pH is 6.3, in the alert range 6.0 to 6.49. Sample B-B1 status is alert. Lead is 55 mg/kg, above 50 and at most 100. pH is 7.9, within 6.5 to 8.5 inclusive. Lead difference for Zone A is 78 minus 42 equals 36 mg/kg. pH alert count is 2 samples, F-A1 at 6.3 and F-B1 at 6.1. Supported claims are Zone A lead increased, Zone B lead decreased, F-A1 pH alert, B-B1 pH within. B-A1 lead 42 mg/kg is within. Missing evidence includes repeat samples, field duplicates, depth profile, seasonal series and quality control batch records. Next steps are request repeat sampling at both zones, check chain of custody and lab batch quality control. Thresholds are fictional scenario assumptions, not legal or health standards. No legal compliance or health safety claim is made.
exemplar.zh: 港景管理交接。根據合成泥土記錄soil-results-2026-05及scenario-thresholds。樣本F-A1狀態為警戒。鉛78 mg/kg，高於50且等於或低於100。pH 6.3，屬警戒範圍6.0至6.49。樣本B-B1狀態為警戒。鉛55 mg/kg，高於50且等於或低於100。pH 7.9，在6.5至8.5（含）範圍內。區域A鉛差值為78減42等於36 mg/kg。pH警戒樣本數目為2個，F-A1為6.3，F-B1為6.1。可支持聲明為區域A鉛上升、區域B鉛下降、F-A1 pH警戒、B-B1 pH在範圍內。B-A1鉛42 mg/kg在範圍內。欠缺證據包括重複樣本、現場重複、深度剖面、季節序列及質量控制批次記錄。下一步為要求兩個區域重複採樣，檢查監管鏈及化驗批次質量控制。門檻為虛構情境假設，並非法律或健康標準。不作出法定合規或健康安全聲明。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct. F-A1 and B-B1 are both alert (lead 78 and 55 mg/kg above 50 and at most 100, plus F-A1 pH 6.3 in the alert band), the lead difference is 36 mg/kg, and the pH alert count is 2.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確。F-A1及B-B1均為警戒（鉛78及55 mg/kg高於50且不超過100，F-A1 pH 6.3亦屬警戒範圍），鉛差值為36 mg/kg，pH警戒數目為2。

feedback.en: Decisions are tied to soil-results-2026-05 and scenario-thresholds and you correctly apply the lead, pH and overall sample rules. You also rightly exclude B-A1 lead 42 mg/kg from the alert range and justify each supported claim.
feedback.zh: 決策連繫至soil-results-2026-05及scenario-thresholds，並正確套用鉛、pH及整體樣本規則。你亦正確指出B-A1鉛42 mg/kg不屬警戒範圍，並為每項可支持聲明提供理據。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and test the weak points, covering repeat sampling at both zones, chain of custody and lab batch quality control. You also list field duplicates, depth profile and seasonal series as gaps to close.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體並針對弱點，涵蓋兩個區域重複採樣、監管鏈及化驗批次質量控制。你亦把現場重複、深度剖面及季節序列列為待補缺口。

feedback.en: You clearly limit the work to synthetic records with one baseline and one follow-up round, and you state the thresholds are fictional and not legal or health standards. No compliance or health safety claim is made.
feedback.zh: 你清楚把工作限於僅一輪基線及一輪跟進的合成記錄，並述明門檻為虛構而非法律或健康標準。未作出合規或健康安全聲明。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable at 173 words, naming Harbour View Management and the source documents while stating both statuses, the 36 mg/kg difference and the pH alert count. It reads as a clear working note for client services to act on.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，共173字，列明港景管理及來源文件，並述明兩個狀態、36 mg/kg差值及pH警戒數目。內容清晰，客戶服務可據此行動。

summary.en: Strong submission. All decisions, calculations and supported claims are correct, evidence is cited, verification steps and scope limits are clear, and the 173-word handover fits the target range.
summary.zh: 表現出色。所有決策、計算及可支持聲明均正確，證據有引用，核實步驟及範圍限制清晰，173字交接亦符合目標範圍。

nextSteps.en: No fixes required. If you repeat this task, you could add a named owner and a due date for the resampling request to make the handover even more actionable.
nextSteps.zh: 無需修正。如重做此任務，可為重新採樣要求加上負責人及期限，令交接更易執行。

brief.en: You support Enviro Labs on an independent learning simulation. Client Harbour View Facilities sent synthetic batch QC-2210 and sample report SR-447 for paper review. Decide which sample results are final, provisional or not reportable under synthetic rule RR-3. Recommend proportionate documentary follow-up. Do not propose field or chemical procedures. Write a concise English or Traditional Chinese handover of about 100 to 180 words for the client, citing source IDs and counts.
brief.zh: 你在環境化驗有限公司的獨立學習模擬中提供支援。客戶 Harbour View Facilities 提交合成的批次 QC-2210 及樣本報告 SR-447 作文件覆核。根據合成規則 RR-3，判斷哪些樣本結果屬最終、暫定或不可報告。建議合比例的文件跟進。不要提出實地或化學程序。為客戶撰寫約100至180字的簡潔英文或繁體中文交接，並引用文件編號及計數。

title.zh: 批次品質控制登記冊 QC-2210

body.en:
Fictional rule RR-3, for this simulation only. These thresholds are not legal standards. No field or chemical procedures are requested.
A sample result is final only if its linked blank-control is within limit and condition confirmation is Yes.
A sample result is provisional if its linked blank-control is flagged above limit, even when condition confirmation is Yes. Provisional results need a written QC note linking the sample to the flagged blank-control.
A sample result is not reportable if condition confirmation is No, regardless of blank-control status. It needs a completed sample-condition record from the client.
body.zh:
虛構規則 RR-3，僅供本模擬使用。這些門檻並非法律標準。不要求實地或化學程序。
只有相連空白對照在限值內且樣本狀況確認為是，樣本結果才屬最終。
若相連空白對照標記為高於限值，即使樣本狀況確認為是，樣本結果仍屬暫定。暫定結果需要書面品質控制備註，將樣本連繫至被標記的空白對照。
若樣本狀況確認為否，不論空白對照狀態如何，樣本結果均不可報告。此情況需要客戶提交完整的樣本狀況記錄。
