Classify each sample as final, provisional or not reportable under synthetic rule RR-4. Recommend proportionate documentary follow-up. Do not propose field or chemical procedures. Write a concise English or Traditional Chinese handover of about 100 to 180 words for the client, citing source IDs and counts.

body.en: Synthetic rule RR-4 for this simulation only. These thresholds are not legal standards. No field or chemical procedures are requested. Final: sample collected outside the post-rain window, or within the window with a completed post-rain sample condition form stating no active rainfall. Provisional: sample collected within the window with a completed form stating active rainfall. Provisional results require a written note linking the sample to rain event RE-12. Not reportable: sample collected within the window with a missing or incomplete post-rain sample condition form. Not reportable until the client provides the completed form.
body.zh: 虛構規則 RR-4，僅供本模擬使用。這些門檻並非法律標準。不要求實地或化學程序。最終：樣本在雨後窗口外採集，或在窗口內採集且已提交完整的雨後樣本狀況表格，並註明無活躍降雨。暫定：樣本在窗口內採集且已提交完整表格，並註明有活躍降雨。暫定結果需要書面備註，將樣本連繫至雨事件 RE-12。不可報告：樣本在窗口內採集且雨後樣本狀況表格缺失或不完整。在客戶提交完整表格前不可報告。

body.en: Synthetic sample report SR-512. All results are synthetic and for documentary review only. Collection times relative to rain event RE-12. Form status: Present, Missing, Incomplete, or Not required. Form content: Active rainfall, No active rainfall, or blank. Samples collected within the 48-hour post-rain window require a form. S-201: collected 2026-03-15 10:00, form present, Active rainfall. S-202: collected 2026-03-15 16:00, form present, No active rainfall. S-203: collected 2026-03-16 09:00, form missing. S-204: collected 2026-03-17 15:00, form not required. S-205: collected 2026-03-16 12:00, form present, Active rainfall. S-206: collected 2026-03-16 18:00, form incomplete (missing collection time).
body.zh: 合成樣本報告 SR-512。所有結果均為合成，僅供文件覆核。採集時間相對於雨事件 RE-12。表格狀態：已提交、缺失、不完整或無需提交。表格內容：有活躍降雨、無活躍降雨或空白。在雨後48小時窗口內採集的樣本需要表格。S-201：2026-03-15 10:00 採集，表格已提交，有活躍降雨。S-202：2026-03-15 16:00 採集，表格已提交，無活躍降雨。S-203：2026-03-16 09:00 採集，表格缺失。S-204：2026-03-17 15:00 採集，表格無需提交。S-205：2026-03-16 12:00 採集，表格已提交，有活躍降雨。S-206：2026-03-16 18:00 採集，表格不完整（缺失採集時間）。

body.en: Synthetic rain event log RE-12. Rain started 2026-03-15 08:00 and ended 2026-03-15 14:00. The post-rain window is 48 hours after rain end, from 2026-03-15 14:00 to 2026-03-17 14:00. Samples collected within this window require a completed post-rain sample condition form. Samples collected outside this window do not require a form. This is a fictional window for simulation only.
body.zh: 合成雨事件紀錄 RE-12。降雨於 2026-03-15 08:00 開始，並於 2026-03-15 14:00 結束。雨後窗口為降雨結束後48小時，即 2026-03-15 14:00 至 2026-03-17 14:00。在此窗口內採集的樣本需要完整的雨後樣本狀況表格。在此窗口外採集的樣本無需表格。此為虛構窗口，僅供模擬使用。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks such as confirming the 48-hour window from RE-12, verifying form completeness for S-206, and requesting the specific missing form for S-203. Suggests documenting the follow-up request and noting that provisional sample S-205 needs a written note. Avoids field or chemical procedures.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如根據 RE-12 確認48小時窗口、核實 S-206 的表格完整性，以及為 S-203 要求提交具體缺失表格。建議記錄跟進要求，並註明暫定樣本 S-205 需要書面備註。避免實地或化學程序。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that results are not reportable until documentation is provided, and that provisional status is not a final compliance statement. Notes that thresholds are fictional and not legal standards. Avoids inferring environmental safety or legal compliance.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認在提交文件前結果不可報告，且暫定狀態並非最終合規聲明。註明門檻為虛構，並非法定標準。避免推斷環境安全或法律合規。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese that lists decisions (final, provisional, not reportable counts and IDs), evidence (source IDs), and next steps (request missing or incomplete forms for S-203 and S-206, add written note for S-205). Includes ownership or escalation if relevant.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，列明決策（最終、暫定、不可報告的計數及編號）、證據（文件編號）及下一步（要求 S-203 及 S-206 的缺失或不完整表格、為 S-205 添加書面備註）。如適用，包括負責人或轉交。

exemplar.en: Evidence from RE-12, SR-512 and RR-4: Rain event RE-12 ended 2026-03-15 14:00, defining a 48-hour post-rain window from 2026-03-15 14:00 to 2026-03-17 14:00. Samples S-202, S-203, S-205 and S-206 were collected within this window. S-201 was collected 2026-03-15 10:00, before the window started, so it is final under RR-4 despite its form. S-202 has a completed form stating no active rainfall, so it is final. S-204 was collected 2026-03-17 15:00, outside the window, so it is final. S-205 has a completed form stating active rainfall, so it is provisional and requires a written note linking to RE-12. S-203 and S-206 have missing or incomplete forms, so they are not reportable until the client provides completed forms. Counts: 3 final (S-201, S-202, S-204), 1 provisional (S-205), 2 not reportable (S-203, S-206). Next steps: request completed forms for S-203 and S-206, and add a written note for S-205. This is a documentary follow-up only, no field or chemical procedures. These are fictional scenario thresholds.
exemplar.zh: 根據 RE-12、SR-512 及 RR-4 的證據：雨事件 RE-12 於 2026-03-15 14:00 結束，定義了48小時雨後窗口，由 2026-03-15 14:00 至 2026-03-17 14:00。樣本 S-202、S-203、S-205 及 S-206 在此窗口內採集。S-201 於 2026-03-15 10:00 採集，在窗口開始前，因此根據 RR-4 屬最終，儘管其表格。S-202 有完整表格顯示無活躍降雨，因此屬最終。S-204 於 2026-03-17 15:00 採集，在窗口外，因此屬最終。S-205 有完整表格顯示活躍降雨，因此屬暫定，需要書面備註連繫至 RE-12。S-203 及 S-206 的表格缺失或不完整，因此在客戶提供完整表格前不可報告。計數：3 個最終（S-201、S-202、S-204），1 個暫定（S-205），2 個不可報告（S-203、S-206）。下一步：要求 S-203 及 S-206 的完整表格，並為 S-205 添加書面備註。此僅為文件跟進，無實地或化學程序。此為虛構情境門檻。

feedback.en: All classifications and counts match RR-4: S-203 and S-206 not reportable, 3 final (S-201, S-202, S-204), 1 provisional (S-205), and the correct documentary follow-up for S-203. The missing or incomplete form limitation is correctly identified as the reporting blocker.
feedback.zh: 所有分類及計數均符合 RR-4：S-203 及 S-206 不可報告，3 個最終（S-201、S-202、S-204），1 個暫定（S-205），並為 S-203 提出正確的文件跟進。表格缺失或不完整被正確識別為報告障礙。

feedback.en: Reasoning ties each decision to specific records, citing RE-12 for the 48-hour window and SR-512 for collection times and form status. S-201 is correctly explained as final because it was collected before the window, which is a subtle and accurate distinction.
feedback.zh: 推理把每項決策連結至具體記錄，引用 RE-12 的48小時窗口及 SR-512 的採集時間與表格狀態。S-201 因在窗口前採集而屬最終，此區分細緻且準確。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete and proportionate: requesting completed forms for S-203 and S-206 and adding a written note for S-205, with no field or chemical procedures. You could strengthen this by naming ownership or escalation for the client request.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體且合比例：為 S-203 及 S-206 要求完整表格，並為 S-205 添加書面備註，且無提出實地或化學程序。若能為客戶要求指明負責人或轉交路徑會更完善。

feedback.en: You correctly note the thresholds are fictional and keep the follow-up documentary, without inferring environmental safety or legal compliance. The caveat that results are not reportable until documentation is provided is well stated.
feedback.zh: 你正確註明門檻為虛構，並把跟進限於文件層面，沒有推斷環境安全或法律合規。你也清楚說明在提交文件前結果不可報告。

feedback.en: The handover is concise (167 words, within the 100 to 180 guidance) and lists decisions, source IDs, counts and next steps clearly. Naming an owner for the outstanding form requests would make it fully actionable.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔（167字，符合100至180字指引），清楚列明決策、文件編號、計數及下一步。若能為待處理的表格要求指明負責人，將更完全可行。

summary.en: Excellent work. All classifications, counts and follow-up recommendations are accurate and well evidenced against RE-12, SR-512 and RR-4, and the scope is properly bounded to the fictional scenario. The handover is concise and actionable.
summary.zh: 表現出色。所有分類、計數及跟進建議均準確，並以 RE-12、SR-512 及 RR-4 充分佐證，範圍亦恰當地限於虛構情境。交接簡潔可行。

nextSteps.en: To reach the top standard, briefly name who owns the S-203 and S-206 form requests and how the follow-up is tracked. This keeps the handover fully actionable for the client.
nextSteps.zh: 如要達至最高水平，可簡述誰負責 S-203 及 S-206 的表格要求，以及如何追蹤跟進。這樣交接對客戶而言會更完全可行。

title.en: Reconcile a merchant delivery budget variance
title.zh: 核對商戶配送預算差異

brief.en: You support a fictional Lalamove merchant cost review. Read the three fictional sources and reconcile the August delivery budget with actuals. Use the supplied variance formulas and favourable or unfavourable convention. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, stating calculations, supported drivers and limits. Do not claim that any operational event caused the variance. This is an independent learning simulation and not endorsed by Lalamove.
brief.zh: 你支援一項虛構的 Lalamove 商戶成本檢視。閱讀三份虛構文件，核對八月配送預算與實際數據。使用提供的差異公式及有利或不利慣例。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔且具證據的交接，約 100 至 180 字，說明計算、獲支持的原因及限制。不要聲稱任何營運事件導致該差異。此為獨立學習模擬，未獲 Lalamove 認可。

body.en:
Fictional merchant: Kowloon Bakery. August delivery cost only.
Budget: 3,200 deliveries, budget unit cost HKD 45.00 per delivery, budget total HKD 144,000.
Actual: 3,500 deliveries, actual unit cost HKD 43.20 per delivery, actual total HKD 151,200.
All amounts in HKD. No other delivery cost items are included. Volume is number of completed deliveries.
body.zh:
虛構商戶：九龍麵包店。只包括八月配送成本。
預算：3,200 次配送，預算單位成本每程 HKD 45.00，預算總額 HKD 144,000。
實際：3,500 次配送，實際單位成本每程 HKD 43.20，實際總額 HKD 151,200。
所有金額以 HKD 計。不包括其他配送成本項目。數量為完成配送次數。

body.en: Favourable and unfavourable convention. Actual total above budget total is unfavourable. Actual total below budget total is favourable. Volume variance equals actual volume minus budget volume multiplied by budget unit cost. Unit cost variance equals actual unit cost minus budget unit cost multiplied by actual volume. Total variance equals actual total minus budget total. This is a fictional learning assumption. It does not describe real Lalamove policy or merchant data.
body.zh: 有利及不利慣例。實際總額高於預算總額為不利。實際總額低於預算總額為有利。數量差異等於實際數量減預算數量再乘以預算單位成本。單位成本差異等於實際單位成本減預算單位成本再乘以實際數量。總差異等於實際總額減預算總額。此為虛構學習假設，不描述真實 Lalamove 政策或商戶數據。

body.en: Fictional operations log extract. Dispatch record shows 3,500 completed deliveries in August. The rate card from 1 August lists a flat HKD 43.20 per delivery for all zones. A promotion ran from 5 to 12 August and two new zones opened on 18 August. The log does not establish what caused the volume or unit cost result. No customer complaints or failed deliveries are included in this cost review.
body.zh: 虛構營運紀錄摘錄。派單記錄顯示八月有 3,500 次完成配送。八月一日起的收費表列明所有區域劃一每程 HKD 43.20。推廣活動於八月五日至十二日進行，兩個新區域於八月十八日開放。紀錄沒有確定數量或單位成本結果的成因。此成本檢視不包括客戶投訴或失敗配送。

label.en: What is the total delivery cost variance for August?
label.zh: 八月配送成本總差異是多少？

label.en: Calculate the volume variance in HKD. Use positive for unfavourable and negative for favourable.
label.zh: 計算數量差異，以 HKD 為單位。不利為正數，有利為負數。

label.en: Calculate the unit cost variance in HKD. Use positive for unfavourable and negative for favourable.
label.zh: 計算單位成本差異，以 HKD 為單位。不利為正數，有利為負數。

label.en: Which statement is supported by the supplied records?
label.zh: 哪項陳述獲提供紀錄支持？

label.en: Volume effect is unfavourable by HKD 13,500 and unit cost effect is favourable by HKD 6,300, netting HKD 7,200 unfavourable.
label.zh: 數量影響為不利 HKD 13,500，單位成本影響為有利 HKD 6,300，淨額為不利 HKD 7,200。

label.en: The promotion caused the extra 300 deliveries.
label.zh: 推廣活動導致額外 300 次配送。

label.en: The unit cost rose because fuel surcharge increased.
label.zh: 單位成本因燃油附加費上升而增加。

label.en: Total cost is favourable because unit cost fell.
label.zh: 總成本因單位成本下降而有利。

label.en: Which checks should be included in the handover?
Verify completed delivery count against dispatch record
label.zh: 根據派單記錄核實完成配送數量

label.en: Verify the HKD 43.20 rate card applied to all billed deliveries
label.zh: 核實 HKD 43.20 收費表已應用於所有已計費配送

label.en: State that the promotion caused the volume increase
label.zh: 聲明推廣活動導致數量增加

label.en: Recalculate total, volume and unit cost variances
label.zh: 重新計算總差異、數量差異及單位成本差異

label.en: Exclude unit cost from the variance explanation
label.zh: 在差異解釋中排除單位成本

about.en: Lalamove describes an on-demand delivery platform founded in Hong Kong in 2013, connecting people and businesses with delivery vehicles.
about.zh: Lalamove 介紹其為 2013 年於香港創立的即時配送平台，連結個人、企業及配送車輛。

publicValues.zh: 快捷、簡單及實惠的配送

simulationStyle.en: Analyse fictional merchant processes, prioritise requirements and compare synthetic operating costs or budget variances. Explain assumptions and service limits without claims about real company finances or platform performance.
simulationStyle.zh: 分析虛構商戶流程、排列需求優先次序，並比較合成營運成本或預算差異。解釋假設及服務限制，不聲稱代表真實公司財務或平台表現。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Reconcile an invented budget and actual table and explain supported drivers without assuming causality.

expectedEvidence.en: Correctly reports total variance HKD 7,200 unfavourable, volume variance HKD 13,500 unfavourable and unit cost variance HKD 6,300 favourable. Uses actual minus budget and the supplied formulas. Accepts equivalent workings that reach the same signs.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確報告總差異為不利 HKD 7,200，數量差異為不利 HKD 13,500，單位成本差異為有利 HKD 6,300。使用實際減預算及提供公式。接受達到相同正負號的等效計算。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source-budget-actual for 3,200 budget deliveries at HKD 45.00, 3,500 actual deliveries at HKD 43.20, totals HKD 144,000 and HKD 151,200. Cites source-variance-policy for formulas. Uses source-ops-log only as a timing overlap and does not claim promotion or new zones caused the variance.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 source-budget-actual 的 3,200 次預算配送每程 HKD 45.00、3,500 次實際配送每程 HKD 43.20、總額 HKD 144,000 及 HKD 151,200。引用 source-variance-policy 的公式。僅把 source-ops-log 用作時間重疊，不聲稱推廣或新區域導致差異。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes verifying completed delivery count against dispatch record, confirming HKD 43.20 rate applied to all billed deliveries, checking no other delivery cost items were excluded, and recalculating the three variances. Accepts other concrete checks tied to sources.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出根據派單記錄核實完成配送數量，確認 HKD 43.20 收費已應用於所有已計費配送，檢查沒有其他配送成本項目被排除，並重新計算三項差異。接受與文件相關的其他具體檢查。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States the review is fictional and limited to supplied August delivery cost. Acknowledges no causal evidence, no zone level rates, no delivery mix and no real Lalamove financial data. Avoids claiming promotion caused volume.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明檢視屬虛構，並限於提供的八月配送成本。承認沒有因果證據、沒有區域級收費、沒有配送組合，也沒有真實 Lalamove 財務數據。避免聲稱推廣導致數量增加。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese. Includes total, volume and unit cost calculations, supported drivers, limits, next checks and owner or escalation to cost analysis lead. Uses source references.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫約 100 至 180 英文字或相若香港繁體中文的簡潔交接。包括總差異、數量及單位成本計算、獲支持原因、限制、下一步檢查，以及負責人或轉交成本分析主管。使用文件引用。

exemplar.en: Handover for fictional Kowloon Bakery August delivery cost review. Source-budget-actual shows budget 3,200 deliveries at HKD 45.00 and actual 3,500 deliveries at HKD 43.20. Using source-variance-policy, total variance is HKD 151,200 minus HKD 144,000 equals HKD 7,200 unfavourable. Volume variance is 300 extra deliveries times HKD 45.00 equals HKD 13,500 unfavourable. Unit cost variance is HKD 1.80 lower times 3,500 deliveries equals HKD 6,300 favourable. The net result is HKD 7,200 unfavourable. Source-ops-log records a promotion and new zones but does not prove cause, so I do not claim causality. Next steps: verify completed delivery count against dispatch records, confirm the HKD 43.20 flat rate applied to all bills, and check that no other delivery cost items were excluded. Owner: cost analysis lead. Limit: this is a fictional learning simulation and not endorsed by Lalamove.
exemplar.zh: 虛構九龍麵包店八月配送成本檢視交接。source-budget-actual 顯示預算 3,200 次配送每程 HKD 45.00，實際 3,500 次配送每程 HKD 43.20。使用 source-variance-policy，總差異為 HKD 151,200 減 HKD 144,000 等於不利 HKD 7,200。數量差異為額外 300 次配送乘以 HKD 45.00 等於不利 HKD 13,500。單位成本差異為每程低 HKD 1.80 乘以 3,500 次配送等於有利 HKD 6,300。淨結果為不利 HKD 7,200。source-ops-log 記錄推廣活動及新區域，但沒有證明成因，因此我不聲稱因果。下一步：根據派單記錄核實完成配送數量，確認 HKD 43.20 劃一收費已應用於所有帳單，並檢查沒有其他配送成本項目被排除。負責人：成本分析主管。限制：此為虛構學習模擬，未獲 Lalamove 認可。

feedback.en: All three calculations are correct. Total variance HKD 151,200 minus HKD 144,000 is HKD 7,200 unfavourable, volume variance of 300 extra deliveries at HKD 45.00 is HKD 13,500 unfavourable, and unit cost variance of HKD 1.80 lower at 3,500 deliveries is HKD 6,300 favourable, with signs applied to the supplied convention.
feedback.zh: 三項計算全部正確。總差異 HKD 151,200 減 HKD 144,000 為不利 HKD 7,200，數量差異為額外 300 次乘以 HKD 45.00 即不利 HKD 13,500，單位成本差異為每程低 HKD 1.80 乘以 3,500 次即有利 HKD 6,300，正負號符合提供的慣例。

feedback.en: You tie each figure to source-budget-actual and the formulas in source-variance-policy, and you treat source-ops-log as context only rather than proof of cause. Keep naming the records that support each claim.
feedback.zh: 你把每項數字連繫到 source-budget-actual 及 source-variance-policy 的公式，並僅將 source-ops-log 視作背景而非成因證明。繼續為每項論點標明支持文件。

feedback.en: Your next steps cover verifying completed deliveries against the dispatch record, confirming the HKD 43.20 flat rate applied to all bills, and checking that no other delivery cost items were excluded. Adding the recomputation of all three variances would make the plan complete.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步涵蓋根據派單記錄核實完成配送、確認 HKD 43.20 劃一收費已應用於所有帳單，以及檢查沒有其他配送成本項目被排除。如再加入重新計算三項差異，計劃便更完整。

feedback.en: You correctly state that the promotion and new zones do not prove cause and that the review is a fictional simulation not endorsed by Lalamove. Noting missing zone level rates or delivery mix would further sharpen the limits.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出推廣及新區域不能證明成因，並說明此為虛構模擬且未獲 Lalamove 認可。若再指出欠缺區域級收費或配送組合，限制說明會更清晰。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and well organised at 149 English words, and it names the cost analysis lead as owner with calculations, evidence, limits and next steps in one place. It is ready to pass on as written.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰有序，共 149 個英文字，並以成本分析主管為負責人，把計算、證據、限制及下一步集中一處。可直接轉交。

summary.en: A complete and accurate reconciliation. All five answers and the 149 word handover match the supplied rules, cite the right sources, avoid causal claims and hand over to the cost analysis lead.
summary.zh: 核對完整且準確。五項答案及 149 字交接均符合提供規則，引用正確文件，避免因果聲明，並轉交成本分析主管。

nextSteps.en: Keep this standard. To add value, extend the next steps with the recomputation of all three variances and note the missing zone level rate detail as an open limit.

title.en: Reconcile a delivery cost budget variance with one-time and recurring costs
title.zh: 核對包含一次性及經常性成本的配送預算差異

brief.en: You support a fictional Lalamove merchant cost review. Read the three fictional sources and reconcile the September delivery budget with actuals for Tuen Mun Home Bakery. Use the supplied formulas and favourable or unfavourable convention. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, stating calculations, supported drivers and limits. Do not claim that any operational event caused the variance. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Lalamove and not endorsed by it.
brief.zh: 你支援一項虛構的 Lalamove 商戶成本檢視。閱讀三份虛構文件，核對屯門家庭麵包店九月配送預算與實際數據。使用提供的公式及有利或不利慣例。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔且具證據的交接，約 100 至 180 字，說明計算、獲支持的原因及限制。不要聲稱任何營運事件導致該差異。此為受 Lalamove 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲其認可。

body.en: Fictional merchant: Tuen Mun Home Bakery. September delivery cost only. Budget. Completed deliveries 2,400. One-time driver onboarding and route setup HKD 18,000. Recurring cost per delivery HKD 12.50. Budget recurring total HKD 30,000. Budget total HKD 48,000. Actual. Completed deliveries 2,500. One-time driver onboarding and route setup HKD 22,500. Recurring cost per delivery HKD 11.80. Actual recurring total HKD 29,500. Actual total HKD 52,000. All amounts in HKD. No other delivery cost items are included.
body.zh: 虛構商戶：屯門家庭麵包店。只包括九月配送成本。預算：完成配送 2,400 次。一次性司機入職及路線設定 HKD 18,000。每程經常性成本 HKD 12.50。預算經常性總額 HKD 30,000。預算總額 HKD 48,000。實際：完成配送 2,500 次。一次性司機入職及路線設定 HKD 22,500。每程經常性成本 HKD 11.80。實際經常性總額 HKD 29,500。實際總額 HKD 52,000。所有金額以 HKD 計。不包括其他配送成本項目。

body.en: Favourable and unfavourable convention. Actual total above budget total is unfavourable. Actual total below budget total is favourable. One-time cost variance equals actual one-time cost minus budget one-time cost. Recurring cost variance equals actual recurring total minus budget recurring total. Budget recurring total equals budget deliveries multiplied by budget recurring unit cost. Actual recurring total equals actual deliveries multiplied by actual recurring unit cost. Total variance equals actual total minus budget total. Positive variance is unfavourable. Negative variance is favourable. This is a fictional learning assumption. It does not describe real Lalamove policy or merchant data.
body.zh: 有利及不利慣例。實際總額高於預算總額為不利。實際總額低於預算總額為有利。一次性成本差異等於實際一次性成本減預算一次性成本。經常性成本差異等於實際經常性總額減預算經常性總額。預算經常性總額等於預算配送次數乘以預算經常性單位成本。實際經常性總額等於實際配送次數乘以實際經常性單位成本。總差異等於實際總額減預算總額。正數差異為不利。負數差異為有利。此為虛構學習假設，不描述真實 Lalamove 政策或商戶數據。

body.en: Fictional operations log extract. Dispatch record shows 2,500 completed deliveries in September. The September rate card lists HKD 11.80 per delivery for all zones. One-time records list driver onboarding and route setup at HKD 22,500, including an extra zone setup kit and refreshed app tutorial. The log does not establish what caused the one-time or recurring cost result. No customer complaints or failed deliveries are included in this cost review.
body.zh: 虛構營運紀錄摘錄。派單記錄顯示九月有 2,500 次完成配送。九月收費表列明所有區域每程 HKD 11.80。一次性紀錄列明司機入職及路線設定為 HKD 22,500，包括額外區域設定套件及更新應用程式教學。紀錄沒有確定一次性或經常性成本結果的成因。此成本檢視不包括客戶投訴或失敗配送。

label.en: What is the total delivery cost variance for September?
label.zh: 九月配送成本總差異是多少？

label.en: Calculate the one-time cost variance in HKD. Use positive for unfavourable and negative for favourable.
label.zh: 計算一次性成本差異，以 HKD 為單位。不利為正數，有利為負數。

label.en: Calculate the recurring cost variance in HKD. Use positive for unfavourable and negative for favourable.
label.zh: 計算經常性成本差異，以 HKD 為單位。不利為正數，有利為負數。

label.en: Which statement is supported by the supplied records?
label.zh: 哪項陳述獲提供紀錄支持？

label.en: One-time cost is unfavourable by HKD 4,500 and recurring cost is favourable by HKD 500, netting HKD 4,000 unfavourable.
label.zh: 一次性成本為不利 HKD 4,500，經常性成本為有利 HKD 500，淨額為不利 HKD 4,000。

label.en: The extra zone setup kit caused the one-time cost increase.
label.zh: 額外區域設定套件導致一次性成本增加。

label.en: The 100 extra deliveries caused the total cost to be unfavourable.
label.zh: 額外 100 次配送導致總成本不利。

label.en: The lower recurring unit cost caused the total cost to be favourable.
label.zh: 較低經常性單位成本導致總成本有利。

label.en: Which checks should be included in the handover?
Verify completed delivery count against dispatch record
label.zh: 根據派單記錄核實完成配送數量

label.en: Verify one-time cost receipts and classification
label.zh: 核實一次性成本收據及分類

label.en: Verify actual recurring unit cost from rate card or invoices
label.zh: 從收費表或發票核實實際經常性單位成本

label.en: State that the extra zone setup kit caused the one-time increase
label.zh: 聲明額外區域設定套件導致一次性增加

label.en: Exclude one-time cost from the variance explanation
label.zh: 在差異解釋中排除一次性成本

exemplar.en: Reconciliation for Tuen Mun Home Bakery September delivery cost. From source-budget-actual, budget total is HKD 48,000 and actual total is HKD 52,000. Total variance is HKD 4,000 unfavourable, using source-variance-policy. One-time cost variance is HKD 22,500 minus HKD 18,000, equal to HKD 4,500 unfavourable. Recurring cost variance is HKD 29,500 minus HKD 30,000, equal to HKD 500 favourable. The net is HKD 4,500 unfavourable plus HKD 500 favourable, equal to HKD 4,000 unfavourable. Source-ops-log confirms 2,500 completed deliveries and the HKD 11.80 rate but does not establish cause. The extra zone setup kit and refreshed app tutorial are noted only as records, not causes. Next checks: verify delivery count against dispatch, verify one-time receipts and classification, verify recurring rate applied to billed deliveries, and recalculate all variances. Risk: missing evidence on why one-time cost exceeded budget and why recurring unit cost fell. Handover owner: cost analysis lead.
exemplar.zh: 屯門家庭麵包店九月配送成本核對。根據 source-budget-actual，預算總額為 HKD 48,000，實際總額為 HKD 52,000。使用 source-variance-policy，總差異為 HKD 4,000 不利。一次性成本差異為 HKD 22,500 減 HKD 18,000，等於 HKD 4,500 不利。經常性成本差異為 HKD 29,500 減 HKD 30,000，等於 HKD 500 有利。淨額為 HKD 4,500 不利加 HKD 500 有利，等於 HKD 4,000 不利。source-ops-log 確認 2,500 次完成配送及 HKD 11.80 收費，但沒有確定成因。額外區域設定套件及更新應用程式教學只屬紀錄，並非成因。下一步檢查：根據派單記錄核實配送數量，核實一次性收據及分類，核實已計費配送的經常性收費，並重新計算所有差異。風險：欠缺一次性成本超預算及經常性單位成本下降的原因證據。交接負責人：成本分析主管。

feedback.en: All decisions are correct. Total variance HKD 4,000 unfavourable is reconciled as one-time HKD 4,500 unfavourable plus recurring HKD 500 favourable, and the favourable or unfavourable convention is applied properly.

title.en: Fictional unit economics for Harbour Bento delivery orders
title.zh: Harbour Bento 配送訂單的虛構單位經濟效益

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Lalamove. It is not endorsed by Lalamove and does not describe real company finances. You are a junior financial analyst. Harbour Bento, a fictional Hong Kong merchant, sells one lunch set through on-demand delivery. Review the cost schedule, policy and manager note. Answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Classify costs, calculate contribution margin per order and monthly break-even orders, and state the revised contribution if the courier fee changes. Flag missing evidence and propose concrete checks. Target about 100 to 180 English words.
brief.zh: 虛構學習模擬，靈感來自 Lalamove，並未獲 Lalamove 認可，亦不描述真實公司財務。你是初級財務分析師。Harbour Bento 是一間虛構香港商戶，透過即時配送售賣一款午餐套裝。請查閱成本表、政策及主管備註。回答問題，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔及以證據為本的交接。分類成本，計算每張訂單貢獻毛利及每月收支平衡訂單數，並說明配送費改變後的修訂貢獻毛利。指出欠缺證據並提出具體檢查。目標約 100 至 180 個英文詞。

title.en: Fictional cost schedule for Harbour Bento lunch set
title.zh: Harbour Bento 午餐套裝虛構成本表

body.en: Fictional simulation data, not real Lalamove finances. Harbour Bento sells one lunch set at HKD 88. Variable costs per delivered order are ingredients HKD 27.00, packaging HKD 4.00, payment processing 2% of revenue, and merchant-paid courier fee HKD 22.00. Fixed monthly costs are kitchen rent HKD 18,000, staff salaries HKD 32,000, and app subscription HKD 1,200. All orders are delivered. No other costs apply. Treat payment processing as exactly 2% of HKD 88.
body.zh: 虛構模擬數據，並非 Lalamove 真實財務。Harbour Bento 以港幣 88 元售賣一款午餐套裝。每張已配送訂單的可變成本為食材港幣 27.00 元、包裝港幣 4.00 元、支付處理費收入的 2%，以及商戶支付的配送費港幣 22.00 元。每月固定成本為廚房租金港幣 18,000 元、員工薪金港幣 32,000 元及應用程式訂閱費港幣 1,200 元。所有訂單均已配送。沒有其他成本。支付處理費按港幣 88 元的 2% 精確計算。

title.zh: 虛構收支平衡分析政策

body.en: Fictional analysis policy. Classify costs as variable only if they change with each delivered order. Classify rent, salaries and subscription as fixed monthly costs. Contribution margin per order equals revenue minus all variable costs per order. Break-even order count is the smallest whole number of orders per month whose total contribution is greater than or equal to total fixed monthly costs. Use exact arithmetic, then round break-even orders up to a whole order. Do not include tax or investment advice.
body.zh: 虛構分析政策。只有隨每張已配送訂單改變的成本才分類為可變成本。租金、薪金及訂閱費分類為每月固定成本。每張訂單貢獻毛利等於收入減去每張訂單的所有可變成本。收支平衡訂單數是每月貢獻總額大於或等於每月固定成本總額的最小整數訂單數。使用精確算術，然後將收支平衡訂單數向上取整至整張訂單。不包含稅務或投資建議。

body.en: Fictional manager note. Please prepare a short handover for the finance lead. Confirm which costs are variable and fixed, show contribution margin per order and monthly break-even order count. If the courier fee changes to HKD 26.00 per order, state the revised contribution margin only. Do not claim these figures describe real Lalamove operations. Flag any missing evidence. Proposed next checks should be concrete.
body.zh: 虛構主管備註。請為財務主管準備簡短交接。確認哪些成本屬可變及固定，顯示每張訂單貢獻毛利及每月收支平衡訂單數。若配送費改為每張訂單港幣 26.00 元，只說明修訂後的貢獻毛利。不要聲稱這些數字描述真實 Lalamove 營運。指出任何欠缺證據。建議的下一步檢查須具體。

label.zh: 哪項成本屬每張已配送訂單的可變成本？
每張已配送訂單的配送費

label.en: Which costs are fixed monthly costs? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些成本屬每月固定成本？選出所有適用者。

label.en: What is the contribution margin per order in HKD?
label.zh: 每張訂單的貢獻毛利是多少港元？

label.en: What is the monthly break-even order count?
label.zh: 每月收支平衡訂單數是多少？

label.en: If the courier fee becomes HKD 26.00 per order, what is the revised contribution margin per order?
label.zh: 若配送費改為每張訂單港幣 26.00 元，修訂後每張訂單貢獻毛利是多少？

exemplar.en: Fictional simulation only, inspired by Lalamove and not endorsed by it. Evidence: the cost schedule gives HKD 88 revenue per order, variable costs of HKD 27 ingredients, HKD 4 packaging, HKD 1.76 payment processing, and HKD 22 courier fee. Total variable cost is HKD 54.76. Contribution margin is HKD 33.24 per order. The policy defines break-even as the smallest whole order count where contribution is greater than or equal to fixed costs. Fixed costs are HKD 18,000 rent, HKD 32,000 salaries, and HKD 1,200 subscription, total HKD 51,200. Break-even is HKD 51,200 divided by HKD 33.24, rounded up to 1,541 orders. If the courier fee becomes HKD 26.00, variable cost rises by HKD 4.00 and contribution falls to HKD 29.24. Missing evidence includes demand and actual courier quotes. Next steps: recheck the 2% fee, confirm no other fixed costs, and test the 1,541 order threshold.

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Lalamove. Not endorsed by Lalamove and does not describe real company finances. You are a junior financial analyst. Lalamove is considering a fictional merchant support service package for Hong Kong merchants. Review the cost schedule, policy and manager note. Answer the questions, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Classify costs, calculate contribution margin per package and monthly break-even package count, and state the revised contribution if the outsourced support agent fee changes. Flag missing evidence and propose concrete checks. Target about 100 to 180 English words.
brief.zh: 虛構學習模擬，靈感來自 Lalamove，並未獲 Lalamove 認可，亦不描述真實公司財務。你是初級財務分析師。Lalamove 正考慮為香港商戶提供虛構的商戶支援服務套裝。請查閱成本表、政策及主管備註。回答問題，然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔及以證據為本的交接。分類成本，計算每套貢獻毛利及每月收支平衡套裝數，並說明外判支援代理費改變後的修訂貢獻毛利。指出欠缺證據並提出具體檢查。目標約 100 至 180 個英文詞。

title.en: Fictional cost schedule for merchant support service package
title.zh: 商戶支援服務套裝虛構成本表

body.en: Fictional simulation data, not real Lalamove finances. Lalamove Merchant Support Package is sold to merchants at HKD 250.00 per package per month. Variable costs per package per month are outsourced support agent fee HKD 80.00, payment processing 2.5% of revenue, and CRM software license per active package HKD 15.00. Fixed monthly costs are support team base salaries HKD 45,000, office rent HKD 22,000, and overall software subscription HKD 3,500. Payment processing is exactly 2.5% of HKD 250.00. No other costs apply.
body.zh: 虛構模擬數據，並非 Lalamove 真實財務。Lalamove 商戶支援套裝以每套每月港幣 250.00 元售予商戶。每套每月可變成本為外判支援代理費港幣 80.00 元、支付處理費收入的 2.5%，以及每套活躍套裝的 CRM 軟件授權費港幣 15.00 元。每月固定成本為支援團隊基本薪金港幣 45,000 元、辦公室租金港幣 22,000 元及整體軟件訂閱費港幣 3,500 元。支付處理費按港幣 250.00 元的 2.5% 精確計算。沒有其他成本。

title.zh: 虛構收支平衡分析政策

body.en: Fictional analysis policy. Classify costs as variable only if they change with each package sold per month. Classify support team base salaries, office rent and overall software subscription as fixed monthly costs. Contribution margin per package equals revenue minus all variable costs per package. Break-even package count is the smallest whole number of packages per month whose total contribution is greater than or equal to total fixed monthly costs. Use exact arithmetic, then round break-even packages up to a whole package. Do not include tax or investment advice.
body.zh: 虛構分析政策。只有隨每月每套售出套裝改變的成本才分類為可變成本。支援團隊基本薪金、辦公室租金及整體軟件訂閱費分類為每月固定成本。每套貢獻毛利等於收入減去每套的所有可變成本。收支平衡套裝數是每月貢獻總額大於或等於每月固定成本總額的最小整數套裝數。使用精確算術，然後將收支平衡套裝數向上取整至整套。不包含稅務或投資建議。

body.en: Fictional manager note. Please prepare a short handover for the finance lead. Confirm which costs are variable and fixed, show contribution margin per package and monthly break-even package count. If the outsourced support agent fee changes to HKD 95.00 per package, state the revised contribution margin only. Do not claim these figures describe real Lalamove operations. Flag any missing evidence. Proposed next checks should be concrete.
body.zh: 虛構主管備註。請為財務主管準備簡短交接。確認哪些成本屬可變及固定，顯示每套貢獻毛利及每月收支平衡套裝數。若外判支援代理費改為每套港幣 95.00 元，只說明修訂後的貢獻毛利。不要聲稱這些數字描述真實 Lalamove 營運。指出任何欠缺證據。建議的下一步檢查須具體。

Missing evidence includes actual merchant demand and contract terms. Next checks: verify payment processing rate with finance, confirm agent fee with outsourcing contract, and validate fixed costs with accounting. Prepared for Ada Cheung.
exemplar.zh: 虛構模擬，並非 Lalamove 真實數據。根據成本表，每套收入為港幣 250.00 元。每套可變成本為外判支援代理費港幣 80.00 元、支付處理費港幣 6.25 元（收入的 2.5%），以及 CRM 授權費港幣 15.00 元，合共港幣 101.25 元。貢獻毛利為港幣 148.75 元。每月固定成本為支援團隊基本薪金港幣 45,000 元、辦公室租金港幣 22,000 元及整體軟件訂閱費港幣 3,500 元，合共港幣 70,500 元。收支平衡套裝數 = 70,500 / 148.75 = 473.95，向上取整至每月 474 套。若外判支援代理費升至港幣 95.00 元，修訂貢獻毛利 = 250 - (95 + 6.25 + 15) = 港幣 133.75 元。欠缺證據包括實際商戶需求及合約條款。下一步檢查：與財務核實支付處理率、與外判合約確認代理費，以及與會計驗證固定成本。為 Ada Cheung 準備。

feedback.en: All decisions and figures are correct. Variable costs are the outsourced agent fee, payment processing at HKD 6.25 and CRM license HKD 15.00, giving contribution of HKD 148.75, break-even of 474 packages after rounding up 473.95, and revised contribution of HKD 133.75.
feedback.zh: 所有決策及數字均正確。可變成本為外判代理費、支付處理費港幣 6.25 元及 CRM 授權費港幣 15.00 元，貢獻毛利為港幣 148.75 元，473.95 向上取整後收支平衡為 474 套，修訂貢獻毛利為港幣 133.75 元。

feedback.en: You tie each figure to the cost schedule and policy, showing the revenue, individual variable costs and the HKD 70,500 fixed total, and you follow the policy rounding rule and the manager note request for the revised contribution.
feedback.zh: 你把每個數字連結至成本表及政策，列出收入、各項可變成本及港幣 70,500 元固定成本總額，並依從政策取整規則及主管備註的修訂貢獻毛利要求。

feedback.en: Your next checks are concrete and test the stated requirements: verifying the payment processing rate with finance, confirming the agent fee against the outsourcing contract, and validating fixed costs with accounting.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步檢查具體且針對既定要求：與財務核實支付處理率、以外判合約確認代理費，以及與會計驗證固定成本。

feedback.en: You correctly state this is fictional and not real Lalamove data, and you flag missing evidence on merchant demand and contract terms. You could also note that payment processing may vary and that no tax or investment advice is given.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出此為虛構而非 Lalamove 真實數據，並指出欠缺商戶需求及合約條款證據。你可補充支付處理費或會變動，以及不提供稅務或投資建議。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 149 words and clearly states classification, contribution margin, break-even packages and revised contribution, and it is addressed to Ada Cheung. All required elements are present and easy to follow.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔共 149 個英文詞，清楚說明分類、貢獻毛利、收支平衡套裝數及修訂貢獻毛利，並以 Ada Cheung 為收件人。所有必要元素齊備且易於理解。

summary.en: Strong submission. Every answer and calculation is correct, evidence is cited from the supplied schedule and policy, missing evidence is flagged, and the handover is clear and actionable. Only minor scope notes could be added.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。所有答案及計算均正確，證據引自提供成本表及政策，欠缺證據已指出，交接清晰可行。僅可略為補充範圍備註。

nextSteps.en: Add a brief note that payment processing could vary in practice and that no tax or investment advice is given, to strengthen the scope and uncertainty section in future handovers.
nextSteps.zh: 可補充一句說明支付處理費在實務上或會變動，以及不提供稅務或投資建議，以加強日後交接的範圍及不確定性部分。

title.en: Repair keyboard-only recovery in a support form
title.zh: 修正支援表單的純鍵盤復原流程

brief.en: Fictional simulation inspired by Oursky, not endorsed by Oursky. You are a frontend developer on the fictional product PulseDesk. Its support form loses keyboard focus and typed input after an invalid submit. Review the fictional acceptance brief, React source and keyboard test sample. Patch the form so labels, focus, validation and input survive recovery, then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, ideally about 100 to 180 words. That is a guide, not a strict graded limit. All code and release decisions are simulated.
brief.zh: 這是一個受 Oursky 啟發的虛構模擬，未獲 Oursky 認可。你是虛構產品 PulseDesk 的前端開發員。其支援表單在提交無效後會失去鍵盤焦點及已輸入內容。請審閱虛構接納簡介、React 原始碼及鍵盤測試樣本。修正表單，使標籤、焦點、驗證及輸入在復原時得以保留，然後用英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據交接。此為建議，並非嚴格評分字數限制。所有程式碼及發布決定均為模擬。

body.en: Fictional acceptance brief for this simulation, not an Oursky policy and not a real release. The PulseDesk support form has three required fields: workspace name, contact email and incident summary. An email is valid only when it contains one at sign and a dot after that at sign. On an invalid submit, typed values must not be cleared, and focus must move to an error summary that lists every error, with each error linking to its own field. Tab order is the fields, then submit, then the error summary when errors exist. A valid submit shows a confirmation message. Keyboard-only operation is required.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構接納簡介，並非 Oursky 政策，亦非真實發布。PulseDesk 支援表單有三個必填欄位：工作區名稱、聯絡電郵及事件摘要。電郵只在包含一個 @ 且該 @ 之後有句點時才有效。提交無效時，不得清空已輸入值，焦點必須移至列出每項錯誤的錯誤摘要，而每項錯誤須連結至其自身欄位。Tab 次序為各欄位、提交按鈕，若有錯誤則接錯誤摘要。有效提交會顯示確認訊息。必須支援純鍵盤操作。

title.zh: 虛構 React 原始碼及合約

body.en: Fictional keyboard test records, simulated for this exercise and not real results. QA lead Marco Lai ran 14 keyboard-only recovery runs on the current build. In 4 runs focus ended on the document body. In 3 runs every typed value was cleared. 2 runs showed both defects, and in the remaining runs neither defect appeared. The post-patch keyboard suite has 8 checks. On the current build 2 of those 8 checks pass. After the corrected patch all 8 checks pass.
body.zh: 虛構鍵盤測試記錄，為本練習模擬，並非真實結果。QA 主管 Marco Lai 在現有版本上進行 14 次純鍵盤復原測試。其中 4 次焦點落在文件主體。3 次清空所有已輸入值。2 次同時出現兩項缺陷，其餘測試則兩項缺陷皆無。修正後的鍵盤測試套件有 8 項檢查。現有版本有 2 項通過。套用修正後全部 8 項通過。

label.en: Which defect directly breaks keyboard-only recovery after an invalid submit?
label.zh: 哪項缺陷直接破壞無效提交後的純鍵盤復原？

label.en: It clears typed values and moves focus to the document body
label.zh: 清空已輸入值並把焦點移至文件主體

label.en: The email rule accepts any value containing an at sign
label.zh: 電郵規則接受任何包含 @ 的值

label.en: The submit button uses type submit
label.zh: 提交按鈕使用 type submit

label.en: The inputs are controlled with value and onChange
label.zh: 輸入欄位以 value 及 onChange 受控

label.en: Which changes does the supplied acceptance brief require?
label.zh: 哪些改動是提供接納簡介所要求？
把標籤與輸入欄位關聯

label.en: Focus an error summary on invalid submit
label.zh: 無效提交時聚焦錯誤摘要

label.en: From the fictional keyboard sample, how many of the 14 runs showed at least one of the two defects, focus on the document body or cleared values?
label.zh: 根據虛構鍵盤樣本，14 次測試中有多少次出現兩項缺陷至少其一，即焦點落在文件主體或已輸入值被清空？

label.en: Which observation demonstrates that input was preserved after an invalid submit?
label.zh: 哪個觀察證明無效提交後輸入得以保留？

label.en: The workspace field still contains the typed text
label.zh: 工作區欄位仍包含已輸入文字

label.en: Focus lands on the document body
Per the acceptance brief, where does the error summary sit in tab order when errors exist?
label.zh: 根據接納簡介，若有錯誤，錯誤摘要位於 Tab 次序的哪個位置？

label.en: Between the email field and the summary field
label.zh: 電郵欄位與摘要欄位之間
從 Tab 次序中移除

starter.en:
Corrected JSX lines:
Why this fixes the defect:
Proposed keyboard tests and expected outcomes:
Limitations and assumptions:
starter.zh:
修正 JSX 程式碼行：

about.en: Oursky builds digital products and publicly describes code review, continuous integration, collaboration and privacy-aware software as part of its engineering approach.
about.zh: Oursky 開發數碼產品，公開介紹其工程方式包括程式碼審查、持續整合、協作及注重私隱的軟件。

publicValues.zh: 程式碼審查及工程品質

simulationStyle.en: Review fictional software and interface changes, design regression tests, triage defects and write an evidence-based teammate handover. All source code and release decisions are simulated.
simulationStyle.zh: 審查虛構軟件及介面改動、設計回歸測試、排列缺陷優先次序，並撰寫有證據支持的同事交接。所有程式碼及發布決策均為模擬。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Patch a supplied UI snippet to preserve labels, focus, validation and input during recovery.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。修正提供的介面程式碼，在復原時保留標籤、焦點、驗證及輸入。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Patch a supplied UI snippet to preserve labels, focus, validation and input during recovery.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。修正提供的介面程式碼，在復原時保留標籤、焦點、驗證及輸入。

expectedEvidence.en: Patch gives each of the three inputs an id and an htmlFor label, deletes the document.body.focus() call and the setValues reset inside the invalid branch, adds an error summary focused by ref with role alert or aria-live on invalid submit, links each error through aria-describedby and aria-invalid, and tightens the email rule to require an at sign plus a dot after it. Correct calculation: 4 + 3 minus 2 equals 5 runs with at least one defect.
expectedEvidence.zh: 修正為三個輸入各設 id 及 htmlFor 標籤，刪除無效分支內的 document.body.focus() 呼叫及 setValues 重設，加入以 ref 聚焦並帶 role alert 或 aria-live 的錯誤摘要，以 aria-describedby 及 aria-invalid 連結每項錯誤，並收緊電郵規則要求 @ 及其後句點。正確計算：4 加 3 減 2 等於 5 次至少一項缺陷。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the source-code lines document.body.focus(), the setValues reset, placeholder-only inputs, the detached toast divs and the email check that uses only includes('@'). Cites the source-brief rules on labels, first focus target, error-to-field links, value preservation and tab order. Explains the sample with inclusion and exclusion over source-test counts 14, 4, 3 and 2, giving 5 union runs and 9 runs with neither defect.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 source-code 的 document.body.focus()、setValues 重設、只有 placeholder 的輸入、分離式提示 div，以及只用 includes('@') 的電郵檢查。引用 source-brief 關於標籤、第一焦點目標、錯誤與欄位連結、保留值及 Tab 次序的規則。以 source-test 的 14、4、3、2 計數，用容斥原理解釋樣本，得出 5 次至少一項缺陷及 9 次兩項皆無。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes keyboard checks covering tab order workspace, email, summary, submit then error summary when errors exist, empty submit focusing the error summary, each error link focusing its own field, typed values surviving an invalid submit, an email without a dot after the at sign showing an error, and a valid submit showing confirmation. Expects all 8 post-patch keyboard checks to pass against the 2 of 8 passing on the current build.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出鍵盤檢查，涵蓋 Tab 次序為工作區、電郵、摘要、提交，若有錯誤則接錯誤摘要，空提交聚焦錯誤摘要，每個錯誤連結聚焦其自身欄位，無效提交後已輸入值仍在，@ 後無句點的電郵顯示錯誤，有效提交顯示確認。預期修正後 8 項鍵盤檢查全部通過，而現有版本為 8 項中 2 項通過。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States this is a fictional simulation not endorsed by Oursky. Notes there is no browser or screen reader matrix, no live user testing, and no evidence about production state or release approval, and that no release approval owner is named in the supplied sources. Limits claims to the supplied build and fictional test records.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明此為虛構模擬，未獲 Oursky 認可。指出沒有瀏覽器或螢幕閱讀器矩陣、沒有真實用戶測試，亦無關於生產狀態或發布批准的證據，且提供來源未列明發布批准負責人。把聲明限於提供的版本及虛構測試記錄。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states the patch decision, cites source-code and source-brief evidence, lists the proposed keyboard tests, assigns keyboard regression to QA lead Marco Lai, and escalates the release approval question to team lead Ada Wong because no approval owner is named in the sources.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接列明修正決定，引用 source-code 及 source-brief 證據，列出建議鍵盤測試，把鍵盤回歸測試交由 QA 主管 Marco Lai 負責，並把發布批准問題轉交團隊主管 Ada Wong，因來源未列明批准負責人。

exemplar.en: Handover. I patched the fictional PulseDesk support form for keyboard-only recovery. Source-code showed document.body.focus() and a setValues reset on invalid submit, placeholder-only inputs, detached toast errors and an email check that used only includes('@'). Source-brief requires persistent labels, unchanged values, an error summary as first focus target, errors linked to their fields, and tab order of fields, submit, then error summary when errors exist. Replacement lines: give every input an id and an htmlFor label, delete the body focus and setValues reset block, add a role alert error summary focused by ref on invalid submit, set aria-invalid and aria-describedby on each field, and require a dot after the at sign. Tests: tab order is workspace, email, summary, submit, error summary. Empty submit focuses the summary. Each error link focuses its field. Typed values survive an invalid submit. A valid submit shows confirmation. Expect all 8 post-patch keyboard checks to pass, against 2 of 8 today. Sample: 4 plus 3 minus 2 equals 5 runs with at least one defect, so 9 of 14 had neither. Limits: fictional simulation, not endorsed by Oursky, no browser or screen reader matrix, no live user testing, no evidence on production state or release approval, and no approval owner named in the sources. QA lead Marco Lai owns keyboard regression. I am escalating the release approval question to team lead Ada Wong.
exemplar.zh: 交接。我為虛構的 PulseDesk 支援表單修正純鍵盤復原流程。source-code 顯示無效提交時有 document.body.focus() 及 setValues 重設、只有 placeholder 的輸入、分離式提示錯誤，以及只用 includes('@') 的電郵檢查。source-brief 要求持久標籤、值不變、錯誤摘要為第一焦點目標、錯誤連結至其欄位，以及 Tab 次序為欄位、提交、若有錯誤則接錯誤摘要。取代行：為每個輸入加上 id 及 htmlFor 標籤，刪除 body focus 及 setValues 重設區塊，加入以 ref 聚焦並帶 role alert 的錯誤摘要，為每個欄位設定 aria-invalid 及 aria-describedby，並要求 @ 後有句點。測試：Tab 次序為工作區、電郵、摘要、提交、錯誤摘要。空提交聚焦摘要。每個錯誤連結聚焦其欄位。無效提交後已輸入值仍在。有效提交顯示確認。預期修正後 8 項鍵盤檢查全部通過，現時為 8 項中 2 項。樣本：4 加 3 減 2 等於 5 次至少一項缺陷，即 14 次中有 9 次兩項皆無。限制：虛構模擬，未獲 Oursky 認可，沒有瀏覽器或螢幕閱讀器矩陣，沒有真實用戶測試，無關於生產狀態或發布批准的證據，來源亦未列明批准負責人。QA 主管 Marco Lai 負責鍵盤回歸測試。我正把發布批准問題轉交團隊主管 Ada Wong。

feedback.en: All five field answers are correct, including the union count of 5 runs, which correctly excludes the 2 runs where both defects appeared. Your patch plan removes document.body.focus() and the setValues reset, adds ids with htmlFor labels, an error summary focused by ref, aria-invalid and aria-describedby, and a dot check after the at sign. This matches the brief and the source-code contract exactly.
feedback.zh: 五項欄位答案全部正確，包括以 5 次為至少一項缺陷的聯集計數，正確排除同時出現兩項缺陷的 2 次。你的修正方案刪除 document.body.focus() 及 setValues 重設，加入 id 與 htmlFor 標籤、以 ref 聚焦的錯誤摘要、aria-invalid 及 aria-describedby，以及 @ 後的句點檢查。這與接納簡介及原始碼合約完全一致。

feedback.en: You name the specific defective lines and the brief rules behind each change, so the decisions are traceable to evidence rather than assertion. Your sample explanation shows the inclusion and exclusion reasoning clearly, giving 5 runs with at least one defect and 9 with neither. One small gap is that you do not spell out how the detached toast divs fail the error-to-field linking rule, which would strengthen the audit trail.
feedback.zh: 你點出具體有問題的程式碼行及每項改動背後的簡介規則，令決策可追溯至證據而非空言。你對樣本的解釋清楚展示容斥推理，得出 5 次至少一項缺陷及 9 次兩項皆無。唯一小缺口是未明言分離式提示 div 如何違反錯誤與欄位連結規則，補上會更鞏固審計線索。

feedback.en: Your proposed checks cover tab order, empty submit focusing the summary, each error link focusing its own field, value preservation, and the email dot rule, plus a valid-submit confirmation case. You also anchor expectations in the sample baseline of 2 of 8 passing now versus all 8 after the patch. Adding a specific check that an email with an at sign but no dot is rejected would make the suite fully cover the brief.
feedback.zh: 你提出的檢查涵蓋 Tab 次序、空提交聚焦摘要、每個錯誤連結聚焦其自身欄位、值保留及電郵句點規則，並包含有效提交確認個案。你亦以樣本基準（現時 8 項中 2 項通過，修正後全部 8 項通過）錨定預期。若再加入一項明確檢查「含 @ 但無句點的電郵被拒絕」，測試套件便完全覆蓋簡介。

feedback.en: You correctly state this is a fictional simulation not endorsed by Oursky and list the missing browser or screen reader matrix, live user testing, and release approval evidence. You also note no approval owner is named in the sources rather than inventing one. This is an appropriately bounded claim set.
feedback.zh: 你正確說明此為虛構模擬、未獲 Oursky 認可，並列出欠缺的瀏覽器或螢幕閱讀器矩陣、真實用戶測試及發布批准證據。你亦指出來源未列明批准負責人，而非憑空虛構。範圍界定恰當。

feedback.en: The handover gives the patch decision, the supporting sources, the test list, and clear ownership with Marco Lai on keyboard regression and Ada Wong escalated for release approval. It is actionable and easy to follow. It runs about 229 English words, above the suggested 100 to 180 guide, so trimming the restated defect list slightly would tighten the read without losing substance.
feedback.zh: 交接列明修正決定、支持來源、測試清單，並清楚劃分由 Marco Lai 負責鍵盤回歸測試、把發布批准轉交 Ada Wong。內容可行且易於跟進。全文約 229 個英文詞，高於建議的 100 至 180 字指引，略為精簡重述的缺陷清單可令閱讀更緊湊而不失內容。

summary.en: Strong submission. All five structured answers are correct, the patch plan matches the source-code contract and the acceptance brief, and the handover carries evidence, limits and ownership. title.en: Repair keyboard recovery in the RelayDesk request form
title.zh: 修正 RelayDesk 請求表單的鍵盤復原流程

brief.en: Fictional simulation inspired by Oursky, not endorsed by Oursky. You are a frontend developer on the fictional product RelayDesk. Its plain HTML and JavaScript request form loses keyboard focus and typed input after an invalid submit, its error messages are detached from their fields, its email check is looser than the stated rule, and its script touches the DOM at load time so the validator cannot be checked without a browser. Review the fictional acceptance rules, the shipped markup, the shipped handler and the three execution observations. Then supply corrected markup and handler, and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, ideally about 100 to 180 words. That is a guide, not a strict graded limit. All code and release decisions are simulated.
brief.zh: 這是一個受 Oursky 啟發的虛構模擬，未獲 Oursky 認可。你是虛構產品 RelayDesk 的前端開發員。其純 HTML 及 JavaScript 請求表單在提交無效後失去鍵盤焦點及已輸入內容，錯誤訊息與欄位分離，電郵檢查比既定規則寬鬆，而且其腳本在載入時就接觸 DOM，令驗證器無法在沒有瀏覽器的情況下受檢。請審閱虛構接納規則、現有標記、現有處理程式及三項執行觀察。然後提供修正後的標記及處理程式，並用英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據交接。此為建議，並非嚴格評分字數限制。所有程式碼及發布決定均為模擬。

body.en: Fictional acceptance rules for this simulation, not an Oursky policy and not a real release. Fictional product RelayDesk has a request form with display name and contact email. A display name is valid only when its trimmed value is not empty. A contact email is valid only when it holds exactly one at sign and at least one full stop after that at sign. No character is required before the at sign, so '@example.com' is valid while 'relay.example@' and 'a@b@c.com' are not. The email validator must be a top-level pure function with no DOM access, so it can be checked without a browser. On an invalid submit the typed values stay unchanged, focus moves to the plain-text summary that carries tabindex=-1, and each field links to its own error element through aria-describedby. Tab order is display name, contact email, submit. The summary is not a Tab stop and sits after the submit button. A valid submit writes 'Thanks, your request was recorded.' into #form-status and leaves no error lines.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構接納規則，並非 Oursky 政策，亦非真實發布。虛構產品 RelayDesk 有一個含顯示名稱及聯絡電郵的請求表單。顯示名稱只在其去除前後空白後的值非空時才有效。聯絡電郵只在其包含剛好一個 @ 符號，且該 @ 符號之後至少有一個句點時才有效。規則不要求 @ 符號之前有任何字元，因此 '@example.com' 有效，而 'relay.example@' 及 'a@b@c.com' 則無效。電郵驗證器必須是頂層純函數，不得接觸 DOM，以便在沒有瀏覽器的情況下受檢。提交無效時，已輸入值保持不變，焦點移至設有 tabindex=-1 的純文字摘要，而每個欄位透過 aria-describedby 連結至其自身的錯誤元素。Tab 次序為顯示名稱、聯絡電郵、提交。摘要不是 Tab 停留點，並位於提交按鈕之後。有效提交會把 'Thanks, your request was recorded.' 寫入 #form-status，且不殘留任何錯誤行。

title.zh: 虛構現有標記及處理程式

body.en:
Fictional observations for the shipped build, simulated for this exercise and not real test results.
Run 1, submit the empty form: the handler writes 'Display name is required.' into the element with id displayName-error and 'Contact email is invalid.' into the element with id contactEmail-error, moves focus to the document body, and never focuses a summary, because index.html contains no element with id error-summary.
Run 2, submit with 'Relay' in the display name field and 'relay.example' in the contact email field: the trimmed name 'Relay' is non-empty, so the name check passes and the element with id displayName-error stays empty. Only 'Contact email is invalid.' is written into the element with id contactEmail-error. Focus lands on the document body, and because the invalid branch runs form.reset() after validation, both inputs render empty, so the typed strings 'Relay' and 'relay.example' are gone.
Run 3, load form.js in a checker that has no document object: the load throws ReferenceError: document is not defined at the first DOM lookup, so isValidEmail is never reached and no email check can run.
body.zh:
現有版本的虛構觀察，為本練習模擬，並非真實測試結果。
執行 1，提交空表單：處理程式把 'Display name is required.' 寫入 id 為 displayName-error 的元素，並把 'Contact email is invalid.' 寫入 id 為 contactEmail-error 的元素，焦點移至文件主體，且從未聚焦任何摘要，因為 index.html 沒有 id 為 error-summary 的元素。
執行 2，在顯示名稱欄位輸入 'Relay'、在聯絡電郵欄位輸入 'relay.example' 後提交：去除空白後的 'Relay' 為非空，因此名稱檢查通過，id 為 displayName-error 的元素保持空白。只有 'Contact email is invalid.' 被寫入 id 為 contactEmail-error 的元素。焦點落在文件主體，而由於無效分支在驗證之後執行 form.reset()，兩個輸入欄位均顯示為空，兩個已輸入字串 'Relay' 及 'relay.example' 皆消失。
執行 3，在沒有 document 物件的檢查器中載入 form.js：載入在第一個 DOM 查詢即拋出 ReferenceError: document is not defined，因此永遠無法到達 isValidEmail，任何電郵檢查都無法執行。

about.en: Oursky builds digital products and publicly describes code review, continuous integration, collaboration and privacy-aware software as part of its engineering approach.

publicValues.zh: 程式碼審查及工程品質

simulationStyle.en: Review fictional software and interface changes, design regression tests, triage defects and write an evidence-based teammate handover. All source code and release decisions are simulated.
simulationStyle.zh: 審查虛構軟件及介面改動、設計回歸測試、排列缺陷優先次序，並撰寫有證據支持的同事交接。所有程式碼及發布決策均為模擬。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Patch a supplied UI snippet to preserve labels, focus, validation and input during recovery.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。修正提供的介面程式碼，在復原時保留標籤、焦點、驗證及輸入。

description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Patch a supplied UI snippet to preserve labels, focus, validation and input during recovery.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。修正提供的介面程式碼，在復原時保留標籤、焦點、驗證及輸入。

expectedEvidence.en: Selects both-typed-strings-stay-in-the-fields, error-summary-element-with-tabindex-minus-one, field-aria-describedby-references-its-own-error-id and status-text-shown-and-no-error-lines-remain. The corrected code removes the form.reset() call and the document.activeElement.blur() call, keeps the ids displayName, contactEmail, displayName-error, contactEmail-error, error-summary and form-status, adds a visible element with id error-summary and tabindex=-1 after the submit button, adds summary.focus() on the invalid branch, keeps the trimmed non-empty display name validator, and defines the email validator as a top-level pure function with no DOM access. The email validator must return false for 'relay.example@' and 'a@b@c.com' and true for '@example.com' and 'relay@example.com', accepting any characters before the at sign and requiring at least one full stop after it. All DOM lookups move inside an initialiser function that is only called when document exists, so the file loads without error in a DOM-less checker.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選出 both-typed-strings-stay-in-the-fields、error-summary-element-with-tabindex-minus-one、field-aria-describedby-references-its-own-error-id 及 status-text-shown-and-no-error-lines-remain。修正後的程式碼移除 form.reset() 呼叫及 document.activeElement.blur() 呼叫，保留 displayName、contactEmail、displayName-error、contactEmail-error、error-summary 及 form-status 這些 id，在提交按鈕之後加入 id 為 error-summary 且設有 tabindex=-1 的可見元素，在無效分支加入 summary.focus()，保留去除空白後非空的顯示名稱驗證，並把電郵驗證器定義為不接觸 DOM 的頂層純函數。電郵驗證器對 'relay.example@' 及 'a@b@c.com' 必須返回 false，對 '@example.com' 及 'relay@example.com' 必須返回 true，即接受 @ 符號前的任何字元，並要求 @ 之後至少有一個句點。所有 DOM 查詢移入初始化函數，只在 document 存在時才呼叫，使檔案在沒有 DOM 的檢查器中載入時不報錯。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source-brief for the two validators, the Tab order, the tabindex=-1 summary, the confirmation string, the requirement that the email validator is a pure top-level function, and the clarified boundary that no character is required before the at sign. Cites source-code for the shipped form.reset(), the shipped document.activeElement.blur(), the missing error-summary element, the absent aria-describedby and the load-time DOM lookups. Cites all three runs in source-handler-test, stating accurately that in Run 2 the trimmed name 'Relay' passes so only contactEmail-error receives a message and that form.reset() then empties both inputs while focus sits on the document body, and that Run 3 throws ReferenceError: document is not defined before isValidEmail can run. Explains that form.reset() erases typed text, that blur() sends focus to the document body, and that value.includes('@') wrongly accepts 'relay.example@'. Does not claim Run 2 shows two error messages.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 source-brief 說明兩項驗證規則、Tab 次序、tabindex=-1 摘要、確認字串、電郵驗證器必須是頂層純函數的要求，以及 @ 符號前不需任何字元這個已釐清的界線。引用 source-code 說明現有的 form.reset()、現有的 document.activeElement.blur()、缺少的 error-summary 元素、沒有 aria-describedby，以及在載入時執行 DOM 查詢。引用 source-handler-test 的全部三次執行，準確指出執行 2 中去除空白後的 'Relay' 通過，因此只有 contactEmail-error 收到訊息，而 form.reset() 隨後清空兩個輸入欄位，焦點則留在文件主體，並指出執行 3 在 isValidEmail 可執行之前就拋出 ReferenceError: document is not defined。解釋 form.reset() 清除已輸入文字、blur() 把焦點送往文件主體，以及 value.includes('@') 會錯誤接受 'relay.example@'。不得聲稱執行 2 顯示兩項錯誤訊息。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checks that follow from the brief: an empty submit keeps both fields empty in value but moves focus to #error-summary, which stays out of sequential Tab order. Tab from the page start reaches display name, then contact email, then submit, with no stop on the summary. A submit with 'Relay' and 'relay.example' on the corrected build keeps both typed strings and keeps focus on #error-summary. A submit with a non-empty trimmed name and 'relay@example.com' shows the confirmation text in #form-status with no error lines. Direct calls to the email validator return false for 'relay.example@' and 'a@b@c.com' and true for '@example.com'. Loading the corrected file in a checker without a document produces no error. States which observations come from the supplied runs and which are proposed by the learner.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出源自簡介的檢查：空表單提交後兩個欄位值仍為空，但焦點移至 #error-summary，而該摘要不屬順序 Tab 次序。由頁面起點按 Tab 會依次到達顯示名稱、聯絡電郵、提交，並不會停留在摘要上。在修正版本上輸入 'Relay' 及 'relay.example' 後提交，兩個已輸入字串保留，焦點留在 #error-summary。輸入去除空白後非空的名稱及 'relay@example.com' 後提交，#form-status 顯示確認文字且沒有錯誤行。直接呼叫電郵驗證器時，'relay.example@' 及 'a@b@c.com' 返回 false，'@example.com' 返回 true。在沒有 document 的檢查器中載入修正檔案不會報錯。並說明哪些觀察來自提供記錄，哪些由學習者提出。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States that the evidence comes from fictional observations on a simulated build, that no real browser or screen reader results are supplied, that the shipped markup assumptions are the missing #error-summary element and the missing aria-describedby, that the load-time DOM access is a structural defect in the simulated file, and that no Oursky policy or real release is being changed. Avoids claiming a measured pass rate for the shipped build.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明證據來自模擬版本上的虛構觀察，未提供真實瀏覽器或螢幕閱讀器結果，現有標記的假設是缺少 #error-summary 元素及缺少 aria-describedby，載入時接觸 DOM 是模擬檔案中的結構缺陷，且並非改動任何 Oursky 政策或真實發布。避免聲稱現有版本有量測通過率。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover in English or Traditional Chinese, ideally around 100 to 180 words, naming the corrected handler structure, the two behaviours removed (form.reset() and blur()), the corrected email rule, the pure validator split so it can be checked without a document, the two files touched (index.html and form.js), the checks run against source-handler-test, and one open item such as screen reader verification, with the team lead Priya Raman as the escalation contact. Complete and clear is graded, not an exact word count.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫交接，理想約 100 至 180 字，列出修正後的處理程式結構、已移除的兩項行為（form.reset() 及 blur()）、修正後的電郵規則、把純驗證器分離以便在沒有 document 時受檢、涉及的兩個檔案（index.html 及 form.js）、對照 source-handler-test 執行的檢查，以及一項待辦如螢幕閱讀器核實，並以團隊主管 Priya Raman 為轉交聯絡人。評分着重完整及清晰，而非精確字數。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: typed values stay in the fields, focus moves to the error summary with tabindex=-1, each field uses aria-describedby for its own error id, and a valid submit writes the confirmation with no error lines left. Your patch keeps every fixed id, removes form.reset() and the blur() call, adds the focusable #error-summary after the submit button, and makes isValidEmail a pure top-level function that returns true for '@example.com' and false for 'relay.example@' and 'a@b@c.com'. The document guard around initForm also clears the DOM-less load failure seen in Run 3.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：已輸入值保留在欄位中、焦點移至設有 tabindex=-1 的錯誤摘要、每個欄位以 aria-describedby 指向自身錯誤 id、有效提交寫入確認文字且不殘留錯誤行。你的修正保留所有固定 id，移除 form.reset() 及 blur() 呼叫，在提交按鈕之後加入可聚焦的 #error-summary，並把 isValidEmail 改為頂層純函數，對 '@example.com' 返回 true，對 'relay.example@' 及 'a@b@c.com' 返回 false。initForm 的 document 檢查亦解決了執行 3 的無 DOM 載入錯誤。

feedback.en: Reasoning is tied to named sources: source-code for the two removed calls, the missing error-summary element, the absent aria-describedby and the load-time lookups, and source-handler-test for Runs 1 to 3, including the accurate point that Run 2 shows only the email error because the trimmed 'Relay' passes and that form.reset() then empties both fields. The explanation of why value.includes('@') wrongly accepts 'relay.example@' and why the at-sign boundary allows '@example.com' matches the brief exactly.
feedback.zh: 推理緊扣具名來源：以 source-code 說明兩項被移除的呼叫、缺少的 error-summary 元素、沒有 aria-describedby 及載入時查詢，並以 source-handler-test 說明執行 1 至 3，準確指出執行 2 只出現電郵錯誤（因去除空白後的 'Relay' 通過），而 form.reset() 隨後清空兩個欄位。你解釋 value.includes('@') 為何錯誤接受 'relay.example@'，以及 @ 符號界線為何容許 '@example.com'，均與簡介一致。

feedback.en: Checks are concrete and traceable to the brief: empty submit keeps values while focus moves to #error-summary, Tab order runs name then email then submit with no stop on the summary, the Run 2 input pair retains both strings, a valid email shows the confirmation with no error lines, and direct validator calls cover the four boundary strings. You also propose loading the corrected file without a document, which directly retests the Run 3 structural defect.
feedback.zh: 檢查具體且可追溯至簡介：空表單提交後值保留而焦點移至 #error-summary、Tab 次序為名稱後電郵後提交且不停留在摘要、執行 2 的輸入組合保留兩個字串、有效電郵顯示確認且無錯誤行，並以直接呼叫驗證器覆蓋四個界線字串。你亦提出在沒有 document 的情況下載入修正檔案，直接重測執行 3 的結構缺陷。

feedback.en: You clearly flag that real screen reader output was not verified and hand that open item to Priya Raman, which is the right kind of limitation. What is missing is an explicit statement that this work concerns a simulated build and fictional observations rather than a real Oursky release, plus a note that no real browser result underpins the corrected behaviour. Adding one sentence on that scope would complete this criterion.
feedback.zh: 你清楚指出未核實真實螢幕閱讀器輸出，並把此待辦交給 Priya Raman，這是正確的限制說明。欠缺的是明確指出本工作針對模擬版本及虛構觀察，而非真實 Oursky 發布，亦未說明修正後行為沒有真實瀏覽器結果支持。補上一句範圍說明即可完成此項。

feedback.en: The handover names both touched files, the corrected handler structure, the two removed behaviours, the corrected email rule, the pure validator split and the escalation contact, so a teammate could act on it directly. Length is well above the 100 to 180 word guide, which carries no mark penalty, but trimming the repeated explanation of the shipped defects would make the decision summary easier to scan.

title.zh: 修正過時搜尋回應狀態

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Oursky public engineering values. Not endorsed by Oursky. You are reviewing Kestrel Support Console, a fictional Oursky-style product. A support agent types quickly in a search box. The current component shows stale results and wrong loading, empty or error states when old requests finish after newer ones. Read the supplied fictional code, contract and trace. Propose corrected code or exact replacement lines, explain the state rules, and give tests. Write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese, about 100 to 180 words. Do not execute code.
brief.zh: 這是以 Oursky 公開工程價值為靈感的虛構學習模擬，並非 Oursky 認可。你正審查 Kestrel Support Console，一個虛構的 Oursky 風格產品。支援人員在搜尋框快速輸入。當舊請求較新請求更遲完成時，現有元件會顯示過時結果，以及錯誤的載入、空白或錯誤狀態。閱讀提供的虛構程式碼、合約及追蹤記錄。提出修正程式碼或確切替換行，解釋狀態規則，並提供測試。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，約100至180字。不要執行程式碼。

body.en: All facts are fictional and for learning only. Project: Kestrel Support Console search panel. Status values are idle, loading, success and error. Empty is success with zero items and is not an error. Only the latest query request may update state. Pending must remain until the latest request settles. A stale settlement from an earlier query must not change results, loading, empty or error. Error text may be shown only when the latest request rejects. The search function is stable. The panel must not render stale results for the current query. Deliverable: corrected code and tests.
body.zh: 所有事實均為虛構，僅供學習。專案：Kestrel Support Console 搜尋面板。狀態值為 idle、loading、success 及 error。空白是指 success 但零項目，並非錯誤。只有最新查詢請求可更新狀態。待處理狀態須維持至最新請求完成。較早查詢的過時結果不得更改結果、載入、空白或錯誤狀態。只有最新請求被拒絕時才可顯示錯誤文字。搜尋函數為穩定。面板不得為現時查詢顯示過時結果。交付物：修正程式碼及測試。

body.en: Trace one. t0 query 'ab' starts request A for 'ab'. t1 query 'abc' starts request B for 'abc'. A and B are pending. t2 B resolves with zero items. t3 A resolves with one item {id:'r1',title:'Abacus'}. Current code shows 'Abacus' for current query 'abc'. Expected state after t2 is empty. Expected state after t3 remains empty. Trace two. t4 query 'ab' starts request C for 'ab'. t5 query 'abc' starts request D for 'abc'. t6 D resolves with one item {id:'r2',title:'Abacus Plus'}. t7 C rejects with Error('offline'). Current code shows error for current query 'abc'. Expected state after t6 is one item. Expected state after t7 remains one item.
body.zh: 追蹤一。t0 查詢 'ab' 開始請求 A 查 'ab'。t1 查詢 'abc' 開始請求 B 查 'abc'。A 及 B 待處理。t2 B 以零項目完成。t3 A 以一個項目 {id:'r1',title:'Abacus'} 完成。現有程式碼為現時查詢 'abc' 顯示 'Abacus'。t2 後預期狀態為空白。t3 後預期狀態仍為空白。追蹤二。t4 查詢 'ab' 開始請求 C 查 'ab'。t5 查詢 'abc' 開始請求 D 查 'abc'。t6 D 以一個項目 {id:'r2',title:'Abacus Plus'} 完成。t7 C 以 Error('offline') 拒絕。現有程式碼為現時查詢 'abc' 顯示錯誤。t6 後預期狀態為一個項目。t7 後預期狀態仍為一個項目。

label.en: Which change is required to prevent stale responses from updating state?
label.zh: 需要哪項更改以防止過時回應更新狀態？

label.en: Track a request sequence number and apply a response only when it belongs to the latest query.
label.zh: 追蹤請求序號，只在回應屬於最新查詢時才套用。

label.en: Set loading to false before each request starts.
label.zh: 在每個請求開始前先把 loading 設為 false。

label.en: Treat zero items as an error so stale successes are hidden.
label.zh: 把零項目視為錯誤，以隱藏過時成功回應。

label.en: Add a 300 ms debounce and remove all state checks.
label.zh: 加入300毫秒防抖，並移除所有狀態檢查。

label.en: Which statements match the supplied contract? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些陳述符合提供合約？選出所有適用者。

label.en: Zero items after the latest success means empty, not error.
label.zh: 最新成功後零項目代表空白，並非錯誤。

label.en: Loading must remain while the latest request is unresolved.
label.zh: 最新請求未完成時，載入狀態必須維持。

label.en: An older request may update results if it resolves later.
label.zh: 較早請求若較遲完成，可更新結果。

label.en: Error may be shown only when the latest request rejects.
label.zh: 只有最新請求被拒絕時才可顯示錯誤。

label.en: Which test best detects stale success overwriting a newer empty state?
label.zh: 哪項測試最能偵測過時成功回應覆蓋較新空白狀態？

label.en: Start request A for 'ab', start request B for 'abc', let B resolve with zero items, then let A resolve with one item. Expect empty.
label.zh: 為 'ab' 開始請求 A，為 'abc' 開始請求 B，讓 B 以零項目完成，再讓 A 以一個項目完成。預期為空白。

label.en: Start request A for 'ab', let A resolve with one item, then start request B for 'abc'. Expect one item.
label.zh: 為 'ab' 開始請求 A，讓 A 以一個項目完成，再為 'abc' 開始請求 B。預期為一個項目。

label.en: Start request B for 'abc', let B reject, then start request A for 'ab'.
label.zh: 為 'abc' 開始請求 B，讓 B 拒絕，再為 'ab' 開始請求 A。

label.en: Start two identical requests for 'abc' and expect one result.
label.zh: 為 'abc' 開始兩個相同請求，並預期一個結果。

label.en: In the supplied trace, how many request settlements from earlier queries must be ignored by a correct implementation?
label.zh: 在提供追蹤記錄中，正確實作須忽略多少個較早查詢的請求完成結果？

label.en: Which replacement line correctly guards the success update?
label.zh: 哪條替換行正確保護成功更新？

label.en: if (requestId !== latestRequestId.current) return; setState({ status: 'success', items });
label.zh: if (requestId !== latestRequestId.current) return; setState({ status: 'success', items });

exemplar.en: Handover. In the fictional Kestrel Support Console search panel, the defect is a missing latest-request guard in useSearch. The contract says only the latest query may update idle, loading, success, error or empty. Trace one confirms this. At t1 request B starts for 'abc'. At t2 B resolves to zero, so the expected state is empty. At t3 stale A resolves with 'Abacus', and the current code shows the stale item. Trace two shows a stale C reject after D succeeds, so the current code shows an error for 'abc' instead of the successful item. Fix: keep a request sequence id in a ref. Increment it when query changes, capture the value, and apply success, empty or error only when the captured id equals the current ref value. Replacement line: if (requestId !== latestRequestId.current) return; setState({ status: 'success', items });. Tests: stale success after newer empty expects empty. Stale reject after newer success expects success. Latest pending shows loading. Latest zero shows empty. Latest reject shows error. Limitations: search is assumed stable, timers and network delay are not modelled, and I did not execute code. Escalate to Mira Chan if acceptance tests fail.
exemplar.zh: 交接。在虛構 Kestrel Support Console 搜尋面板中，缺陷是 useSearch 缺少最新請求保護。合約規定只有最新查詢可更新 idle、loading、success、error 或空白。追蹤一證實此事。t1 時請求 B 為 'abc' 開始。t2 時 B 以零項目完成，所以預期狀態為空白。t3 時過時 A 以 'Abacus' 完成，現有程式碼顯示過時項目。追蹤二顯示 D 成功後過時 C 拒絕，所以現有程式碼為 'abc' 顯示錯誤，而非成功項目。修正：在 ref 保留請求序號。查詢改變時遞增，捕捉該值，只在捕捉值等於現時 ref 值時套用 success、空白或 error。替換行：if (requestId !== latestRequestId.current) return; setState({ status: 'success', items });。測試：較新空白後的過時成功預期為空白。較新成功後的過時拒絕預期為成功。最新待處理顯示載入。最新零項目顯示空白。最新拒絕顯示錯誤。限制：搜尋函數假定穩定，未模擬計時器及網絡延遲，亦未執行程式碼。若接納測試失敗，轉交 Mira Chan。

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Oursky public engineering values. Not endorsed by Oursky. Product: Orbit Notes, a fictional note-taking app. The save hook does not show a pending state immediately, and a stale earlier save can overwrite a newer retry attempt. The empty state already matches the acceptance rules. Read the fictional code, contract and trace. Propose corrected code or exact replacement lines, explain the state rules, and give proposed tests. Write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. Do not execute code.
brief.zh: 以 Oursky 公開工程價值為靈感的虛構學習模擬。並非 Oursky 認可。產品：Orbit Notes，一個虛構筆記應用程式。儲存 hook 不會立即顯示待處理狀態，而且較早的過時儲存可覆寫較新的重試嘗試。空白狀態已符合接納規則。閱讀虛構程式碼、合約及追蹤記錄。提出修正程式碼或確切替換行，解釋狀態規則，並提供建議測試。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，約100至180字。不要執行程式碼。

body.en: All facts are fictional and for learning only. Project: Orbit Notes save feature. Save states are idle, empty, saving, saved and error. Empty means content is blank after trimming, no request is made and the state becomes empty. When content is non-blank and save is called, the state must become saving immediately. save(content) returns Promise<void>. On resolve the state becomes saved. On reject the state becomes error with the message. A retry after error must immediately clear the error and become saving. The latest attempt owns the state, so any earlier attempt that settles later must be ignored and must not change the state.
body.zh: 所有事實均為虛構，僅供學習。專案：Orbit Notes 儲存功能。儲存狀態為 idle、empty、saving、saved 及 error。空白是指修剪後內容為空，不發出請求，狀態變為 empty。當內容非空並呼叫儲存時，狀態必須立即變為 saving。save(content) 傳回 Promise<void>。成功解決時狀態變為 saved。被拒絕時狀態變為 error 並附帶訊息。錯誤後重試必須立即清除錯誤並變為 saving。最新嘗試擁有狀態，因此任何較早嘗試若較遲完成，必須被忽略，且不得改變狀態。

body.en:
Events are listed in order. Each event shows the expected state and the state the current code produces.
t0 initial render. Expected: idle. Current: idle.
t1 handleSave called with content 'Draft A', attempt A starts. Expected: saving. Current: idle.
t2 attempt A rejects with Error('Gateway unavailable'). Expected: error 'Error: Gateway unavailable'. Current: same.
t3 handleSave called again with content 'Draft A', attempt B starts as a retry. Expected: saving. Current: stays error until B settles.
t4 attempt B resolves. Expected: saved. Current: saved.
t5 handleSave called with content 'Draft B', attempt C starts. Expected: saving. Current: stays saved until C settles.
t6 handleSave called again with content 'Draft B', attempt D starts. Expected: saving. Current: stays saved until C settles.
t7 attempt C resolves while attempt D is still in flight. Expected: saving, because D is the latest attempt. Current: saved.
t8 attempt D rejects with Error('Request timed out'). Expected: error 'Error: Request timed out'. Current: same.
body.zh:
事件按次序排列。每個事件顯示預期狀態及現有程式碼產生的狀態。
t0 首次渲染。預期：idle。現時：idle。
t1 以內容 'Draft A' 呼叫 handleSave，嘗試 A 開始。預期：saving。現時：idle。
t2 嘗試 A 以 Error('Gateway unavailable') 拒絕。預期：error 'Error: Gateway unavailable'。現時：相同。
t3 再次以內容 'Draft A' 呼叫 handleSave，嘗試 B 作為重試開始。預期：saving。現時：維持 error 直至 B 完成。
t4 嘗試 B 解決。預期：saved。現時：saved。
t5 以內容 'Draft B' 呼叫 handleSave，嘗試 C 開始。預期：saving。現時：維持 saved 直至 C 完成。
t6 再次以內容 'Draft B' 呼叫 handleSave，嘗試 D 開始。預期：saving。現時：維持 saved 直至 C 完成。
t7 嘗試 C 在嘗試 D 仍在進行時解決。預期：saving，因為 D 是最新嘗試。現時：saved。
t8 嘗試 D 以 Error('Request timed out') 拒絕。預期：error 'Error: Request timed out'。現時：相同。

label.en: Which change is required so the state shows 'saving' immediately when a save is attempted?
label.zh: 需要哪項更改以確保嘗試儲存時狀態立即顯示 'saving'？

label.en: Set state to 'saving' before awaiting the save function.
label.zh: 在等待儲存函數前將狀態設為 'saving'。

label.en: Set state to 'saving' after the save function resolves.
label.zh: 在儲存函數解決後將狀態設為 'saving'。

label.en: Set state to 'saving' only when the content is not empty and the response is slow.
label.zh: 僅當內容非空且回應緩慢時將狀態設為 'saving'。

label.en: Set state to 'saving' on every render.
label.zh: 在每次渲染時將狀態設為 'saving'。

label.en: Which statements match the supplied contract? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些陳述符合提供合約？選出所有適用者。

label.en: When content is empty, the state must become 'empty' and no save request is made.
label.zh: 當內容為空時，狀態必須變為 'empty' 且不發出儲存請求。

label.en: After a save failure, the state must stay 'error' until a save succeeds.
label.zh: 儲存失敗後，狀態必須維持 'error' 直至儲存成功。

label.en: A retry after an error must immediately become 'saving' and clear the error.
label.zh: 錯誤後重試必須立即變為 'saving' 並清除錯誤。

label.en: The state must become 'saved' only after the save promise resolves successfully.
label.zh: 狀態僅在儲存 promise 成功解決後才變為 'saved'。

label.en: Once a newer attempt has started, a settlement from an earlier attempt must be ignored.
label.zh: 一旦較新嘗試已開始，較早嘗試的完成結果必須被忽略。

label.en: In the supplied trace, at which event does the current code first differ from the expected state?
label.zh: 在提供追蹤記錄中，現有程式碼首次與預期狀態不同是在哪個事件？

label.en: In the supplied trace, how many of the nine events t0 to t8 list an expected state of 'saving'?
label.zh: 在提供追蹤記錄的九個事件 t0 至 t8 中，有多少個列出預期狀態為 'saving'？

label.en: Which patch pair fixes both the missing transition and the stale-settlement problem?
label.zh: 哪組修正同時解決缺少的狀態轉換及過時完成結果問題？

label.en: Add setState({ status: 'saving' }) before the await, record an attempt id per call, and return before any setState when the settling attempt is not the latest one.
label.zh: 在 await 前加入 setState({ status: 'saving' })，每次呼叫記錄嘗試編號，並在完成結果並非最新嘗試時於任何 setState 前返回。

label.en: Add setState({ status: 'saving' }) before the await and change nothing else.
label.zh: 只在 await 前加入 setState({ status: 'saving' })，其他不變。

label.en: Record an attempt id per call and return before any setState when the settling attempt is not the latest, and change nothing else.
label.zh: 每次呼叫記錄嘗試編號，並在完成結果並非最新嘗試時於任何 setState 前返回，其他不變。

label.en: Set the state to 'idle' before each attempt and add no attempt guard.
label.zh: 在每次嘗試前將狀態設為 'idle'，不加入嘗試守衛。
