The 3 orders confirmed within 3 minutes are unaffected. Monitoring uses 12-order windows. Escalate to the city operations manager after two consecutive red windows or any single window with average confirmation latency over 15 minutes. Green resets the consecutive red count. Uncertainty remains because counts are synthetic and no compensation records are supplied. Next steps are to verify counts, confirm compensation status, and run the first monitoring window.
exemplar.zh: 我們批准方案 P + Q。事故記錄顯示 6 張自動取消訂單符合 P 資格，9 張在 12 至 19 分鐘後手動確認的訂單符合 Q 資格。P 每張成本 HK$18，得 4 分。Q 每張成本 HK$30，得 3 分。支出為 6 x 18 = HK$108 加 9 x 30 = HK$270，共 HK$378，在 HK$420 硬預算內。分數為 6 x 4 = 24 加 9 x 3 = 27，共 51。我們排除方案 R，因為 P + Q 在預算內得分更高。其他方案：P + R 成本 HK$158，得 34 分。Q + R 成本 HK$320，得 37 分。三個方案全選成本 HK$428，超出預算。R 資格為嚴格超過 5 分鐘，因此 5 張在 6 至 7 分鐘後確認的訂單僅符合 R 資格。3 張在 3 分鐘內確認的訂單不受影響。監測以 12 張訂單為一窗口。連續兩個紅色窗口或任一個平均確認時延超過 15 分鐘的窗口後，轉交城市營運經理。綠色窗口會重設連續紅色計數。不確定性在於數字屬虛構，且未提供補償記錄。下一步是核對數量、確認補償狀態，並執行首個監測窗口。

feedback.en: All four answers are correct: Bundle P + Q, HK$378 spend, 51 points, the P/Q eligibility groups, and the two-consecutive-red-or-single-over-15-minutes escalation rule. Calculations 6 x 18 = 108 plus 9 x 30 = 270 and 24 + 27 = 51 are right and stay under the HK$420 cap.
feedback.zh: 四項答案全部正確：方案 P + Q、支出 HK$378、51 分、P/Q 合資格組別，以及連續兩個紅色或單一窗口平均超過 15 分鐘的轉交規則。計算 6 x 18 = 108 加 9 x 30 = 270，以及 24 + 27 = 51 正確，並在 HK$420 上限內。

feedback.en: You tie each decision to the incident log counts (6 auto-cancelled, 9 manual after 12 to 19 minutes, 5 at 6 to 7 minutes, 3 within 3 minutes) and the policy costs and scores. You correctly explain that Bundle R is excluded and that all three would exceed budget at HK$428.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連結到事故記錄數字（6 張自動取消、9 張在 12 至 19 分鐘後手動確認、5 張在 6 至 7 分鐘、3 張在 3 分鐘內）及政策成本與分數。你正確解釋排除方案 R，以及三個方案全選成本 HK$428 會超出預算。

feedback.en: Your next steps cover verifying counts, confirming compensation status and running the first monitoring window. Add a check that no order sits exactly at 5 minutes and that each monitoring window uses 12 completed orders to fully test the requirements.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步涵蓋核對數量、確認補償狀態及執行首個監測窗口。可再加入檢查沒有訂單剛好落在 5 分鐘，以及每個監測窗口以 12 張完成訂單為單位，以更完整測試要求。

feedback.en: You note the counts are synthetic and that no compensation records are supplied. You could also state the exercise is inspired by foodpanda but not endorsed by it and that the monitoring thresholds are invented for this scenario.
feedback.zh: 你指出數字屬虛構，且未提供補償記錄。可再說明本練習受 foodpanda 啟發但不獲其認可，以及監測門檻為本情境虛構。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable with the bundle, spend, points, eligible groups, and named escalation to the city operations manager. It reads well as a single pass to the team lead.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰可行，列明方案、支出、分數、合資格組別，以及轉交城市營運經理。作為交給團隊主管的單次交代相當清楚。

summary.en: Strong submission. All structured answers are correct and the written reasoning matches the supplied recovery and monitoring policies with accurate arithmetic. The main gaps are minor: fuller verification checks and a broader scope-and-uncertainty statement. The 209-word handover exceeds the suggested 100 to 180 words but no marks were deducted for length.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。所有結構化答案正確，書面推理與提供的復原及監測政策一致，計算準確。主要不足屬輕微：核實檢查可更完整，範圍及不確定性聲明可更全面。交接共 209 英文字，超出建議的 100 至 180 字，但並未因長度扣分。

nextSteps.en: Add explicit verification checks for the 5-minute boundary and the 12-order window, and extend the uncertainty note to cover the fictional and non-endorsed nature of the exercise. Both are small edits that would lift the evidence and scope marks.
nextSteps.zh: 加入針對 5 分鐘界線及 12 張訂單窗口的明確核實檢查，並把不確定性說明擴展至涵蓋本練習的虛構性及不獲認可。兩者均屬小修改，可提升證據及範圍分數。

brief.en: You are a PCB designer at ASMPT (fictional simulation). Review the fictional low-voltage board LVB-204 against supplied design rules. Compare connector mapping, clearance measurements, and trace widths. Produce a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Include decisions, evidence, risks, and next steps. All rules and data are supplied in the documents. Focus on correctness and clear reasoning. This is a paper review only. No fabrication or certification. Not endorsed by ASMPT.
brief.zh: 您是一名 ASMPT 的 PCB 設計師（虛構模擬）。根據提供的設計規則審查虛構低壓電路板 LVB-204。比較連接器映射、間距量度及線寬。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔的書面交接。包括決策、證據、風險及下一步。所有規則及數據均在文件中提供。專注於正確性及清晰推理。此為紙本審查。沒有製造或認證。未獲 ASMPT 認可。

body.en: Fictional design rules for low-voltage board LVB-204. Units are millimetres (mm). Minimum clearance between any two distinct nets is 0.20 mm. A clearance below 0.20 mm fails. Minimum trace width for signal nets is 0.15 mm. A width below 0.15 mm fails. Minimum trace width for power nets (+3V3, GND) is 0.30 mm. A width below 0.30 mm fails. Connector J1 has six pins (1 to 6). Required mapping: pin1 +3V3, pin2 GND, pin3 SCL, pin4 SDA, pin5 INT, pin6 GND. Each pin must match the required net. For clearance checks, each unique net pair is counted once. Duplicate net labels on different pins do not create additional clearance pairs. A net with multiple pins is still one net for clearance and trace width checks. Each failing clearance pair, each net with a trace width below minimum, and each incorrect connector pin assignment counts as one mandatory design rule failure.
body.zh: 虛構低壓電路板 LVB-204 的設計規則。單位為毫米 (mm)。任何兩個不同網路之間的最小間距為 0.20 mm。間距低於 0.20 mm 即不合格。信號網路的最小線寬為 0.15 mm。線寬低於 0.15 mm 即不合格。電源網路（+3V3、GND）的最小線寬為 0.30 mm。線寬低於 0.30 mm 即不合格。連接器 J1 有六個引腳（1 至 6）。所需映射：引腳1 +3V3，引腳2 GND，引腳3 SCL，引腳4 SDA，引腳5 INT，引腳6 GND。每個引腳必須符合所需網路。對於間距檢查，每個唯一網路對僅計算一次。不同引腳上的重複網路標籤不會產生額外的間距對。具有多個引腳的網路在間距和線寬檢查中仍視為一個網路。每個不合格的間距對、每個線寬低於最小值的網路、以及每個不正確的連接器引腳分配，均計為一個強制性設計規則失敗。

title.en: Net Mapping and Clearance Measurements LVB-204
title.zh: 網路映射與間距量度 LVB-204

body.en: Fictional measured data for LVB-204. J1 pin mapping as built: pin1 +3V3, pin2 GND, pin3 SCL, pin4 SDA, pin5 INT, pin6 +3V3. Measured clearances (mm) between net pairs: +3V3 and GND 0.18, SCL and SDA 0.22, SCL and INT 0.19, +3V3 and SCL 0.25, GND and SDA 0.21, GND and INT 0.17. All other net pairs have clearance greater than or equal to 0.25 mm and are not listed. No other violations exist.
body.zh: 虛構的 LVB-204 量度數據。J1 引腳映射（實測）：引腳1 +3V3，引腳2 GND，引腳3 SCL，引腳4 SDA，引腳5 INT，引腳6 +3V3。網路對之間的實測間距 (mm)：+3V3 與 GND 0.18，SCL 與 SDA 0.22，SCL 與 INT 0.19，+3V3 與 SCL 0.25，GND 與 SDA 0.21，GND 與 INT 0.17。所有其他網路對的間距大於或等於 0.25 mm，未列出。不存在其他違規。

body.en: Fictional measured trace widths for LVB-204. Net +3V3: 0.28 mm. Net GND: 0.32 mm. Net SCL: 0.16 mm. Net SDA: 0.14 mm. Net INT: 0.15 mm. All measurements are in millimetres. No other nets are present on this board.
body.zh: 虛構的 LVB-204 實測線寬。網路 +3V3：0.28 mm。網路 GND：0.32 mm。網路 SCL：0.16 mm。網路 SDA：0.14 mm。網路 INT：0.15 mm。所有量度單位為毫米。此電路板上沒有其他網路。

label.en: Which J1 pin is incorrectly mapped according to the design rules?
label.zh: 根據設計規則，哪個 J1 引腳映射不正確？

label.en: Which net pairs violate the minimum clearance rule of 0.20 mm? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些網路對違反 0.20 mm 的最小間距規則？選取所有適用者。

label.en: Which nets have a trace width below the required minimum for their net class? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些網路的線寬低於其網路類別所需的最小值？選取所有適用者。

label.en: How many mandatory design rule failures exist in total? Count each failing clearance pair as one, each net with a trace width below minimum as one, and each incorrect connector pin as one.
label.zh: 總共有多少項強制性設計規則失敗？每個不合格的間距對計為一項，每個線寬低於最小值的網路計為一項，每個不正確的連接器引腳計為一項。

label.en: What is the correct net assignment for J1 pin6 according to the design rules?
label.zh: 根據設計規則，J1 引腳6 的正確網路分配是什麼？

exemplar.en: Handover for fictional LVB-204 review. Sources: Design Rules DR-LVB-204, Net Mapping and Clearance Measurements, Trace Width Measurements. Decision: one connector mapping error at J1 pin6 (should be GND, measured +3V3). Three clearance failures: +3V3-GND 0.18 mm, SCL-INT 0.19 mm, GND-INT 0.17 mm, all below 0.20 mm. Two trace width failures: +3V3 0.28 mm (power min 0.30 mm) and SDA 0.14 mm (signal min 0.15 mm). Total mandatory failures: 6 (3 clearance + 2 trace width + 1 pin mapping). Risk: +3V3 has clearance and width issues, could affect power integrity. Next steps: correct pin6 mapping, increase +3V3 and SDA trace widths, re-space failing clearances, then re-measure. This is a paper review only. No fabrication. Escalate to senior engineer before any layout change.
exemplar.zh: 虛構 LVB-204 審查交接。來源：設計規則 DR-LVB-204、網路映射與間距量度、線寬量度。決策：J1 引腳6 有一個連接器映射錯誤（應為 GND，實測為 +3V3）。三個間距不合格：+3V3-GND 0.18 mm、SCL-INT 0.19 mm、GND-INT 0.17 mm，均低於 0.20 mm。兩個線寬不合格：+3V3 0.28 mm（電源最小 0.30 mm）及 SDA 0.14 mm（信號最小 0.15 mm）。總強制性失敗：6 項（3 間距 + 2 線寬 + 1 引腳映射）。風險：+3V3 有間距及線寬問題，可能影響電源完整性。下一步：修正引腳6 映射、增加 +3V3 及 SDA 線寬、重新間隔不合格間距，然後重新量度。此為紙本審查。沒有製造。在進行任何佈局變更前上報高級工程師。

feedback.en: All five field answers and the total are correct. You correctly flag J1 pin6 as the mapping error, identify the three failing clearance pairs (+3V3-GND 0.18, SCL-INT 0.19, GND-INT 0.17), the two narrow nets (+3V3 0.28, SDA 0.14), and total 6 failures.
feedback.zh: 五個欄位答案及總數全部正確。你正確指出 J1 引腳6 為映射錯誤，識別三個不合格間距對（+3V3-GND 0.18、SCL-INT 0.19、GND-INT 0.17）、兩個線寬不足網路（+3V3 0.28、SDA 0.14），總失敗為 6 項。

feedback.en: You cite all three supplied documents and tie each value to its limit, which is strong evidence. To reach full marks, add the point that +3V3 appears on pin1 and pin6 but counts as one net for the width check while pin6 remains a mapping error.
feedback.zh: 你引用了三份提供文件並把每個數值連結至限值，證據充分。若要取滿分，請補充：+3V3 雖同時出現於引腳1 及引腳6，但在線寬檢查中仍算一個網路，而引腳6 仍屬映射錯誤。

feedback.en: Your next steps to re-map pin6, widen +3V3 and SDA, re-space the failing pairs and re-measure are concrete and appropriate. Consider also cross-checking J1 against the netlist and confirming widths with a calibrated tool for a stronger check.
feedback.zh: 你建議重映射引腳6、加寬 +3V3 及 SDA、重新間隔不合格間距並重新量度，具體恰當。可再補充對照網路表交叉檢查 J1，以及用校準工具核實線寬，令核實更完整。

feedback.en: You correctly state this is a paper review of a fictional board with no fabrication, which bounds the claim well. You could add that no layer stackup, impedance data or measurement uncertainty was supplied, and that only the listed net pairs and nets were considered.
feedback.zh: 你正確聲明此為虛構電路板的紙本審查且沒有製造，良好界定範圍。可再補充未提供層疊結構、阻抗數據或量度不確定性，且僅考慮所列網路對及網路。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and well structured with decisions, evidence, risk and next steps, and you note escalation to a senior engineer before layout changes. Adding document names to each evidence line would make it fully actionable.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔且結構清晰，包含決策、證據、風險及下一步，並註明佈局變更前上報高級工程師。若在每項證據旁標明文件名稱，可行動性會更完整。

summary.en: Excellent complete work at 128 words. All field answers are correct and the narrative applies every supplied limit with matched evidence. Minor gaps remain in distinguishing net-pair versus net counting and in stating the limits of the supplied data.
summary.zh: 全文 128 字，表現優秀完整。所有欄位答案正確，敘述把每個提供限值與對應證據配對。尚有小缺口：未區分網路對與網路計數，亦未說明提供數據的局限。

nextSteps.en: Add one sentence explaining that duplicate +3V3 pins count as a single net for width checks while pin6 stays a mapping error, and note the missing stackup, impedance and uncertainty data.

brief.en: You are a PCB designer in a fictional ASMPT learning simulation. Review the paper design package for fictional low-voltage board LVB-311 against the supplied rules. Compare measured footprint pad gaps, silkscreen overlaps, silkscreen line widths and reference designator distances, then count every mandatory failure. Deliver a concise evidence-based written handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering decisions, evidence, remaining uncertainty and next steps. This is a paper review only. Do not fabricate, build or certify a board. Not endorsed by ASMPT.
brief.zh: 您是一名 ASMPT 虛構學習模擬的 PCB 設計師。請根據提供的規則，審查虛構低壓電路板 LVB-311 的紙本設計文件。比較實測封裝焊盤間距、絲印重疊、絲印線寬及參考標號距離，然後計算所有強制性失敗。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的書面交接，約 100 至 180 字，涵蓋決策、證據、剩餘不確定性及下一步。此為紙本審查。請勿製造、建板或認證電路板。未獲 ASMPT 認可。

body.en: Fictional design rules for low-voltage board LVB-311. All units are millimetres (mm). Rule 1, minimum pad-to-pad clearance within one footprint is 0.20 mm, and a gap below 0.20 mm fails. Rule 2, a silkscreen line may overlap a pad by at most 0.10 mm, and an overlap greater than 0.10 mm fails. Rule 3, minimum silkscreen line width is 0.12 mm, and a width below 0.12 mm fails. Rule 4, a reference designator text must sit at least 0.20 mm from the nearest pad edge, and a distance below 0.20 mm fails. Counting, each failing pad pair counts once, each silkscreen line failing a rule counts once per rule, and each failing reference designator counts once.
body.zh: 虛構低壓電路板 LVB-311 的設計規則。所有單位為毫米 (mm)。規則1，同一封裝內焊盤對焊盤的最小間距為 0.20 mm，間距低於 0.20 mm 即不合格。規則2，絲印線與焊盤的重疊最多為 0.10 mm，重疊大於 0.10 mm 即不合格。規則3，絲印線最小線寬為 0.12 mm，線寬低於 0.12 mm 即不合格。規則4，參考標號文字須距離最近焊盤邊緣至少 0.20 mm，距離低於 0.20 mm 即不合格。計算方式：每個不合格焊盤對計一次，每條絲印線每違反一項規則計一次，每個不合格參考標號計一次。

body.en: Fictional measured data for LVB-311. Footprint FP-A is connector J2 with four pads, measured pad-to-pad clearances: P1 to P2 0.22 mm, P2 to P3 0.18 mm, P3 to P4 0.21 mm. Footprint FP-B is IC U1 with three pads, measured pad-to-pad clearances: P1 to P2 0.25 mm, P2 to P3 0.24 mm. Silkscreen overlap over a pad: S1 over J2-P2 is 0.14 mm, S2 over U1-P1 is 0.05 mm, S3 over J2-P4 is 0.08 mm, S4 over U1-P3 is 0.11 mm, S5 over J2-P1 is 0.00 mm. No other overlaps exist.
body.zh: LVB-311 的虛構量度數據。封裝 FP-A 為連接器 J2，共四個焊盤，實測焊盤對焊盤間距：P1 至 P2 為 0.22 mm，P2 至 P3 為 0.18 mm，P3 至 P4 為 0.21 mm。封裝 FP-B 為集成電路 U1，共三個焊盤，實測焊盤對焊盤間距：P1 至 P2 為 0.25 mm，P2 至 P3 為 0.24 mm。絲印與焊盤重疊：S1 於 J2-P2 為 0.14 mm，S2 於 U1-P1 為 0.05 mm，S3 於 J2-P4 為 0.08 mm，S4 於 U1-P3 為 0.11 mm，S5 於 J2-P1 為 0.00 mm。不存在其他重疊。

title.en: Silkscreen Widths and Reference Designator Distances LVB-311
title.zh: 絲印線寬與參考標號距離 LVB-311

body.en: Fictional measured data for LVB-311. Silkscreen line widths: S1 is 0.10 mm, S2 is 0.13 mm, S3 is 0.11 mm, S4 is 0.14 mm, S5 is 0.15 mm. Reference designator distance from the nearest pad edge: R1 near J2 is 0.18 mm, R2 near U1 is 0.22 mm, R3 near C1 is 0.16 mm, R4 near R5 is 0.13 mm. All measurements are in millimetres. expectedEvidence.en: Correctly identifies 8 total mandatory failures. Pad gap FP-A P2 to P3 at 0.18 mm fails Rule 1, all other pad gaps pass. Refdes failures are R1 at 0.18 mm, R3 at 0.16 mm and R4 at 0.13 mm, all below 0.20 mm. R2 at 0.22 mm passes. Accepts any equivalent correct identification and total.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確指出共 8 項強制性失敗。焊盤間距 FP-A P2 至 P3 為 0.18 mm，違反規則1，其餘焊盤間距合格。重疊失敗為 S1 的 0.14 mm 及 S4 的 0.11 mm，均大於 0.10 mm 上限。線寬失敗為 S1 的 0.10 mm 及 S3 的 0.11 mm，均低於 0.12 mm。參考標號失敗為 R1 的 0.18 mm、R3 的 0.16 mm 及 R4 的 0.13 mm，均低於 0.20 mm。R2 的 0.22 mm 合格。任何等效的正確判斷及總數均接受。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites document ids design-rules, footprint-silkscreen and widths-refdes, and shows the arithmetic 1 pad pair plus 2 overlap lines plus 2 width lines plus 3 refdes equals 8. States that S1 is counted once under overlap and once under width because the counting rule counts each silkscreen line once per rule. Notes that 0.10 mm overlap and 0.12 mm width both pass because the thresholds are strict 'greater than' and 'below'.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用文件編號 design-rules、footprint-silkscreen 及 widths-refdes，並展示算式 1 個焊盤對加 2 條重疊線加 2 條線寬線加 3 個參考標號等於 8。說明 S1 在重疊及線寬各計一次，因計算規則為每條絲印線每違反一項規則計一次。指出 0.10 mm 重疊及 0.12 mm 線寬均合格，因門檻為嚴格的「大於」及「低於」。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

Names an owner or escalation such as the layout owner or lead engineer.

exemplar.en: Handover for LVB-311 paper review. Decisions. LVB-311 has 8 mandatory rule failures. Pad gap FP-A P2 to P3 is 0.18 mm, below the 0.20 mm minimum under Rule 1 in doc footprint-silkscreen. Silkscreen overlap fails for S1 at 0.14 mm and S4 at 0.11 mm, both above the 0.10 mm limit under Rule 2. Silkscreen width fails for S1 at 0.10 mm and S3 at 0.11 mm, both below 0.12 mm under Rule 3 in doc widths-refdes. Reference designator distance fails for R1 at 0.18 mm, R3 at 0.16 mm and R4 at 0.13 mm, all below 0.20 mm under Rule 4. Evidence and counting. 1 pad pair plus 2 overlap lines plus 2 width lines plus 3 reference designators equals 8. S1 counts twice because it fails two separate rules. Risks and scope. This is a synthetic paper check of supplied measurements only, and it does not certify manufacturability. Fabrication tolerance and other board data are not supplied. Next steps. Ask the layout owner to widen the FP-A P2 to P3 gap, move or trim S1, S3 and S4, reposition R1, R3 and R4, then rerun all four checks before release review.
exemplar.zh: LVB-311 紙本審查交接。決策。LVB-311 共有 8 項強制性規則失敗。焊盤間距 FP-A P2 至 P3 為 0.18 mm，低於文件 footprint-silkscreen 中規則1 的 0.20 mm 下限。絲印重疊失敗為 S1 的 0.14 mm 及 S4 的 0.11 mm，均高於規則2 的 0.10 mm 上限。絲印線寬失敗為 S1 的 0.10 mm 及 S3 的 0.11 mm，均低於文件 widths-refdes 中規則3 的 0.12 mm。參考標號距離失敗為 R1 的 0.18 mm、R3 的 0.16 mm 及 R4 的 0.13 mm，均低於規則4 的 0.20 mm。證據與計算。1 個焊盤對加 2 條重疊線加 2 條線寬線加 3 個參考標號等於 8。S1 計兩次，因它違反兩項獨立規則。風險與範圍。此為僅就所提供量度的合成紙本檢查，不認證可製造性。製造公差及其他電路板數據並未提供。下一步。請佈局負責人加寬 FP-A P2 至 P3 間距，移動或修剪 S1、S3、S4，重新放置 R1、R3、R4，然後在發佈審核前重跑全部四項檢查。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct, and the handover states 8 mandatory failures with the right breakdown: FP-A P2 to P3 at 0.18 mm, overlaps S1 and S4, widths S1 and S3, and refdes R1, R3 and R4. R2 at 0.22 mm is correctly treated as passing.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確，交接指出共 8 項強制性失敗，細分無誤：FP-A P2 至 P3 為 0.18 mm、重疊 S1 及 S4、線寬 S1 及 S3、參考標號 R1、R3 及 R4。R2 的 0.22 mm 亦正確判斷為合格。

feedback.en: You cite doc footprint-silkscreen and doc widths-refdes, show the arithmetic 1 plus 2 plus 2 plus 3 equals 8, and correctly explain that S1 is counted twice because it breaks two separate rules. Adding the strict threshold reasoning for 0.10 mm overlap and 0.12 mm width would make the evidence even tighter.
feedback.zh: 你引用了文件 footprint-silkscreen 及 widths-refdes，展示 1 加 2 加 2 加 3 等於 8 的算式，並正確解釋 S1 因違反兩項獨立規則而計兩次。若能補充 0.10 mm 重疊及 0.12 mm 線寬屬嚴格門檻的理據，證據會更嚴密。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete and actionable: widen the FP-A P2 to P3 gap, move or trim S1, S3 and S4, reposition R1, R3 and R4, then rerun all four rule checks before release review. An owner, the layout owner, is named for escalation.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體可行：加寬 FP-A P2 至 P3 間距、移動或修剪 S1、S3、S4、重新放置 R1、R3、R4，並在發佈審核前重跑全部四項規則檢查。已指名佈局負責人作轉交對象。

feedback.en: You correctly limit the review to a synthetic paper check of the supplied measurements, state it does not certify manufacturability, and note that fabrication tolerance and other board data are absent. This matches the rules DR-LVB-311 scope.
feedback.zh: 你正確地把審查限於就所提供量度進行的合成紙本檢查，說明此不認證可製造性，並指出製造公差及其他電路板數據欠奉，符合規則 DR-LVB-311 的範圍。

feedback.en: The handover is well structured under Decisions, Evidence, Risks and Next steps, and is easy to act on. At 205 English words it runs a little past the 100 to 180 word target, so trimming repeated rule names and figures would tighten it.

summary.en: Strong submission. All five field answers are correct, the evidence chain is transparent, and scope limits are stated honestly. Only minor polish is needed: trim length toward the 100 to 180 word target and add the strict-threshold reasoning.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。五項答案全部正確，證據鏈清晰，範圍限制亦誠實交代。只須略作修飾：把篇幅收窄至 100 至 180 詞目標，並補充嚴格門檻的理據。

nextSteps.en: Trim the handover to the target range, keep the 1 plus 2 plus 2 plus 3 equals 8 arithmetic, and add one line explaining why 0.10 mm and 0.12 mm pass under strict thresholds. Hand the corrected items to the layout owner for re-measure before release review.
nextSteps.zh: 把交接精簡至目標字數範圍，保留 1 加 2 加 2 加 3 等於 8 的算式，並加一句說明 0.10 mm 及 0.12 mm 何以在嚴格門檻下合格。把須修正項目交予佈局負責人重新量度，然後才作發佈審核。

brief.en: You are a PCB designer supporting a fictional ASMPT-inspired low-voltage sensor interface board review. Reconcile the NV-24 board, BOM and test-point revisions using the supplied fictional records. Identify the mismatched component revision and count the mismatched BOM line items. State how many mandatory release conditions are confirmed met. Decide the required fix and the primary risk. title.en: NV-24 release gate and mandatory conditions
title.zh: NV-24 發佈閘門及強制條件

body.en: Fictional release gate for NV-24. Five mandatory conditions must all pass. 1 Board, BOM and test-point revision identifiers equal baseline set C. 2 Every BOM line item has BOM revision equal to schematic required revision. 3 Test-point count meets minimum 12 for 34 nets. 4 All test points have matching net labels in net table. 5 No waiver request is open. Counting scope: one mismatched line item means one unique BOM line number where schematic required revision differs from BOM revision. Quantity does not multiply the count. A fix plan must resolve all failures before release.
body.zh: 虛構 NV-24 發佈閘門。五項強制條件必須全部符合。1 電路板、物料表及測試點修訂標識等於基準組 C。2 每個物料表行項目的物料表修訂等於電路圖要求修訂。3 測試點數量符合 34 條網絡最低 12 點。4 所有測試點在網絡表中有匹配的網絡標籤。5 沒有開啟的豁免請求。計算範圍：一個不符行項目指一個唯一物料表行號，其電路圖要求修訂與物料表修訂不同。數量不會倍增計算。修正計劃必須在發佈前解決所有失敗。

body.en: From: Man Kit Lai, Manufacturing Engineer. To: PCB Designer. Subject: NV-24 rev C board with rev B U4 reel. The line received a rev B U4 regulator reel with part LDO-3312-B against the rev C board. I also checked the test-point table, it is rev C and all 12 test points match the rev C net table. Test-point count is 12 against 34 nets, which meets the minimum. No waiver is open. Please reconcile the BOM before we load the line.
body.zh: 寄件人：Man Kit Lai，製造工程師。收件人：PCB 設計師。主旨：NV-24 修訂 C 電路板配修訂 B U4 捲盤。生產線收到的修訂 B U4 穩壓器捲盤零件編號為 LDO-3312-B，對應修訂 C 電路板。我亦已檢查測試點表，它是修訂 C，全部 12 個測試點均符合修訂 C 網絡表。測試點數量為 12 對 34 條網絡，符合最低要求。沒有開啟豁免。請在我們上線前核對物料表。

label.en: Which action resolves the only BOM line item mismatch before release?
label.zh: 哪項行動可在發佈前解決唯一物料表行項目的不符？

label.en: Update BOM L4 U4 to part LDO-3312-C and set BOM revision C
label.zh: 更新物料表 L4 U4 為 LDO-3312-C 並設物料表修訂為 C

label.en: Update schematic U4 to rev B
label.zh: 把電路圖 U4 更新至修訂 B

label.en: Open a waiver for the U4 mismatch
label.zh: 為 U4 不符開啟豁免

label.en: Which statements are supported by the revision register and BOM extract?
label.zh: 哪些陳述獲修訂登記冊及物料表摘錄支持？

label.en: U4 BOM revision is B while schematic required revision is C
label.zh: U4 物料表修訂為 B 而電路圖要求修訂為 C

label.en: All 8 BOM line items match schematic revision
label.zh: 全部 8 個物料表行項目均符合電路圖修訂

label.en: How many BOM line items have a component revision that does not match the schematic required revision? Count each unique line item once regardless of quantity.
label.zh: 有多少個物料表行項目的元件修訂與電路圖要求修訂不符？每個唯一行項目只計一次，不按數量倍增。

label.en: The release gate lists 5 mandatory conditions. How many are currently confirmed met by the supplied records?
label.zh: 發佈閘門列出 5 項強制條件。根據提供的記錄，目前確認符合的有多少項？

label.en: What is the primary risk if the package is released without resolving the U4 mismatch?

label.en: The rev B regulator may have a different pinout and cause assembly or functional failure
label.zh: 修訂 B 穩壓器可能引腳不同，導致組裝或功能失效

label.en: The test-point count may be too low

about.en: ASMPT supplies hardware, software and services for semiconductor and electronics manufacturing, including surface-mount technology solutions.

simulationStyle.en: Review a fictional low-voltage PCB design package against explicit simulated design rules and hand over issues for engineering review. This does not certify a real board or reproduce ASMPT designs.
simulationStyle.zh: 按明確模擬設計規則審查虛構低電壓 PCB 設計文件，並把問題交予工程審核。這不會認證真實電路板或重製 ASMPT 設計。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Reconcile board, BOM and test-point revisions and propose a complete verification handover.

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Reconcile board, BOM and test-point revisions and propose a complete verification handover.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。核對電路板、物料表及測試點修訂，並提出完整核實交接。

expectedEvidence.en: Identifies L4 U4 as the single mismatched BOM line item. States BOM rev B against schematic required rev C. States board rev C, BOM rev B, test-point rev C. Counts 1 mismatched line item, not 2 or more. States 3 of 5 mandatory release conditions are confirmed met because condition 1 fails and condition 2 fails.
expectedEvidence.zh: 識別 L4 U4 為唯一不符的物料表行項目。指出物料表修訂 B 對電路圖要求修訂 C。指出電路板修訂 C、物料表修訂 B、測試點修訂 C。計算不符行項目為 1，而非 2 或以上。指出 5 項強制發佈條件中有 3 項確認符合，因條件 1 及條件 2 失敗。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the revision register table rows L1 to L8, especially L4 U4 rev B versus rev C. Cites the five release conditions and the counting scope. Cites Man Kit Lai email for rev B U4 reel and rev C test-point table. Explains that quantity does not multiply mismatch count.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用修訂登記冊 L1 至 L8 行，尤其是 L4 U4 修訂 B 對修訂 C。引用五項發佈條件及計算範圍。引用 Man Kit Lai 電郵關於修訂 B U4 捲盤及修訂 C 測試點表。解釋數量不會倍增不符計算。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes updating BOM L4 to LDO-3312-C at rev C, regenerating the BOM at rev C, rerunning schematic to BOM mismatch check for all 8 lines, confirming test-point count 12 against 34 nets, and clearing all 5 release conditions before release.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出更新物料表 L4 為 LDO-3312-C 並設修訂 C，重新產生修訂 C 物料表，對全部 8 行重跑電路圖至物料表不符檢查，確認測試點數量 12 對 34 條網絡，並在發佈前清除全部 5 項發佈條件。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Labels the review as paper-only and fictional. Notes no physical board was inspected, no test was run and no ASMPT certification is claimed. Limits conclusions to supplied records and acknowledges that other unseen checks may exist.
expectedEvidence.zh: 表明審查僅為文書及虛構。指出未檢查實體電路板、未執行測試，亦不聲稱 ASMPT 認證。把結論限於提供記錄，並承認可能存在其他未見檢查。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover with decision, evidence from source-one and source-three, owner or escalation to manufacturing engineer, and next steps to release only after all 5 conditions pass.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫簡潔交接，列明決策、來自文件一及文件三的證據、負責人或轉交製造工程師，以及僅在全部 5 項條件符合後才發佈的下一步。

exemplar.en: Handover for fictional NV-24 package. Decision: do not release. The revision register shows board rev C, BOM rev B and test-point rev C. One BOM line item is mismatched: L4 U4 requires schematic rev C but BOM lists LDO-3312-B at rev B. Count of mismatched line items is 1 because quantity does not multiply the count. Of the 5 mandatory release conditions, 3 are confirmed met. Condition 1 fails because BOM rev B does not equal baseline set C. Condition 2 fails because L4 U4 rev B does not match schematic rev C. Conditions 3, 4 and 5 pass per source two and the manufacturing engineer email. Fix: update L4 U4 to LDO-3312-C and set BOM rev C, then rerun the mismatch check. Primary risk: rev B regulator pinout may cause assembly or functional failure. Next step: manufacturing engineer confirms reel change, then rerun all 5 release checks before release.
exemplar.zh: 虛構 NV-24 套件交接。決策：不發佈。修訂登記冊顯示電路板修訂 C、物料表修訂 B 及測試點修訂 C。一個物料表行項目不符：L4 U4 要求電路圖修訂 C，但物料表列出 LDO-3312-B 修訂 B。不符行項目數為 1，因數量不會倍增計算。5 項強制發佈條件中，3 項確認符合。條件 1 失敗，因物料表修訂 B 不等於基準組 C。條件 2 失敗，因 L4 U4 修訂 B 不符合電路圖修訂 C。條件 3、4 及 5 按文件二及製造工程師電郵符合。修正：更新 L4 U4 為 LDO-3312-C 並設物料表修訂 C，然後重跑不符檢查。主要風險：修訂 B 穩壓器引腳可能導致組裝或功能失效。下一步：製造工程師確認捲盤更換，然後在發佈前重跑全部 5 項發佈檢查。

feedback.en: All decisions and calculations are correct. You identified L4 U4 as the single mismatched line, stated board rev C, BOM rev B, test-point rev C, counted 1 mismatched line item and 3 of 5 conditions met, and chose the regulator pinout as the primary risk.
feedback.zh: 所有決策及計算均正確。你識別 L4 U4 為唯一不符行項目，指出電路板修訂 C、物料表修訂 B、測試點修訂 C，計算不符行項目為 1 及 5 項中 3 項符合，並選出穩壓器引腳為主要風險。

feedback.en: You tied each conclusion to the supplied records, citing the register for L4 U4 rev B versus rev C, the release gate conditions 1 and 2, and Man Kit Lai's email for the rev B reel and rev C test points. You also explained that quantity does not multiply the mismatch count.
feedback.zh: 你把每項結論連結至提供記錄，引用登記冊的 L4 U4 修訂 B 對修訂 C、發佈閘門條件 1 及 2，以及 Man Kit Lai 電郵的修訂 B 捲盤及修訂 C 測試點。你亦解釋數量不會倍增不符計算。

feedback.en: Your fix and next steps are concrete: update L4 U4 to LDO-3312-C at rev C, rerun the mismatch check, confirm the reel change with the manufacturing engineer and clear all 5 conditions before release. Adding a check of all 8 BOM lines would make the verification even tighter.
feedback.zh: 你的修正及下一步具體：更新 L4 U4 為 LDO-3312-C 並設修訂 C、重跑不符檢查、與製造工程師確認捲盤更換，並在發佈前清除全部 5 項條件。若能加入對全部 8 個物料表行項目的檢查，核實會更嚴密。

feedback.en: You correctly labelled the package as fictional, but you did not state that no physical board was inspected, no test was run and no certification is claimed, nor limited conclusions to the supplied records. Adding those caveats would raise this mark.
feedback.zh: 你正確表明套件為虛構，但未指出未檢查實體電路板、未執行測試及不聲稱認證，亦未把結論限於提供記錄。加入這些說明可提高此項分數。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 150 words and clearly states the decision, evidence, fix, risk, owner and escalation to the manufacturing engineer. It reads as an actionable working note.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，共 150 字，清楚列明決策、證據、修正、風險、負責人及轉交製造工程師，可作為可行工作記錄。

summary.en: A strong handover that gets every decision, count and condition right and grounds them in the supplied records. The main gap is scope framing: you note the scenario is fictional but do not state what was not verified, such as no physical inspection or test and no certification claim.
summary.zh: 整體交接紮實，所有決策、計算及條件均正確，並以提供記錄為依據。主要不足在範圍界定：你指出情境為虛構，但未說明未核實的事項，例如未檢查實體、未執行測試及不聲稱認證。

nextSteps.en: Add one or two sentences stating the review is paper-only, that no physical board or test was performed, and that conclusions are limited to the supplied records. Consider listing a recheck of all 8 BOM lines to strengthen the verification plan.
nextSteps.zh: 加入一至兩句，說明此審查僅為文書、未進行實體電路板檢查或測試，並把結論限於提供記錄。亦可列出重檢全部 8 個物料表行項目，以強化核實計劃。

title.en: Hand over the MR-07 rev D package
title.zh: 交接 MR-07 修訂 D 套件

brief.en: You are a PCB designer supporting a fictional ASMPT-inspired low-voltage board review. Reconcile the MR-07 rev D board, BOM, test-point and net table records in the supplied fictional documents. Identify the test-point labels that disagree with the net table, count the mismatched unique test points, and state how many of the five mandatory release conditions are confirmed met. Propose the fix and the primary risk. Write a concise evidence-based handover of about 100 to 180 words in English or Traditional Chinese. This is an independent learning simulation, not an ASMPT certification or a real board release.
brief.zh: 你是 PCB 設計師，支援一項受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構低電壓電路板審查。使用提供的虛構記錄，核對 MR-07 修訂 D 電路板、物料表、測試點表及網絡表。找出與網絡表不符的測試點標籤，計算不符的唯一測試點數量，並說明五項強制發佈條件中有多少項確認符合。提出修正及主要風險。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、基於證據的交接，約 100 至 180 字。此為獨立學習模擬，並非 ASMPT 認證或真實電路板發佈。

title.en: MR-07 rev D test-point table and net table extract
title.zh: MR-07 修訂 D 測試點表及網絡表摘錄

body.en: Fictional MR-07 rev D records. Test-point table columns are designator, test-point label, net name in the rev D net table. TP1 VBAT_SENSE VBAT_SENSE. TP2 GND_REF GND_REF. TP2 GND_REF GND_REF (same row repeated on page 2). TP3 VREF_1V2 VREF_1V8. TP4 CLK_48M CLK_48M. TP5 CS_ADC CS_ADC. TP6 DRDY DRDY_N. TP7 SDA SDA. TP8 SCL SCL. TP9 PG_LED PG_EN. TP10 VDD_3V3 VDD_3V3. The rev D net table lists 26 nets.
body.zh: 虛構 MR-07 修訂 D 記錄。測試點表欄目為標號、測試點標籤、修訂 D 網絡表中的網絡名稱。TP1 VBAT_SENSE VBAT_SENSE。TP2 GND_REF GND_REF。TP2 GND_REF GND_REF（同一行於第 2 頁重複）。TP3 VREF_1V2 VREF_1V8。TP4 CLK_48M CLK_48M。TP5 CS_ADC CS_ADC。TP6 DRDY DRDY_N。TP7 SDA SDA。TP8 SCL SCL。TP9 PG_LED PG_EN。TP10 VDD_3V3 VDD_3V3。修訂 D 網絡表列出 26 條網絡。

title.en: MR-07 rev D release gate and counting scope
title.zh: MR-07 修訂 D 發佈閘門及計算範圍

body.en: Fictional MR-07 rev D release gate. All five conditions must pass. C1 Board, BOM, test-point table and net table revision identifiers all equal baseline set D. C2 Every BOM line item has a BOM revision equal to its schematic required revision. C3 The test-point table holds at least 10 unique test-point designators, and 10 meets the condition. C4 Every test-point table label equals the net name at that designator in the rev D net table. C5 No waiver or deviation request is open. Counting scope: test-point count means unique designators, and a repeated row for the same designator and net counts once. One mismatched test point means one unique designator whose label differs from the net table. The rev D net table is the governing source of net names.
body.zh: 虛構 MR-07 修訂 D 發佈閘門。五項條件必須全部符合。C1 電路板、物料表、測試點表及網絡表的修訂標識均等於基準組 D。C2 每個物料表行項目的物料表修訂等於其電路圖要求修訂。C3 測試點表至少載有 10 個唯一測試點標號，10 個符合條件。C4 每個測試點表標籤等於修訂 D 網絡表中該標號的網絡名稱。C5 沒有開啟的豁免或偏差請求。計算範圍：測試點數量指唯一標號，同一標號及同一網絡的重複行只計一次。一個不符測試點指一個標籤與網絡表不同的唯一標號。網絡名稱以修訂 D 網絡表為管轄來源。

body.en: From Ho Chun-kit, Manufacturing Engineer. To PCB Designer. Subject: MR-07 rev D package before fixture load. Revision register check: board rev D, BOM rev D, test-point table rev D, net table rev D. BOM rev D holds 9 line items and every BOM revision equals its schematic required revision. The test-point table has 11 rows covering 10 unique designators. No waiver or deviation request is open. My concern is the label column, please reconcile it before we build the test fixture.
body.zh: 寄件人：Ho Chun-kit，製造工程師。收件人：PCB 設計師。主旨：夾具上線前的 MR-07 修訂 D 套件。修訂登記冊檢查：電路板修訂 D、物料表修訂 D、測試點表修訂 D、網絡表修訂 D。物料表修訂 D 有 9 個行項目，每個物料表修訂均等於其電路圖要求修訂。測試點表有 11 行，涵蓋 10 個唯一標號。沒有開啟的豁免或偏差請求。我關注的是標籤欄，請在我們製造測試夾具前核對。

label.en: The rev D net table is the governing source of net names. Which action resolves the test-point label disagreement before release?
label.zh: 修訂 D 網絡表是網絡名稱的管轄來源。哪項行動可在發佈前解決測試點標籤的不符？

label.en: Correct the test-point table labels to match the rev D net table, then recheck the label column
label.zh: 把測試點表標籤更正為符合修訂 D 網絡表，然後重新檢查標籤欄

label.en: Correct the rev D net table to match the test-point table labels
label.zh: 把修訂 D 網絡表更正為符合測試點表標籤

label.en: Open a waiver for the label disagreement and release the package
label.zh: 為標籤不符開啟豁免並發佈套件

label.en: Release the package as is because the test-point count passes C3
label.zh: 因測試點數量符合 C3 而按現狀發佈套件

label.en: Which statements are supported by the supplied rev D records?
label.zh: 哪些陳述獲提供的修訂 D 記錄支持？

label.en: Board, BOM, test-point table and net table revision identifiers all equal baseline set D
label.zh: 電路板、物料表、測試點表及網絡表的修訂標識均等於基準組 D

label.en: The rev D net table is the governing source of net names for the test-point table
label.zh: 修訂 D 網絡表是測試點表網絡名稱的管轄來源

label.en: Every test-point table label equals the net name in the rev D net table
label.zh: 每個測試點表標籤均等於修訂 D 網絡表中的網絡名稱

label.en: No waiver or deviation request is open for this package
label.zh: 此套件沒有開啟的豁免或偏差請求

label.en: The BOM revision is B while the schematic required revision is C
label.zh: 物料表修訂為 B 而電路圖要求修訂為 C

label.en: How many unique test-point designators carry a table label that differs from the rev D net table net name? Count each unique designator once.
label.zh: 有多少個唯一測試點標號的表標籤與修訂 D 網絡表的網絡名稱不同？每個唯一標號只計一次。

label.en: The release gate lists five mandatory conditions. How many are confirmed met by the supplied records?
label.zh: 發佈閘門列出五項強制條件。根據提供的記錄，有多少項確認符合？

label.en: What is the primary risk if the label disagreement is released unresolved?
label.zh: 若標籤不符未解決即發佈，主要風險是甚麼？

label.en: A probe at the mislabelled test point measures a different net, so a real fault can pass the check
label.zh: 在標籤錯誤的測試點探測會量度另一條網絡，令真實故障可通過檢查

label.en: The unique test-point count falls below the minimum of 10
label.zh: 唯一測試點數量低於最低 10 點

label.en: The board revision changes without approval
label.zh: 電路板修訂未經批准而改變

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Reconcile board, BOM and test-point revisions and propose a complete verification handover.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。核對電路板、物料表及測試點修訂，並提出完整核實交接。

expectedEvidence.en: Applies the release gate and counting scope correctly. States that the fix is to correct the test-point table labels TP3, TP6 and TP9 to the governing rev D net table names VREF_1V8, DRDY_N and PG_EN. Reports 3 mismatched unique test points (TP1, TP2, TP4, TP5, TP7, TP8 and TP10 agree). Reports 4 of 5 conditions met, with C4 the only failure, and treats the test-point count of 10 unique designators as meeting the inclusive minimum of 10.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確應用發佈閘門及計算範圍。指出修正為把測試點表標籤 TP3、TP6 及 TP9 更正為管轄的修訂 D 網絡表名稱 VREF_1V8、DRDY_N 及 PG_EN。指出有 3 個不符的唯一測試點（TP1、TP2、TP4、TP5、TP7、TP8 及 TP10 相符）。指出五項條件中 4 項符合，僅 C4 不符，並視 10 個唯一標號為符合包含式最低 10 點的要求。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites specific records. Source-one rows for TP3, TP6 and TP9 give the disagreeing labels. Source-three confirms revisions at set D, 9 BOM line items all matching schematic required revision, 11 rows covering 10 unique designators, and no open waiver. Source-two supplies C1 to C5, the inclusive minimum of 10, the count-once rule for repeated rows and the governing-source clause. Explains mismatch counting per unique designator, not per row.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用具體記錄。來源一 TP3、TP6 及 TP9 行給出不符標籤。來源三確認各項修訂為組 D、9 個物料表行項目全部符合電路圖要求修訂、11 行涵蓋 10 個唯一標號，以及沒有開啟豁免。來源二提供 C1 至 C5、包含式最低 10 點、重複行只計一次的規則及管轄來源條款。解釋不符數按唯一標號而非行數計算。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks such as correcting the three labels and then re-running the label-to-net-name comparison across all 10 unique designators, confirming the corrected table still holds at least 10 unique designators, re-confirming no waiver is open, and holding the fixture load until the corrected rev D test-point table is re-verified against the net table. Names an owner or escalation path, for example Ho Chun-kit for fixture load.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如更正三個標籤後對全部 10 個唯一標號重跑標籤對網絡名稱的比對、確認更正後的表仍載有至少 10 個唯一標號、再次確認沒有開啟豁免，以及在更正後的修訂 D 測試點表重新核實前暫緩夾具上線。列明負責人或轉交途徑，例如 Ho Chun-kit 負責夾具上線。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States that this is a fictional learning simulation and that no fabrication, certification or real ASMPT design is involved. Notes the limits of the records, for example no physical probe or continuity data is supplied, and that revisions come from the register statement rather than independent inspection.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出此為虛構學習模擬，不涉及製造、認證或真實 ASMPT 設計。指出記錄的限制，例如沒有提供實體探測或導通數據，而各項修訂來自登記冊陳述而非獨立檢查。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering the decision to correct the three test-point labels, the counts of 3 mismatched unique test points and 4 of 5 conditions met, the risk of probing the wrong net, and next steps with an owner. Around 100 to 180 words or comparable Chinese, with no strict word limit applied.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，涵蓋更正三個測試點標籤的決定、3 個不符唯一測試點及五項條件中 4 項符合的數字、探測錯誤網絡的風險，以及列明負責人的下一步。約 100 至 180 字或相若中文，不設嚴格字數限制。

exemplar.en: Handover: MR-07 rev D package. Evidence: source-one test-point table rows TP3, TP6 and TP9 carry labels VREF_1V2, DRDY and PG_LED, while the rev D net table names those designators VREF_1V8, DRDY_N and PG_EN. All other rows agree. Source-three confirms board, BOM, test-point table and net table at set D, BOM rev D with 9 line items all matching schematic required revision, a test-point table of 11 rows covering 10 unique designators, and no open waiver. Source-two makes the net table the governing source of net names. Decision: count each unique designator once, so the mismatch count is 3. Conditions met: C1 yes, C2 yes, C3 yes because 10 meets the inclusive minimum of 10, C4 no, C5 yes, so 4 of 5. Fix: correct the three test-point labels to the net table names, then recheck the label column. Risk: a probe at a mislabelled pad measures a different net, so a real rail fault can pass unnoticed. Next steps: Ho Chun-kit holds the fixture load until the corrected rev D test-point table is re-verified against the net table. Scope: fictional simulation, no fabrication or certification claimed.
exemplar.zh: 交接：MR-07 修訂 D 套件。證據：來源一測試點表 TP3、TP6 及 TP9 行的標籤為 VREF_1V2、DRDY 及 PG_LED，而修訂 D 網絡表把該等標號命名為 VREF_1V8、DRDY_N 及 PG_EN。其餘各行相符。來源三確認電路板、物料表、測試點表及網絡表均為組 D，物料表修訂 D 有 9 個行項目全部符合電路圖要求修訂，測試點表 11 行涵蓋 10 個唯一標號，且沒有開啟豁免。來源二訂明網絡表為網絡名稱的管轄來源。決策：每個唯一標號只計一次，故不符數為 3。條件：C1 符合、C2 符合、C3 符合（10 符合包含式最低 10 點）、C4 不符、C5 符合，即 5 項中 4 項符合。修正：把三個測試點標籤更正為網絡表名稱，然後重檢標籤欄。風險：在標籤錯誤的銲盤探測會量度另一條網絡，令真實電源軌故障未被發現。下一步：Ho Chun-kit 暫緩夾具上線，直至更正後的修訂 D 測試點表對網絡表重新核實。範圍：虛構模擬，不聲稱製造或認證。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct. You identified TP3, TP6 and TP9 as the mismatched labels, set the fix to correcting the test-point table to VREF_1V8, DRDY_N and PG_EN, reported 3 unique mismatched designators, and counted 4 of 5 conditions met with C4 the only failure since 10 unique designators meets the inclusive minimum.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確。你指出 TP3、TP6 及 TP9 為不符標籤，修正為把測試點表改為 VREF_1V8、DRDY_N 及 PG_EN，報告 3 個不符的唯一標號，並指出五項條件中 4 項符合，僅 C4 不符，因為 10 個唯一標號符合包含式最低要求。

feedback.en: Your reasoning ties each decision to the supplied records, citing the source-one label rows, the source-three register check covering revisions, 9 BOM lines, 11 rows over 10 unique designators and no open waiver, and the source-two governing-source and count-once rules. The explanation of counting per unique designator rather than per row is exactly right.
feedback.zh: 你的推理把每項決定連繫至提供記錄，引用來源一的標籤行、來源三涵蓋修訂的登記冊檢查、9 個物料表行、11 行涵蓋 10 個唯一標號及沒有開啟豁免，以及來源二的管轄來源及只計一次規則。按唯一標號而非行數計算不符的解釋完全正確。

feedback.en: You give concrete next steps: correct the three labels, recheck the label column against the net table, and have Ho Chun-kit hold the fixture load until the corrected rev D table is re-verified. Adding an explicit recheck that the table still holds at least 10 unique designators would make the plan fully complete.
feedback.zh: 你提出具體下一步：更正三個標籤、把標籤欄對網絡表重檢，並由 Ho Chun-kit 暫緩夾具上線直至更正後的修訂 D 表重新核實。若明確重檢該表仍載有至少 10 個唯一標號，計劃會更完整。

feedback.en: You correctly state this is a fictional simulation with no fabrication or certification claimed. You could also note that no physical probe or continuity data was supplied and that revisions come from the register statement rather than independent inspection.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出此為虛構模擬，不聲稱製造或認證。你亦可補充沒有提供實體探測或導通數據，而各項修訂來自登記冊陳述而非獨立檢查。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable, covering the decision, the counts of 3 mismatches and 4 of 5 conditions, the wrong-net risk and an owner. At 191 words it runs slightly past the 100 to 180 guidance, though no strict limit applies.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰可行，涵蓋決定、3 個不符及 5 項中 4 項符合的數字、探測錯誤網絡的風險及負責人。全文 191 字略超 100 至 180 的建議範圍，但不設嚴格字數限制。

summary.en: An accurate, well-evidenced handover. All field answers, the mismatch count of 3 and the condition count of 4 are correct, and the labels, risk and fix match the governing rev D net table.
summary.zh: 一份準確且證據充分的交接。所有欄位答案、3 個不符數及 4 項符合條件均正確，標籤、風險及修正亦符合管轄的修訂 D 網絡表。

nextSteps.en: Tighten the handover by naming the recheck that the corrected table still holds at least 10 unique designators, and note the record limits such as absent physical probe data. Trim slightly to sit nearer the suggested length.
nextSteps.zh: 可在交接中明確列出重檢更正後表格仍載有至少 10 個唯一標號，並註明記錄限制如欠缺實體探測數據。亦可略作精簡以更接近建議長度。

brief.en: You are the product manager for a fictional SHOPLINE Hong Kong merchant onboarding squad. Review the supplied synthetic merchant messages, funnel data and prioritisation policy. Choose one product opportunity for the next release under the declared rule. The budget is a hard cap. Write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words. Include your decision, calculations, evidence, uncertainty and next checks. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE's public commerce software context and is not endorsed by SHOPLINE.
brief.zh: 你是虛構的 SHOPLINE 香港商戶開戶小組產品經理。請檢視提供的虛構商戶訊息、漏斗數據及優先次序政策。根據聲明的規則，為下一個版本選擇一個產品機會。預算為硬上限。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據導向交接。包括決策、計算、證據、不確定性及下一步檢查。此為受 SHOPLINE 公開商貿軟件背景啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由 SHOPLINE 認可。

body.en: Fictional support summary for the last 14 days. Of 112 surveyed merchants who abandoned onboarding, 38 cited business registration number entry, 27 cited document upload losing progress after a network timeout, and 19 cited unclear setup steps. The survey had a 9% response rate among 1,300 abandoned merchants. Support tickets do not record merchant identifiers. No payment or personal data is included.
body.zh: 過去 14 天的虛構支援摘要。112 名受訪並放棄開戶的商戶中，38 名提及商業登記號碼輸入，27 名提及文件上載在網絡逾時後失去進度，19 名提及設定步驟不清。該調查在 1,300 名放棄開戶商戶中的回應率為 9%。支援工單不記錄商戶識別碼。內容不包含付款或個人資料。

title.zh: 開戶漏斗及候選機會估算
虛構第二季開戶優先次序政策

body.en: Rule: choose the opportunity with the highest estimated completion lift among opportunities that pass both gates. Gate 1: evidence quality must be high. Evidence quality is high only when at least two independent fictional sources agree on problem, impact and cause. Medium or low evidence is ineligible. Gate 2: one-time build cost must not exceed the hard budget of HKD 120,000. If no opportunity passes both gates, select none. Ties break in favour of lower cost.
body.zh: 規則：在通過兩道門檻的機會中，選擇估計完成率提升最高者。門檻一：證據質素必須為高。只有當至少兩個獨立虛構來源就問題、影響及成因一致時，證據質素方為高。中或低證據不合資格。門檻二：一次性建置成本不得超過 HKD 120,000 的硬預算。若無機會通過兩道門檻，則不選擇任何項目。同分時以成本較低者優先。

label.en: If the selected opportunity achieves its estimated lift, how many additional merchants complete onboarding per month? Use the baseline monthly cohort of 4,000 and the selected lift in percentage points.
label.zh: 若選定機會達到其估計提升，每月額外完成開戶的商戶數目是多少？使用每月基準群組 4,000 名商戶及選定提升的百分點。

label.zh: 資助選定機會後，剩餘硬預算為多少？

exemplar.en: Decision: prioritise O1, the BR validation fix. Under the fictional Q2 policy, O1 is the only candidate passing both gates. O1 has high evidence quality and costs HKD 78,000, within the HKD 120,000 hard budget. O3 has a higher estimated lift of +12 points but low evidence quality, so it is ineligible. O2 is medium evidence quality, so it is ineligible. Calculation: 4,000 monthly starters × 9% lift = 360 additional completions. Remaining budget: HKD 120,000 − HKD 78,000 = HKD 42,000. Evidence: merchant-voices reports 38 of 112 abandoned-onboarding merchants cited BR number entry. The funnel data records a baseline completion rate of 62% and an O1 lift of +9 points. The code contract accepts pattern A or B, but the current function rejects valid pattern-B input. Uncertainty: support tickets lack merchant identifiers and the survey response rate is 9%. Next: instrument weekly completion for the pattern-B rejection cohort versus control, confirm the validation contract with engineering, and pre-register a stop rule. Owner: onboarding squad lead.
exemplar.zh: 決策：優先處理 O1，即商業登記驗證修正。根據虛構第二季政策，O1 是唯一通過兩道門檻的候選機會。O1 具高證據質素，成本為 HKD 78,000，在 HKD 120,000 硬預算之內。O3 估計提升較高，為 +12 個百分點，但證據質素低，故不合資格。O2 證據質素為中，故不合資格。計算：每月 4,000 名開始開戶商戶 × 9% 提升 = 額外 360 名完成開戶。剩餘預算：HKD 120,000 − HKD 78,000 = HKD 42,000。證據：merchant-voices 報告 112 名放棄開戶受訪商戶中有 38 名提及商業登記號碼輸入。funnel-data 記錄基準完成率 62%，O1 提升 +9 個百分點。程式合約接受模式 A 或模式 B，但現行函式拒絕有效的模式 B 輸入。不確定性：支援工單缺少商戶識別碼，調查回應率為 9%。下一步：為模式 B 拒絕群組與對照組建立每週完成率度量，與工程團隊確認驗證合約，並預先登記停止規則。負責人：開戶小組主管。

feedback.en: All checks are correct. You selected O1, treated O2 as ineligible on medium evidence and O3 as ineligible on low evidence despite its +12 point lift, and confirmed O3 still sits inside the HKD 120,000 cap. Your figures of 360 additional completions (4,000 × 9%) and HKD 42,000 remaining (120,000 − 78,000) are exact.
feedback.zh: 所有判斷正確。你選擇 O1，以證據質素中為由排除 O2，並以證據質素低為由排除提升較高的 O3（+12 個百分點），同時確認 O3 仍在 HKD 120,000 上限之內。額外 360 名完成開戶（4,000 × 9%）及剩餘 HKD 42,000（120,000 − 78,000）計算準確。

feedback.en: Strong linkage between the decision and the supplied records. You cited the 38 of 112 merchants naming business registration entry, the 62% baseline with the +9 point O1 lift, and the validation defect that rejects valid pattern-B input. You also explained why O3's larger lift cannot overcome its low evidence quality.
feedback.zh: 決策與提供記錄連結緊密。你引用了 112 名中 38 名提及商業登記號碼輸入、62% 基準與 O1 的 +9 個百分點提升，以及拒絕有效模式 B 輸入的驗證缺陷。你亦解釋為何 O3 較高提升無法克服其低證據質素。

feedback.en: Concrete and testable next steps. Weekly completion tracking for the pattern-B rejection cohort against a control, plus contract confirmation with engineering and a pre-registered stop rule, directly test the stated requirement. Naming the onboarding squad lead as owner makes it actionable.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體且可驗證。為模式 B 拒絕群組與對照組建立每週完成率度量，配合與工程團隊確認合約及預先登記停止規則，直接測試聲明要求。列明開戶小組主管為負責人，令交接可行。

feedback.en: You correctly flagged the 9% survey response rate and the missing merchant identifiers in tickets, and kept claims inside the fictional scenario and the +9 point estimate. Adding that the dataset is synthetic and holds no payment or personal data would tighten the scope statement further.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出 9% 調查回應率及工單缺少商戶識別碼，並把聲明限於虛構情境及 +9 個百分點估算之內。若再補充資料屬虛構且不含付款或個人資料，範圍聲明會更嚴謹。

feedback.en: Clear, concise handover at 168 English words with decision, calculations, evidence, uncertainty and owner all present. A stakeholder could act on it without further reading.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰簡潔，共 168 個英文詞，決策、計算、證據、不確定性及負責人齊備，持份者毋須額外閱讀即可行動。

summary.en: Excellent submission. Every structured answer is correct and the written handover is fully consistent with the prioritisation policy, the funnel numbers and the merchant evidence. No material gaps were found across the five criteria.
summary.zh: 表現優異。所有結構化答案正確，書面交接與優先次序政策、漏斗數據及商戶證據完全一致。五項準則均未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: Extend the uncertainty note to state that the dataset is synthetic and contains no payment or personal data. If this were a live release, also confirm the validation contract fix owner and target date before the pre-registered stop rule is reviewed.
nextSteps.zh: 在不确定性說明中補充資料屬虛構且不含付款或個人資料。若為真實發佈，另需在檢視預先登記停止規則前，確認驗證合約修正的負責人及目標日期。

brief.en: You are the product manager for a fictional SHOPLINE Hong Kong inventory squad. Review the supplied synthetic merchant requests, inventory incident data with a reservation code sample, and prioritisation policy. Choose one inventory opportunity for the next release under the declared rule. The budget is a hard cap of HKD 150,000. Evidence quality must be high. Write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words. Include your decision, calculations, evidence, uncertainty and next checks. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE public commerce software context and is not endorsed by SHOPLINE.
brief.zh: 你是虛構的 SHOPLINE 香港庫存小組產品經理。請檢視提供的虛構商戶請求、載有預留代碼樣本的庫存事件數據及優先次序政策。根據聲明的規則，為下一個版本選擇一個庫存機會。預算為 HKD 150,000 的硬上限。證據質素必須為高。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據導向交接。包括決策、計算、證據、不確定性及下一步檢查。此為受 SHOPLINE 公開商貿軟件背景啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由 SHOPLINE 認可。

body.en: Fictional inventory request summary for the last 30 days. Among 340 surveyed merchants, 24 reported overselling after simultaneous online and in-store sales. 15 reported stock counts disagreeing between channels. 11 reported low-stock alerts firing after stock already reached zero. Survey response rate was 18 percent. Support tickets do not record merchant identifiers. No payment or personal data is included. Merchants describe stock updating only after a sale completes in the other channel.
body.zh: 過去 30 天的虛構庫存請求摘要。340 名受訪商戶中，24 名回報在網上及店內同時銷售後出現超賣。15 名回報不同渠道的庫存數量不一致。11 名回報低庫存警示在庫存已降至零後才發出。調查回應率為 18%。支援工單不記錄商戶識別碼。內容不包含付款或個人資料。商戶描述庫存僅在另一渠道的銷售完成後才更新。

title.en: Inventory incident data and candidate estimates
title.zh: 庫存事件數據及候選機會估算
虛構庫存優先次序政策

body.en: Fictional inventory prioritisation policy. Choose the opportunity with the highest estimated reduction in oversold orders per month among opportunities passing both gates. Gate 1: evidence quality must be high. Evidence quality is high only when at least two independent fictional sources agree on problem, impact and cause. Medium or low evidence is ineligible. Gate 2: one-time cost must not exceed the hard budget of HKD 150,000. If no opportunity passes both gates, select none. Ties break in favour of lower cost.
body.zh: 虛構庫存優先次序政策。在通過兩道門檻的機會中，選擇估計每月超賣訂單減幅最高者。門檻一：證據質素必須為高。只有當至少兩個獨立虛構來源就問題、影響及成因一致時，證據質素方為高。中或低證據不合資格。門檻二：一次性成本不得超過 HKD 150,000 的硬預算。若無機會通過兩道門檻，則不選擇任何項目。同分時以成本較低者優先。

You selected I1, which is the only opportunity passing both gates, and the figures 2,160 remaining oversold orders and HKD 54,000 remaining budget are right. The corrected reserveStock patch is the strongest part of the submission because the conditional $gte filter with $inc makes the check and decrement atomic.

title.zh: 結帳自動填寫試行決策

brief.en: SHOPLINE is a real commerce software company. This independent fictional learning simulation is not endorsed by SHOPLINE. You are a product manager reviewing a fictional checkout autofill pilot for Hong Kong merchants. Use only the charter, results and support notes. Decide whether to roll out, hold or stop the variant. Complete a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, about 100 to 180 words, with calculations, guardrail result, uncertainty and next steps.
brief.zh: SHOPLINE 是一間真實商貿軟件公司。這個獨立虛構學習模擬未獲 SHOPLINE 認可。你是產品經理，正審核一個為香港商戶而設的虛構結帳自動填寫試行。只使用章程、結果及支援備註。決定應推出、暫停還是停止變體。以英文或香港繁體中文完成簡潔且基於證據的交接，約一百至一百八十字，包含計算、限制指標結果、不確定性及下一步。

title.zh: 結帳自動填寫試行章程

body.en: Fictional pilot rules. Cohorts are unique assigned checkout sessions. Success metric is checkout completion rate, completed orders divided by assigned sessions. Success requires variant completion rate at least 1.5 percentage points above control and at least 8 percent relative lift. Guardrail 1 is checkout support contact rate, checkout-related support contacts within 7 days divided by completed orders. Maximum is 1.20 percent. Guardrail 2 is payment error rate, sessions with a payment error divided by assigned sessions. Maximum is 2.00 percent. If success is met but any guardrail is breached, hold rollout and investigate. If success and all guardrails are met, roll out. If success is not met, stop.
body.zh: 虛構試行規則。組別是唯一的已分配結帳工作階段。成功指標是結帳完成率，即已完成訂單除以已分配工作階段。成功要求變體完成率比對照組最少高 1.5 個百分點，且相對提升最少百分之八。限制指標一是結帳支援聯絡率，即七天內與結帳相關的支援聯絡除以已完成訂單。上限為百分之 1.20。限制指標二是付款錯誤率，即出現付款錯誤的工作階段除以已分配工作階段。上限為百分之 2.00。若成功達標但任何限制指標被違反，暫停推出並調查。若成功及所有限制指標達標，推出。若成功不達標，停止。

body.en: Fictional 10-day results. Control cohort has 10000 assigned checkout sessions, 3200 completed orders, 32 checkout-related support contacts within 7 days, and 150 sessions with a payment error. Variant cohort has 10000 assigned checkout sessions, 3520 completed orders, 55 checkout-related support contacts within 7 days, and 180 sessions with a payment error. Counts are unique. No other cohorts are used. All rates use the definitions in the charter.
body.zh: 虛構十天結果。對照組有 10000 個已分配結帳工作階段，3200 張已完成訂單，32 個七天內與結帳相關的支援聯絡，以及 150 個出現付款錯誤的工作階段。變體組有 10000 個已分配結帳工作階段，3520 張已完成訂單，55 個七天內與結帳相關的支援聯絡，以及 180 個出現付款錯誤的工作階段。所有數目均為唯一。沒有使用其他組別。所有比率均使用章程的定義。

body.en: Fictional support summary. Of 55 variant contacts, 30 ask how autofill stores card details, 15 ask how to remove a saved card, and 10 request payment retry. Of 32 control contacts, 25 ask how to remove a saved card and 7 request payment retry. Merchant mix is not fully recorded. The notes do not prove a cause. The 7-day support window matches the charter. Support operations can review ticket text before any rerun.
body.zh: 虛構支援摘要。55 個變體聯絡中，30 個詢問自動填寫如何儲存卡資料，15 個詢問如何移除已儲存卡，10 個要求付款重試。32 個對照聯絡中，25 個詢問如何移除已儲存卡，7 個要求付款重試。商戶組合未完全記錄。備註不證明原因。七天支援窗口與章程一致。支援營運可在重跑前檢視聯絡文字。

expectedEvidence.en: Hold rollout or equivalent. Variant completion is 3520 divided by 10000, equal to 35.2 percent. Control is 3200 divided by 10000, equal to 32.0 percent. Absolute lift is plus 3.2 percentage points and relative lift is 10.0 percent, so success is met. Variant support contact rate is 55 divided by 3520, equal to 1.5625 percent, above the 1.20 percent maximum, so a guardrail is breached and rollout must be held or stopped.
expectedEvidence.zh: 暫停推出或同等決定。變體完成率是 3520 除以 10000，等於百分之 35.2。對照組是 3200 除以 10000，等於百分之 32.0。絕對提升是加 3.2 個百分點，相對提升是百分之 10.0，因此成功達標。變體支援聯絡率是 55 除以 3520，等於百分之 1.5625，高於百分之 1.20 上限，因此限制指標被違反，必須暫停或停止推出。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source-one thresholds of 1.5 percentage points, 8 percent relative lift, 1.20 percent support maximum and 2.00 percent payment maximum. Uses source-two counts 10000, 3200, 3520, 32, 55, 150 and 180. Shows division and comparison. Notes payment error rate is 180 divided by 10000, equal to 1.80 percent, below the 2.00 percent maximum.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用文件一的門檻，即 1.5 個百分點、相對提升百分之八、支援上限百分之 1.20 及付款上限百分之 2.00。使用文件二的數目 10000、3200、3520、32、55、150 及 180。展示除法及比較。指出付款錯誤率是 180 除以 10000，等於百分之 1.80，低於百分之 2.00 上限。

exemplar.en: Decision: Hold rollout and investigate. Source-one says success requires at least 1.5 percentage points absolute lift and 8 percent relative lift. Source-two shows control completion is 3200 divided by 10000, equal to 32.0 percent. Variant completion is 3520 divided by 10000, equal to 35.2 percent. The absolute lift is plus 3.2 percentage points and relative lift is 10.0 percent, so success is met. The support contact guardrail failed. Variant contacts are 55 divided by 3520 completed orders, equal to 1.5625 percent, above the 1.20 percent maximum. Control is 32 divided by 3200, equal to 1.00 percent. Payment errors are 180 divided by 10000, equal to 1.80 percent, below the 2.00 percent maximum. Next steps: pause rollout, review the 55 variant contacts, segment the 30 card-storage questions and 15 saved-card removal questions, update autofill guidance, then rerun with the same thresholds. Uncertainty: merchant mix is not fully recorded and the support notes do not prove cause. Owner: Product Lead with Support Operations.
exemplar.zh: 決策：暫停推出並調查。文件一指出成功要求最少 1.5 個百分點絕對提升及百分之八相對提升。文件二顯示對照組完成率是 3200 除以 10000，等於百分之 32.0。變體完成率是 3520 除以 10000，等於百分之 35.2。絕對提升是加 3.2 個百分點，相對提升是百分之 10.0，因此成功達標。支援聯絡限制指標失敗。變體聯絡是 55 除以 3520 張已完成訂單，等於百分之 1.5625，高於百分之 1.20 上限。對照組是 32 除以 3200，等於百分之 1.00。付款錯誤是 180 除以 10000，等於百分之 1.80，低於百分之 2.00 上限。下一步：暫停推出，檢視 55 個變體聯絡，把 30 個卡資料儲存問題及 15 個移除已儲存卡問題分類，更新自動填寫指引，然後以相同門檻重跑。不確定性：商戶組合未完全記錄，支援備註不證明原因。負責人：產品主管聯同支援營運。

feedback.en: All selections and figures are correct. You report 35.2 percent variant completion against 32.0 percent control, a plus 3.2 point and 10.0 percent relative lift, and the 1.5625 percent support rate above the 1.20 percent maximum, so holding is right. Payment error at 1.80 percent stays under the 2.00 percent cap.
feedback.zh: 所有選項及數字均正確。你指出變體完成率百分之 35.2，對照組百分之 32.0，絕對提升 3.2 個百分點、相對提升百分之 10.0，而支援聯絡率百分之 1.5625 高於百分之 1.20 上限，因此暫停推出正確。付款錯誤率百分之 1.80 低於百分之 2.00 上限。

feedback.en: Strong linkage to source-one thresholds and source-two counts with the divisions shown, including the control support rate of 1.00 percent and the payment check. Adding the relative-lift comparison of 10.0 percent against the 8 percent rule explicitly would make the success test even clearer.
feedback.zh: 你有力連繫文件一門檻與文件二數目，並展示除法，包括對照組支援率百分之 1.00 及付款檢查。若明確寫出相對提升百分之 10.0 對比百分之八規則，成功判定會更清晰。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and consistent with the charter, covering the pause, reviewing the 55 contacts, segmenting 30 card-storage and 15 saved-card questions, guidance fixes, a same-threshold rerun and an owner. Naming the 10 payment-retry contacts would complete the segmentation.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體且符合章程，包括暫停、檢視 55 個聯絡、把 30 個卡資料儲存及 15 個移除已儲存卡問題分類、修正指引、以相同門檻重跑及列明負責人。若補上 10 個付款重試聯絡，分類就更完整。

feedback.en: You correctly note the merchant mix is not fully recorded and that support notes do not prove cause. Adding that the data are fictional and that only a 7-day support window exists would tighten the scope limits further.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出商戶組合未完全記錄，且支援備註不證明原因。若補充資料屬虛構及只提供七天支援窗口，範圍界定會更嚴謹。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable with decision, calculations, guardrail outcomes, uncertainty and a named owner. It reads cleanly at 171 English words and needs no restructuring.

Minor gaps are the omission of the 10 payment-retry contacts in segmentation and narrower scope wording about fictional data and the 7-day window.

nextSteps.zh: 在分類中加入 10 個付款重試聯絡，並在不確定性部分說明虛構資料及七天窗口限制。保留相同門檻重跑，以及產品主管聯同支援營運的負責安排。

title.zh: 補貨助手採用試行決策

brief.en: SHOPLINE is a real commerce software company. This independent fictional learning simulation is not endorsed by SHOPLINE. You are a product manager reviewing a fictional Reorder Assistant adoption pilot for Hong Kong merchants. Use only the charter, results and feedback notes. Decide whether to roll out, hold or stop the variant under the predeclared rules. Complete a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering calculations, the guardrail result, uncertainty and next steps.
brief.zh: SHOPLINE 是一間真實商貿軟件公司。這個獨立虛構學習模擬未獲 SHOPLINE 認可。你是產品經理，正審核一個為香港商戶而設的虛構補貨助手採用試行。只使用章程、結果及反饋備註。按預先聲明規則決定應推出、暫停還是停止變體。以英文或香港繁體中文完成簡潔且基於證據的交接，約一百至一百八十字，涵蓋計算、限制指標結果、不確定性及下一步。

body.en: Fictional pilot rules. Cohorts are unique merchants assigned to the Reorder Assistant pilot. Success metric is feature adoption rate: merchants who activate within 14 days divided by assigned merchants. Success requires variant adoption at least 4 percentage points above control and at least 12 percent relative lift. Guardrail 1 is 30-day active-use retention: merchants who use the feature in days 24 to 30 divided by merchants who activated. Minimum 35.00 percent. Guardrail 2 is feature support contact rate: feature-related support contacts divided by merchants who activated. Maximum 7.00 percent. If success is met but any guardrail is breached, hold rollout and investigate. If success and all guardrails are met, roll out. If success is not met, stop.
body.zh: 虛構試行規則。組別是唯一的已分配商戶，並獲分配至補貨助手試行。成功指標是功能採用率：十四天內啟用的商戶除以已分配商戶。成功要求變體採用率比對照組最少高 4 個百分點，且相對提升最少百分之十二。限制指標一是三十天活躍使用留存率：在第二十四至三十天使用功能的商戶除以已啟用功能的商戶。下限為百分之 35.00。限制指標二是功能支援聯絡率：與功能相關的支援聯絡除以已啟用功能的商戶。上限為百分之 7.00。若成功達標但任何限制指標被違反，暫停推出並調查。若成功及所有限制指標達標，推出。若成功不達標，停止。

body.en: Fictional 30-day results. Control cohort: 600 assigned merchants, 90 activated within 14 days, 42 of those activated merchants used the feature in days 24 to 30, and 4 feature-related support contacts were recorded. Variant cohort: 600 assigned merchants, 144 activated within 14 days, 45 of those activated merchants used the feature in days 24 to 30, and 9 feature-related support contacts were recorded. Counts are unique merchants and no other cohorts are used. All rates use the definitions in the charter.
body.zh: 虛構三十天結果。對照組：600 個已分配商戶，90 個在十四天內啟用，其中 42 個已啟用商戶在第二十四至三十天使用功能，並記錄了 4 個與功能相關的支援聯絡。變體組：600 個已分配商戶，144 個在十四天內啟用，其中 45 個已啟用商戶在第二十四至三十天使用功能，並記錄了 9 個與功能相關的支援聯絡。所有數目均為唯一商戶，沒有使用其他組別。所有比率均使用章程的定義。

body.en: Fictional feedback summary. Of 144 variant merchants who activated the feature, 30 reported that reorder suggestions appeared on a separate dashboard rather than the order screen. Of 90 control merchants who activated the feature, 12 reported the same placement. Merchant mix by plan tier is not fully recorded. These notes do not prove a cause for the retention difference. Support operations can review merchant feedback before any rerun. The 30-day window matches the charter.
body.zh: 虛構反饋摘要。144 個已啟用功能的變體商戶中，30 個報告補貨建議出現在獨立儀表板而非訂單畫面。90 個已啟用功能的對照組商戶中，12 個報告相同位置安排。按方案級別的商戶組合未完全記錄。這些備註不證明留存差異的原因。支援營運可在任何重跑前檢視商戶反饋。三十天窗口與章程一致。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Compare experiment results with predeclared success and guardrail metrics and recommend the next step.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按預先聲明的成功及限制指標比較實驗結果，並建議下一步。

expectedEvidence.en: Decision is hold rollout and investigate because success was met (variant adoption 24.0% versus control 15.0%, absolute lift 9.0 percentage points and relative lift 60.0%, above the 4 percentage point and 12 percent thresholds) but guardrail 1 was breached (variant retention 31.25% versus minimum 35.00%). Guardrail 2 was met (variant support contact rate 6.25% versus maximum 7.00%).
expectedEvidence.zh: 決策是暫停推出並調查，因為成功達標（變體採用率 24.0% 對比對照組 15.0%，絕對提升 9.0 個百分點，相對提升 60.0%，高於 4 個百分點及百分之十二門檻），但限制指標一被違反（變體留存率 31.25% 對比最低要求 35.00%）。限制指標二達標（變體支援聯絡率 6.25% 對比上限 7.00%）。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source-two counts: control 90/600 activated, variant 144/600 activated, control 42/90 retained, variant 45/144 retained, control 4 support contacts, variant 9 support contacts. Explains calculations: adoption rate is activated divided by assigned, retention rate is retained divided by activated, support contact rate is contacts divided by activated. Notes the source-three dashboard placement reports but states they do not prove cause.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用來源二數目：對照組 90/600 已啟用，變體 144/600 已啟用，對照組 42/90 已留存，變體 45/144 已留存，對照組 4 個支援聯絡，變體 9 個支援聯絡。解釋計算：採用率是已啟用除以已分配，留存率是已留存除以已啟用，支援聯絡率是聯絡除以已啟用。提及來源三的儀表板位置報告，但聲明這不證明原因。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes pausing rollout, inspecting variant merchant feedback, and segmenting the retention figures by plan tier, which source three says is not fully recorded. Proposes rechecking variant retention against the 35.00% minimum and the support contact rate against the 7.00% maximum before any further rollout decision. Does not assume a proven cause or an approved fix.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議暫停推出、檢查變體商戶反饋，並按方案級別分類留存數字，來源三指該組合未完全記錄。建議在任何進一步推出決定前，重新檢查變體留存率對比 35.00% 下限，以及支援聯絡率對比 7.00% 上限。不假設已證實原因或已批准修正。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that plan-tier mix is not fully recorded and that the dashboard placement notes do not prove a cause for the retention gap. States conclusions are limited to the fictional pilot data and the charter thresholds. Does not claim the retention gap is explained or that the pilot result generalises beyond the supplied 600-merchant cohorts.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認方案級別組合未完全記錄，儀表板位置備註不證明留存差距的原因。聲明結論僅限於虛構試行資料及章程門檻。不聲稱留存差距已獲解釋，亦不聲稱試行結果可推廣至所提供 600 個商戶組別以外。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover is concise and structured with decision, calculations, guardrail result, uncertainty and next steps. Names an owner such as the product manager coordinating with support operations, and states a clear escalation route to engineering if the retention investigation requires data or instrumentation checks.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接簡潔且有結構，包含決策、計算、限制指標結果、不確定性及下一步。列明負責人，例如產品經理與支援營運協調，並說明若留存調查需要資料或埋點檢查，可清晰轉交工程團隊。

exemplar.en: Decision: hold rollout and investigate. The variant met the success metric. Adoption was 24.0% (144/600) versus control 15.0% (90/600), an absolute lift of 9.0 percentage points and a relative lift of 60.0%, above the charter thresholds of 4 percentage points and 12%. However, guardrail 1 is breached: variant 30-day active-use retention is 31.25% (45/144), below the 35.00% minimum. Control retention is 46.67% (42/90). Guardrail 2 is met: variant support contact rate is 6.25% (9/144), below the 7.00% maximum. Source three reports a dashboard placement difference but plan-tier mix is incomplete and placement is not proven to cause the retention gap. Next steps: pause rollout, inspect variant feedback, and segment retention by plan tier before rechecking both guardrails. Owner: product manager with support operations, escalating to engineering if the retention investigation needs instrumentation checks.
exemplar.zh: 決策：暫停推出並調查。變體達到成功指標。採用率為 24.0%（144/600），對照組為 15.0%（90/600），絕對提升 9.0 個百分點，相對提升 60.0%，高於章程門檻的 4 個百分點及百分之十二。然而，限制指標一被違反：變體三十天活躍使用留存率為 31.25%（45/144），低於 35.00% 下限。對照組留存率為 46.67%（42/90）。限制指標二達標：變體支援聯絡率為 6.25%（9/144），低於 7.00% 上限。來源三報告儀表板位置差異，但方案級別組合未完整，且位置安排不證明導致留存差距。下一步：暫停推出，檢查變體反饋，並按方案級別分類留存後再重新檢查兩項限制指標。負責人：產品經理與支援營運，若留存調查需要埋點檢查則轉交工程團隊。

feedback.en: All four selections are correct: hold and investigate, variant adoption 24.0%, variant retention 31.25%, and retention as the breached guardrail. Your comparison shows success met with a 9.0 percentage point absolute lift and 60.0% relative lift against thresholds of 4 points and 12%, and guardrail 2 met at 6.25% against the 7.00% maximum.
feedback.zh: 四項選擇全部正確：暫停並調查、變體採用率 24.0%、變體留存率 31.25%，以及被違反的是留存限制指標。你指出成功達標，絕對提升 9.0 個百分點及相對提升 60.0%，高於 4 個百分點及百分之十二門檻，而限制指標二以 6.25% 對比 7.00% 上限達標。

feedback.en: You anchor every rate to the source-two counts, showing activated divided by assigned for adoption and retained divided by activated for retention, and you include the control figures 15.0% and 46.67%. You also cite the source-three dashboard placement reports while noting they do not prove a cause.
feedback.zh: 你把每個比率連繫至來源二的數目，說明採用率為已啟用除以已分配、留存率為已留存除以已啟用，並列出對照組 15.0% 及 46.67%。你亦引用來源三的儀表板位置報告，同時指出這不證明原因。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and charter-consistent: pause rollout, inspect variant feedback, segment retention by plan tier, then recheck both guardrails before any further decision. Naming the engineering escalation for instrumentation checks adds a useful verification route.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體且符合章程：暫停推出、檢查變體反饋、按方案級別分類留存，並在進一步決定前重新檢查兩項限制指標。提出若需埋點檢查則轉交工程團隊，增加了有用的核實途徑。

feedback.en: You correctly flag that plan-tier mix is incomplete and that the dashboard placement difference is not a proven cause of the retention gap. The conclusion stays within the fictional 600-merchant cohorts and the charter thresholds.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出方案級別組合未完整，並說明儀表板位置差異並非留存差距的已證實原因。結論亦限於虛構的 600 個商戶組別及章程門檻之內。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 147 English words and follows the decision, calculations, guardrail, uncertainty and next-step structure. It names the product manager coordinating with support operations and gives a clear escalation to engineering.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，共 147 個英文詞，並依決策、計算、限制指標、不確定性及下一步的結構編排。內容列明產品經理與支援營運協調，並清楚說明轉交工程團隊的路徑。

summary.en: A complete and accurate submission. All selections and computed rates match the charter definitions, the hold-and-investigate decision is correctly justified by the breached retention guardrail, and the handover is well bounded and actionable at 147 words.
summary.zh: 提交完整且準確。所有選擇及計算比率均符合章程定義，暫停並調查的決策因留存限制指標被違反而獲正確支持，交接在 147 個英文詞內界線清晰且可行。

nextSteps.en: Keep the same structure in future experiments and add a short note on what a rerun would need, such as a fixed dashboard placement or a larger sample, so the retention question can be answered rather than only flagged.
nextSteps.zh: 日後實驗可沿用相同結構，並簡短補充重跑所需條件，例如固定儀表板位置或擴大樣本，讓留存問題能真正獲得解答，而不只是被指出。

title.en: Tiered subtotal discount: acceptance and rollout handover
title.zh: 分級小計折扣：接納要求及推出交接

brief.en: Fictional independent simulation inspired by SHOPLINE, not an official company policy or release. You are covering for the product manager on the Tiered Subtotal Discount pilot. Read source-approved-brief, source-pricing-helper and source-pilot-notes. Deliver a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese: state acceptance criteria with inclusive boundary tests, decide whether to expand the pilot, list the exact code corrections you would request, and name missing evidence. Target 100 to 180 words. No code execution and no real rollout.
brief.zh: 本練習為受 SHOPLINE 啟發的虛構獨立模擬，並非官方公司政策或發布。你暫代產品經理，負責分級小計折扣試行。請閱讀 source-approved-brief、source-pricing-helper 及 source-pilot-notes。以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔交接：列明含邊界（含等號）的接納準則、決定是否擴大試行、列出你會要求的具體程式修正，並指出欠缺的證據。目標 100 至 180 字。不執行程式，亦不作真實推出。

title.en: Approved feature brief: tiered subtotal discounts
title.zh: 已批准功能簡介：分級小計折扣

body.en: Fictional learning brief. Independent SHOPLINE-inspired simulation, not an official SHOPLINE policy or release. Feature: Tiered Subtotal Discounts in the merchant admin. Tiers use cart subtotal in HKD with inclusive thresholds. Tier 1 starts at HKD 500, 5 percent, cap HKD 60. Tier 2 starts at HKD 1,200, 8 percent, cap HKD 150. Tier 3 starts at HKD 2,500, 12 percent, cap HKD 400. Only the highest qualifying tier applies. Tiers never stack with coupon codes in this release. Discounts apply to subtotal only, never to shipping. The cap is the maximum discount in HKD. Rollout: three pilot merchants only. No general release without acceptance sign-off.
body.zh: 虛構學習簡介。SHOPLINE 啟發的獨立模擬，並非官方 SHOPLINE 政策或發布。功能：商戶後台的分級小計折扣。分級以港幣購物車小計計算，門檻包含等號。第 1 級由港幣 500 起，5%，上限港幣 60。第 2 級由港幣 1,200 起，8%，上限港幣 150。第 3 級由港幣 2,500 起，12%，上限港幣 400。只適用符合資格中最高一級。本版本不與優惠碼疊加。折扣只適用於小計，永不適用於運費。上限為港幣最高折扣額。推出：僅三家試行商戶。未經接納簽核不得全面推出。

title.en: Pricing helper contract and current code
title.zh: 定價輔助程式合約與現行程式

body.en: Fictional pilot reports, week of 3 March. Merchant P-104 (homeware) reports a cart with subtotal exactly HKD 1,200 received a discount of HKD 60, while the storefront banner promised 8 percent. Merchant P-311 (stationery) reports a cart with subtotal exactly HKD 500 received no discount, although the published rule says discounts start from HKD 500. Merchant P-207 (snacks) reports a cart with subtotal HKD 4,000 received HKD 60, far below the promised 12 percent cap of HKD 400. All three merchants are live in the pilot. No coupon or shipping complaints were filed.
body.zh: 虛構試行報告，3 月 3 日該週。商戶 P-104（家居用品）報告小計剛好港幣 1,200 的購物車只獲港幣 60 折扣，但店面橫幅承諾 8%。商戶 P-311（文具）報告小計剛好港幣 500 的購物車未獲任何折扣，但公布規則列明折扣由港幣 500 起。商戶 P-207（零食）報告小計港幣 4,000 的購物車只獲港幣 60，遠低於承諾的 12% 上限港幣 400。三家商戶均在試行中。未收到優惠碼或運費相關投訴。

label.en: A cart with subtotal HKD 1,200 and no coupon. What discount should the corrected engine award, in HKD?
label.zh: 小計為港幣 1,200 且無優惠碼的購物車。修正後的引擎應給予多少港幣折扣？

label.en: A cart with subtotal HKD 4,000 and no coupon. What discount should the corrected engine award, in HKD?
label.zh: 小計為港幣 4,000 且無優惠碼的購物車。修正後的引擎應給予多少港幣折扣？

label.en: Which pilot report is direct evidence that the inclusive threshold rule is broken?
label.zh: 哪一份試行報告直接證明「門檻包含等號」規則已被破壞？

label.en: P-104, the HKD 1,200 cart receiving HKD 60
label.zh: P-104，港幣 1,200 購物車獲港幣 60

label.en: P-207, the HKD 4,000 cart receiving HKD 60
label.zh: P-207，港幣 4,000 購物車獲港幣 60

label.en: P-311, the HKD 500 cart receiving no discount
label.zh: P-311，港幣 500 購物車未獲折扣

label.en: No pilot report shows this failure
label.zh: 沒有試行報告顯示此失效

label.en: Which changes are required to satisfy the stated contract? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 為符合所述合約，哪些改動是必需的？請選出所有適用者。

label.en: Compare subtotal with >= against the tier minimum
label.zh: 以小計與分級下限比較時使用 >=

label.en: Select the highest qualifying tier instead of the first match
label.zh: 選取符合資格中最高一級，而非第一個符合項

label.en: Raise the tier 1 cap above HKD 60
label.zh: 把第 1 級上限提高至高於港幣 60

label.en: Round the discount up to whole HKD
label.zh: 把折扣向上取整至整數港幣

label.en: Given the supplied evidence, what should the product manager decide now?
label.zh: 根據提供證據，產品經理現時應作何決定？

label.en: Expand to all merchants this week
Hold expansion, fix the helper, re-run boundary tests, then re-pilot
label.zh: 暫停擴大，修正輔助程式，重跑邊界測試，然後重新試行

label.en: Release generally and document the cap behaviour
label.zh: 全面推出並把上限行為記錄在文件
移除第 3 級並全面推出

expectedEvidence.en: Awards 96 HKD at exactly HKD 1,200 (tier 2, 8 percent of 1,200 = 96, under the 150 cap). Awards 400 HKD at HKD 4,000 (12 percent = 480, capped at 400). Identifies P-311 (HKD 500 cart, no discount) as the inclusive-threshold failure. Requires the >= comparison and highest-qualifying-tier selection. Decides to hold pilot expansion.
expectedEvidence.zh: 在剛好港幣 1,200 時給予 96 港幣（第 2 級，1,200 的 8% = 96，低於 150 上限）。在港幣 4,000 時給予 400 港幣（12% = 480，以 400 為上限）。指出 P-311（港幣 500 購物車無折扣）為門檻含等號失效。要求使用 >= 比較並選取最高符合資格級別。決定暫停擴大試行。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source-approved-brief for tiers, inclusive thresholds, cap rule, no coupon stacking and three-merchant pilot. Cites source-pricing-helper contract line plus the > comparison defect and the find returning the lowest tier. Cites source-pilot-notes amounts of 60, 0 and 60 HKD and explains 8 percent of 1,200 = 96 and that 12 percent of 4,000 = 480, capped at 400.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 source-approved-brief 的分級、含等號門檻、上限規則、不與優惠碼疊加及三家商戶試行。引用 source-pricing-helper 的合約條文，以及 > 比較缺陷與 find 回傳最低級別。引用 source-pilot-notes 的 60、0 及 60 港幣，並解釋 1,200 的 8% = 96，以及 4,000 的 12% = 480 而以上限 400 計算。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes boundary tests at exactly 500, 1,200 and 2,500 plus just below 499, 1,199 and 2,499, a cap-binding case at 4,000, a coupon non-stacking check, a shipping exclusion check, and admin tier preview checks. Suggests re-piloting with P-104, P-207 and P-311 before acceptance sign-off.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出在剛好 500、1,200 及 2,500，以及略低於的 499、1,199 及 2,499 的邊界測試，一個觸及上限的 4,000 案例，優惠碼不疊加檢查，運費排除檢查，以及後台分級預覽檢查。建議在接納簽核前以 P-104、P-207 及 P-311 重新試行。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Notes that only three pilot merchants are live, that there is no coupon, shipping or non-HKD market evidence, that no general release is authorised, and that the case is a fictional simulation not endorsed by SHOPLINE.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出僅三家試行商戶在線、沒有優惠碼、運費或非港幣市場的證據、未獲授權全面推出，以及本案例為未經 SHOPLINE 認可的虛構模擬。
