expectedEvidence.en: Correctly applies QE-24 and returns Grade C, because independence is not established: both summaries draw on production lot L7, neither states a separate sampling frame, and the records do not state non-overlapping test units. States that the 22 total samples meet the Grade B sample count but Grade B also needs two independent studies. Correctly computes mean difference 150 cycles (2100 minus 1950) and threshold margin 50 cycles (1850 minus 1800). Concludes provisional status inconclusive.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確應用 QE-24 並得出 C 級，因為獨立性未確立：兩份摘要均取自生產批次 L7、均未說明獨立抽樣框，且紀錄未說明非重疊測試單元。指出 22 個總樣本符合 B 級樣本數量，但 B 級亦需兩項獨立研究。正確計算平均差異 150 次循環（2100 減 1950）及門檻差距 50 次循環（1850 減 1800）。結論為暫定狀態不確定。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites specific records: S1 has 8 samples from lot L7, mean 1950, no confidence interval and no separate sampling frame. S2 has 14 samples from lot L7, mean 2100, 95 percent confidence interval 1850 to 2350, and no separate sampling frame. States that both records omit non-overlapping test units, so the QE-24 independence test fails on lot overlap plus unestablished frames and units. States that shared calibration record TR-3 neither proves nor disproves independence. Notes S1 lacks uncertainty so its lower bound is unknown and cannot support a pass.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用具體紀錄：S1 有 8 個樣本取自批次 L7、平均值 1950、沒有置信區間、沒有獨立抽樣框。S2 有 14 個樣本取自批次 L7、平均值 2100、95% 置信區間 1850 至 2350，亦沒有獨立抽樣框。指出兩份紀錄均未說明非重疊測試單元，故 QE-24 獨立性測試因批次重疊及抽樣框與單元未確立而不通過。指出共用校準紀錄 TR-3 既不證明亦不否定獨立性。指出 S1 欠缺不確定性，其下限未知，不能支持通過。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks: request the missing 95 percent confidence interval for S1, confirm whether each summary used a separate sampling frame and non-overlapping test units, and verify how calibration record TR-3 applies. States that adding a single further study to S1 and S2 cannot yield three independent groups, because S1 and S2 already share lot L7. Proposes three wholly new independent summaries, each with a separate sampling frame, a distinct production lot, non-overlapping units and a reported 95 percent confidence interval, totalling at least 40 samples, before any Grade A claim.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查：要求 S1 欠缺的 95% 置信區間、確認每份摘要是否採用獨立抽樣框及非重疊測試單元，並核實校準紀錄 TR-3 的適用方式。指出在 S1 及 S2 之上再加一項研究不能得出三組獨立數據，因為 S1 及 S2 已共用批次 L7。提出三份全新獨立摘要，每份具備獨立抽樣框、不同生產批次、非重疊單元及所報告的 95% 置信區間，合計至少 40 個樣本，方可提出 A 級聲明。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions. States explicitly that no real certification or product decision is made and that no health or product performance claim is asserted. States that unproven independence and the missing S1 confidence interval prevent any conclusion stronger than inconclusive, and avoids inferring independence from sample count or from the shared calibration record.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。明確說明不作出真實認證或產品決定，亦不主張健康或產品性能結論。指出獨立性未獲證明及 S1 欠缺置信區間，令結論不能強於不確定，並避免僅憑樣本數量或共用校準紀錄推斷獨立性。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Provides a concise handover of about 100 to 180 words in English or Traditional Chinese with clear sections for evidence, decision and calculations, risks and next steps. States evidence grade C and provisional status inconclusive, gives the 150-cycle mean difference and the 50-cycle threshold margin, and names a specific owner or escalation route, for example requesting the S1 confidence interval and frame details from the S1 record owner or escalating the independence gap to team lead Ada Cheung.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提供約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接（英文或香港繁體中文），清楚分段列出證據、決策與計算、風險及下一步。說明證據級別為 C 級、暫定狀態為不確定，列出 150 次循環的平均差異及 50 次循環的門檻差距，並列明具體負責人或轉交途徑，例如向 S1 紀錄負責人要求 S1 置信區間及抽樣框資料，或把獨立性缺口轉交團隊主管 Ada Cheung。

exemplar.en: Evidence: S1 covers 8 samples from lot L7, mean 1950 cycles, no confidence interval and no separate sampling frame. S2 covers 14 samples from lot L7, mean 2100 cycles, 95 percent confidence interval 1850 to 2350, and no separate sampling frame. Neither record states non-overlapping test units, so independence is not established. Shared calibration record TR-3 neither proves nor disproves independence. Decision: Grade C, because Grade B needs at least two independent studies even though the 22 samples meet the sample count. Mean difference is 2100 minus 1950 equals 150 cycles. The S2 lower bound exceeds the 1800-cycle threshold by 1850 minus 1800 equals 50 cycles. Status is inconclusive because independence is unproven and S1 reports no interval. This is a fictional exercise, so no real certification or product decision is made and no health or performance claim is asserted. Risks: shared lot L7 and missing S1 uncertainty. Next steps: I will request the S1 interval and the frame details needed to check how TR-3 applies from the S1 record owner, and escalate the independence gap to team lead Ada Cheung. Adding one further study cannot give three independent groups because S1 and S2 already share lot L7. Three wholly new independent summaries are needed, each with a separate sampling frame, a distinct lot, non-overlapping units and a reported 95 percent confidence interval, totalling at least 40 samples.
exemplar.zh: 證據：S1 涵蓋批次 L7 的 8 個樣本，平均值 1950 次循環，沒有置信區間，也沒有獨立抽樣框。S2 涵蓋批次 L7 的 14 個樣本，平均值 2100 次循環，95% 置信區間 1850 至 2350，亦沒有獨立抽樣框。兩份紀錄均未說明非重疊測試單元，因此獨立性未確立。共用校準紀錄 TR-3 既不證明亦不否定獨立性。決策：C 級，因為即使 22 個樣本符合樣本數量，B 級仍要求至少兩項獨立研究。平均差異為 2100 減 1950 等於 150 次循環。S2 下限超出 1800 次循環門檻，即 1850 減 1800 等於 50 次循環。狀態為不確定，因為獨立性未獲證明且 S1 沒有報告置信區間。此為虛構練習，不作出真實認證或產品決定，亦不主張健康或性能結論。風險：共用批次 L7 及 S1 欠缺不確定性。下一步：我會向 S1 紀錄負責人要求 S1 置信區間及用以核實 TR-3 適用方式的抽樣框資料，並把獨立性缺口轉交團隊主管 Ada Cheung。在 S1 及 S2 之上再加一項研究不能得出三組獨立數據，因為兩者已共用批次 L7。需要三份全新獨立摘要，各具獨立抽樣框、不同批次、非重疊單元及所報告的 95% 置信區間，合計至少 40 個樣本。

feedback.en: All decisions and calculations are correct. You properly assigned Grade C because independence is not established, noted that 22 samples meet the count but not the independence requirement, computed 150 cycles and 50 cycles, and concluded inconclusive.
feedback.zh: 所有決策及計算均正確。你正確評定為 C 級，因為獨立性未確立，並指出 22 個樣本符合數量但不符合獨立性要求，計算出 150 次循環及 50 次循環，結論為不確定。

feedback.en: Your reasoning cites the key records clearly, including S1 and S2 sample counts, means, the S2 interval, shared lot L7, missing separate sampling frames and non-overlapping units, and TR-3. You also correctly explain that S1 lacks an interval and cannot support a pass.
feedback.zh: 你的推理清楚引用關鍵紀錄，包括 S1 及 S2 的樣本數、平均值、S2 置信區間、共用批次 L7、欠缺獨立抽樣框及非重疊單元，以及 TR-3。你亦正確解釋 S1 欠缺置信區間，不能支持通過。

feedback.en: The next steps are concrete and useful. You request the S1 interval and frame details, escalate the independence gap to Ada Cheung, and specify three new independent summaries with 40 total samples for any Grade A claim.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體且有用。你要求 S1 置信區間及抽樣框資料，把獨立性缺口轉交 Ada Cheung，並指明任何 A 級聲明需要三份全新獨立摘要及合計至少 40 個樣本。

feedback.en: You limit the conclusion to the fictional scenario and state that no real certification or product decision is made. You also correctly avoid claiming independence from sample count or from shared calibration record TR-3.
feedback.zh: 你把結論限於虛構情境，並說明不作出真實認證或產品決定。你亦正確避免僅憑樣本數量或共用校準紀錄 TR-3 推斷獨立性。

feedback.en: The handover is complete and actionable at 228 English words, with evidence, decision, calculations, risks and next steps. It names a specific owner and escalation route, so the slightly longer length does not reduce clarity or usefulness.
feedback.zh: 交接完整且可行，以 228 個英文字撰寫，包含證據、決策、計算、風險及下一步。它列明具體負責人及轉交途徑，因此篇幅稍長並無降低清晰度或實用性。

summary.en: All five criteria are fully met. The submission correctly applies memo QE-24, gives Grade C and inconclusive status, supports every answer with supplied records, and provides clear verification actions.
summary.zh: 五項準則均完全達到。提交正確應用備忘錄 QE-24，得出 C 級及不確定狀態，以提供紀錄支持每項答案，並提出清晰的核實行動。

nextSteps.en: No further remediation is required. Keep the same evidence-linked structure in future handovers, and ensure any later pass claim rests on genuinely independent studies with reported intervals.
nextSteps.zh: 無需進一步補救。日後交接可保持相同的證據連結結構，並確保任何日後的通過聲明均建基於真正獨立且已報告置信區間的研究。

title.zh: 合成兩組測試紀錄可比性審查

brief.en: You are supporting a fictional STC-inspired record review. A synthetic record set RS-26 compares Supplier A and Supplier B recycled PET sheet elongation in percent. The groups are unequal and Group B calibration expired before its records were taken. Review the records and rules, decide whether the comparison is comparable, compute the recorded mean difference, list the violated conditions, and propose a proportionate revision. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by the STC public profile. It is not endorsed by STC and is not a real certification decision.
brief.zh: 你正支援一項受 STC 公開資料啟發的虛構紀錄審查。合成紀錄集 RS-26 比較供應商 A 與供應商 B 的回收 PET 片材伸長率，以百分比計。兩組數量不等，且 B 組校準在其紀錄產生前已經過期。請檢視紀錄及規則，判斷該比較是否具可比性，計算記錄平均差，列出所違反的條件，並提出合乎比例的修訂。請以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔且基於證據的交接。此為受 STC 公開資料啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲 STC 認可，亦非真實認證決定。

body.en: Fictional internal record set RS-26 for paper review only. Group A (Supplier A): 10 specimens, parameter version P-3, system S1, operator OP-12, calibration current to 2026-12-31, records taken 2026-03-02. Values in percent: 118, 122, 120, 119, 121, 123, 117, 120, 122, 118. Group B (Supplier B): 4 specimens, parameter version P-3, system S2, operator OP-07, calibration expired 2026-02-28, records taken 2026-03-05. Values in percent: 126, 130, 128, 132. Both groups were filed as one fictional comparison.
body.zh: 僅供文件審查的虛構內部紀錄集 RS-26。A 組（供應商 A）：10 個樣本，參數版本 P-3，系統 S1，操作員 OP-12，校準有效至 2026-12-31，紀錄日期 2026-03-02。數值以百分比計：118、122、120、119、121、123、117、120、122、118。B 組（供應商 B）：4 個樣本，參數版本 P-3，系統 S2，操作員 OP-07，校準已於 2026-02-28 過期，紀錄日期 2026-03-05。數值以百分比計：126、130、128、132。兩組被歸入同一虛構比較。

title.en: Comparability and sampling rules for synthetic record review
title.zh: 合成紀錄審查的可比性及抽樣規則

body.en: Fictional rules for this exercise only. A two group comparison is comparable only when each group has at least 8 valid specimens, every equipment calibration status is current at the time the record was taken, and the same parameter version is used. A record taken while calibration is expired is invalid and contributes zero valid specimens. The recorded mean difference is mean(B) minus mean(A) in percentage points. If a group holds fewer than 8 valid specimens, mark the comparison not comparable and add valid specimens under current calibration and the same parameter version. Do not pool groups into one mean.
body.zh: 僅供本練習使用的虛構規則。兩組比較僅在每組有至少 8 個有效樣本、每項設備校準於紀錄產生時屬現行有效，以及使用相同參數版本時，方具可比性。在校準過期期間產生的紀錄屬無效，並計為零個有效樣本。記錄平均差為 B 組平均減 A 組平均，以百分點計。若某組少於 8 個有效樣本，須標示該比較不具可比性，並在現行校準及相同參數版本下補足有效樣本。不得把各組合併為一個平均值。

title.en: Handover request from fictional review desk

body.en: Prepare a short written handover for the fictional review desk. State whether the two group comparison is comparable, give the recorded mean difference computed from the recorded values, identify the sampling limitation and the calibration issue, and propose a proportionate revision. Keep claims within the synthetic records and the supplied rules. Send the handover to the fictional review desk by the end of the exercise. Do not treat this as a real certification decision.
body.zh: 請為虛構審查台準備簡短書面交接。說明該兩組比較是否具可比性，根據紀錄數值給出記錄平均差，指出抽樣限制及校準問題，並提出合乎比例的修訂。所有主張須限於合成紀錄及提供的規則。請於練習結束前把交接送交虛構審查台。不得把此事視為真實認證決定。

label.en: Which statement best describes comparability under the supplied rules?
label.zh: 根據提供的規則，哪項陳述最能描述可比性？

label.en: Comparable because both groups use parameter version P-3
label.zh: 具可比性，因為兩組均使用參數版本 P-3

label.en: Not comparable because all four Group B records were taken under expired calibration and are invalid, leaving zero valid specimens
label.zh: 不具可比性，因為 B 組全部 4 個紀錄均在校準過期期間產生而屬無效，導致零個有效樣本

label.en: Comparable because Group B has 4 specimens
label.zh: 具可比性，因為 B 組有 4 個樣本

label.en: Not comparable only because the group sizes differ
label.zh: 僅因兩組樣本數不同而不具可比性

label.en: Which two conditions are violated by the supplied record set?
label.zh: 提供的紀錄集違反哪兩項條件？

label.en: Group A size is below the minimum
label.zh: A 組樣本數低於最低要求

label.en: Group B has zero valid specimens, below the minimum of 8
label.zh: B 組有零個有效樣本，低於最低 8 個

label.en: Group B calibration was expired when its records were taken
label.zh: B 組紀錄產生時校準已過期

label.en: Recorded mean difference computed from the recorded values, mean(B) minus mean(A), in percentage points
label.zh: 根據紀錄數值計算的記錄平均差，即 B 組平均減 A 組平均，以百分點計

label.en: Minimum number of additional valid specimens needed for Group B to reach the minimum group size of 8 valid specimens
label.zh: B 組為達到最低組別要求 8 個有效樣本所需的最少額外有效樣本數

label.en: Which revised plan is proportionate and consistent with the supplied rules?
label.zh: 哪項修訂計劃合乎比例並符合提供的規則？

label.en: Report the 9.0 percentage point difference as the final comparison
label.zh: 把 9.0 個百分點差距報告為最終比較結果

label.en: Add at least 8 valid specimens to Group B under current calibration and parameter version P-3, then recalculate
label.zh: 在現行校準及參數版本 P-3 下為 B 組增加至少 8 個有效樣本，然後重新計算

label.en: Pool all 14 specimens into one mean
label.zh: 把全部 14 個樣本合併為一個平均值

label.en: Discard Group A and test 8 new specimens from both groups
label.zh: 捨棄 A 組並從兩組重新測試 8 個新樣本

about.en: Hong Kong Standards and Testing Centre describes itself as an independent, not-for-profit testing, inspection and certification organisation established in 1963.
about.zh: 香港標準及檢定中心介紹其為成立於 1963 年的獨立非牟利測試、檢驗及認證機構。

simulationStyle.en: Inspect synthetic sample records and quality-control results on paper. Interpret supplied criteria and document uncertainty. No chemicals, organisms or real certification decisions are involved.
simulationStyle.zh: 在文件上檢視合成樣本紀錄及品質控制結果，解讀提供的標準並記錄不確定性，不涉及化學品、生物或真實認證決策。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Review a synthetic documentary study plan for comparability, sampling limitations and a proportionate revision.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。審查合成文件研究計劃的可比較性、抽樣限制及合比例修訂。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Review a synthetic documentary study plan for comparability, sampling limitations and a proportionate revision.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。審查合成文件研究計劃的可比較性、抽樣限制及合比例修訂。

expectedEvidence.en: Q1 correct value: not-comparable-b-no-valid-records. Q2 correct array: group-b-valid-size-below-minimum and group-b-calibration-expired. Q3 correct numeric answer: 9.0. Q4 correct numeric answer: 8. Q5 correct value: add-8-valid-specimens-and-recalculate. Rules applied: minimum 8 valid specimens per group, calibration must be current when the record is taken, same parameter version P-3. Group B records were taken 2026-03-05 while calibration expired 2026-02-28, so all four Group B records are invalid and Group B has zero valid specimens. Group A mean is 120.0 percent (1200 divided by 10). Group B recorded mean is 129.0 percent (516 divided by 4). Recorded mean difference is 9.0 percentage points. Group B needs 8 additional valid specimens to reach 8 valid specimens.
expectedEvidence.zh: 第 1 題正確值：not-comparable-b-no-valid-records。第 2 題正確陣列：group-b-valid-size-below-minimum 及 group-b-calibration-expired。第 3 題正確數值：9.0。第 4 題正確數值：8。第 5 題正確值：add-8-valid-specimens-and-recalculate。應用的規則：每組至少 8 個有效樣本、紀錄產生時校準須現行有效、相同參數版本 P-3。B 組紀錄日期為 2026-03-05，而校準已於 2026-02-28 過期，故 B 組全部 4 個紀錄均無效，B 組有效樣本為零。A 組平均為 120.0%（1200 除以 10）。B 組紀錄平均為 129.0%（516 除以 4）。記錄平均差為 9.0 個百分點。B 組需再增加 8 個有效樣本才達 8 個有效樣本。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Learner cites record set RS-26 values, the calibration dates (Group B expired 2026-02-28, records taken 2026-03-05, Group A current to 2026-12-31), parameter version P-3, and the rule document. Shows arithmetic: Group A sum 1200 and mean 120.0 percent. Group B recorded sum 516 and recorded mean 129.0 percent. Recorded difference 9.0 percentage points. Connects the failure to zero valid Group B specimens and expired calibration. States that the 9.0 figure is arithmetic only and not a final comparable estimate.
expectedEvidence.zh: 學習者引用紀錄集 RS-26 的數值、校準日期（B 組於 2026-02-28 過期、紀錄日期 2026-03-05，A 組有效至 2026-12-31）、參數版本 P-3 及規則文件。展示算術：A 組總和 1200，平均 120.0%。B 組紀錄總和 516，紀錄平均 129.0%。記錄差距為 9.0 個百分點。把失敗連結至 B 組零個有效樣本及校準過期。說明 9.0 這個數值僅屬算術結果，並非最終可比估計。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Concrete checks: confirm Group B calibration is current before any new records are taken. Confirm added specimens use parameter version P-3. Add at least 8 valid specimens to Group B so it reaches 8 valid specimens. Recalculate Group B mean and mean(B) minus mean(A) after new records. Keep groups separate and do not pool all 14 specimens. Escalate to the fictional review desk if calibration cannot be confirmed.
expectedEvidence.zh: 具體檢查：在產生任何新紀錄前確認 B 組校準現行有效。確認新增樣本使用參數版本 P-3。為 B 組增加至少 8 個有效樣本，使其達到 8 個有效樣本。新增紀錄後重新計算 B 組平均及 B 組平均減 A 組平均。保持各組獨立，不得把全部 14 個樣本合併。如無法確認校準，升級至虛構審查台。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States that this is a synthetic exercise with fictional records and not a real certification decision. Acknowledges that Group B recorded values are arithmetic only because calibration was expired, so Group B contributes zero valid specimens. Does not claim a confirmed product difference or real compliance. Limits conclusions to RS-26 and the supplied rules.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明此為合成練習及虛構紀錄，並非真實認證決定。承認 B 組紀錄數值僅屬算術結果，因校準過期，B 組不提供任何有效樣本。不得聲稱已確認產品差異或真實合規。把結論限於 RS-26 及提供的規則。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover states decision not comparable, evidence from RS-26 and the rules, calculation 129.0 minus 120.0 equals 9.0 percentage points from invalid records, sampling limitation of zero valid Group B specimens below the minimum 8, calibration issue expired 2026-02-28 against records taken 2026-03-05, and next action to add at least 8 valid specimens under current calibration and parameter version P-3. Names the fictional review desk as recipient or escalation point.
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接說明決策為不具可比性，引用 RS-26 及規則的證據，計算為 129.0 減 120.0 等於 9.0 個百分點且來自無效紀錄，抽樣限制為 B 組有效樣本為零並低於最低 8 個，校準問題為 2026-02-28 過期而紀錄日期為 2026-03-05，下一步為在現行校準及參數版本 P-3 下增加至少 8 個有效樣本。列明虛構審查台為收件人或升級點。

exemplar.en: Decision: the synthetic two group comparison RS-26 is not comparable. All four Group B records were taken on 2026-03-05 while Group B calibration expired on 2026-02-28, and the supplied rules treat records taken under expired calibration as invalid. Group B therefore has zero valid specimens. Evidence: Group A has 10 valid specimens under current calibration and parameter version P-3. Group A mean is 120.0 percent (1200 divided by 10). Group B recorded values give a recorded mean of 129.0 percent (516 divided by 4) and a recorded difference of 9.0 percentage points, but that figure is arithmetic only and cannot support a comparison. Next steps: add at least 8 valid specimens to Group B under current calibration and parameter version P-3, then recalculate both means and the difference. Keep groups separate. Escalate to the fictional review desk if calibration cannot be confirmed. No real certification decision is made.
exemplar.zh: 決策：合成兩組比較 RS-26 不具可比性。B 組全部 4 個紀錄均於 2026-03-05 產生，而 B 組校準已於 2026-02-28 過期，提供的規則視在校準過期期間產生的紀錄為無效。因此 B 組有效樣本為零。證據：A 組有 10 個有效樣本，校準現行有效，參數版本 P-3。A 組平均為 120.0%（1200 除以 10）。B 組紀錄數值的紀錄平均為 129.0%（516 除以 4），記錄差距為 9.0 個百分點，但該數值僅屬算術結果，不能支持比較結論。下一步：在現行校準及參數版本 P-3 下為 B 組增加至少 8 個有效樣本，然後重新計算兩個平均值及差距。保持各組獨立。如無法確認校準，升級至虛構審查台。本練習不作真實認證決定。

feedback.en: All five responses are correct. You correctly ruled the comparison not comparable because all four Group B records were taken on 2026-03-05 under calibration that expired 2026-02-28, leaving zero valid specimens, and gave mean difference 9.0 percentage points and 8 additional specimens.
feedback.zh: 五項作答全部正確。你正確判定比較不具可比性，因 B 組全部 4 個紀錄均於 2026-03-05 產生，而校準已於 2026-02-28 過期，導致零個有效樣本，並給出記錄平均差 9.0 個百分點及需補 8 個有效樣本。

feedback.en: You anchored the decision in RS-26 specifics including the calibration dates, Group A current to 2026-12-31, parameter version P-3, and both sums (1200 and 516) with their means. You also correctly flagged the 9.0 figure as arithmetic only and not a comparable estimate.
feedback.zh: 你把決策連結至 RS-26 的具體細節，包括校準日期、A 組有效至 2026-12-31、參數版本 P-3，以及兩個總和（1200 及 516）與其平均值。你亦正確指出 9.0 僅屬算術結果，並非可比估計。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and proportionate: add at least 8 valid specimens to Group B under current calibration and P-3, recalculate both means and the difference, keep groups separate, and escalate if calibration cannot be confirmed. Naming a check of the Group B calibration status before new records are taken would make the verification sequence even more explicit.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體且合比例：在現行校準及 P-3 下為 B 組增加至少 8 個有效樣本、重新計算兩個平均及差距、保持各組獨立，並在無法確認校準時升級。若在產生新紀錄前先明確檢查 B 組校準狀態，核實次序會更清晰。

feedback.en: You limited claims to the supplied rules, noted the Group B figures are arithmetic only, and stated no real certification decision is made. Adding that this is a synthetic fictional exercise would complete the scope caveat.
feedback.zh: 你把聲明限於提供的規則，指出 B 組數值僅屬算術結果，並說明不作真實認證決定。若補充此為合成虛構練習，範圍說明會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable with decision, evidence, calculation, sampling and calibration issues, and next steps, and it names the fictional review desk as escalation point. Explicitly labelling the review desk as recipient would strengthen the routing detail.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，包含決策、證據、計算、抽樣及校準問題與下一步，並列明虛構審查台為升級點。若明確標示審查台為收件人，傳遞細節會更強。

summary.en: Strong, accurate submission with all decisions and calculations correct and clear use of RS-26 evidence. Only minor scope and routing details could be tightened.
summary.zh: 表現出色且準確，所有決策及計算均正確，並清晰運用 RS-26 證據。僅範圍及傳遞細節可稍作補充。

nextSteps.en: Add a brief line confirming this is a synthetic fictional exercise limited to RS-26, and name the fictional review desk explicitly as the handover recipient before routing. Keep the current calculation and evidence structure.
nextSteps.zh: 補充一句確認此為僅限 RS-26 的合成虛構練習，並在傳遞前明確列明虛構審查台為交接收件人。保留現有的計算及證據結構。

title.en: Synthetic historical report review with a changed measurement definition
title.zh: 量測定義變更下的合成歷史報告審查

brief.en: You are supporting a fictional STC-inspired documentary review. Synthetic historical record set HR-47 contains two groups. Group A used measurement definition D1. Group B used measurement definition D2. Calibration was current for all records. Review the records and supplied rules, decide whether the comparison is comparable, compute the recorded mean difference, identify the definition and sampling limitations, and propose a proportionate revision. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by the STC public profile. It is not endorsed by STC and is not a real certification decision. No real testing or certification decision is involved.
brief.zh: 你正支援一項受 STC 公開資料啟發的虛構文件審查。合成歷史紀錄集 HR-47 包含兩組。A 組使用量測定義 D1。B 組使用量測定義 D2。所有紀錄產生時校準均為現行有效。請檢視紀錄及提供的規則，判斷該比較是否具可比性，計算記錄平均差，指出定義及抽樣限制，並提出合乎比例的修訂。請以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔且基於證據的交接。此為受 STC 公開資料啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲 STC 認可，亦非真實認證決定。不涉及真實測試或認證決定。

body.en: Fictional internal record set HR-47 for paper review only. Group A used measurement definition D1. It has 8 valid records taken with equipment E1 and current calibration. Values in retention points: 84, 86, 82, 88, 85, 87, 83, 89. Group B used measurement definition D2. It has 4 valid records taken with equipment E2 and current calibration. Values in retention points: 80, 84, 82, 84. The two groups were filed as one historical comparison. No real testing is involved.
body.zh: 僅供文件審查的虛構內部紀錄集 HR-47。A 組使用量測定義 D1。該組有 8 個有效紀錄，使用設備 E1，校準屬現行有效。數值以留存點計：84、86、82、88、85、87、83、89。B 組使用量測定義 D2。該組有 4 個有效紀錄，使用設備 E2，校準屬現行有效。數值以留存點計：80、84、82、84。兩組被歸入同一歷史比較。不涉及真實測試。

title.en: Comparability and sampling rules for synthetic historical review
title.zh: 合成歷史審查的可比性及抽樣規則

body.en: Fictional rules for this exercise only. A two group historical comparison is comparable only when both groups use the same measurement definition version and each group has at least 8 comparable valid records. Calibration must be current at the time each record was taken. A record under a different measurement definition version is not comparable with the other group and contributes zero comparable records. The recorded mean difference is mean of Group B minus mean of Group A in retention points. If a group has fewer than 8 comparable valid records, mark the comparison not comparable and add valid records under the same measurement definition version. Do not pool groups into one mean.
body.zh: 僅供本練習使用的虛構規則。兩組歷史比較僅在兩組使用相同量測定義版本，且每組至少有 8 個可比有效紀錄時，方具可比性。每項紀錄產生時，校準須屬現行有效。在另一量測定義版本下產生的紀錄與另一組不具可比性，並計為零個可比紀錄。記錄平均差為 B 組平均減 A 組平均，以留存點計。若某組少於 8 個可比有效紀錄，須標示該比較不具可比性，並在相同量測定義版本下補足有效紀錄。不得把各組合併為一個平均值。

title.en: Handover request from fictional review desk

body.en: Prepare a short written handover for the fictional review desk. State whether the two group historical comparison is comparable. Give the recorded mean difference computed from the recorded values. Identify the measurement definition issue and the sampling limitation. Propose a proportionate revision. Keep claims within the synthetic records and the supplied rules. Send the handover to the fictional review desk by the end of the exercise. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by the STC public profile. It is not endorsed by STC and is not a real certification decision.
body.zh: 請為虛構審查台準備簡短書面交接。說明該兩組歷史比較是否具可比性。根據紀錄數值給出記錄平均差。指出量測定義問題及抽樣限制。提出合乎比例的修訂。所有主張須限於合成紀錄及提供的規則。請於練習結束前把交接送交虛構審查台。此為受 STC 公開資料啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲 STC 認可，亦非真實認證決定。

label.en: Which statement best describes comparability under the supplied rules?
label.zh: 根據提供的規則，哪項陳述最能描述可比性？

label.en: Comparable because calibration was current for all records
label.zh: 具可比性，因為所有紀錄的校準均屬現行有效

label.en: Not comparable because the measurement definition versions differ and Group B has fewer than 8 comparable valid records
label.zh: 不具可比性，因為量測定義版本不同，且 B 組少於 8 個可比有效紀錄

label.en: Comparable because Group A has 8 valid records
label.zh: 具可比性，因為 A 組有 8 個有效紀錄

label.en: Not comparable only because different equipment was used
label.zh: 僅因使用不同設備而不具可比性

label.en: Which two conditions are violated by the supplied record set?
label.zh: 提供的紀錄集違反哪兩項條件？

label.en: Group B has fewer than 8 comparable valid records
label.zh: B 組少於 8 個可比有效紀錄

label.en: Calibration was expired when records were taken
label.zh: 紀錄產生時校準已過期

label.en: Group A size is below the minimum
label.zh: A 組紀錄數低於最低要求

label.en: Recorded mean difference, mean(B) minus mean(A), in retention points
label.zh: 記錄平均差，即 B 組平均減 A 組平均，以留存點計

label.en: Minimum number of additional comparable valid records needed for Group B to reach the minimum group size of 8
label.zh: B 組為達到最低組別要求 8 個可比有效紀錄所需的最少額外可比有效紀錄數

label.en: Which revised plan is proportionate and consistent with the supplied rules?
label.zh: 哪項修訂計劃合乎比例並符合提供的規則？

label.en: Report the minus 3.0 retention point difference as the final comparison
label.zh: 把負 3.0 留存點差距報告為最終比較結果

label.en: Add at least 8 valid Group B records under measurement definition D1 and current calibration, then recalculate
label.zh: 在量測定義 D1 及現行校準下為 B 組增加至少 8 個有效紀錄，然後重新計算

label.en: Pool all 12 records into one mean
label.zh: 把全部 12 個紀錄合併為一個平均值

label.en: Discard Group A and use only Group B records
label.zh: 捨棄 A 組並只使用 B 組紀錄

expectedEvidence.en: Marks the comparison not comparable because measurement definition versions differ and Group B has fewer than 8 comparable valid records. Identifies the two violated conditions as definition version differs and Group B comparable size is below the minimum. Computes Group A mean 85.5 retention points, Group B mean 82.5 retention points, and recorded mean difference minus 3.0 retention points. States that at least 8 additional comparable valid records are needed for Group B under definition D1.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把該比較標示為不具可比性，因為量測定義版本不同，且 B 組少於 8 個可比有效紀錄。指出兩項違反條件為定義版本不同，以及 B 組可比紀錄數低於最低要求。計算 A 組平均 85.5 留存點，B 組平均 82.5 留存點，記錄平均差為負 3.0 留存點。說明 B 組須在定義 D1 下增加至少 8 個額外可比有效紀錄。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites source one Group A values 84, 86, 82, 88, 85, 87, 83, 89 and Group B values 80, 84, 82, 84. Explains 684 divided by 8 equals 85.5 and 330 divided by 4 equals 82.5. Explains 82.5 minus 85.5 equals minus 3.0. Links the decision to source two rules on same measurement definition version, minimum 8 comparable valid records, and zero comparable records for a different definition version.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用文件一 A 組數值 84、86、82、88、85、87、83、89，以及 B 組數值 80、84、82、84。解釋 684 除以 8 等於 85.5，330 除以 4 等於 82.5。解釋 82.5 減 85.5 等於負 3.0。把決策連結至文件二關於相同量測定義版本、最少 8 個可比有效紀錄，以及不同定義版本計為零個可比紀錄的規則。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checking measurement definition version fields for both groups, confirming calibration status at each record time, confirming the minimum 8 comparable valid records, and recalculating Group A and Group B means after adding Group B records under D1. States that groups must not be pooled.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出檢查兩組的量測定義版本欄位，確認每項紀錄產生時的校準狀態，確認最少 8 個可比有效紀錄，並在 D1 下為 B 組增加紀錄後重新計算 A 組及 B 組平均值。說明不得把各組合併。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States that the review is synthetic and not a real certification decision. Notes that the recorded mean difference is informational only because the groups are not comparable. Avoids claiming that D2 values can be converted to D1 without a supplied conversion rule. Keeps conclusions within HR-47 and the fictional rules.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明此審查為合成練習，並非真實認證決定。指出記錄平均差僅供參考，因為兩組不具可比性。避免聲稱在沒有提供換算規則下可把 D2 數值換算為 D1。把結論限於 HR-47 及虛構規則之內。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover for the fictional review desk with a clear comparability decision, the mean difference calculation, the definition and sampling limitations, the proportionate revision to add at least 8 Group B records under D1, and relevant next checks. Uses English or Traditional Chinese.
expectedEvidence.zh: 為虛構審查台撰寫簡潔交接，列明清晰的可比性決定、平均差計算、定義及抽樣限制、在 D1 下為 B 組增加至少 8 個紀錄的合比例修訂，以及相關下一步檢查。使用英文或香港繁體中文。

exemplar.en: Decision. The HR-47 two group comparison is not comparable. Source two requires the same measurement definition version and at least 8 comparable valid records per group. Group A has 8 valid D1 records from source one. Group B has 4 D2 records, so it has zero comparable records under D1. The definition version and group size conditions are therefore violated. Calculation. Group A mean is 684 divided by 8, which is 85.5 retention points. Group B mean is 330 divided by 4, which is 82.5 retention points. The recorded mean difference, Group B minus Group A, is minus 3.0 retention points. This value is informational only because the groups are not comparable. Revision. Add at least 8 valid Group B records under D1 and current calibration, then recalculate. Do not pool the groups. Verification. Check definition version fields, calibration records, the 8 record minimum, and recalculate both means. This is a synthetic review and not a certification decision.
exemplar.zh: 決策。HR-47 的兩組比較不具可比性。文件二要求兩組使用相同量測定義版本，且每組至少有 8 個可比有效紀錄。文件一的 A 組有 8 個有效 D1 紀錄。B 組有 4 個 D2 紀錄，因此在 D1 下為零個可比紀錄。定義版本及組別數量條件均被違反。計算。A 組平均值為 684 除以 8，即 85.5 留存點。B 組平均值為 330 除以 4，即 82.5 留存點。記錄平均差為 B 組減 A 組，即負 3.0 留存點。此數值僅供參考，因為兩組不具可比性。修訂。在 D1 及現行校準下為 B 組增加至少 8 個有效紀錄，然後重新計算。不得把各組合併。核實。檢查定義版本欄位、校準紀錄、最少 8 個紀錄的規定，並重新計算兩組平均值。此為合成審查，並非認證決定。

feedback.en: All decisions and calculations are correct. You correctly labelled the comparison not comparable, identified the differing definition versions and the Group B shortfall below 8 comparable records, gave minus 3.0 retention points, and required at least 8 additional D1 records for Group B.
feedback.zh: 所有決定及計算均正確。你正確地把比較標示為不具可比性，指出定義版本不同及 B 組可比紀錄不足 8 個，給出負 3.0 留存點，並要求 B 組在 D1 下至少增加 8 個紀錄。

feedback.en: Strong linkage between the supplied records and your conclusions. You cited the Group A and Group B values, showed 684/8 = 85.5 and 330/4 = 82.5, and tied the decision to the same-version and minimum-8 rules in source two.
feedback.zh: 你有力地把提供記錄連繫至結論。你引用 A 組及 B 組數值，展示 684/8 = 85.5 及 330/4 = 82.5，並把決定連繫至文件二的相同版本及最少 8 個紀錄規則。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and testable: checking definition version fields, calibration records and the 8-record minimum, then recalculating both means. You also correctly stated that groups must not be pooled.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體可驗證：檢查定義版本欄位、校準紀錄及最少 8 個紀錄，然後重新計算兩組平均值。你亦正確指出不得把各組合併。

feedback.en: You correctly framed the mean difference as informational only and noted this is a synthetic review rather than a certification decision. You avoided claiming unsupported D2-to-D1 conversion.
feedback.zh: 你正確地把平均差界定為僅供參考，並指出此為合成審查而非認證決定。你亦避免聲稱可在缺乏規則下把 D2 換算為 D1。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable for the fictional review desk, covering the decision, calculation, revision and verification within the suggested length guidance. Escalation to the review desk is implied by the framing.
feedback.zh: 交接對虛構審查台而言簡潔可行，在建議長度範圍內涵蓋決定、計算、修訂及核實。整體框架已隱含把事項轉交審查台。

summary.en: Excellent submission. Every structured answer matches the supplied rules, and the written handover gives correct means, mean difference, both violated conditions, the proportionate revision and scope limits.
summary.zh: 表現出色。所有結構化答案均符合提供的規則，書面交接亦給出正確平均值、平均差、兩項違反條件、合比例修訂及範圍限制。

nextSteps.en: No correction needed. For future tasks you could briefly note which specific records would be re-verified first, but the current evidence and reasoning are complete.
nextSteps.zh: 無須更正。日後可簡略說明會優先重新核實哪些具體紀錄，但現時證據及推理已屬完整。

title.zh: 分析非預期服務帳戶存取

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE. Not endorsed by SHOPLINE. All records, policies and staff are fictional. You are a security analyst on a 20-minute paper triage. A monitoring alert, P1-2026-1012, reports unexpected service-account access in the commerce platform. Review the fictional standard, access log and shift-lead message. Decide what the logs confirm, what remains suspicion and what bounded containment follows policy. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese for the security lead. Do not execute code or contact merchants.
brief.zh: 本學習模擬以 SHOPLINE 為靈感，並非由 SHOPLINE 認可。所有記錄、政策及員工均為虛構。你是資訊保安分析師，須在 20 分鐘內完成紙本分析。監控警報 P1-2026-1012 指商貿平台出現非預期服務帳戶存取。請查閱虛構標準、存取日誌及值班主管訊息。判斷日誌已確認的事實、仍屬疑點的事項，以及符合政策的有限度遏止措施。為保安主管準備簡潔的實證交接，可用英文或香港繁體中文。不要執行程式碼或聯絡商戶。

title.zh: 虛構服務帳戶存取標準

body.en: Simulation assumption. This fictional standard applies only to the commerce platform in this exercise. Service accounts must authenticate only from allowlist 10.20.30.0/24. Normal read-only actions are GET /catalog/items between 01:00 and 03:00 HKT. Admin actions such as POST /admin/merchant/export and POST /admin/token/rotate are restricted, require an approved change ticket and two-person approval. New API key creation outside a change window is a P1 suspected compromise. Containment for P1: revoke active sessions and disable new keys, preserve logs, notify the security lead within 15 minutes. Do not notify merchants until compromise is confirmed.
body.zh: 模擬假設。本虛構標準只適用於本練習的商貿平台。服務帳戶只可從允許清單 10.20.30.0/24 驗證。正常唯讀操作為 01:00 至 03:00 HKT 的 GET /catalog/items。管理操作如 POST /admin/merchant/export 及 POST /admin/token/rotate 受限制，須有已批准變更單及雙人批准。在變更窗口外建立新 API 金鑰屬 P1 懷疑入侵。P1 遏止措施：撤銷現有工作階段及停用新金鑰、保留日誌、15 分鐘內通知保安主管。在確認入侵前不要通知商戶。

label.en: The source IP 203.0.113.77 is outside allowlist 10.20.30.0/24.

label.en: The alert was generated at 05:02 HKT.

exemplar.en: Handover for P1-2026-1012. Confirmed from the fictional log: service account svc-shopline-catalog-sync authenticated from 203.0.113.77 at 04:17 HKT, outside allowlist 10.20.30.0/24. It ran POST /admin/merchant/export and returned 312 records, then POST /admin/token/rotate created new key KEY-8842, then ran POST /admin/merchant/export and returned 120 more records. Total exported from that IP is 312 plus 120 equals 432. The 01:05, 01:07 and 02:30 calls from 10.20.30.12 match the read-only baseline and the 01:00 to 03:00 HKT window. Suspicion remains: credential compromise, insider misuse or deployment misconfiguration. Containment per fictional standard: revoke active sessions, disable KEY-8842, preserve logs, notify security lead within 15 minutes. Next checks: review identity provider and API gateway logs for KEY-8842 after 04:19, check change tickets, confirm endpoint owner for 203.0.113.77. Do not notify merchants until compromise is confirmed. Owner: Ada Wong, Security Shift Lead.

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE. Not endorsed by SHOPLINE. All records, policies and staff are fictional. You are a security analyst on a 20-minute paper triage. A monitoring alert, P2-2026-1105, reports a failed-login burst for account merchant_admin_4412. Review the fictional standard, synthetic log and shift-lead message. Decide what the logs confirm, what remains suspicion and what bounded containment follows policy. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese for the security lead. Do not execute code or contact merchants.
brief.zh: 本學習模擬以 SHOPLINE 為靈感，並非由 SHOPLINE 認可。所有記錄、政策及員工均為虛構。你是資訊保安分析師，須在 20 分鐘內完成紙本分析。監控警報 P2-2026-1105 指帳戶 merchant_admin_4412 出現失敗登入爆發。請查閱虛構標準、合成日誌及值班主管訊息。判斷日誌已確認的事實、仍屬疑點的事項，以及符合政策的有限度遏止措施。為保安主管準備簡潔的實證交接，可用英文或香港繁體中文。不要執行程式碼或聯絡商戶。

body.en: Simulation assumption. This fictional standard applies only to the commerce platform in this exercise. A failed-login burst is 20 or more failed authentication attempts for the same account within 10 minutes. Bursts from a single source IP are P1 suspected credential attack. Bursts from multiple source IPs with incomplete user-agent data are P2 suspected credential stuffing. P1 containment: lock the targeted account, block the source IP, preserve logs, notify the security lead within 15 minutes. P2 containment: add rate limiting, require multi-factor authentication for the targeted account, preserve logs, notify the security lead within 60 minutes. Do not notify merchants until compromise is confirmed. Confirmed facts are only what logs record. Attribution is incomplete when source IP is shared, proxied, or missing user agent.
body.zh: 模擬假設。本虛構標準只適用於本練習的商貿平台。失敗登入爆發指同一帳戶在 10 分鐘內有 20 次或以上失敗驗證嘗試。單一來源 IP 的爆發屬 P1 懷疑憑證攻擊。多個來源 IP 且用戶代理資料不完整屬 P2 懷疑憑證填充。P1 遏止：鎖定目標帳戶、封鎖來源 IP、保留日誌、15 分鐘內通知保安主管。P2 遏止：加入速率限制、為目標帳戶要求多重認證、保留日誌、60 分鐘內通知保安主管。在確認入侵前不要通知商戶。已確認事實僅限日誌記錄。當來源 IP 共享、經代理或缺少用戶代理時，歸因屬不完整。

title.zh: 合成失敗登入日誌摘錄

body.en: Simulation record. All entries are fictional. Time range 03:02 to 03:05 HKT on 2026-11-05. Account merchant_admin_4412 had 22 failed login attempts. Source 198.51.100.23 contributed 15 failed attempts with user-agent missing. Source 203.0.113.45 contributed 7 failed attempts with user-agent missing. No successful authentication for this account during the window. Alert P2-2026-1105 generated at 03:12 HKT.
body.zh: 模擬記錄。所有條目均為虛構。時間範圍為 2026-11-05 03:02 至 03:05 HKT。帳戶 merchant_admin_4412 有 22 次失敗登入嘗試。來源 198.51.100.23 佔 15 次失敗嘗試，用戶代理缺失。來源 203.0.113.45 佔 7 次失敗嘗試，用戶代理缺失。該時段內此帳戶沒有成功驗證。警報 P2-2026-1105 於 03:12 HKT 產生。

body.en: Simulation message. From: Priya Nair, Security Operations Lead. At 03:12 HKT monitoring raised P2-2026-1105 for account merchant_admin_4412 after a failed-login burst. Triage on paper in 20 minutes. Confirm only what logs prove. State what remains suspicion. Recommend bounded containment that follows the fictional standard. Prepare a 100 to 180 word handover in English or Traditional Chinese for the security lead. Do not contact merchants yet.
body.zh: 模擬訊息。寄件者：Priya Nair，保安運作主管。03:12 HKT 監控就帳戶 merchant_admin_4412 的失敗登入爆發發出 P2-2026-1105。你有 20 分鐘進行紙本分析。只確認日誌可證明的事項。說明仍屬疑點的事項。建議符合虛構標準的有限度遏止措施。為保安主管準備 100 至 180 字的交接，可用英文或香港繁體中文。暫時不要聯絡商戶。

body.en: Policy IR-7: Data exposure severity: Critical if >=1000 records; High if 500-999; Medium if 100-499; Low if <100. For High or Critical: notify affected merchants within 24 hours, preserve all logs for 180 days, revoke exposed access within 1 hour of detection, assign incident owner from Security team. Recovery checks: confirm access revoked, verify no further access for 72 hours, document evidence gaps. Incident owner must produce handover within 4 hours.

exemplar.en:
Incident handover: accidental merchant order data exposure
On 2026-10-12, an internal share link for 'merchant_orders_2026-10-10.csv' was created at 09:14 with 'anyone with link can view' permission. It was accessed by eng-204 at 09:22. Merchant Success lead detected exposure at 09:47, and the link was revoked at 10:05. 842 merchant records were exposed. Severity is High per IR-7 (500-999 records). Required actions: notify affected merchants within 24 hours, preserve logs 180 days, verify no further access for 72 hours. Access was revoked within 51 minutes, meeting the 1-hour requirement. Incident owner: Security analyst. Evidence gaps: post-revocation access log missing, external access logs not retained, no DLP alert. Next steps: enable logging, monitor 72 hours, send merchant notifications, document gaps. This is a fictional simulation, not endorsed by SHOPLINE.

feedback.en: All five answers are correct: severity High (842 records falls in the 500-999 band of IR-7), the five required actions chosen with no extras, 51 minutes elapsed, post-revocation access log as the limiting gap, and Security analyst as incident owner. feedback.en: You tie severity to the 842-record count and the IR-7 threshold, derive 51 minutes from the 09:14 and 10:05 timestamps, and cite the evidence register for the missing post-revocation log plus the unretained external logs and absent DLP alert. brief.en: You are a security analyst at SHOPLINE (fictional simulation, not endorsed). A synthetic token revocation incident occurred on 2026-11-06. Review the supplied token audit log, policy IR-9, and evidence register. Write a concise evidence-based handover (suggested 100-180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese) in English or Traditional Chinese. Include a factual timeline, severity classification, required actions, evidence gaps, owners, and proportionate recovery checks. Answer the multiple-choice and number questions. All records are fictional learning assumptions.

Audit logs for token usage between 2026-11-05 15:00 and 2026-11-06 08:00 are missing due to audit pipeline failure.

title.zh: 事故應變政策 IR-9（虛構）

body.en: Policy IR-9: Token revocation incident severity based on merchant records accessed. Critical if 500 or more records. High if 100 to 499. Medium if 10 to 99. Low if fewer than 10. For High or Critical, required actions: notify affected merchants within 24 hours, preserve all logs for 180 days, revoke token within 1 hour of detection, assign incident owner from Security team, and perform recovery checks: confirm token revoked, verify no further access for 72 hours, document evidence gaps. Incident owner must produce handover within 4 hours.
body.zh: 政策 IR-9：權杖撤銷事故的嚴重程度基於存取的商戶記錄數量。500 筆或以上為嚴重。100 至 499 為高。10 至 99 為中。少於 10 為低。對於高或嚴重，所需行動：於 24 小時內通知受影響商戶、保留所有日誌 180 天、於偵測後 1 小時內撤銷權杖、從資訊保安團隊指派事故負責人，並執行復原檢查：確認權杖已撤銷、核實 72 小時內無進一步存取、記錄證據缺口。事故負責人必須於 4 小時內提交交接。

body.en: Evidence register: 1. Token creation log: available. 2. Token usage log until 2026-11-05 15:00 HKT: available. 3. Token usage log after 2026-11-05 15:00 HKT until 2026-11-06 08:00 HKT: missing (audit pipeline failure). 4. Token usage log after 2026-11-06 08:00 HKT: available. 5. Post-revocation access log: available. 6. External access logs: not retained. 7. Data loss prevention alert: none. 8. Token revocation confirmation: available. 9. Access review record: last reviewed 2026-10-15.
body.zh: 證據登記冊：1. 權杖建立日誌：可用。2. 2026-11-05 15:00 HKT 之前的權杖使用日誌：可用。3. 2026-11-05 15:00 HKT 之後至 2026-11-06 08:00 HKT 期間的權杖使用日誌：缺失（審計管道故障）。4. 2026-11-06 08:00 HKT 之後的權杖使用日誌：可用。5. 撤銷後存取日誌：可用。6. 外部存取日誌：未保留。7. 資料外洩防護警報：無。8. 權杖撤銷確認：可用。9. 存取審查記錄：上次審查於 2026-10-15。

exemplar.en: Incident handover: Token revocation (IR-9). Timeline: 2026-11-05 08:00 token created; 14:30 exported 620 merchant records; 2026-11-06 08:30 detected; 09:00 revoked. Severity: Critical (620 >= 500). Required actions: notify affected merchants within 24h, preserve logs 180 days, revoke within 1h (done in 30 min), assign Security owner, verify no access for 72h. Evidence gaps: token usage logs missing from 2026-11-05 15:00 to 2026-11-06 08:00 (17 hours); external logs not retained; no DLP alert. Recovery checks: confirm revocation, monitor access logs for 72h, document missing coverage. Owner: Security analyst. Next: notify merchants, preserve logs, produce handover.
exemplar.zh: 事故交接：權杖撤銷（IR-9）。時間線：2026-11-05 08:00 權杖建立；14:30 匯出 620 個商戶記錄；2026-11-06 08:30 偵測；09:00 撤銷。嚴重程度：嚴重（620 >= 500）。所需行動：於 24 小時內通知受影響商戶、保留日誌 180 天、於 1 小時內撤銷（已於 30 分鐘內完成）、指派資訊保安負責人、核實 72 小時內無存取。證據缺口：2026-11-05 15:00 至 2026-11-06 08:00 期間的權杖使用日誌缺失（17 小時）；外部日誌未保留；無資料外洩防護警報。復原檢查：確認撤銷、監控存取日誌 72 小時、記錄缺失覆蓋。負責人：資訊保安分析師。下一步：通知商戶、保留日誌、提交交接。

title.zh: 商戶支援最少權限矩陣（虛構）

body.en: Fictional policy for this simulation only. Effective 2026-10-01. Scope covers four support roles. support-tier1 may use view_merchant_profile and view_orders. support-tier2 may also use issue_refund. support-lead may also use edit_merchant_profile and view_payouts. billing-specialist may use view_merchant_profile, view_orders and view_payouts. No role in scope may use edit_payouts, export_customer_data or manage_users. Any profile with an extra permission must have that permission removed before renewal.

body.en: Simulated export. Account A, role support-tier1, permissions: view_merchant_profile, view_orders, edit_payouts. Account B, role support-tier2, permissions: view_merchant_profile, view_orders, issue_refund, export_customer_data, manage_users. Account C, role support-lead, permissions: view_merchant_profile, view_orders, issue_refund, edit_merchant_profile, view_payouts, edit_payouts. body.en: From: Ada Wong, fictional support operations lead. Please complete a taster access review for four accounts. Compare each profile to the matrix effective 2026-10-01. Count every assigned permission that the role matrix does not allow. For each over-permission, name the account and permission. Propose only removals that restore the matrix. State any missing evidence. Send a concise handover by end of day. This simulation is not an official SHOPLINE policy.
body.zh: 寄件人：Ada Wong，虛構支援營運主管。請為四個帳戶完成一次入門存取審查。將每個設定檔對照 2026-10-01 生效的矩陣。計算每個角色矩陣不允許的已指派權限。每項超額權限須列明帳戶及權限。只提出可回復矩陣的移除項目。說明任何欠缺證據。於今日完結前提交簡潔交接。此模擬並非正式 SHOPLINE 政策。

expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 source-export 中各帳戶的紀錄及 source-matrix 規則。解釋 support-tier2 允許 view_merchant_profile、view_orders 及 issue_refund，因此 B 的兩項額外權限為 export_customer_data 及 manage_users。使用矩陣禁止清單 edit_payouts、export_customer_data 及 manage_users 計算超額。展示 A 1 加 B 2 加 C 1 加 D 1 等於 5 的總計。

exemplar.en: Handover for fictional SHOPLINE merchant support access review. Matrix effective 2026-10-01. Account B has the largest excess, it holds export_customer_data and manage_users beyond support-tier2. Remove both. Account A holds edit_payouts which no matrix role allows, remove it. Account C holds edit_payouts beyond support-lead, remove only edit_payouts. Account D holds export_customer_data beyond billing-specialist, remove it. Total excess assignments are 5, calculated as A 1, B 2, C 1, D 1. Evidence is the fictional permission export and matrix. Missing evidence includes assignment dates and approval records. Next steps: re-export after removals, compare each account to matrix, and confirm no account retains edit_payouts, export_customer_data, or manage_users. Escalate to Ada Wong if a removed permission is still needed for a documented support task.
exemplar.zh: 虛構 SHOPLINE 商戶支援存取審查交接。矩陣生效日為 2026-10-01。帳戶 B 超額最多，持有超出 support-tier2 的 export_customer_data 及 manage_users。兩者均須移除。帳戶 A 持有矩陣任何角色均不允許的 edit_payouts，須移除。帳戶 C 持有超出 support-lead 的 edit_payouts，只須移除 edit_payouts。帳戶 D 持有超出 billing-specialist 的 export_customer_data，須移除。超額指派總數為 5，計算為 A 1、B 2、C 1、D 1。證據為虛構權限匯出及矩陣。欠缺證據包括指派日期及審批紀錄。下一步：移除後重新匯出，逐一對照矩陣，確認沒有帳戶保留 edit_payouts、export_customer_data 或 manage_users。如移除權限仍為有文件支援的支援工作需要，轉交 Ada Wong。

feedback.en: All five decisions are correct. You identify Account B as the largest excess with export_customer_data and manage_users, remove edit_payouts from A and C, remove export_customer_data from D, and total 5. Your removals restore the matrix with no unnecessary role changes.
feedback.zh: 五項決策全部正確。你指出帳戶 B 超額最多，持有 export_customer_data 及 manage_users；帳戶 A 及 C 移除 edit_payouts；帳戶 D 移除 export_customer_data；總數為 5。你的移除項目可回復矩陣，亦無多餘的角色更改。

feedback.en: You tie each finding to the permission export and matrix, showing how each role's allowed set produces the excess. The total is shown as A 1 plus B 2 plus C 1 plus D 1 equals 5, which is verifiable. Adding the specific role comparisons, such as support-tier2 allowing issue_refund, would strengthen it further.
feedback.zh: 你把每項發現連結至權限匯出及矩陣，說明各角色允許範圍如何產生超額。總數以 A 1 加 B 2 加 C 1 加 D 1 等於 5 展示，可核實。如再列明支援層級二允許 issue_refund 等具體角色比較，會更完整。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete: re-export after removals, compare each account to the 2026-10-01 matrix, and confirm none retains edit_payouts, export_customer_data or manage_users. The escalation to Ada Wong for a documented need is the right ownership step.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體可行：移除後重新匯出、逐一對照 2026-10-01 矩陣，並確認沒有帳戶保留 edit_payouts、export_customer_data 或 manage_users。就文件化需要轉交 Ada Wong，是正確的負責安排。

feedback.en: You clearly frame this as a fictional review and name missing evidence such as assignment dates and approval records. You could also note that effective access versus profile display is unverified and that review is limited to these four accounts.
feedback.zh: 你清楚說明此為虛構審查，並指出欠缺證據，例如指派日期及審批紀錄。你可再補充有效存取與設定檔顯示之間的差異尚未核實，以及審查僅限於這四個帳戶。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 132 English words, names all four accounts, states exact removals, the total of 5, the sources and clear next steps with an owner. It is directly actionable for Ada Wong.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，共 132 個英文字，列明四個帳戶、精確移除項目、總數 5、來源，以及附負責人的清晰下一步。Ada Wong 可直接執行。

summary.en: A fully accurate review. All five decisions match the least-privilege matrix, the arithmetic totals 5, and the handover names sources, corrections and next steps. Only minor additions on effective access and broader scope limits would improve it.
summary.zh: 審查完全準確。五項決策均符合最少權限矩陣，超額總數為 5，交接列明來源、修正及下一步。只需就有效存取及範圍限制稍作補充，即更完善。

brief.en: You are a security analyst in a fictional SHOPLINE learning simulation. Review four reporting service accounts against the supplied export policy effective 2026-11-01. Identify permissions that exceed the least-privilege matrix or lack required approval. Count total excess permission assignments. Propose exact removals. Complete the five questions before writing a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. Use only supplied fictional records. Do not use real credentials. This simulation is not endorsed by SHOPLINE.
brief.zh: 你係虛構 SHOPLINE 學習模擬中嘅資訊保安分析師。請按 2026-11-01 生效嘅匯出政策，審查四個報表服務帳戶。找出超出最少權限矩陣或欠缺所需批准嘅權限。計算超額權限指派總數。提出精確移除項目。先完成五條問題，再撰寫簡潔交接，可用英文或香港繁體中文，約 100 至 180 字。只可使用提供嘅虛構記錄。不要使用真實憑證。此模擬不獲 SHOPLINE 認可。

title.zh: 虛構報表服務匯出政策

body.en: Fictional policy for this SHOPLINE learning simulation only. Effective 2026-11-01. Defines three export scopes: export:aggregated (aggregated metrics, no PII), export:raw (raw transaction data with PII, only for data-engineer group or reporting-lead with written approval), export:metadata (table and field metadata, allowed for all reporting roles). Roles: reporting-analyst may use export:aggregated and export:metadata. reporting-lead may also use export:raw with approval. data-engineer may use all three scopes. No role in scope may use export:pii. Any permission beyond role assignment or lacking required approval must be removed before next audit.
body.zh: 此政策僅為本 SHOPLINE 學習模擬而設。生效日為 2026-11-01。定義三個匯出範圍：export:aggregated（彙總指標，不含個人資料）、export:raw（含個人資料嘅原始交易數據，僅供 data-engineer 群組或獲書面批准嘅 reporting-lead 使用）、export:metadata（表格及欄位元資料，所有報表角色均可使用）。角色：reporting-analyst 可使用 export:aggregated 及 export:metadata。reporting-lead 亦可使用 export:raw，但須獲批准。data-engineer 可使用全部三個範圍。範圍內任何角色均不得使用 export:pii。任何超出角色指派或欠缺所需批准嘅權限，必須在下次審計前移除。

title.zh: 虛構服務帳戶權限匯出 2026-11-01

body.en: Simulated export. Account S1, role reporting-analyst, permissions: export:aggregated, export:metadata. Account S2, role reporting-lead, permissions: export:aggregated, export:metadata, export:raw, export:pii. Approval for export:raw: none on file. Account S3, role data-engineer, permissions: export:aggregated, export:metadata, export:raw. Account U1, role reporting-analyst, permissions: export:aggregated, export:metadata, export:raw. Approval for export:raw: none on file. All permissions are effective permissions including any group inheritance.
body.zh: 模擬匯出。帳戶 S1，角色 reporting-analyst，權限：export:aggregated、export:metadata。帳戶 S2，角色 reporting-lead，權限：export:aggregated、export:metadata、export:raw、export:pii。export:raw 嘅批准：沒有存檔。帳戶 S3，角色 data-engineer，權限：export:aggregated、export:metadata、export:raw。帳戶 U1，角色 reporting-analyst，權限：export:aggregated、export:metadata、export:raw。export:raw 嘅批准：沒有存檔。所有權限均為有效權限，包括任何群組繼承。

title.en: Fictional access review request from analytics lead
title.zh: 虛構分析主管存取審查要求

body.en: From: Ken Lau, fictional analytics lead. Please review the four accounts above against the reporting service export policy effective 2026-11-01. Identify any permissions that exceed the least-privilege matrix or lack required approval. Count total excess permission assignments across all accounts. Propose removals to restore least privilege. State any missing evidence. Send a concise handover by end of day. This simulation is not an official SHOPLINE policy.
body.zh: 寄件人：Ken Lau，虛構分析主管。請按 2026-11-01 生效嘅報表服務匯出政策，審查上述四個帳戶。找出任何超出最少權限矩陣或欠缺所需批准嘅權限。計算所有帳戶嘅超額權限指派總數。提出移除項目以回復最少權限。說明任何欠缺證據。於今日完結前提交簡潔交接。此模擬並非正式 SHOPLINE 政策。

label.zh: S2 必須移除哪些權限？

expectedEvidence.en: Cites policy effective 2026-11-01. Cites data export list showing S2 permissions include export:raw and export:pii, with approval none on file. Cites U1 role reporting-analyst with export:raw. Explains that reporting-lead requires approval for export:raw, none on file so excess. Explains export:pii not allowed for any role. Explains reporting-analyst does not allow export:raw.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 2026-11-01 生效政策。引用數據匯出清單顯示 S2 權限包括 export:raw 及 export:pii，批准為沒有存檔。引用 U1 角色 reporting-analyst 擁有 export:raw。解釋 reporting-lead 需要批准才可使用 export:raw，沒有存檔故屬超額。解釋 export:pii 不獲任何角色允許。解釋 reporting-analyst 不允許 export:raw。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checks: verify approval records for export:raw, check group memberships for inherited permissions, review audit logs for export:raw usage, confirm removals in IAM system, schedule re-audit after changes.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出檢查：核實 export:raw 嘅批准記錄、檢查群組成員資格以了解繼承權限、審查 export:raw 使用嘅審計日誌、在 IAM 系統確認移除、在變更後安排重新審計。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges missing evidence: no approval records provided, no group membership list, no confirmation of effective permission calculation. Limits claims to fictional scenario and supplied data. Does not assume real SHOPLINE policies.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認欠缺證據：未提供批准記錄、未提供群組成員清單、未確認有效權限計算。把聲明限於虛構情境及提供數據。不假設真實 SHOPLINE 政策。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover with decisions, evidence, calculations, risks and next steps. Mentions escalation to security team if approval missing. Ownership: analytics lead or IAM team.
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接包含決策、證據、計算、風險及下一步。提及如欠缺批准則轉交保安團隊。負責人：分析主管或 IAM 團隊。

exemplar.en: Access review for reporting service exports, policy effective 2026-11-01. Evidence from policy and permission export. S2 (reporting-lead) has two excess permissions: export:raw lacks required approval, and export:pii is not allowed for any role. U1 (reporting-analyst) has one excess: export:raw is not permitted for this role. S1 and S3 have no excess. Total excess assignments: 3. Proposed corrections: remove export:raw and export:pii from S2. Remove export:raw from U1. Verification: check approval records for export:raw, verify group memberships, review audit logs, confirm removals in IAM, and re-audit in 30 days. Risk: export:raw and export:pii could expose PII. Escalate to security team if approval cannot be produced. Missing evidence: approval records and group membership details. This is a simulation, not official SHOPLINE policy.
exemplar.zh: 報表服務匯出存取審查，政策生效日 2026-11-01。證據來自政策及權限匯出。S2（reporting-lead）有兩項超額權限：export:raw 欠缺所需批准，export:pii 不獲任何角色允許。U1（reporting-analyst）有一項超額：export:raw 不允許此角色使用。S1 及 S3 無超額。超額指派總數：3。建議修正：從 S2 移除 export:raw 及 export:pii。從 U1 移除 export:raw。核實：檢查 export:raw 批准記錄、核實群組成員資格、審查審計日誌、在 IAM 確認移除，並於 30 日後重新審計。風險：export:raw 及 export:pii 可能洩露個人資料。若無法提供批准，轉交保安團隊。欠缺證據：批准記錄及群組成員詳情。此為模擬，並非正式 SHOPLINE 政策。

feedback.en: All five decisions are correct: S2 as the account with most excess, its removals export:raw plus export:pii, U1 remove export:raw, total excess of 3, and export:pii as disallowed for every role. S1 and S3 are correctly cleared with no excess. Your proposed removals restore least privilege exactly as the policy requires.
feedback.zh: 五項決策全部正確：S2 為超額最多嘅帳戶、須移除 export:raw 同 export:pii、U1 移除 export:raw、超額總數 3 項、以及 export:pii 不獲任何角色允許。S1 及 S3 正確列為無超額。你提出嘅移除項目完全按政策回復最少權限。

feedback.en: You tie each decision to the supplied records: the 2026-11-01 policy, the permission export, and the approval state of 'none on file'. You correctly explain that reporting-lead needs approval for export:raw, that reporting-analyst is never permitted export:raw, and that export:pii is disallowed for all roles. Adding a short line on why the two S2 items differ (missing approval versus role-scope breach) would sharpen the reasoning further.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連結至提供記錄：2026-11-01 政策、權限匯出，以及「沒有存檔」嘅批准狀態。你正確解釋 reporting-lead 使用 export:raw 須獲批准、reporting-analyst 從不允許 export:raw，以及 export:pii 不獲任何角色允許。如再補一句指出 S2 兩項問題性質不同（欠缺批准對比超出角色範圍），推理會更銳利。

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete and testable: approval records for export:raw, group membership review for inherited permissions, audit logs, IAM confirmation of removals, and a 30-day re-audit. Ownership is implied through escalation to the security team. Naming the IAM or analytics lead as the confirming owner would make the plan even more actionable.
feedback.zh: 你嘅檢查具體且可驗證：export:raw 批准記錄、群組成員資格審查以了解繼承權限、審計日誌、在 IAM 確認移除，以及 30 日後重新審計。透過轉交保安團隊已隱含負責人。若能明確指出 IAM 或分析主管為確認負責人，計劃會更可行。

feedback.en: You clearly acknowledge missing evidence (approval records and group membership details) and label the work as a simulation rather than official SHOPLINE policy. Claims stay within the supplied fictional data. A brief note that effective permissions were taken as stated would complete the uncertainty picture.
feedback.zh: 你清楚承認欠缺證據（批准記錄及群組成員詳情），並標明此為模擬而非正式 SHOPLINE 政策。聲明維持於提供嘅虛構數據內。若補一句說明有效權限按匯出所述為準，不確定性描述會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 129 words and covers decisions, evidence, calculations, risk and next steps in a scannable order. The PII exposure risk and escalation path give the reader clear actions. It is ready to send to the analytics lead as is.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，共 129 字，按易讀次序涵蓋決策、證據、計算、風險及下一步。個人資料洩露風險同轉交途徑為讀者提供清晰行動。可直接發送予分析主管。

summary.en: Full marks across all criteria. Every decision, calculation and proposed removal matches the 2026-11-01 policy and the permission export, and the handover is concise, evidenced and actionable. No corrections needed.
summary.zh: 所有評分準則均獲滿分。每項決策、計算及建議移除均符合 2026-11-01 政策同權限匯出，交接簡潔、有證據支持且可行。無需修正。

nextSteps.en: No resubmission is needed. For your own development you could practice distinguishing 'missing approval' from 'out-of-scope permission' when two findings share an account, and name a confirming owner in the verification plan.
nextSteps.zh: 無需重新提交。如想進一步提升，可練習當同一帳戶有兩項發現時，區分「欠缺批准」同「超出範圍權限」，並在核實計劃中指名確認負責人。

brief.en: You are reviewing a small fictional API handler for an Oursky-inspired learning simulation. The endpoint lists synthetic documents by page. The contract uses one-based page numbers and defines success and failure responses. A boundary defect is suspected in the supplied TypeScript. Read the contract, code and staging observations. Then write a concise teammate handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Include corrected code or precise replacement lines, explain why the boundary fix works, list proposed tests with expected outcomes, and state limitations. Do not execute code.
brief.zh: 你正在為一個受 Oursky 啟發的學習模擬審查小型虛構 API 處理器。端點按頁列出合成文件。合約使用以 1 為起始的頁碼，並定義成功及失敗回應。提供的 TypeScript 懷疑有邊界缺陷。請閱讀合約、程式碼及測試環境觀察。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔同事交接。包括修正程式碼或精確替換行、解釋為何邊界修正有效、列出建議測試及預期結果，並說明限制。請勿執行程式碼。

title.en: Fictional API contract and paging rules
title.zh: 虛構 API 合約及分頁規則

body.en: Fictional simulation for Oursky-inspired learning. This is not Oursky code and is not endorsed by Oursky. Synthetic endpoint GET /api/documents. The page query is a one-based integer. The first page is page=1. pageSize is an integer from 1 to 100 inclusive. Success 200 returns items for the requested page, plus page, pageSize, total and hasNext. If page is beyond the last page, return 200 with items empty and hasNext false. Invalid page or pageSize returns 400 with error code invalid_paging. The synthetic dataset has 120 documents.
body.zh: 虛構模擬，靈感來自 Oursky 學習情境。這並非 Oursky 程式碼，亦未獲 Oursky 認可。合成端點 GET /api/documents。page 查詢參數是以 1 為起始的整數。第一頁是 page=1。pageSize 是 1 至 100 的整數，包含 1 及 100。成功 200 會回傳所請求頁面的 items，以及 page、pageSize、total 和 hasNext。若 page 超出最後一頁，回傳 200，items 為空，hasNext 為 false。page 或 pageSize 無效會回傳 400，錯誤代碼 invalid_paging。合成資料集有 120 份文件。

body.en: Fictional staging observations for 120 synthetic documents with pageSize=50. These are supplied records, not solved answers. Request page=1 returned first item doc-051 and 50 items. Request page=2 returned first item doc-101 and 20 items. Request page=3 returned 0 items. Request page=0 returned first item doc-001 and 50 items. Request pageSize=101 returned 400 invalid_paging. No request used pageSize=100. The observations show boundary behaviour for review.
body.zh: 虛構測試環境觀察，針對 120 份合成文件及 pageSize=50。這些是提供記錄，並非已解答答案。請求 page=1 回傳第一個項目 doc-051 及 50 個 items。請求 page=2 回傳第一個項目 doc-101 及 20 個 items。請求 page=3 回傳 0 個 items。請求 page=0 回傳第一個項目 doc-001 及 50 個 items。請求 pageSize=101 回傳 400 invalid_paging。沒有請求使用 pageSize=100。這些觀察顯示待審查的邊界行為。

label.en: With the current handler, 120 documents and pageSize=50, what does page=1 return?
label.zh: 使用現時處理器、120 份文件及 pageSize=50，page=1 會回傳甚麼？

label.en: Under the corrected one-based contract, how many items should page=3 return for 120 documents with pageSize=50?
label.zh: 在修正後以 1 為起始的合約下，120 份文件及 pageSize=50 時，page=3 應回傳多少 items？

label.en: Which changes belong in the corrected handler? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些改動屬於修正後的處理器？選出所有適用項。

label.en: Validate page as an integer greater than or equal to 1
label.zh: 驗證 page 為大於或等於 1 的整數
驗證 pageSize 為 1 至 100，包含 1 及 100

label.en: Return 404 when page is beyond the last page
label.zh: page 超出最後一頁時回傳 404

label.en: What is the defined failure outcome for page=0 with the contract?
label.zh: 根據合約，page=0 的既定失敗結果是甚麼？

label.en: For 120 documents with pageSize=50, how many pages does the corrected contract expose?
label.zh: 120 份文件及 pageSize=50 時，修正後合約會顯示多少頁？

starter.en:
Corrected code patch:
Why it fixes the defect:
Proposed test cases and expected outcomes:
Limitations:
starter.zh:
修正程式碼：
為何能修正問題：
建議測試個案及預期結果：
限制：

about.en: Oursky builds digital products and publicly describes code review, continuous integration, collaboration and privacy-aware software as part of its engineering approach.
about.zh: Oursky 開發數碼產品，公開介紹其工程方式包括程式碼審查、持續整合、協作及注重私隱的軟件。

publicValues.zh: 程式碼審查及工程品質

simulationStyle.en: Review a small fictional software change, propose tests and write an evidence-based teammate handover. This is not Oursky source code or an actual hiring exercise.
simulationStyle.zh: 審查小型虛構軟件改動，提出測試，並撰寫有證據支持的同事交接紀錄。這並非 Oursky 程式碼或真實招聘測試。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Correct boundary handling in a supplied API snippet and define successful and failure outcomes.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。修正提供的 API 程式碼邊界處理，並定義成功及失敗結果。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Correct boundary handling in a supplied API snippet and define successful and failure outcomes.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。修正提供的 API 程式碼邊界處理，並定義成功及失敗結果。

expectedEvidence.en: Identifies that start must be (page - 1) * pageSize. Under the corrected contract page=1 returns doc-001 to doc-050. page=3 returns 20 items, doc-101 to doc-120, with hasNext false. page=4 returns empty items and hasNext false. page=0 and pageSize=0 and pageSize=101 return 400 invalid_paging. pageSize=100 is valid. Total pages for 120 records at pageSize=50 is 3.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出 start 必須是 (page - 1) * pageSize。在修正後合約下，page=1 回傳 doc-001 至 doc-050。page=3 回傳 20 個 items，即 doc-101 至 doc-120，hasNext 為 false。page=4 回傳空白 items，hasNext 為 false。page=0、pageSize=0 及 pageSize=101 回傳 400 invalid_paging。pageSize=100 有效。120 筆記錄及 pageSize=50 時總頁數是 3。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the current code start = page * pageSize and the observation that page=1 begins at doc-051. Explains the off-by-one shift. Notes page=2 observation returns only 20 items because the current code reads the final page. Notes page=0 incorrectly returns first page because page validation is missing. Connects final page rule to page=3.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用現時程式碼 start = page * pageSize，以及 page=1 由 doc-051 開始的觀察。解釋差一錯誤造成的位移。指出 page=2 觀察只回傳 20 個 items，因為現時程式碼讀取最後一頁。指出 page=0 錯誤地回傳第一頁，因為缺少 page 驗證。把最後一頁規則連結至 page=3。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete assertions such as getPage(120 items, 1, 50) returns 50 items from doc-001 to doc-050 and hasNext true. getPage(120 items, 3, 50) returns 20 items and hasNext false. getPage(120 items, 4, 50) returns 0 items and hasNext false. getPage(120 items, 0, 50) and getPage(120 items, 1, 0) and getPage(120 items, 1, 101) return invalid_paging. Also suggests edge tests for pageSize=1, pageSize=100 and non-integer input.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體斷言，例如 getPage(120 items, 1, 50) 回傳 50 個 items，由 doc-001 至 doc-050，hasNext 為 true。getPage(120 items, 3, 50) 回傳 20 個 items，hasNext 為 false。getPage(120 items, 4, 50) 回傳 0 個 items，hasNext 為 false。getPage(120 items, 0, 50)、getPage(120 items, 1, 0) 及 getPage(120 items, 1, 101) 回傳 invalid_paging。亦建議為 pageSize=1、pageSize=100 及非整數輸入加入邊界測試。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States the scenario is fictional, read-only and not executed. Limits conclusions to the synthetic 120-document dataset and supplied contract. Notes no production logs, real user data or framework version are supplied. Avoids claiming API security or performance is verified.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明情境是虛構、唯讀及沒有執行。把結論限於合成 120 份文件資料集及提供的合約。指出沒有提供生產日誌、真實用戶資料或框架版本。避免聲稱已驗證 API 安全性或效能。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Provides a concise handover with the boundary decision, exact corrected code or replacement lines, test list, expected outcomes and next owner such as the reviewer or backend maintainer. Keeps it actionable and readable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提供簡潔交接，包含邊界決定、精確修正程式碼或替換行、測試清單、預期結果及下一步負責人，例如審查者或後端維護者。保持可行及易讀。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct, including page=1 returning doc-051 to doc-100 under the current code, page=3 giving 20 items, page=0 as 400 invalid_paging and 3 total pages at pageSize=50. Your patch using (page - 1) * pageSize plus integer page and pageSize 1 to 100 validation matches the contract exactly.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確，包括現時程式碼下 page=1 回傳 doc-051 至 doc-100、page=3 得 20 個 items、page=0 為 400 invalid_paging，以及 pageSize=50 時共 3 頁。你以 (page - 1) * pageSize 修正並加入 page 及 pageSize 1 至 100 的整數驗證，完全符合合約。

feedback.en: You correctly cite start = page * pageSize and the observation that page=1 begins at doc-051 to explain the off-by-one shift, and you tie the missing page validation to the page=0 result. To strengthen reasoning, also note that the page=2 observation returning only 20 items shows the current code already read the last page.
feedback.zh: 你正確引用 start = page * pageSize 及 page=1 由 doc-051 開始的觀察來解釋差一錯誤，並把缺少 page 驗證連繫到 page=0 結果。如要加強推理，可補充 page=2 只回傳 20 個 items 顯示現時程式碼已讀取最後一頁。

feedback.en: Your five assertions cover the key boundaries including page=3, page=4, page=0 and pageSize=101 with clear expected outcomes. Add explicit cases for pageSize=1, pageSize=100 (a valid boundary never tested in staging) and non-integer input to fully cover the contract.
feedback.zh: 你的五項斷言涵蓋主要邊界，包括 page=3、page=4、page=0 及 pageSize=101，並附清晰預期結果。請補上 pageSize=1、pageSize=100（測試環境從未測的有效邊界）及非整數輸入的明確個案，以完整覆蓋合約。

feedback.en: You clearly state this is a fictional read-only review that you did not execute, and you limit conclusions to the synthetic 120-document dataset and supplied contract. You avoid overclaiming on security or performance, which is the right level of caution.
feedback.zh: 你清楚說明這是虛構唯讀審查、沒有執行程式碼，並把結論限於合成 120 份文件資料及提供合約。你沒有誇大安全性或效能，謹慎程度恰當。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable with the decision, exact replacement lines, tests and expected outcomes in a readable structure. Name a next owner or escalation step, such as the backend maintainer or reviewer, so the handover clearly closes the loop.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，含決定、精確替換行、測試及預期結果，結構易讀。請指明下一步負責人或轉交對象，例如後端維護者或審查者，令交接有明確跟進。

summary.en: Strong submission: all field answers are correct and your patch, tests and limitations align with the supplied contract and staging records. Minor gaps are deeper reasoning on the page=2 observation, extra edge tests for pageSize=1 and 100, and naming a next owner.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀：所有欄位答案正確，你的修正、測試及限制均符合提供合約及測試環境記錄。可改進之處包括就 page=2 觀察作更深入推理、補上 pageSize=1 及 100 的邊界測試，以及指明下一步負責人。

nextSteps.en: Add test cases for pageSize=1, pageSize=100 and non-integer input, note that the page=2 observation confirms the current code reads the last page, and assign the fix to a named owner for review.
nextSteps.zh: 加入 pageSize=1、pageSize=100 及非整數輸入的測試個案，補充 page=2 觀察確認現時程式碼讀取最後一頁，並把修正指派給具名負責人審查。

title.en: Review idempotency boundaries in a timeout retry API
title.zh: 審查逾時重試 API 的冪等性邊界

brief.en: You are reviewing a fictional API handler for an Oursky-inspired learning simulation. The endpoint creates orders and must handle client retries after timeouts using idempotency keys. The contract defines success and failure outcomes. A boundary defect is suspected in the supplied TypeScript. Read the contract, code and staging observations. Then write a concise teammate handover in English or Traditional Chinese. body.en: Fictional simulation for Oursky-inspired learning. This is not Oursky code and is not endorsed by Oursky. Synthetic endpoint POST /api/orders. Requires header Idempotency-Key: a non-empty string of 1 to 64 characters. Request body is { amount: number > 0, currency: string of 3 uppercase letters }. On first request with a new key, process and return 201 with order { id, amount, currency }. On retry with an existing key and identical payload, return 200 with the original order. On retry with an existing key and different payload, return 409 error idempotency_conflict. Missing or invalid key returns 400 error invalid_idempotency_key. Client timeout retries use the same key and payload.
body.zh: 虛構模擬，靈感來自 Oursky 學習情境。這並非 Oursky 程式碼，亦未獲 Oursky 認可。合成端點 POST /api/orders。需要標頭 Idempotency-Key：一個非空字串，長度 1 至 64 個字元。請求主體為 { amount: 數字 > 0, currency: 3 個大寫字母的字串 }。首次以新鍵請求時，處理並回傳 201 及訂單 { id, amount, currency }。以現有鍵及相同主體重試時，回傳 200 及原始訂單。以現有鍵及不同主體重試時，回傳 409 錯誤 idempotency_conflict。缺少或無效鍵會回傳 400 錯誤 invalid_idempotency_key。客戶端逾時重試使用相同鍵及主體。

body.en: Fictional staging observations for the handler. These are supplied records, not solved answers. Request with key "key-1" and amount 10 returns 201 with order ord-1. Retry with same key "key-1" and amount 10 returns 200 with order ord-1. Retry with same key "key-1" and amount 20 returns 200 with order ord-1 (incorrect, should be 409). Request with empty key "" and amount 5 returns 201 with order ord-2 (incorrect, should be 400). Request with key "a".repeat(65) and amount 7 returns 201 with order ord-3 (incorrect, should be 400). No request used a key with 64 characters.
body.zh: 虛構測試環境觀察，針對處理器。這些是提供記錄，並非已解答答案。以鍵 "key-1" 及金額 10 請求會回傳 201 及訂單 ord-1。以相同鍵 "key-1" 及金額 10 重試會回傳 200 及訂單 ord-1。以相同鍵 "key-1" 及金額 20 重試會回傳 200 及訂單 ord-1（不正確，應為 409）。以空鍵 "" 及金額 5 請求會回傳 201 及訂單 ord-2（不正確，應為 400）。以鍵 "a".repeat(65) 及金額 7 請求會回傳 201 及訂單 ord-3（不正確，應為 400）。沒有請求使用 64 個字元的鍵。

body.en:
Fictional QA ticket for the parser review. No code was executed in this exercise. Six synthetic observations:
1. parseTags('') returned ['']. Contract expected [].
2. parseTags(' , ') returned ['','']. Contract expected [].
3. parseTags('alpha, beta') returned ['alpha','beta']. Contract expected ['alpha','beta'].
4. parseTags('alpha,,beta') returned ['alpha','','beta']. Contract expected ['alpha','beta'].
5. parseTags('alpha,alpha') returned ['alpha','alpha']. Contract expected ['alpha','alpha'].
6. parseTags('\u00A0alpha\u00A0') returned ['alpha']. Contract expected ['\u00A0alpha\u00A0'] because NBSP U+00A0 is not ASCII whitespace.

exemplar.en:
Decision: parseTags fails the empty-input contract and the NBSP boundary. For raw '', split returns [''], and map leaves ['']. For ' , ' it returns ['','']. The current .trim() also removes NBSP U+00A0, so '\u00A0alpha\u00A0' becomes ['alpha'] instead of preserving both NBSP characters. Corrected patch:
```ts
const ASCII_WS = /^[\t\n\v\f\r ]+|[\t\n\v\f\r ]+$/g
export function parseTags(raw: string): string[] {
  return raw
    .split(',')
    .map((tag) => tag.replace(ASCII_WS, ''))
    .filter((tag) => tag.length > 0)
}
```
This trims only ASCII whitespace and drops segments empty after trimming. It preserves order, case, duplicates and NBSP. Proposed assertions:
expect(parseTags('')).toEqual([])
expect(parseTags(' , ')).toEqual([])
expect(parseTags('alpha,,beta')).toEqual(['alpha','beta'])
expect(parseTags('\u00A0alpha\u00A0')).toEqual(['\u00A0alpha\u00A0'])
The QA ticket lists six observations and four fail: 1, 2, 4 and 6. I have not executed code. Next step: add these assertions, then ask a reviewer to confirm the ASCII-only whitespace rule before release.

```ts
    .filter((tag) => tag.length > 0)
}
```

body.en:
Fictional QA ticket for the flag resolver review. No code was executed in this exercise. Six synthetic observations:
1. resolveFlag("beta", { beta: false }, true, true) returned false. Contract expected false.
2. resolveFlag("beta", {}, false, true) returned false. Contract expected false.
3. resolveFlag("beta", {}, undefined, true) returned true. Contract expected true.
4. resolveFlag("toString", {}, undefined, false) returned the inherited Object.prototype.toString function. Contract expected false.
5. resolveFlag("valueOf", {}, undefined, false) returned the inherited Object.prototype.valueOf function. Contract expected false.
6. resolveFlag("Beta", { beta: false }, undefined, true) returned true. Contract expected true because flag names are case-sensitive.

exemplar.en:
Handover. I reviewed the fictional PulseDesk logging code in logging-code and rule LM-7 in logging-rule. The defect is that logRequest serialises the whole payload, so the sample log includes userId, email, phone and message. Rule LM-7 allows event, ticketId, route, status, durationMs and errorCode. My patch uses a narrow allowlist.
```ts
export function logRequest(payload: RequestPayload) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    event: 'request_received',
    ticketId: payload.ticketId,
    route: payload.route,
    status: payload.status,
    durationMs: payload.durationMs,
    errorCode: payload.errorCode
  }))
}
```
Why it fixes: the output can no longer contain prohibited personal fields. Tests: assert output lacks lee@example.test and reset my access, assert output includes T-4402 and 84. Count check: 4 prohibited fields out of 8 sample fields. Limitation: I have not run tests. Next action: teammate runs the three assertions in staging and confirms the log parser still reads event and ticketId.
