```ts
export function logRequest(payload: RequestPayload) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    event: 'request_received',
    ticketId: payload.ticketId,
    route: payload.route,
    status: payload.status,
    durationMs: payload.durationMs,
    errorCode: payload.errorCode
  }))
}
```
為何能修正：輸出不再可能包含禁止的個人欄位。測試：斷言輸出不含 lee@example.test 及 reset my access，斷言輸出包含 T-4402 及 84。數量檢查：樣本 8 個欄位中有 4 個禁止。限制：我尚未運行測試。下一步：同事在預備環境運行三項斷言，並確認記錄解析器仍能讀取 event 及 ticketId。

You selected the LM-7 allowlist, removed exactly userId, email, phone and message, counted 4 prohibited fields, identified whole-payload logging as the cause, and chose the four sound verification checks. Your patch logs only event, ticketId, route, status, durationMs and errorCode, which keeps operational evidence while removing prohibited personal fields.

exemplar.en:
Decision: log only allowlisted fields from PRIV-2.

```ts
export function writeErrorTrace(event: ErrorEvent) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    event: 'api_error',
    requestId: event.requestId,
    path: event.path,
    statusCode: event.statusCode,
    errorKind: event.errorKind,
    latencyMs: event.latencyMs
  }))
}
```

Evidence: sample trace has event at top level and five allowed fields inside payload, so the count is 6. It exposed token tok_demo_7Q2B91 through metadata. PRIV-2 prohibits payload and metadata.

Tests: assert output does not contain tok_demo_7Q2B91. Assert output contains REQ-2214, /checkout, 503, GatewayTimeout and 840.

Limitation: synthetic staging data only. Next: open PR for code review and ask teammate to verify tests. Owner: Marcus Lee.
exemplar.zh:
決策：只記錄 PRIV-2 允許的欄位。

```ts
export function writeErrorTrace(event: ErrorEvent) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    event: 'api_error',
    requestId: event.requestId,
    path: event.path,
    statusCode: event.statusCode,
    errorKind: event.errorKind,
    latencyMs: event.latencyMs
  }))
}
```

證據：樣本追蹤在頂層有 event，payload 內有五個允許欄位，總數為 6。它透過 metadata 洩露權杖 tok_demo_7Q2B91。PRIV-2 禁止 payload 及 metadata。

測試：斷言輸出不含 tok_demo_7Q2B91。斷言輸出包含 REQ-2214、/checkout、503、GatewayTimeout 及 840。

限制：只限合成預備環境資料。下一步：開啟 PR 供程式碼審查，並請同事核實測試。負責人：Marcus Lee。

feedback.en: All four field decisions and the count of 6 are correct, and your patch logs only event, requestId, path, statusCode, errorKind and latencyMs while dropping payload and metadata. This fully resolves the PRIV-2 violation seen in the staging trace.
feedback.zh: 四個欄位決策及 6 的計數全部正確，你的修補只記錄 event、requestId、path、statusCode、errorKind 及 latencyMs，並移除 payload 及 metadata。此舉完全修正預備環境追蹤中違反 PRIV-2 的問題。

feedback.en: You correctly tie the fix to rule PRIV-2 prohibited fields and explain the count of 6 by noting event is top level and five allowed fields sit inside payload. You also name the exposed token tok_demo_7Q2B91 and reference REQ-2214 in your tests.
feedback.zh: 你正確把修正連結至規則 PRIV-2 的禁止欄位，並解釋數量為 6，因 event 位於頂層而五個允許欄位在 payload 內。你亦指出洩露的權杖 tok_demo_7Q2B91，並在測試中引用 REQ-2214。

feedback.en: Your tests cover the critical negative assertion for tok_demo_7Q2B91 plus positive checks for REQ-2214, /checkout, 503, GatewayTimeout and 840, and you propose a PR for review. This is a concrete, well-targeted verification plan.
feedback.zh: 你的測試涵蓋 tok_demo_7Q2B91 的關鍵否定斷言，以及 REQ-2214、/checkout、503、GatewayTimeout 及 840 的正面檢查，並提出開啟 PR 供審查。這是具體且對焦的核實計劃。

feedback.en: You note the limitation of synthetic staging data, which is the key caveat. To strengthen scope control, add that this is a fictional scenario using no real systems and that it is not legal advice.
feedback.zh: 你指出只限合成預備環境資料的限制，這是關鍵告誡。為加強範圍控制，可補充此為虛構情境、沒有使用真實系統，且並非法律意見。

feedback.en: Your handover is concise and actionable with the corrected function, evidence, tests, a limitation, a next action and owner Marcus Lee. A teammate could act on this without further clarification.
feedback.zh: 你的交接簡潔可行，包含修正函數、證據、測試、限制、下一步及負責人 Marcus Lee。同事無需額外澄清即可跟進。

summary.en: An accurate and well-evidenced submission. Decision answers, the corrected patch and tests are correct and grounded in PRIV-2 and the REQ-2214 staging trace. Only a slightly fuller scope caveat was missing.
summary.zh: 提交準確且證據充分。決策答案、修正修補及測試均正確，並以 PRIV-2 及 REQ-2214 預備環境追蹤為依據。僅範圍告誡略欠完整。

nextSteps.en: Add one sentence stating the scenario is fictional with synthetic data only and not legal advice, then open the PR and ask a teammate to confirm the negative token assertion fails against the original code.

title.en: Plan a reorder for SMT feeder components
title.zh: 規劃表面貼裝送料器零件補貨

brief.en: You are a supply chain planner in a fictional ASMPT-inspired learning simulation. Review the fictional reorder coverage policy and component snapshot for a synthetic SMT feeder bracket. Plan which component needs a reorder and calculate quantities using the stated 20-working-day horizon, component lead times, demand and eligible inventory. No safety stock, reserved stock or unconfirmed incoming supply is allowed. Complete the five questions and a concise handover. This simulation is not endorsed by ASMPT.
brief.zh: 你是受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構學習模擬中的供應鏈規劃員。請審閱虛構補貨覆蓋政策及合成表面貼裝送料器支架的零件快照。按所述 20 個工作日規劃期、零件交付期、需求及合資格庫存，規劃哪些零件需要補貨並計算數量。不允許安全庫存、保留庫存或未確認入庫供應。完成五條問題及簡潔交接。此模擬不獲 ASMPT 認可。

body.en: Fictional ASMPT-inspired simulation only. This is not an ASMPT policy. Horizon is 20 working days. Demand is 40 finished feeder brackets per working day. For each component, coverage is calculated over its own lead time in working days. Eligible inventory is unallocated on-hand units only. No safety stock is allowed. A component requires a reorder when eligible inventory is less than component demand during lead time. Reorder quantity is component demand during lead time minus eligible inventory. Lead times and component quantities per bracket are in the snapshot.
body.zh: 僅為受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構模擬。此非 ASMPT 政策。規劃期為 20 個工作日。需求為每個工作日 40 件完成送料器支架。每個零件按其自身交付期工作日數計算覆蓋。合資格庫存僅為未分配的在手單位。不允許隱含安全庫存。當合資格庫存低於零件交付期內需求時，該零件需要補貨。補貨量為零件交付期內需求減合資格庫存。交付期及每支架零件用量見快照。

body.en:
Fictional snapshot for week 14 of the simulation. Component quantities are per finished bracket.

| Component ID | Description | Qty per bracket | Lead time (working days) | Eligible inventory (units) |
| CMP-101 | Stepper mount | 1 | 12 | 150 |
| CMP-202 | Sensor bracket | 2 | 8 | 350 |
| CMP-303 | Vision clip | 1 | 15 | 620 |

All three components are required for the synthetic feeder bracket. There is no confirmed incoming supply in this snapshot. Reserved stock is excluded from eligible inventory.
body.zh:
第 14 週虛構快照。零件用量以每件完成支架計。

| 零件編號 | 說明 | 每支架用量 | 交付期（工作日） | 合資格庫存（單位） |
| CMP-101 | 步進馬達座 | 1 | 12 | 150 |
| CMP-202 | 感應器支架 | 2 | 8 | 350 |
| CMP-303 | 視覺夾 | 1 | 15 | 620 |

合成送料器支架需要全部三個零件。此快照沒有已確認入庫供應。保留庫存不計入合資格庫存。

title.en: Planning note from fictional team lead
title.zh: 虛構團隊主管規劃備註

body.en: Previous fictional run added a 10 percent buffer and compared eligible inventory with full 20-day demand. That is not the approved method. Use only component lead-time coverage from the policy. The snapshot is complete for the three components. No other demand or supply changes apply. Escalate a component to the team lead only if its reorder quantity is positive and its lead time is greater than 10 working days.
body.zh: 之前的虛構運行加入了 10% 緩衝，並把合資格庫存與完整 20 日需求比較。此非認可方法。只使用政策中的零件交付期覆蓋。快照已包含三個零件的完整資料。沒有其他需求或供應變動。只有當零件補貨量為正且交付期大於 10 個工作日時，才升級至團隊主管。

label.en: Which component has the largest positive reorder quantity?
label.zh: 哪個零件有最大的正補貨量？

label.en: Calculate the reorder quantity for CMP-202 in units.
label.zh: 以單位計算 CMP-202 的補貨量。

label.en: Which components have eligible inventory sufficient to cover demand during their lead time? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些零件的合資格庫存足以覆蓋其交付期內需求？選取所有適用者。

label.en: What is the correct reorder quantity for CMP-101?
label.zh: CMP-101 的正確補貨量是多少？

label.en: Calculate total reorder quantity across all components in units.
label.zh: 以單位計算所有零件的總補貨量。

exemplar.en: Decision: reorder CMP-101 and CMP-202. CMP-101 needs 12 working days coverage. Daily usage is 40 units, so lead-time demand is 480. Eligible inventory is 150, so reorder 330. CMP-202 uses 2 per bracket, 80 per day, 8-day lead time, demand 640. Eligible inventory 350, so reorder 290. CMP-303 has 15-day demand of 600 and 620 eligible, so no reorder. Total reorder is 620 units. Evidence: Fictional reorder coverage policy, component snapshot, planning note. Risk: no safety stock is allowed, so any demand increase creates shortage. Next step: verify arithmetic with the team lead and escalate CMP-101 because its reorder is positive and lead time is 12 working days, above the 10-day escalation threshold. This is a fictional learning simulation, not ASMPT policy.
exemplar.zh: 決策：為 CMP-101 及 CMP-202 補貨。CMP-101 需覆蓋 12 個工作日。每日用量 40 單位，交付期內需求為 480。合資格庫存 150，故補貨 330。CMP-202 每支架用 2 件，每日 80 件，交付期 8 個工作日，需求 640。合資格庫存 350，故補貨 290。CMP-303 的 15 個工作日需求為 600，合資格庫存 620，故不補貨。總補貨量為 620 單位。證據：虛構補貨覆蓋政策、零件快照、規劃備註。風險：不允許安全庫存，需求上升會造成短缺。下一步：與團隊主管核對計算，並升級 CMP-101，因其補貨量為正且交付期 12 個工作日，高於 10 日升級門檻。此為虛構學習模擬，非 ASMPT 政策。

Naming Ada Cheung as the verification owner would strengthen this slightly.

title.en: Plan a reorder for SMT nozzle assembly components
title.zh: 規劃表面貼裝噴嘴組件補貨

brief.en: You are a supply chain planner in a fictional ASMPT-inspired learning simulation. Review the fictional reorder policy and component snapshot for a synthetic SMT nozzle assembly. Plan which components need a reorder and calculate quantities using the stated 15-working-day horizon, component lead times, daily demand, and eligible inventory rules that account for reserved stock and confirmed incoming supply. No implicit safety stock is allowed. Complete the questions and a concise handover. This simulation is not endorsed by ASMPT.
brief.zh: 你是受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構學習模擬中的供應鏈規劃員。請審閱虛構補貨政策及合成表面貼裝噴嘴組件的零件快照。按所述 15 個工作日規劃期、零件交付期、每日需求及計入保留庫存與已確認入庫供應的合資格庫存規則，規劃哪些零件需要補貨並計算數量。不允許隱含安全庫存。完成問題及簡潔交接。此模擬不獲 ASMPT 認可。

body.en: Fictional ASMPT-inspired simulation only. This is not an ASMPT policy. Horizon is 15 working days. Daily demand is 30 finished nozzle assemblies per working day. For each component, demand during lead time equals daily demand times the component lead time in working days. Eligible inventory equals on-hand units minus reserved units plus confirmed incoming units. No safety stock is allowed. A component requires a reorder when eligible inventory is less than demand during lead time. Reorder quantity is demand during lead time minus eligible inventory. All incoming supply shown is confirmed and arrives within the lead time.
body.zh: 僅為受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構模擬。此非 ASMPT 政策。規劃期為 15 個工作日。每日需求為每個工作日 30 件完成噴嘴組件。每個零件的交付期內需求等於每日需求乘以零件交付期工作日數。合資格庫存等於在手單位減保留單位加已確認入庫單位。不允許安全庫存。當合資格庫存低於交付期內需求時，該零件需要補貨。補貨量為交付期內需求減合資格庫存。所示所有入庫供應均為已確認，並於交付期內到達。

body.en:
Fictional snapshot for week 22 of the simulation. Component quantities are per finished nozzle assembly.

| Component ID | Description | Lead time (working days) | On-hand units | Reserved units | Confirmed incoming units |
| CMP-501 | Nozzle holder | 10 | 200 | 50 | 100 |
| CMP-502 | Spring pin | 6 | 300 | 80 | 0 |
| CMP-503 | Alignment sleeve | 12 | 500 | 100 | 30 |

All three components are required one per finished assembly. There is no other supply. Reserved stock is excluded from eligible inventory.
body.zh:
第 22 週虛構快照。零件用量以每件完成噴嘴組件計（每件一個）。

| 零件編號 | 說明 | 交付期（工作日） | 在手單位 | 保留單位 | 已確認入庫單位 |
| CMP-501 | 噴嘴座 | 10 | 200 | 50 | 100 |
| CMP-502 | 彈簧銷 | 6 | 300 | 80 | 0 |
| CMP-503 | 對準套筒 | 12 | 500 | 100 | 30 |

所有三個零件每件完成組件各需一個。沒有其他供應。保留庫存不計入合資格庫存。

title.en: Planning note from fictional team lead
title.zh: 虛構團隊主管規劃備註

body.en: Previous fictional run mistakenly added a 10 percent buffer and ignored reserved stock. That is not the approved method. Use only the policy. The snapshot includes only confirmed incoming supply. Unconfirmed incoming must be excluded. No other demand or supply changes apply. Escalate a component to the team lead only if its reorder quantity is positive and its lead time is greater than 8 working days.
body.zh: 之前的虛構運行錯誤地加入了 10% 緩衝，並忽略了保留庫存。此非認可方法。只使用政策。快照僅包含已確認入庫供應。未確認入庫必須排除。沒有其他需求或供應變動。只有當零件補貨量為正且交付期大於 8 個工作日時，才升級至團隊主管。

label.en: Which components require a reorder? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些零件需要補貨？選取所有適用者。

label.en: Calculate the reorder quantity for CMP-501 in units.

simulationStyle.en: Review fictional PCB or mechanical design records and plan inventory or supplier choices using explicit simulated constraints. Hand over findings for review. No real design certification, fabrication or company designs are involved.

expectedEvidence.en: Correctly identifies that only CMP-501 requires a reorder. Computes demand during lead time for CMP-501 as 30 * 10 = 300 units. Computes eligible inventory as 200 - 50 + 100 = 250 units. Reorder quantity = 300 - 250 = 50 units. For CMP-502, demand = 30 * 6 = 180, eligible = 300 - 80 + 0 = 220, no reorder. For CMP-503, demand = 30 * 12 = 360, eligible = 500 - 100 + 30 = 430, no reorder. Total reorder quantity = 50 units. Accepts any correct calculation that follows the policy and yields these numbers.

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the policy document for the definition of eligible inventory (on-hand minus reserved plus confirmed incoming) and the reorder rule. References the component snapshot table for specific numbers: CMP-501 lead time 10 days, on-hand 200, reserved 50, confirmed incoming 100. Notes that CMP-502 and CMP-503 do not require reorder because eligible inventory exceeds demand during lead time. Uses the planning note to confirm only confirmed incoming is counted and reserved stock is subtracted. Explains the calculation steps clearly.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用政策文件說明合資格庫存定義（在手減保留加已確認入庫）及補貨規則。引用零件快照表具體數字：CMP-501 交付期 10 日、在手 200、保留 50、已確認入庫 100。指出 CMP-502 及 CMP-503 因合資格庫存高於交付期內需求而無需補貨。使用規劃備註確認僅計入已確認入庫並減去保留庫存。清晰解釋計算步驟。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks such as verifying the confirmed incoming quantities are actually confirmed and will arrive within lead time, checking that reserved stock figures are current and correctly excluded, and recalculating eligible inventory for each component. Suggests escalating CMP-501 to team lead because reorder quantity is positive and lead time (10 days) is greater than 8 working days. Recommends validating the demand rate of 30 units per working day with production planning.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如核實已確認入庫數量確實已確認並將於交付期內到達、檢查保留庫存數字為最新並正確排除、重新計算每個零件的合資格庫存。建議將 CMP-501 升級至團隊主管，因補貨量為正且交付期（10 日）大於 8 個工作日。建議與生產規劃驗證每日需求 30 件。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese that includes: decision (only CMP-501 needs reorder, quantity 50 units), evidence from policy and snapshot, calculation steps, risk of unconfirmed incoming or ignored reserved stock, and next steps such as escalating to team lead and verifying demand rate. Uses clear professional language and is actionable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，包括：決策（只有 CMP-501 需補貨，數量 50 件）、來自政策及快照的證據、計算步驟、未確認入庫或忽略保留庫存的風險，以及下一步如升級至團隊主管及驗證需求率。使用清晰專業語言且可行。

exemplar.en:
Evidence: The policy states horizon is 15 working days, daily demand 30 units, and eligible inventory equals on-hand minus reserved plus confirmed incoming. The snapshot shows CMP-501 lead time 10 days, on-hand 200, reserved 50, confirmed incoming 100. CMP-502 lead time 6 days, on-hand 300, reserved 80, confirmed incoming 0. CMP-503 lead time 12 days, on-hand 500, reserved 100, confirmed incoming 30.
Decision and calculations: CMP-501 demand during lead time = 30 * 10 = 300. Eligible = 200 - 50 + 100 = 250. Reorder = 300 - 250 = 50 units. CMP-502 demand = 30 * 6 = 180, eligible = 300 - 80 + 0 = 220, no reorder. CMP-503 demand = 30 * 12 = 360, eligible = 500 - 100 + 30 = 430, no reorder. Total reorder = 50 units.
Risks: Confirmed incoming may not arrive on time. Reserved stock may change.
Next steps: Escalate CMP-501 to team lead because lead time 10 > 8 and reorder positive. Verify demand rate with production planning. Confirm incoming supply. Validate reserved stock.
exemplar.zh:
證據：政策訂明規劃期為 15 個工作日，每日需求 30 件，合資格庫存等於在手減保留加已確認入庫。快照顯示 CMP-501 交付期 10 日、在手 200、保留 50、已確認入庫 100。CMP-502 交付期 6 日、在手 300、保留 80、已確認入庫 0。CMP-503 交付期 12 日、在手 500、保留 100、已確認入庫 30。
決策與計算：CMP-501 交付期內需求 = 30 * 10 = 300。合資格庫存 = 200 - 50 + 100 = 250。補貨量 = 300 - 250 = 50 件。CMP-502 需求 = 30 * 6 = 180，合資格庫存 = 300 - 80 + 0 = 220，無需補貨。CMP-503 需求 = 30 * 12 = 360，合資格庫存 = 500 - 100 + 30 = 430，無需補貨。總補貨量 = 50 件。
風險：已確認入庫可能延遲到達。保留庫存可能變動。
下一步：因交付期 10 > 8 且補貨量為正，將 CMP-501 升級至團隊主管。與生產規劃驗證需求率。確認入庫供應。核實保留庫存。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct. You identified only CMP-501 for reorder, computed 30 x 10 = 300 against eligible inventory of 200 - 50 + 100 = 250 to get 50 units, correctly showed CMP-502 (180 vs 220) and CMP-503 (360 vs 430) need none, total 50, and picked CMP-503 for the largest lead-time demand.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確。你只選出 CMP-501 需補貨，以 30 乘 10 得 300 對比合資格庫存 200 減 50 加 100 等於 250，得出 50 件，並正確顯示 CMP-502（180 對 220）及 CMP-503（360 對 430）無需補貨，總數 50，且選出 CMP-503 為交付期內需求最大者。

feedback.en: You cite the policy definition of eligible inventory and the reorder rule, then quote the exact snapshot figures for each component, including lead times, reserved units and confirmed incoming. The reasoning behind why CMP-502 and CMP-503 fall short of a reorder is shown step by step.
feedback.zh: 你引用了政策中合資格庫存的定義及補貨規則，並逐一列出快照數字，包括交付期、保留單位及已確認入庫。CMP-502 及 CMP-503 為何無需補貨的推理亦逐步展示。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and test the requirements: escalating CMP-501 since lead time 10 exceeds 8 and the reorder is positive, verifying the 30-unit daily demand with production planning, confirming incoming supply and validating reserved stock.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體並能測試要求：因交付期 10 大於 8 且補貨量為正而把 CMP-501 升級，與生產規劃核實每日 30 件需求，確認入庫供應並核實保留庫存。

feedback.en: You note risks that confirmed incoming may slip and reserved stock may change, but you never state that this is fictional simulation data rather than actual company policy, nor that no safety stock is used and only confirmed incoming counts. Add that framing to bound the claims fully.
feedback.zh: 你指出已確認入庫可能延遲及保留庫存可能變動的風險，但未說明此屬虛構模擬數據而非公司實際政策，亦未指出不使用安全庫存且僅計入已確認入庫。補充此框架才能完整界定聲明範圍。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 150 English words and follows the evidence, decision, risk and next-step structure, so a reviewer can act on it immediately. Ownership is clear through the named escalation to the team lead.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，共 150 個英文詞，依證據、決策、風險及下一步結構撰寫，審閱者可即時跟進。透過明確轉交團隊主管，責任歸屬清晰。

summary.en: Strong submission with every calculation and answer correct, supported by cited policy and snapshot figures and a clear, actionable handover. The main gap is scope framing: state that this is fictional simulation data, that no safety stock is used and that only confirmed incoming supply counts.
summary.zh: 提交表現出色，所有計算及答案正確，並以政策及快照數字佐證，交接清晰可行。主要不足在範圍界定：應說明此為虛構模擬數據、不使用安全庫存，且僅計入已確認入庫供應。

nextSteps.en: Add one scope sentence confirming the fictional simulation basis and the no-safety-stock, confirmed-incoming-only assumptions, then keep the same calculation format and escalation logic.
nextSteps.zh: 加入一句範圍說明，確認屬虛構模擬，並列明不使用安全庫存及僅計已確認入庫的假設，其後維持相同的計算格式及升級邏輯。

title.en: Expedite order ER-2418: compare suppliers and select one
title.zh: 加急訂單 ER-2418：比較供應商並選定一家

brief.en: This is an independent fictional learning simulation inspired by ASMPT's public electronics manufacturing business. It is not endorsed by ASMPT and uses no real suppliers, prices or company records. Order ER-2418 needs 480 units of component SMT-CX7 for a customer retrofit line. Read the expedite rules and the four supplier quotations, apply the eligibility gates, rank the eligible suppliers by total landed expedited cost and confirm one selection. Submit a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering your decision, calculations, checks and escalation.
brief.zh: 這是一個獨立虛構學習模擬，靈感來自 ASMPT 的公開電子製造業務。本模擬不獲 ASMPT 認可，亦不使用任何真實供應商、價格或公司記錄。加急訂單 ER-2418 為客戶改造產線採購 480 件 SMT-CX7 元件。請閱讀加急規則及四份供應商報價，套用資格門檻，並按總到岸加急成本為合資格供應商排名，確認唯一選擇。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔書面交接，涵蓋決策、計算、核查及轉交事項。

title.en: Fictional record ER-2418: expedite request and selection rules
title.zh: 虛構記錄 ER-2418：加急需求及選擇規則

body.en: Fictional simulation record. Order ER-2418 covers 480 units of component SMT-CX7 for a customer retrofit line. Order release is Day 0. The hard build start requires all 480 units on site on or before Day 9. A supplier is eligible only if it passes all four gates: confirmed arrival on or before Day 9, incoming quality acceptance rate (QAR) at or above 97.0% across the last 12 received lots, a valid RoHS declaration on file, and at least 480 units available in one lot. Among eligible suppliers, rank by lowest total landed expedited cost, which equals unit price multiplied by 480, plus the expedite fee, plus freight. A tie is broken by the earlier confirmed arrival day. All amounts are HKD and no duty or tax applies in this simulation.
body.zh: 虛構模擬記錄。訂單 ER-2418 為客戶改造產線採購 480 件 SMT-CX7 元件。下單日為第 0 天。硬性投產要求全部 480 件於第 9 天或之前到廠。供應商須通過全部四項門檻方為合資格：確認到貨日為第 9 天或之前、最近 12 批來料品質合格率（QAR）達 97.0% 或以上、具備有效 RoHS 聲明、單批可提供至少 480 件。合資格供應商按最低總到岸加急成本排名，該成本等於單價乘以 480，加急費再加運費。同分時以較早確認到貨日為先。所有金額為港元，本模擬不計關稅或稅項。

expectedEvidence.en: Kaida Components is excluded on arrival day 11, which is later than the Day 9 gate. Meridian Micro is excluded on QAR 96.5%, below the 97.0% gate. exemplar.en: Decision: award order ER-2418 to Tatsumi Denki. Eligibility: Kaida Components fails the arrival gate, its confirmed booking is Day 11 against the Day 9 requirement. Meridian Micro fails the quality gate, 96.5% against the 97.0% minimum. Tatsumi Denki (Day 8, QAR 97.8%, RoHS Yes, 800 units) and Vantage Interconnect (Day 9, QAR 97.2%, RoHS Yes, 700 units) pass all four gates. Ranking by total landed expedited cost: Tatsumi = 44.20 x 480 + 2,600 + 1,100 = 24,916 HKD. Vantage = 43.60 x 480 + 3,100 + 1,450 = 25,478 HKD. Tatsumi is lower by 562 HKD, so the ranking rule selects Tatsumi Denki. Kaida is cheapest on unit price but cannot meet the deadline. Before release: obtain written re-confirmation of the Tatsumi Day 8 booking, re-check the trailing 12-lot QAR and the RoHS validity date, and confirm 480 units are allocated to this order in one lot. Arrival is a confirmed booking, not a guarantee, and any slip past Day 9 reopens the comparison. Escalate booking changes to the supply planning team lead. This is a fictional simulation, no purchase order has been placed and no supplier has been told it has won.

title.en: Split order PLT-88: compare supplier split plans and select one
title.zh: 分拆訂單 PLT-88：比較供應商分拆方案並選定一個

brief.en: This is an independent fictional learning simulation inspired by ASMPT's public electronics manufacturing business. It is not endorsed by ASMPT and uses no real suppliers, prices or company records. Order PLT-88 requires 800 units of component PLT-88 for a customer build. You may split the order across multiple suppliers. Read the split rules and supplier quotations, apply the eligibility gates and constraints, compare all permitted split plans, and select the one with the lowest total cost. Submit a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering your decision, calculations, checks and escalation.
brief.zh: 這是一個獨立虛構學習模擬，靈感來自 ASMPT 的公開電子製造業務。本模擬不獲 ASMPT 認可，亦不使用任何真實供應商、價格或公司記錄。訂單 PLT-88 為客戶生產採購 800 件 PLT-88 元件。你可把訂單分拆給多家供應商。請閱讀分拆規則及供應商報價，套用資格門檻及限制，比較所有允許的分拆方案，並選出總成本最低的方案。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔書面交接，涵蓋決策、計算、核查及轉交事項。

title.en: Fictional record PLT-88: split order requirements and selection rules
title.zh: 虛構記錄 PLT-88：分拆訂單要求及選擇規則

body.en: Fictional simulation record. Order PLT-88 covers 800 units of component PLT-88 for a customer build. All units must arrive on or before Day 10. The order may be split across multiple suppliers. Each supplier used must receive an order quantity that is at least that supplier's minimum order quantity (MOQ) and no more than its maximum available in one lot. A supplier is eligible only if it passes all three gates: confirmed arrival on or before Day 10, incoming quality acceptance rate (QAR) at or above 97.0% across the last 12 received lots, and a valid RoHS declaration on file. Among all permitted split plans that sum to exactly 800 units, rank by lowest total cost, which equals the sum over suppliers of unit price multiplied by order quantity. No other fees apply. A tie is broken by the earlier confirmed arrival day of the supplier with the larger quantity. All amounts are HKD.
body.zh: 虛構模擬記錄。訂單 PLT-88 為客戶生產採購 800 件 PLT-88 元件。全部元件須於第 10 天或之前到貨。訂單可分拆給多家供應商。每家使用的供應商的訂購數量須至少等於其最低訂購量（MOQ），且不得超過其單批最大可供數量。供應商須通過全部三項門檻方為合資格：確認到貨日為第 10 天或之前、最近 12 批來料品質合格率（QAR）達 97.0% 或以上、具備有效 RoHS 聲明。在所有總數恰好為 800 件的允許分拆方案中，按最低總成本排名，總成本等於各供應商單價乘以訂購數量之總和。不計其他費用。同分時以數量較大供應商的較早確認到貨日為先。所有金額為港元。

description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Select an eligible supplier using complete cost, timing and quality assumptions and a stated ranking rule.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按完整成本、時間、品質假設及聲明排名規則選擇合資格供應商。

expectedEvidence.en: Correctly identifies Alpha Components and Beta Electronics as eligible suppliers. Calculates costs for all four feasible splits: Alpha 200 / Beta 600 costs 38,800 HKD; Alpha 300 / Beta 500 costs 39,000 HKD; Alpha 400 / Beta 400 costs 39,200 HKD; Alpha 500 / Beta 300 costs 39,400 HKD. Selects Alpha 200 / Beta 600 as the lowest cost. Provides 38,800 for question 3 and 39,400 for question 4. Identifies quality rate as the gate disqualifying Gamma Supplies.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確識別 Alpha Components 及 Beta Electronics 為合資格供應商。計算所有四個可行分拆方案的成本：Alpha 200 / Beta 600 成本為 38,800 港元；Alpha 300 / Beta 500 成本為 39,000 港元；Alpha 400 / Beta 400 成本為 39,200 港元；Alpha 500 / Beta 300 成本為 39,400 港元。選出 Alpha 200 / Beta 600 為最低成本。為問題 3 提供 38,800，為問題 4 提供 39,400。指出品質合格率為令 Gamma Supplies 不合資格的門檻。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: References the split rules and supplier quotations. Explains that Gamma fails the QAR gate at 96.8% and Delta fails the RoHS gate, so they cannot be used. Shows total cost calculation as unit price times quantity summed across suppliers. Explains why the other three splits have higher total cost. Uses data from the supplier table.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用分拆規則及供應商報價。解釋 Gamma 因 QAR 為 96.8% 而未達門檻，Delta 因 RoHS 不合格，故不可使用。展示總成本計算為各供應商單價乘以數量之總和。解釋其餘三個分拆方案總成本較高的原因。使用供應商表格中的數據。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checks such as confirming Beta Electronics current QAR remains at or above 97.0% and that its arrival day of 9 is still firm. Suggests verifying RoHS certificates for Alpha and Beta. Recommends confirming MOQ and max availability for the chosen quantities. Notes that any change could alter the ranking.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出檢查，例如確認 Beta Electronics 目前 QAR 仍達 97.0% 或以上，且其到貨日第 9 天仍然確定。建議核實 Alpha 及 Beta 的 RoHS 證書。建議確認選定數量符合最低訂購量及最大可供數量。指出任何變動都可能改變排名。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that this is a fictional simulation with no real suppliers or company data. States that the decision is limited to the supplied assumptions and records. Notes that no real orders have been placed and that actual quality and lead times may differ. Does not claim endorsement by ASMPT.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認此為虛構模擬，並無真實供應商或公司數據。聲明決策僅限於所提供假設及記錄。指出尚未下達真實訂單，實際品質及交期可能不同。不聲稱獲 ASMPT 認可。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Presents a clear decision for Alpha 200 / Beta 600, supported by cost calculations. States total cost of 38,800 HKD. Identifies risks such as QAR verification for Beta. Lists next steps with an owner, such as verifying RoHS and confirming bookings. Uses a concise structure.
expectedEvidence.zh: 清晰提出選定 Alpha 200 / Beta 600 的決策，並以成本計算支持。說明總成本為 38,800 港元。指出風險如 Beta 的 QAR 核實。列明下一步及負責人，例如核實 RoHS 及確認訂艙。結構簡潔。

exemplar.en: Decision: Select Alpha 200 units and Beta 600 units for order PLT-88. Total cost is 38,800 HKD. Evidence: Alpha and Beta pass all gates. Gamma fails QAR at 96.8%. Delta fails RoHS. Feasible splits are Alpha 200/Beta 600 (38,800), Alpha 300/Beta 500 (39,000), Alpha 400/Beta 400 (39,200), and Alpha 500/Beta 300 (39,400). Calculations: 200 times 50 plus 600 times 48 equals 38,800. Risks: Beta QAR is 97.5%, close to the 97.0% gate. Verification: Confirm Beta QAR remains valid and arrival day 9 holds. Check RoHS certificates for Alpha and Beta. Confirm quantities meet MOQ and max. Next steps: Supply planner to verify quality records. Logistics to confirm bookings. Escalate any change in QAR or arrival day.
exemplar.zh: 決策：為訂單 PLT-88 選定 Alpha 200 件及 Beta 600 件。總成本為 38,800 港元。證據：Alpha 及 Beta 通過所有門檻。Gamma 因 QAR 為 96.8% 而不合格。Delta 因 RoHS 不合格。可行分拆為 Alpha 200/Beta 600（38,800）、Alpha 300/Beta 500（39,000）、Alpha 400/Beta 400（39,200）及 Alpha 500/Beta 300（39,400）。計算：200 乘以 50 加 600 乘以 48 等於 38,800。風險：Beta QAR 為 97.5%，接近 97.0% 門檻。核實：確認 Beta QAR 仍然有效及到貨日第 9 天不變。檢查 Alpha 及 Beta 的 RoHS 證書。確認數量符合最低訂購量及最大可供數量。下一步：供應規劃員核實品質記錄。物流確認訂艙。如 QAR 或到貨日有任何變動即上報。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct. You identified Alpha and Beta as eligible, selected Alpha 200 and Beta 600 as the lowest cost at 38,800 HKD, gave 39,400 HKD for the Alpha 500 and Beta 300 split, and correctly named the quality gate disqualifying Gamma.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確。你識別 Alpha 及 Beta 為合資格供應商，選出總成本最低的 Alpha 200 件及 Beta 600 件（38,800 港元），並為 Alpha 500 件及 Beta 300 件方案提供 39,400 港元，亦正確指出令 Gamma 不合格的品質門檻。

feedback.en: You linked decisions to the supplied rules and quotation table, showing all four feasible split costs and explaining that Gamma fails QAR at 96.8% and Delta fails the RoHS gate. The cost formula of unit price times quantity is shown clearly.
feedback.zh: 你把決策連結至提供規則及報價表，列出全部四個可行分拆方案的成本，並解釋 Gamma 因 QAR 96.8% 及 Delta 因 RoHS 門檻而不合格。單價乘以數量的成本計算展示清晰。

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete and relevant, covering the narrow Beta QAR margin, its arrival day 9, RoHS certificates and MOQ or max confirmation, with owners for quality records and bookings. Escalating any QAR or arrival change is a sound trigger.
feedback.zh: 你的核查具體且相關，涵蓋 Beta QAR 僅略高於門檻、其到貨日第 9 天、RoHS 證書及最低訂購量或最大可供數量確認，並列明品質記錄及訂艙的負責人。以 QAR 或到貨日變動作為上報條件亦合理。

feedback.en: You flag the tight Beta QAR margin and that changes could shift the ranking. You could strengthen this by stating explicitly that this is a fictional simulation with no real orders placed and that conclusions are limited to the supplied records.
feedback.zh: 你已指出 Beta QAR 餘量狹窄，並說明變動可能改變排名。你可進一步明確指出此為虛構模擬、尚未下達真實訂單，且結論僅限於所提供記錄。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable with a clear decision, cost of 38,800 HKD, risks and next steps with owners. The structure matches the starter headings and reads well.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，清楚列明決策、38,800 港元成本、風險及附負責人的下一步。結構符合起始標題，易於閱讀。

summary.en: Strong submission: all field answers are correct, the four split costs are shown, and the quality gate for Gamma is correctly identified. Verification and ownership are clear. The main gap is an explicit scope statement that this is a fictional simulation with conclusions limited to the supplied records.
summary.zh: 表現優秀：所有欄位答案正確，四個分拆方案成本均已列出，並正確指出 Gamma 的品質門檻。核實步驟及負責人清晰。主要不足是未明確聲明此為虛構模擬，且結論僅限於所提供記錄。

nextSteps.en: Add one sentence noting the fictional scope and that no real orders exist, then keep this level of calculation detail and verification ownership in future handovers.
nextSteps.zh: 加入一句說明虛構範圍及並無真實訂單，並在日後交接中保持這種計算細節及核實負責人的做法。

title.zh: 比較公共區域照明減排方案

brief.en: You are a sustainability analyst at a fictional property management team. The team is reviewing common-area lighting upgrades at Harbour View Court. Three fictional options have costs, operating-hour assumptions and verified warranty evidence. Apply the hard budget and eligibility rules, calculate the bounded baseline and corrected reductions, then select the greatest eligible reduction. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. All data and policies are fictional for this learning simulation. This simulation is inspired by Swire Properties public sustainability values but is not endorsed by Swire Properties.
brief.zh: 你是一間虛構物業管理團隊的可持續發展分析師。團隊正檢視海景苑的公共區域照明升級。三個虛構方案各有成本、營運小時假設及已核實保養證據。請應用硬性預算及合資格規則，計算限定範圍的基準及經修正減排量，然後選擇合資格最高減排方案。請以英文或繁體中文撰寫一份簡潔且基於證據的交接說明，約 100 至 180 字。所有數據及政策均為此學習模擬的虛構內容。此模擬受太古地產公開可持續發展價值啟發，但未獲太古地產認可。

title.en: Common-area lighting baseline and option table
title.zh: 公共區域照明基準及方案表

body.en: Baseline annual electricity for common-area lighting at Harbour View Court is 1,200,000 kWh. The grid emission factor is 0.7 kgCO2e per kWh. The hard budget is HKD 500,000. Verified actual operating hours are 4,000 per year. Option A costs HKD 450,000, saves 180,000 kWh per year and reduces 126 tCO2e based on 4,000 hours. Its warranty is 6 years, verified by vendor letter. Option B costs HKD 480,000, saves 214,286 kWh and reduces 150 tCO2e but assumes 8,000 hours. Its warranty is 3 years, verified by vendor letter. Option C costs HKD 520,000, saves 200,000 kWh and reduces 140 tCO2e based on 4,000 hours. Its warranty is 7 years, verified by vendor letter.
body.zh: 海景苑公共區域照明每年基準用電量為 1,200,000 千瓦時。電網排放因子為每千瓦時 0.7 千克二氧化碳當量。硬性預算為 500,000 港元。核實的實際營運小時為每年 4,000 小時。選項甲成本 450,000 港元，每年節省 180,000 千瓦時，基於 4,000 小時減排 126 公噸二氧化碳當量。其保養為 6 年，已由供應商信件核實。選項乙成本 480,000 港元，節省 214,286 千瓦時，減排 150 公噸二氧化碳當量，但假設 8,000 小時。其保養為 3 年，已由供應商信件核實。選項丙成本 520,000 港元，節省 200,000 千瓦時，基於 4,000 小時減排 140 公噸二氧化碳當量。其保養為 7 年，已由供應商信件核實。

title.en: Lighting upgrade eligibility and verification policy
title.zh: 照明升級合資格及核實政策

body.en: All options must stay within the hard budget of HKD 500,000. Every option must have a verified warranty of at least 5 years. Options with quoted savings based on operating hours different from the verified actual 4,000 hours per year must be adjusted proportionally. Only corrected emissions reductions count for selection. The selected option must provide the greatest corrected eligible reduction. Independent measurement and verification is required after installation. All quoted figures are subject to confirmation. All figures are fictional for this simulation.
body.zh: 所有方案必須控制在 500,000 港元的硬性預算內。每個方案必須具備至少 5 年的已核實保養。若報稱節省量所基於的營運小時與核實的實際每年 4,000 小時不同，必須按比例調整。只有經修正的減排量才可用於選擇。獲選方案必須提供最大的經修正合資格減排量。安裝後須進行獨立測量與驗證。所有報稱數字均須確認。所有數字均為此模擬的虛構數據。

body.en: Please review the three lighting options for Harbour View Court common areas. We need a clear recommendation for the next sustainability committee meeting. Focus on corrected emissions reductions, the hard budget and verified warranty eligibility. Do not assume any additional contingency or approval costs. All figures are fictional for this simulation. Prepare a short handover with your calculations, decision and proposed verification steps.
body.zh: 請審閱海景苑公共區域的三個照明選項。我們需要為下一次可持續發展委員會會議提供明確建議。重點關注經修正的減排量、硬性預算及已核實保養合資格要求。不要假設任何額外應急費用或審批成本。所有數字均為此模擬的虛構數據。請準備一份簡短交接，包含你的計算、決定及建議核實步驟。

label.en: Which option should be selected for implementation?
Which statements are correct based on the data and policy?
label.zh: 根據數據及政策，哪些陳述正確？

label.en: Option C is ineligible because its cost exceeds the hard budget.
label.zh: 選項丙成本超出硬性預算，因此不合資格。

label.en: Option B's corrected annual emissions reduction is 75 tCO2e.
label.zh: 選項乙的經修正年減排量為 75 公噸二氧化碳當量。

label.en: Option B meets the minimum 5-year warranty rule.
label.zh: 選項乙符合至少 5 年保養規則。

label.en: Option A provides the greatest eligible reduction within the hard budget and warranty rule.
label.zh: 選項甲在硬性預算及保養規則內提供最大合資格減排量。

label.en: What is the baseline annual emissions in tCO2e?
label.zh: 基準年排放量為多少公噸二氧化碳當量？

label.en: What is the corrected annual emissions reduction for Option B in tCO2e?
label.zh: 選項乙的經修正年減排量為多少公噸二氧化碳當量？

expectedEvidence.en: Calculates baseline emissions as 840 tCO2e from 1,200,000 kWh times 0.7 kgCO2e per kWh divided by 1000. Corrects Option B reduction to 75 tCO2e by proportional adjustment (150 times 4000 divided by 8000). Identifies Option C as ineligible because cost 520,000 exceeds hard budget 500,000. Identifies Option B as ineligible because verified warranty 3 years is below the minimum 5 years. Selects Option A as greatest eligible reduction (126 tCO2e). Must not select B or C.
expectedEvidence.zh: 計算基準排放為 840 公噸二氧化碳當量，由 1,200,000 千瓦時乘以每千瓦時 0.7 千克二氧化碳當量再除以 1000 得出。按比例將選項乙減排修正為 75 公噸二氧化碳當量，即 150 乘以 4000 除以 8000。識別選項丙因成本 520,000 超出硬性預算 500,000 而不合資格。識別選項乙因已核實保養 3 年低於最低 5 年而不合資格。選擇選項甲為最大合資格減排量 126 公噸二氧化碳當量。不得選擇乙或丙。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites Document 1 for baseline electricity 1,200,000 kWh, emission factor 0.7 kgCO2e per kWh, Option A cost 450,000 and reduction 126 tCO2e, Option B cost 480,000 and assumed 8,000 hours, Option C cost 520,000, and verified warranty durations 6 years for A, 3 years for B, 7 years for C. Cites Document 2 for hard budget 500,000, minimum 5-year verified warranty, proportional adjustment rule, and actual 4,000 hours. Explains the proportional correction method.

expectedEvidence.en: Provides a concise handover with decision to select Option A, supporting evidence including baseline 840 tCO2e, Option A 126 tCO2e, Option B corrected 75 tCO2e and warranty ineligibility, Option C budget ineligibility, and next steps for verification and implementation. Clear and actionable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提供簡潔交接，決定選擇選項甲，支持證據包括基準 840 公噸、選項甲 126 公噸、選項乙修正後 75 公噸及保養不合資格、選項丙預算不合資格，以及核實與實施的下一步。清晰可行。

exemplar.en: Decision: Select Option A. Baseline emissions are 1,200,000 kWh times 0.7 kgCO2e per kWh divided by 1000, giving 840 tCO2e per year. Option A costs HKD 450,000, within the HKD 500,000 hard budget, has a verified 6-year warranty and reduces 126 tCO2e based on verified 4,000 operating hours. Option B costs HKD 480,000 and quotes 150 tCO2e but assumes 8,000 hours. Corrected to 4,000 hours, its reduction is 75 tCO2e. Its verified warranty is 3 years, below the minimum 5 years, so it is ineligible. Option C costs HKD 520,000, which exceeds the budget, so it is ineligible. Therefore Option A provides the greatest eligible reduction within budget and warranty rules. Next steps: confirm operating hours with facilities, verify Option A cost and warranty letter, and plan independent measurement and verification after installation. All figures are fictional for this simulation.
exemplar.zh: 決定：選擇選項甲。基準排放為 1,200,000 千瓦時乘以每千瓦時 0.7 千克二氧化碳當量除以 1000，即每年 840 公噸二氧化碳當量。選項甲成本 450,000 港元，在 500,000 港元硬性預算內，具備已核實 6 年保養，基於核實的 4,000 營運小時減排 126 公噸二氧化碳當量。選項乙成本 480,000 港元，報稱減排 150 公噸，但假設 8,000 營運小時。修正至 4,000 小時後，減排為 75 公噸。其已核實保養為 3 年，低於最低 5 年，因此不合資格。選項丙成本 520,000 港元，超出預算，因此不合資格。因此選項甲在預算及保養規則內提供最大的合資格減排量。下一步：與設施部門確認營運小時，核實選項甲成本及保養信件，並計劃安裝後進行獨立測量與驗證。所有數字均為此模擬的虛構數據。

feedback.en: All four answers are correct. You computed the baseline as 840 tCO2e (1,200,000 kWh x 0.7 / 1000), corrected Option B to 75 tCO2e at 4,000 hours, and correctly ruled out Option C on budget and Option B on warranty before selecting Option A.
feedback.zh: 四項答案全部正確。你計算基準為 840 公噸二氧化碳當量（1,200,000 千瓦時乘以 0.7 再除以 1000），把選項乙按 4,000 小時修正為 75 公噸，並正確以預算排除選項丙、以保養排除選項乙，最終選擇選項甲。

feedback.en: Strong linkage to the supplied records: you cite the baseline electricity and emission factor, each option cost, the 126 tCO2e figure for A, the 8,000-hour assumption for B, and the verified warranty durations. You also explain the proportional correction method clearly, which makes the reasoning auditable.
feedback.zh: 你與提供記錄的連結紮實：引用基準用電量及排放因子、各方案成本、選項甲的 126 公噸、選項乙的 8,000 小時假設及已核實保養年期。你亦清楚解釋按比例修正方法，推理可被審核。

feedback.en: You propose confirming operating hours with facilities, checking Option A cost and warranty letter, and independent measurement and verification after installation. Adding a specific check on whether Option B could become eligible if its figures or warranty were re-confirmed would make the plan more complete.
feedback.zh: 你提出與設施部門確認營運小時、核實選項甲成本及保養信件，以及安裝後獨立測量與驗證。若能加入一項具體檢查，說明若選項乙數字或保養重新確認後是否可能合資格，計劃會更完整。

feedback.en: You state that all figures are fictional for this simulation, which correctly limits the claims. You could add that actual reductions depend on verified operating hours and final vendor confirmation, since the 4,000-hour basis and costs are still subject to confirmation.
feedback.zh: 你說明所有數字均為此模擬的虛構數據，正確限定了聲明範圍。你亦可補充實際減排取決於核實的營運小時及供應商最終確認，因為 4,000 小時基礎及成本仍待確認。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and action-focused at about 150 words, with a clear decision, supporting figures for each option and concrete next steps. It is readable and ready for the committee without extra interpretation.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔且以行動為本，約 150 字，決策清晰，並列出各方案的支持數字及具體下一步。內容易讀，無需額外解讀即可供委員會使用。

summary.en: Excellent submission. All decisions and figures are correct, including the Option B proportional correction to 75 tCO2e and the two ineligibility findings. Evidence is tied to the supplied tables and policy, and the handover is clear and actionable.
summary.zh: 表現優異。所有決策及數字正確，包括把選項乙按比例修正為 75 公噸，以及兩項不合資格判斷。證據緊扣提供的數據表及政策，交接清晰可行。

nextSteps.en: Add a sentence noting that actual reductions remain subject to confirmed operating hours and final vendor sign-off, and consider whether Option B could become eligible if its warranty or figures were re-verified. Otherwise the submission is complete.
nextSteps.zh: 可加一句指出實際減排仍待確認營運小時及供應商最終簽核，並思考若選項乙的保養或數字重新核實後是否可能合資格。除此之外，提交內容已完整。

title.en: Compare carbon options for Neighbourhood Green Fair materials
title.zh: 比較鄰里綠色市集材料減排方案

brief.en: You are a sustainability analyst at a fictional property management team. We are planning a community event, Neighbourhood Green Fair, at Harbourview Community Hall. Four material options for signage and booths are proposed. Calculate the bounded baseline event material emissions, apply eligibility rules including the minimum 3-year reuse guarantee and hard budget of HKD 120,000, and select the option with the greatest eligible emissions reduction within budget. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. All data and policies are fictional for this simulation. This simulation is inspired by Swire Properties' public sustainability values but is not endorsed by Swire Properties.
brief.zh: 你是一間虛構物業管理團隊的可持續發展分析師。我們正計劃在河畔社區中心舉辦社區活動「鄰里綠色市集」。現有四個標牌及攤位材料方案。請計算限定範圍的活動材料基準排放，應用合資格規則，包括至少 3 年重用保證及 120,000 港元硬性預算，並在預算內選擇合資格最高減排方案。請以英文或繁體中文撰寫一份簡潔且基於證據的交接說明，約 100 至 180 字。所有數據及政策均為此模擬的虛構內容。此模擬受太古地產公開可持續發展價值啟發，但未獲太古地產認可。

title.en: Neighbourhood Green Fair material baseline and option data
title.zh: 鄰里綠色市集材料基準及方案數據

body.en: Baseline event material emissions for Harbourview Community Hall's Neighbourhood Green Fair are 6,200 kgCO2e, covering signage and booth materials only. It excludes transport, energy and waste. Hard budget: HKD 120,000. Option A costs HKD 112,000, reduces 2,800 kgCO2e, verified 5-year reuse guarantee. Option B costs HKD 95,000, claims 3,600 kgCO2e reduction assuming 80% recycling, verified 2-year reuse guarantee. Option C costs HKD 125,000, reduces 3,200 kgCO2e, verified 4-year reuse guarantee. Option D costs HKD 118,000, reduces 2,400 kgCO2e, verified 3-year reuse guarantee.
body.zh: 河畔社區中心鄰里綠色市集的基準活動材料排放為 6,200 千克二氧化碳當量，僅涵蓋標牌及攤位材料。不包括運輸、能源及廢物。硬性預算：120,000 港元。選項甲成本 112,000 港元，減排 2,800 千克二氧化碳當量，已核實 5 年重用保證。選項乙成本 95,000 港元，報稱減排 3,600 千克二氧化碳當量，假設 80% 回收率，已核實 2 年重用保證。選項丙成本 125,000 港元，減排 3,200 千克二氧化碳當量，已核實 4 年重用保證。選項丁成本 118,000 港元，減排 2,400 千克二氧化碳當量，已核實 3 年重用保證。

title.en: Community event material eligibility and verification policy
title.zh: 社區活動材料合資格及核實政策

body.en: All options must stay within the hard budget of HKD 120,000. Options must provide a minimum 3-year reuse guarantee. Options with quoted savings based on assumptions different from verified event conditions must be adjusted proportionally. For Option B, the verified recycling rate is 45% not 80%. Only corrected emissions reductions count. The selected option must provide the greatest corrected eligible reduction. Independent measurement and verification is required after the event. All quoted figures are subject to confirmation.
body.zh: 所有選項必須控制在 120,000 港元硬性預算內。選項必須提供至少 3 年重用保證。若報稱節省量所基於的假設與核實活動條件不同，必須按比例調整。選項乙的核實回收率為 45%，而非 80%。只有經修正的減排量才可用於選擇。獲選選項必須提供最大的經修正合資格減排量。活動後須進行獨立測量與驗證。所有報稱數字均須確認。

body.en: Please review the four material options for the Neighbourhood Green Fair at Harbourview Community Hall. We need a clear recommendation for the next sustainability committee meeting. Focus on the corrected emissions reductions, the hard budget, and the reuse guarantee requirements. Do not assume any additional contingency or approval costs. All figures are fictional for this simulation. Prepare a short handover with your calculations, decision, and proposed verification steps.
body.zh: 請審閱河畔社區中心鄰里綠色市集的四個材料方案。我們需要為下一次可持續發展委員會會議提供明確建議。重點關注經修正的減排量、硬性預算及重用保證要求。不要假設任何額外應急費用或審批成本。所有數字均為此模擬的虛構數據。請準備一份簡短交接，包含你的計算、決定及建議核實步驟。

label.en: Which option should be selected for implementation?
Which statements are correct based on the data and policy?
label.zh: 根據數據及政策，哪些陳述正確？

label.en: Option C is ineligible because its cost exceeds the hard budget.
label.zh: 選項丙成本超出硬性預算，因此不合資格。

label.en: Option B is ineligible because it does not meet the minimum 3-year reuse guarantee.
label.zh: 選項乙因未符合至少 3 年重用保證，因此不合資格。

label.en: Option A provides the greatest corrected eligible reduction within the budget.
label.zh: 選項甲在預算內提供最大的經修正合資格減排量。

label.en: Option D provides the greatest corrected eligible reduction within the budget.
label.zh: 選項丁在預算內提供最大的經修正合資格減排量。

label.en: What is the baseline event material emissions in kgCO2e?
label.zh: 基準活動材料排放為多少千克二氧化碳當量？

label.en: What is the corrected emissions reduction for Option B in kgCO2e?
label.zh: 選項乙的經修正減排量為多少千克二氧化碳當量？

starter.en:
Evidence:
Decision and calculations:
Risks and uncertainty:
Next steps:
starter.zh:
證據：
決策與計算：
風險與不確定性：
下一步：

about.en: Swire Properties publicly describes a Sustainable Development 2050 strategy covering Places, People, Partners, Planet and Performance.
about.zh: 太古地產公開介紹其 2050 可持續發展策略，涵蓋社區、人才、夥伴、環境及績效。

simulationStyle.en: Compare fictional sustainability improvements and coordinate event or information-project dependencies, budgets and scope changes. Synthetic figures and plans do not represent company results or real property operations.
simulationStyle.zh: 比較虛構可持續發展改善方案，並協調活動或資訊項目的相依工作、預算及範圍改動。合成數字及計劃並不代表公司成果或真實物業營運。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Calculate bounded baseline and reductions and select the greatest eligible reduction within a hard budget.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。計算限定範圍的基準及減排量，並在硬性預算內選擇合資格最高減排方案。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Calculate bounded baseline and reductions and select the greatest eligible reduction within a hard budget.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。計算限定範圍的基準及減排量，並在硬性預算內選擇合資格最高減排方案。

expectedEvidence.en: Selects Option A. Baseline = 6,200 kgCO2e. Option A reduction = 2,800 kgCO2e. Option B quoted reduction = 3,600 kgCO2e, corrected to 2,025 kgCO2e because verified recycling rate is 45% (3,600 * 45/80 = 2,025). Option B is ineligible due to 2-year reuse guarantee, below minimum 3 years. Option C cost HKD 125,000 exceeds budget HKD 120,000, so ineligible. Option D is eligible (cost HKD 118,000, 3-year guarantee) but reduction 2,400 kgCO2e is less than Option A's 2,800. Thus Option A has greatest eligible reduction within budget.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選擇選項甲。基準 = 6,200 千克二氧化碳當量。選項甲減排 = 2,800 千克二氧化碳當量。選項乙報稱減排 = 3,600 千克二氧化碳當量，因核實回收率為 45%，經修正為 2,025 千克二氧化碳當量（3,600 * 45/80 = 2,025）。選項乙因 2 年重用保證，低於最低 3 年要求，因此不合資格。選項丙成本 125,000 港元超出 120,000 港元預算，因此不合資格。選項丁合資格（成本 118,000 港元，3 年保證），但減排 2,400 千克二氧化碳當量低於選項甲的 2,800。因此選項甲在預算內提供最大的合資格減排量。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: References the data document for baseline and option figures, the policy document for budget limit, guarantee rule, and adjustment rule, and the manager message for scope. Explains calculation: Option B corrected reduction = 3,600 * 45/80 = 2,025 kgCO2e. Compares Option A 2,800 vs Option B 2,025 vs Option D 2,400, selects A. Notes Option B fails guarantee and Option C fails budget.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用數據文件中的基準及選項數字，政策文件中的預算上限、保證規則及調整規則，以及主管訊息中的範圍。解釋計算：選項乙經修正減排 = 3,600 * 45/80 = 2,025 千克二氧化碳當量。比較選項甲 2,800、選項乙 2,025、選項丁 2,400，選擇甲。註明選項乙不符合保證，選項丙超出預算。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes independent measurement and verification after event, checks actual recycling rate, confirms material costs and reuse guarantees (e.g., 5-year for Option A), and validates emissions reduction against baseline.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議活動後進行獨立測量與驗證，檢查實際回收率，確認材料成本及重用保證（例如選項甲的 5 年保證），並對照基準驗證減排量。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that figures are synthetic and for simulation only. Notes that baseline is bounded to materials only and excludes other event emissions. States that reductions are based on provided assumptions and require confirmation.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認數字為合成且僅供模擬。指出基準僅限於材料，不包括其他活動排放。說明減排量基於提供假設，需要確認。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover with clear decision, calculations, evidence references, and next steps. Includes recommendation for Option A and notes verification actions.
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接，包含明確決策、計算、證據引用及下一步。包括推薦選項甲及註明核實行動。

exemplar.en: Evidence: The material data gives a bounded baseline of 6,200 kgCO2e for event materials only. Option A costs HKD 112,000, reduces 2,800 kgCO2e, and has a verified 5-year reuse guarantee. Option B costs HKD 95,000 and claims 3,600 kgCO2e reduction based on an 80% recycling rate. The policy states the verified recycling rate is 45%, so corrected reduction is 3,600 * 45/80 = 2,025 kgCO2e. Option B also has only a 2-year reuse guarantee, below the required minimum of 3 years, so it is ineligible. Option C costs HKD 125,000, exceeding the HKD 120,000 hard budget, so it is ineligible. Option D costs HKD 118,000, reduces 2,400 kgCO2e, and has a 3-year guarantee, so it is eligible but lower reduction. Decision: Select Option A because it provides the greatest eligible reduction within budget (2,800 kgCO2e). Risks: All figures are synthetic and subject to confirmation. The baseline excludes transport and energy. Next steps: Obtain independent measurement and verification after the event, confirm actual recycling rate, and check the 5-year reuse guarantee for Option A.
exemplar.zh: 證據：數據文件提供僅限活動材料的限定基準 6,200 千克二氧化碳當量。選項甲成本 112,000 港元，減排 2,800 千克二氧化碳當量，並有已核實 5 年重用保證。選項乙成本 95,000 港元，報稱減排 3,600 千克二氧化碳當量，基於 80% 回收率。政策列明核實回收率為 45%，故經修正減排為 3,600 * 45/80 = 2,025 千克二氧化碳當量。選項乙亦只有 2 年重用保證，低於最低 3 年要求，因此不合資格。選項丙成本 125,000 港元，超出 120,000 港元硬性預算，因此不合資格。選項丁成本 118,000 港元，減排 2,400 千克二氧化碳當量，並有 3 年保證，因此合資格但減排較低。決策：選擇選項甲，因其在預算內提供最大的合資格減排量（2,800 千克二氧化碳當量）。風險：所有數字均為合成，須待確認。基準不包括運輸及能源。下一步：活動後進行獨立測量與驗證，確認實際回收率，並檢查選項甲的 5 年重用保證。

feedback.en: All four field answers are correct: Option A, statements C-ineligible, B-ineligible-guarantee and A-greatest, baseline 6,200 kgCO2e and corrected Option B 2,025 kgCO2e (3,600 x 45/80). Your written text applies the hard HKD 120,000 budget, the corrected recycling assumption and the 3-year reuse guarantee correctly when selecting Option A.
feedback.zh: 四個欄位答案全部正確：選項甲、丙不合資格、乙不符保證、甲為最高減排，基準 6,200 千克二氧化碳當量，乙經修正為 2,025 千克二氧化碳當量（3,600 x 45/80）。你的文字正確應用 120,000 港元硬性預算、修正回收率假設及 3 年重用保證來選擇選項甲。

feedback.en: You link each decision to the material data, the policy rule on the 45% verified recycling rate, and the budget and guarantee thresholds, and you show the adjustment arithmetic explicitly. The comparison of A at 2,800 against B at 2,025 and D at 2,400 is clear and traceable.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決定連繫至材料數據、政策中 45% 核實回收率的規則，以及預算和保證門檻，並明確展示調整運算。甲 2,800 與乙 2,025、丁 2,400 的比較清晰可追溯。

feedback.en: Your next steps cover independent measurement and verification after the event, confirming the actual recycling rate and checking the 5-year reuse guarantee for Option A. To strengthen this, consider adding confirmation of the quoted HKD 112,000 cost and a named owner for the committee follow-up.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步涵蓋活動後獨立測量與驗證、確認實際回收率，以及檢查選項甲的 5 年重用保證。可再補充確認 112,000 港元報價成本，以及為委員會跟進指定負責人。

feedback.en: You correctly state that the figures are synthetic and subject to confirmation, and that the baseline covers materials only and excludes transport and energy. This keeps claims within the supplied fictional scope.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出數字為合成且須待確認，並說明基準僅涵蓋材料，不包括運輸及能源，使聲明維持在提供的虛構範圍內。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and structured with evidence, decision, risks and next steps, and the 184-word length is acceptable for this guidance range. It reads as an actionable note for the sustainability committee.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔且具結構，包含證據、決策、風險及下一步，184 字長度在此指引範圍內可接受，可作為提交可持續發展委員會的行動說明。

summary.en: Strong submission. All calculations, eligibility rules and the Option A selection are accurate, and the handover is well evidenced and scoped to the fictional simulation. No material errors were found across the rubric criteria.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。所有計算、合資格規則及選項甲的選擇均準確，交接具充分證據並限定於虛構模擬範圍。各評分準則均未發現實質錯誤。

nextSteps.en: Before the committee, add the quoted cost confirmation and a named owner for the post-event verification, and note that final figures depend on independent measurement. Keep the current calculation format as it makes the reasoning easy to audit.
nextSteps.zh: 在提交委員會前，補充報價成本確認及活動後核實的指定負責人，並註明最終數字取決於獨立測量。保留現有計算格式，因其推理易於審核。

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Swire Properties, not endorsed by it. You are a sustainability analyst at Harbour East Place. A draft tenant waste claim states an 18% building-wide Q1 2026 diversion result. The collection log has incomplete floor records. Reconcile the figures, choose one Q2 plan under the HKD 220,000 hard budget by maximum net monthly diversion, and edit the claim to reflect scope and uncertainty. Submit a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. All records are fictional.
brief.zh: 此為受太古地產啟發的虛構學習模擬，並未獲其認可。你是海港東廣場的可持續發展分析師。草擬租戶廢物聲明指 2026 年第一季全樓轉移率為 18%。收集記錄中有樓層記錄不完整。請核對數字，按每月最高淨轉移量在港幣 220,000 元硬性預算內選擇一個第二季計劃，並修改聲明以反映範圍及不確定性。以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔且基於證據的交接。所有記錄均為虛構。

title.en: Fictional waste claim review rules: Harbour East Place pilot
title.zh: 虛構廢物聲明審核規則：海港東廣場試行計劃

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. For Q1 2026 tenant waste review, baseline is total disposed tenant waste from floors with at least 4 valid collection records in the month. Any floor with fewer than 4 valid records is excluded from baseline and diversion claims. Diversion rate equals recycled or composted tonnes divided by recycled or composted tonnes plus disposed tonnes. A building-wide claim needs complete records for every occupied floor. A savings claim is allowed only when measured reduction is at least 5% against the stated baseline. Hard budget for Q2 2026 pilot is HKD 220,000. Plan costs and net monthly diversion are in the Q2 plan table.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。就 2026 年第一季租戶廢物審核而言，基準為當月有至少 4 份有效收集記錄的樓層所產生的總棄置租戶廢物。任何少於 4 份有效記錄的樓層會從基準及轉移聲明中剔除。轉移率等於回收或堆肥公噸除以回收或堆肥公噸加棄置公噸。全樓聲明須涵蓋所有已佔用樓層的完整記錄。節省聲明僅在計量減幅達所述基準至少 5% 時才允許。2026 年第二季試行計劃的硬性預算為港幣 220,000 元。計劃成本及每月淨轉移量載於第二季計劃表。

title.en: Fictional Q1 2026 tenant waste log and Q2 plan table
title.zh: 虛構 2026 年第一季租戶廢物記錄及第二季計劃表

body.en:
Fictional Q1 2026 tenant waste log. Tonnes per month by floor:
Floor 10: recycled 1.4, disposed 5.6, valid records 4 of 4.
Floor 12: recycled 0.8, disposed 4.2, valid records 3 of 4.
Floor 14: recycled 1.1, disposed 3.9, valid records 4 of 4.
Floor 16: recycled 0.5, disposed 2.1, valid records 2 of 4.
Floor 18: recycled 0.9, disposed 3.3, valid records 4 of 4.
Q2 plans: Plan A cost HKD 150,000 and net monthly diverted 1.2 tonnes. Plan B cost HKD 210,000 and net monthly diverted 2.0 tonnes. Plan C cost HKD 320,000 and net monthly diverted 3.5 tonnes.
body.zh:
虛構 2026 年第一季租戶廢物記錄。各樓層每月公噸：
10 樓：回收 1.4，棄置 5.6，有效記錄 4 份中 4 份。
12 樓：回收 0.8，棄置 4.2，有效記錄 4 份中 3 份。
14 樓：回收 1.1，棄置 3.9，有效記錄 4 份中 4 份。
16 樓：回收 0.5，棄置 2.1，有效記錄 4 份中 2 份。
18 樓：回收 0.9，棄置 3.3，有效記錄 4 份中 4 份。
第二季計劃：計劃 A 成本港幣 150,000 元，每月淨轉移 1.2 公噸。計劃 B 成本港幣 210,000 元，每月淨轉移 2.0 公噸。計劃 C 成本港幣 320,000 元，每月淨轉移 3.5 公噸。

title.en: Fictional manager message on draft claim
title.zh: 虛構主管關於草擬聲明的訊息

body.en: Fictional manager message. From Ada Cheng, sustainability team lead. Please review our draft claim: "The tenant sorting pilot diverted 18% of all waste from Harbour East Place in Q1 2026 and cut disposal by 20%." Use the Q1 log and the review rules. Recommend one Q2 plan under the hard budget. The final handover must state scope, calculation method, missing evidence and next checks. Do not present these synthetic figures as Swire Properties results. Write in English or Traditional Chinese.
body.zh: 虛構主管訊息。可持續發展團隊主管 Ada Cheng。請審閱我們的草擬聲明：「租戶分類試行計劃於 2026 年第一季把海港東廣場所有廢物的 18% 轉移，並減少棄置 20%。」使用第一季記錄及審核規則。在硬性預算內推薦一個第二季計劃。最終交接須列明範圍、計算方法、缺失證據及下一步檢查。不得把這些合成數字表述為太古地產的成果。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫。

label.en: Which Q2 plan should be recommended?
label.zh: 應推薦哪個第二季計劃？

label.en: Plan A tenant sorting campaign, HKD 150,000, 1.2 tonnes per month.
label.zh: 計劃 A 租戶分類活動，港幣 150,000 元，每月 1.2 公噸。

label.en: Plan B smart compactor sensors, HKD 210,000, 2.0 tonnes per month.
label.zh: 計劃 B 智能壓縮機感應器，港幣 210,000 元，每月 2.0 公噸。

label.en: Plan C on-site food waste processor, HKD 320,000, 3.5 tonnes per month.
label.zh: 計劃 C 現場廚餘處理器，港幣 320,000 元，每月 3.5 公噸。

label.en: No plan because Q1 records are incomplete.
label.zh: 不推薦任何計劃，因第一季記錄不完整。

label.en: Which statements about the Q1 2026 tenant waste data are correct? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 以下哪些關於 2026 年第一季租戶廢物數據的陳述正確？選出所有適用者。

label.en: Floor 12 has 3 valid records of 4 and is excluded from the baseline.
label.zh: 12 樓有 4 份中 3 份有效記錄，並從基準中剔除。

label.en: Floor 16 has 2 valid records of 4 and is excluded from the baseline.
label.zh: 16 樓有 4 份中 2 份有效記錄，並從基準中剔除。

label.en: Complete floors show 3.4 tonnes recycled against 12.8 tonnes disposed.
label.zh: 完整記錄樓層顯示回收 3.4 公噸，棄置 12.8 公噸。

label.en: The draft 18% building-wide diversion claim is fully supported.
label.zh: 草擬的 18% 全樓轉移聲明獲完全支持。

label.en: All five floors have complete collection records.
label.zh: 全部五個樓層均有完整收集記錄。

label.en: What is the Q1 2026 diversion rate for floors with complete records only? Enter percent to one decimal place.
label.zh: 2026 年第一季僅計完整記錄樓層的轉移率是多少？輸入百分比至一位小數。

label.en: What is the maximum net monthly waste diverted from landfill under the HKD 220,000 hard budget? Enter tonnes per month to one decimal place.
label.zh: 在港幣 220,000 元硬性預算下，每月從堆填區轉移的最大淨廢物量是多少？輸入每月公噸至一位小數。

label.en: Which edited claim best reflects the supplied evidence and uncertainty?
label.zh: 哪項修改後的聲明最能反映所提供證據及不確定性？

label.en: The tenant sorting pilot diverted 18% of all building waste in Q1 2026.
label.zh: 租戶分類試行計劃於 2026 年第一季把全樓廢物的 18% 轉移。

label.en: Across three floors with complete Q1 2026 records, 3.4 tonnes were recycled against 12.8 tonnes disposed, a 21.0% diversion rate. Two floors are excluded because records are incomplete, so this is not a building-wide result.
label.zh: 在三個 2026 年第一季有完整記錄的樓層中，回收 3.4 公噸，棄置 12.8 公噸，轉移率為 21.0%。兩個樓層因記錄不完整而剔除，因此這不是全樓結果。

label.en: The pilot cut disposal by 20% at Harbour East Place, proving a building-wide reduction.
label.zh: 試行計劃在海港東廣場減少棄置 20%，證明全樓減幅。

label.en: The pilot diverted 21.0% of all waste and all floors had complete records.
label.zh: 試行計劃把所有廢物的 21.0% 轉移，且所有樓層均有完整記錄。

about.en: Swire Properties publicly describes a Sustainable Development 2050 strategy covering Places, People, Partners, Planet and Performance.
about.zh: 太古地產公開介紹其 2050 可持續發展策略，涵蓋社區、人才、夥伴、環境及績效。

simulationStyle.en: Compare fictional building or event improvements with explicit budgets and limited emissions boundaries. Do not portray synthetic figures as a company sustainability result.
simulationStyle.zh: 在明確預算及有限排放範圍內比較虛構樓宇或活動改善方案，不把合成數字當作公司可持續發展成果。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Reconcile resource figures and edit an unsupported sustainability claim to reflect scope and uncertainty.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。核對資源數據，並修改無依據的可持續發展聲明以反映範圍及不確定性。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Reconcile resource figures and edit an unsupported sustainability claim to reflect scope and uncertainty.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。核對資源數據，並修改無依據的可持續發展聲明以反映範圍及不確定性。

expectedEvidence.en: Selects Plan B. Calculates complete-floor diversion as 3.4 divided by 16.2 equals 21.0%. Identifies Floor 12 and Floor 16 as excluded because each has fewer than 4 valid records. Edits the claim to the three complete-floor scope.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選擇計劃 B。計算完整記錄樓層轉移率為 3.4 除以 16.2 等於 21.0%。指出 12 樓及 16 樓因各少於 4 份有效記錄而剔除。把聲明修改為三個完整記錄樓層的範圍。

description.en: Connects the decisions to specific supplied records and explains the calculation or reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋計算或推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites Q1 log floors 10, 14 and 18 as complete. Uses policy rule that baseline excludes floors with fewer than 4 valid records. Distinguishes 3.4 tonnes recycled from 12.8 tonnes disposed. Explains Plan C exceeds HKD 220,000 and Plan A diverts less than Plan B.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用第一季記錄的 10、14、18 樓為完整。使用政策規則，基準剔除少於 4 份有效記錄的樓層。區分回收 3.4 公噸與棄置 12.8 公噸。解釋計劃 C 超出港幣 220,000 元，計劃 A 轉移量低於計劃 B。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and useful next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及有用下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes obtaining missing records for floors 12 and 16, checking collection tickets or meter logs, recalculating after complete data, confirming Plan B invoice stays within budget, and asking the waste contractor to validate totals.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出取得 12 樓及 16 樓缺失記錄、檢查收集單據或計量記錄、在完整數據後重新計算、確認計劃 B 發票不超預算，以及要求廢物承辦商核實總數。

description.en: Acknowledges relevant missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and supplied assumptions.
description.zh: 承認相關欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及提供假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States the result is limited to three complete floors at fictional Harbour East Place in Q1 2026. Notes missing records and unverified figures. Avoids claiming a building-wide or Swire Properties result.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明結果僅限於虛構海港東廣場 2026 年第一季三個完整記錄樓層。指出缺失記錄及未核實數字。避免聲稱全樓或太古地產成果。

description.en: Writes a concise, actionable handover with decisions, evidence, ownership or escalation where relevant.
description.zh: 撰寫簡潔可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用負責人或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover with decision Plan B, calculation method, scope limit, missing evidence, and next owner or check. About 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese is acceptable, not a strict count.
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接列明選擇計劃 B、計算方法、範圍限制、缺失證據及下一步負責人或檢查。約 100 至 180 英文字或相若香港繁體中文為可接受，並非嚴格字數限制。

exemplar.en: Decision. Recommend Plan B smart compactor sensors. It costs HKD 210,000, within the HKD 220,000 hard budget, and diverts 2.0 tonnes per month, higher than Plan A at 1.2 tonnes. Plan C is excluded at HKD 320,000. Q1 claim check. Floors 10, 14 and 18 have complete records. Floors 12 and 16 do not meet the 4-valid-record rule and are excluded. Complete-floor recycled total is 3.4 tonnes and disposed total is 12.8 tonnes. Diversion rate is 3.4 divided by 16.2, which equals 21.0%. Proposed claim. Across three floors with complete Q1 2026 records, 3.4 tonnes were recycled against 12.8 tonnes disposed, a 21.0% diversion rate. Two floors are excluded because records are incomplete, so this is not a building-wide result. Next steps. Obtain missing floor records, verify collection tickets, confirm Plan B invoice, and ask the waste contractor to validate figures. This is a fictional simulation and not a Swire Properties result.
exemplar.zh: 決策。建議計劃 B 智能壓縮機感應器。成本港幣 210,000 元，在港幣 220,000 元硬性預算之內，每月轉移 2.0 公噸，高於計劃 A 的 1.2 公噸。計劃 C 因港幣 320,000 元而剔除。第一季聲明核對。10、14、18 樓有完整記錄。12 樓及 16 樓不符合 4 份有效記錄規則，須剔除。完整記錄樓層回收總數 3.4 公噸，棄置總數 12.8 公噸。轉移率為 3.4 除以 16.2，等於 21.0%。建議聲明。在三個 2026 年第一季有完整記錄的樓層中，回收 3.4 公噸，棄置 12.8 公噸，轉移率為 21.0%。兩個樓層因記錄不完整而剔除，因此這不是全樓結果。下一步。取得缺失樓層記錄、核實收集單據、確認計劃 B 發票，並要求廢物承辦商核實數字。此為虛構模擬，並非太古地產成果。

feedback.en: All five answers are correct: Plan B, the two excluded floors plus the 3.4/12.8 split, 21.0% diversion and 2.0 tonnes per month, and claim-b. Your written work also shows the 3.4 divided by 16.2 method and the HKD 320,000 exclusion for Plan C.
feedback.zh: 五項答案全部正確：計劃 B、兩個剔除樓層及 3.4／12.8 的分項、21.0% 轉移率與每月 2.0 公噸，以及聲明 B。你的書面內容亦展示 3.4 除以 16.2 的計算方法，以及計劃 C 因港幣 320,000 元被剔除。

feedback.en: You cite floors 10, 14 and 18 as complete, apply the 4-valid-record rule to exclude floors 12 and 16, and separate 3.4 tonnes recycled from 12.8 tonnes disposed. Plan B is justified against Plan A on diversion and against Plan C on budget.
feedback.zh: 你引用 10、14、18 樓為完整記錄，套用 4 份有效記錄規則剔除 12 樓及 16 樓，並區分回收 3.4 公噸與棄置 12.8 公噸。計劃 B 亦分別以轉移量及預算理由對比計劃 A 及計劃 C。

feedback.en: Your next steps cover missing floor records, collection ticket verification, Plan B invoice confirmation and contractor validation, which directly test the claim. Assign a named owner and a target date for each check to make the follow-up actionable.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步涵蓋缺失樓層記錄、收集單據核實、計劃 B 發票確認及承辦商核實，直接檢驗該聲明。為每項檢查指定負責人及目標日期會令跟進更可行。

feedback.en: You clearly limit the figure to three complete floors in Q1 2026, state that it is not a building-wide result, and note the synthetic simulation status rather than a Swire Properties result. That matches the required scope discipline.
feedback.zh: 你清楚把數字限於 2026 年第一季三個完整記錄樓層，說明這不是全樓結果，並指出屬虛構模擬而非太古地產成果，符合所需的範圍紀律。

feedback.en: At 165 English words the handover is concise and well structured across decision, claim check, proposed claim and next steps. Adding an owner or escalation name would complete the handover template.
feedback.zh: 全篇 165 個英文字，交接簡潔並按決策、聲明核對、建議聲明及下一步分段。若補上負責人或轉交對象姓名，交接便更完整。

summary.en: Excellent submission. Every structured answer is correct and your narrative shows the reconciliation method, the exclusion rule, the budget reasoning and the scope limits without overclaiming. Only ownership of the follow-up checks is missing.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。所有結構化答案正確，敘述亦展示核對方法、剔除規則、預算推理及範圍限制，沒有誇大聲明。唯一缺漏是跟進檢查的負責人。

nextSteps.en: Add a named owner and due date to each of the four verification checks, then issue the edited claim for manager approval. Keep the fictional-simulation note on any external version.
nextSteps.zh: 為四項核實檢查各加上負責人姓名及到期日，然後把修改後聲明交主管審批。任何對外版本均須保留虛構模擬的註明。

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Swire Properties, not endorsed by it. You are a sustainability analyst at Riverside Tower. A draft water savings claim states 15% savings for Q1 2026 compared to Q4 2025 baseline. The baseline data has only 72 valid meter readings out of 90 days, below the 85-reading policy threshold. Reconcile the figures, recommend one Q3 2026 plan under the HKD 180,000 hard budget by maximum net monthly water saved, and edit the claim to reflect scope and uncertainty. Submit a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. All records are fictional.
brief.zh: 受太古地產啟發的虛構學習模擬，並未獲其認可。你是 Riverside Tower 的可持續發展分析師。草擬水資源節省聲明指 2026 年第一季相比 2025 年第四季基準節省 15%。基準數據在 90 天中僅有 72 份有效水錶讀數，低於 85 份讀數的政策門檻。請核對數字，按每月最高淨節水量在港幣 180,000 元硬性預算內推薦一個 2026 年第三季計劃，並修改聲明以反映範圍及不確定性。以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔且基於證據的交接。所有記錄均為虛構。

title.en: Fictional water savings claim review rules: Riverside Tower pilot
title.zh: 虛構水資源節省聲明審核規則：Riverside Tower 試行計劃

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. Baseline validity requires at least 85 valid meter readings out of 90 days. If the baseline is invalid, no savings percentage may be claimed. Average daily consumption equals total consumption divided by number of valid readings. Savings percentage equals baseline average daily consumption minus reporting period average daily consumption, divided by baseline average daily consumption. A building-wide claim requires valid meter data for every occupied floor. Hard budget for Q3 2026 water efficiency pilot is HKD 180,000. Plan costs and net monthly water savings are in the plan table. A savings claim is allowed only if reduction is at least 5% against a valid baseline.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。基準有效性要求在 90 天中有至少 85 份有效水錶讀數。若基準無效，不得聲稱任何節省百分比。平均每日用水量等於總用水量除以有效讀數數目。節省百分比等於基準平均每日用水量減報告期平均每日用水量，再除以基準平均每日用水量。全樓聲明須涵蓋所有已佔用樓層的有效水錶數據。2026 年第三季水資源效率試行計劃的硬性預算為港幣 180,000 元。計劃成本及每月淨節水量載於計劃表。節省聲明僅在計量減幅達有效基準至少 5% 時才允許。

title.en: Fictional water meter data and Q3 plan table
title.zh: 虛構水錶數據及第三季計劃表

body.en: Fictional water meter data. Baseline period: 1 Oct to 31 Dec 2025. Total consumption 4,500,000 liters. Valid meter readings: 72 of 90 days. Reporting period: 1 Jan to 31 Mar 2026. Total consumption 3,800,000 liters. Valid meter readings: 88 of 90 days. Floor 5 missing 12 days in baseline. Floor 9 missing 6 days in baseline. All other floors complete. Q3 2026 plans: Plan A cost HKD 120,000, net monthly water saved 1,200,000 liters. Plan B cost HKD 160,000, net monthly water saved 2,000,000 liters. Plan C cost HKD 220,000, net monthly water saved 2,800,000 liters.
body.zh: 虛構水錶數據。基準期：2025 年 10 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日。總用水量 4,500,000 公升。有效水錶讀數：90 天中 72 份。報告期：2026 年 1 月 1 日至 3 月 31 日。總用水量 3,800,000 公升。有效水錶讀數：90 天中 88 份。基準期內 5 樓缺 12 天，9 樓缺 6 天。其他樓層完整。2026 年第三季計劃：計劃 A 成本港幣 120,000 元，每月淨節水 1,200,000 公升。計劃 B 成本港幣 160,000 元，每月淨節水 2,000,000 公升。計劃 C 成本港幣 220,000 元，每月淨節水 2,800,000 公升。

title.en: Fictional manager message on draft claim
title.zh: 虛構主管關於草擬聲明的訊息

body.en: Fictional manager message. From Michelle Wong, sustainability team lead. Please review our draft claim: "Riverside Tower achieved 15% water savings in Q1 2026 compared to Q4 2025 baseline." Use the water data and review rules. Recommend one Q3 plan under the hard budget. Final handover must state scope, calculation method, missing evidence and next checks. Do not present synthetic figures as Swire Properties results. Write in English or Traditional Chinese.
body.zh: 虛構主管訊息。可持續發展團隊主管 Michelle Wong。請審閱我們的草擬聲明：「Riverside Tower 於 2026 年第一季相比 2025 年第四季基準節省 15% 水資源。」使用水錶數據及審核規則。在硬性預算內推薦一個第三季計劃。最終交接須列明範圍、計算方法、缺失證據及下一步檢查。不得把合成數字表述為太古地產的成果。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫。

label.en: Which Q3 2026 plan should be recommended under the HKD 180,000 hard budget by maximum net monthly water saved?
label.zh: 在港幣 180,000 元硬性預算下，按每月最高淨節水量應推薦哪個 2026 年第三季計劃？

label.en: Plan A: cost HKD 120,000, net monthly water saved 1,200,000 liters.
label.zh: 計劃 A：成本港幣 120,000 元，每月淨節水 1,200,000 公升。

label.en: Plan B: cost HKD 160,000, net monthly water saved 2,000,000 liters.
label.zh: 計劃 B：成本港幣 160,000 元，每月淨節水 2,000,000 公升。

label.en: Plan C: cost HKD 220,000, net monthly water saved 2,800,000 liters.
label.zh: 計劃 C：成本港幣 220,000 元，每月淨節水 2,800,000 公升。

label.en: No plan because baseline is invalid.
label.zh: 不推薦任何計劃，因基準無效。

label.en: Which statements about the supplied water data are correct? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 以下哪些關於所提供水錶數據的陳述正確？選出所有適用者。

label.en: The baseline has 72 valid readings, below the 85-reading threshold, so the baseline is invalid.
label.zh: 基準有 72 份有效讀數，低於 85 份門檻，故基準無效。

label.en: The reporting period has 88 valid readings, meeting the 85-reading threshold.
label.zh: 報告期有 88 份有效讀數，符合 85 份門檻。

label.en: The draft 15% savings claim is fully supported by the data.
label.zh: 草擬的 15% 節省聲明獲數據完全支持。

label.en: Floor 5 and Floor 9 have incomplete baseline meter data.
label.zh: 5 樓及 9 樓的基準水錶數據不完整。

label.en: All floors have complete meter data for both periods.
label.zh: 所有樓層在兩個時期均有完整水錶數據。

label.en: What is the baseline average daily water consumption based on the 72 valid readings? Enter liters per day.
label.zh: 根據 72 份有效讀數，基準平均每日用水量是多少？輸入每日公升。

label.en: What is the maximum net monthly water savings under the HKD 180,000 hard budget? Enter liters per month.
label.zh: 在港幣 180,000 元硬性預算下，每月最大淨節水量是多少？輸入每月公升。

label.en: Which edited claim best reflects the supplied evidence and uncertainty?
label.zh: 哪項修改後的聲明最能反映所提供證據及不確定性？

label.en: Riverside Tower achieved 15% water savings in Q1 2026 compared to Q4 2025 baseline.
label.zh: Riverside Tower 於 2026 年第一季相比 2025 年第四季基準節省 15% 水資源。

label.en: The Q4 2025 baseline is invalid because it has only 72 valid meter readings, below the required 85. Therefore no savings percentage can be claimed. Based on engineering estimates, Plan B can save 2,000,000 liters per month under the HKD 180,000 budget.
label.zh: 2025 年第四季基準無效，因僅有 72 份有效水錶讀數，低於要求的 85 份。因此不得聲稱任何節省百分比。根據工程估算，計劃 B 可在港幣 180,000 元預算內每月節省 2,000,000 公升。

label.en: Riverside Tower achieved 30.9% water savings in Q1 2026, exceeding the 5% threshold.
label.zh: Riverside Tower 於 2026 年第一季節省 30.9% 水資源，超過 5% 門檻。

label.en: The water efficiency pilot saved 15% and all floors had complete data.
label.zh: 水資源效率試行計劃節省 15%，且所有樓層均有完整數據。

about.en: Swire Properties publicly describes a Sustainable Development 2050 strategy covering Places, People, Partners, Planet and Performance.
